rows.original: Are you ready to take back the centaur village? Once you start, you doubt there will be much time for rest.
rows.translation: 你准备好夺回半人马村庄了吗？一旦开始行动，你就不会再有太多时间休息了。
rows.raw: "\n    Are you ready to take back the centaur village? Once you start, you doubt there will be much time for rest."

rows.original: You need more time to get ready.
rows.translation: 你需要更多的时间来做好准备。
rows.raw: "You need more time to get ready."

rows.original:
Alright, it's time to do this. You call Ahmri over, and Atani's twin guards carry in a hefty folding table, unfurling a beautifully sewn cloth with a map of the valley embossed on its surface. New additions have clearly been added over the course of its life, with some of the oldest fraying at the edges. Atani herself totes a wicker basket full of neatly tucked clay figures. Some are of mares and others of centaurs.

        "Ok. Mom was always the one to do this kind of thing, but I might be able to help. We might be able to spare some hunters for the battle, but..." she trails off, setting out at least twice as many centaur figures as marefolk. It seems obvious what the outcome of such a direct confrontation would be. Not good.
        
        "Wait! You don't have to fight them. Just get them out of the village for a bit. Up here, err, it's all nameless mountains on this map, but if its layout is the way I think it is, then... here! There should be a lower path to the mountain caves where we pick medicinal herbs," Ahmri interjects, stretching to trace her finger along a line of mountains that looks like it hasn't been touched since the map was created. The line she follows weaves briefly through the range before exiting in the smaller hills just beyond the neck of the centaurs closed in ravine. 
        
        Fantastic. If the marefolk can distract the centaurs long enough for you to get into the village and deal with the source of the corruption there, that should restore some semblance of balance to the valley. 
        
        "Our hunters and foragers have eluded the centaurs for centuries. I'm sure one venture won't be difficult," one of the guards huffs proudly. You trust the two of them will be able to keep Ahmri and the standing chieftain safe while you're gone? Each one gets halfway through a unified nod when Ahmri pipes up.
        
        "Uh-uh, no way! You can't leave me behind here! I'm the only one who knows the paths that lead to the village rather than sheer falls or dead-end cliffs." 
        
        As much as you want her to be safe, she's right. You don't even know where the entry paths are, let alone the exits. But how does she expect you to keep her safe if things do go south?
        
        "Well you're my hero, of course I'll be safe. Besides, I can do a little magic! Miss Kavi said I have a knack! She couldn't teach me much on account of she makes potions instead of weaving spells, but I can make my symbol of Lumia glow real bright!" she gushes, concentrating on the round symbol of fertility around her neck. A warm, flickering light grows until it's as bright as any torch, but no harder to look at. You don't really see how helpful such a thing would be in a fight, but you keep that to yourself. There's no talking the snowy mare out of this, it seems.
        
        "That settles it then! I'll send word to the hunters. Especially now, the centaur warband won't be able to resist a game of high-stakes hide and seek. They can hardly keep it in their pants long enough to gather food anymore," Atani says, pumping her fists in the air as she gives an excited jump. The stress built up inside Ahmri seems completely evaporated, gone with the idea of helping her father.
rows.translation:
好了，是时候行动了。你把阿姆里叫过来，然后阿塔尼的双胞胎护卫搬来一张沉重的折叠桌，将上面铺开的布料展开——那块布料上绣着精美的图案，地图图案清晰可见。显然，在这块布料的使用过程中，有人不断地在上面添加新的内容，有些最古老的图案边缘已经开始磨损了。阿塔尼自己则提着一个柳条编成的篮子，里面装满了整齐摆放的陶土制品，有些是马的形象，有些则是半人半马的形象。

        好吧，这种事情以前总是妈妈来处理的，但这次我也许能帮上忙。我们或许可以抽调一些猎人参加这场战斗，不过……”她的话说到这里戛然而止，因为她安排的半人马数量是马人的两倍。这种直接的对抗结果显然不言而喻——不会有什么好结果。
        
        等等！你们不必与他们战斗，只要把他们暂时赶出村子就行了。在这张地图上，这些山都还没有名字，但如果我的记忆没有错的话，应该……在这里！应该有一条小路通向那些我们采药的山洞。”阿姆里边说边伸手指着地图上那片仿佛自地图绘制以来就未曾有人踏足的山脉。她所指的那条路线在山脉中蜿蜒穿行，最终在半人马群所在的峡谷之外的一些小山丘处消失了。 
        
        太好了。如果那些马人女性能够吸引半人马的注意力，让你有足够的时间进入村庄并解决那里的腐败根源，那么这个山谷应该就能恢复某种平衡了吧。

“我们的猎人和采集者们几个世纪以来一直都在躲避半人马的追击。我相信这次行动肯定不会有什么困难，”其中一名卫兵自豪地说道。你相信他们两个人能够在你离开期间保护好阿姆里以及那位现任首领吧？就在他们两人同时点头表示同意的时候，阿姆里突然插话道。
        
        不行，绝对不行！你不能把我留在这里！只有我知道通往村庄的路，那些路既不是断崖，也不是死路。”

尽管你非常希望她能平安无事，但她说得对。你甚至都不知道入口在哪里，更别提出口了。但如果真的出了什么问题，她又怎么能指望你保护她的安全呢？
        
        嗯，你可是我的英雄，我当然会安全的。而且，我还会一点魔法呢！卡维小姐说我有这个天赋！因为她擅长制作药水而不是施展法术，所以她没能教我太多，但我可以让自己的卢米亚符号发出非常明亮的光芒！”她兴奋地说道，同时注视着自己脖子上那个圆形的生育符号。那温暖而闪烁的光芒逐渐变强，最终亮得就像一支火把，但却不会让人感到刺眼。你其实不太明白这样的东西在战斗中能有什么用处，但也没敢说出来。看来，是没法说服这匹雪色的母马改变主意的了……
        
        那就这么定了！我会通知那些猎人。尤其是现在，半人马战队根本无法抵挡这种高风险的捉迷藏游戏——他们连收集食物的时间都挤不出来呢。”阿塔尼一边兴奋地跳来跳去，一边挥舞着拳头说道。啊姆里内心积压的压力似乎也随着帮助父亲的决心而烟消云散了。

rows.original:
You and Ahmri take the safest paths you can find through the valley, walking along the riverside till you reach the steep base of the mountains. Your fluffy companion scrutinizes the cliffside, letting you fall in behind her as she continues along the edge of the range. For all you know, any of these paths would lead straight to dead-ends or maze-like forgotten trails.

            Ahmri seems to know what she's looking for, picking out a nondescript cliff path from its myriad siblings and leading [party.hasCompanions|the group|you] up and into the mountain range. You walk for a deceptively short amount of time before you run into a split in the way, but the hefty centaur picks one direction and sticks to it. From that point the twists are everywhere, a sure way to get lost without a guide.
            
            The repetitive scenery breaks suddenly as you pass an opening in the cliffside, and Ahmri stops to rest. A well-beaten circle of earth provides enough ground for even a small group of centaurs to stop and rest. Through the gap in the pass, you can see the top of some of the smaller hills, dotted with springs and pools lined with drifts of snow. Along the mountain closest to you, vibrant flowers catch the light of the [dayNight|setting|rising] sun in a scintillating display. Where the sun touches the cliff, the flowers shine with fiery reds and bright oranges. In the shade their color shifts to soft blues and royal purples, seeming to banish the darkness with their glow. Wow.
            
            "We can rest here for a little bit. We're really close. I just need to catch my breath..." Ahmri huffs, plainly unused to the exertion. [party.som||[companion1.name] stretches, taking a seat on [companion1.hisHer] bedroll. |Your companions take the time to relax, chatting amongst themselves in the brief downtime. ]You take a seat next to Ahmri, offering her a skin of water that she accepts with a happy sigh. This might be the last peaceful moment you have for a while.
rows.translation:
你和阿姆里选择了山谷中最为安全的路径前行，沿着河岸行走，直到抵达山脉陡峭的山脚。你那毛茸茸的伙伴仔细地观察着悬崖峭壁，让你跟在她身后，继续沿着山脉边缘前进。谁也不知道，这些路径中哪一条会通向死路，或者是一些被遗忘的迷宫般的小径。

阿姆里似乎知道自己在寻找什么，她在众多类似的路径中挑选出了一条不起眼的悬崖小径，然后带头走了进去。 [party.hasCompanions|该团队|你] 你继续向上行走，进入了山脉之中。走了一段看似不长的距离后，你突然遇到了道路的分岔——但那个体型庞大的半人马只是选择了一个方向，然后便一直沿着那个方向前进。从那以后，道路上的弯道变得越来越多，如果没有向导的话，很容易就会迷路。

突然间，重复出现的相同景色被打破了——当你穿过悬崖边的一处缺口时，Ahmri停了下来休息。那里有一块被踩得平整的土地，即使是一小群半人马也能够在这里停下来休息。透过山隘中的缝隙，你可以看到一些较小的山丘的顶端，那些山丘上分布着泉水和小池塘，池塘边还堆满了积雪。而在你所在的那座山上，五彩缤纷的花朵正在阳光下绽放…… [dayNight|场景设定|上升] 阳光在闪烁中绽放光芒。当阳光照射在悬崖上时，花朵会呈现出炽热的红色和明亮的橙色；而在阴凉处，它们的颜色则会变为柔和的蓝色和皇家紫，那种光芒仿佛能驱散黑暗。真是太神奇了。

“我们可以在这里休息一会儿。我们已经很接近目标了，我只是需要喘口气……”阿姆里喘着气说道，显然她还不太习惯这样的运动量。 [party.som||[companion1.name] 伸展身体，然后坐下来。 [companion1.hisHer] 睡袋。 |你的同伴们会利用这段短暂的休息时间，互相聊天放松一下。 ]你坐在阿姆里旁边，递给她一张水皮，她高兴地接过，轻声说道：“谢谢。”这或许是你接下来一段时间里为数不多的宁静时刻了。

rows.original: Ask Ahmri any last minute questions you still wonder about.
rows.translation: 如果有任何最后时刻还想知道的问题，可以随时向Ahmri咨询。
rows.raw: "Ask Ahmri any last minute questions you still wonder about."

rows.original: You need to hurry — who knows how long the mares distraction will last.
rows.translation: 你得抓紧时间了——谁也不知道这些母马的分心状态会持续多久。
rows.raw: "You need to hurry — who knows how long the mares distraction will last."

rows.original: Since this is your last relaxing moment before entering the village, it might be good to go over your plans with Ahmri, and ask any other questions you might have.
rows.translation: 既然这是你在进入村庄之前最后的放松时光，那么与Ahmri仔细讨论一下你的计划，或者提出任何你可能有的疑问，应该是件好事。
rows.raw: "\n    Since this is your last relaxing moment before entering the village, it might be good to go over your plans with Ahmri, and ask any other questions you might have."

rows.original:
What are these flowers? You can't say you've seen anything like them in other parts of the Marches. Ahmri giggles, reaching out to run a palm over the blanketed wall.

        "You might have, actually! Elsewhere I hear they call it Gardener's Curse or cursevine. They're actually weeds, and nigh impossible to get rid of on account of how deep the roots go. You have to use magic, and the last seed trader I talked to said they're getting accustomed to that, too," she laughs. You had heard of the weed, but cursevine doesn't flower. It grows deeper than other plants and sucks up nutrients in the soil.
        
        "I don't know if it just doesn't get the right food elsewhere, or if it gets too much, but up here in the mountains it always opens up like this when the weather is cold. We call them everblooms. They wilt on the vine when it gets too hot, but if you pick them like this they'll stay that way forever! Or well, they look like that. The flowery bits actually change into something like the down they put in fancy pillows," Ahmri explains. You push one of the thick blossoms aside, revealing a thick cord of green vine that looks very much like what you think cursevine should look like. You'd have never guessed it could look so pretty. What do the centaurs do with it, then? Is it one of the medical herbs she mentioned?
        
        "Ah, uhm... no. It doesn't really have any practical uses, but because there's so much of it, and we don't do much metalworking, they get used instead of rings or pendants when people, uhm, propose," Ahmri details, her cheeks doing their best radish impression as she shuffles her hooves in the dirt.
rows.translation:
这些花是什么？在边境地区的其他地方，你肯定没见过这样的花吧。啊姆里轻笑着，伸手抚摸着那被苔藓覆盖的墙壁。



        “其实你可能见过哦！我听说在其他地方，人们把这种植物叫做‘园丁的诅咒’或‘诅咒藤’。其实它们就是杂草，而且由于根系非常发达，几乎不可能彻底清除。必须用魔法才能处理它们。我上次遇到的种子商还说，人们已经渐渐习惯了这种情况了。”她笑着说。你确实听说过这种杂草，但诅咒藤并不会开花。它的根系比其他植物更深，会吸收土壤中的养分。


        
        “我不知道是因为在其他地方它得不到合适的养分，还是因为得到了过多的养分，但在这座山上，每当天气变冷的时候，这种植物就会开出这样的花来。我们把它们叫做‘常开花’。天气太热的时候，这些花就会枯萎，但如果你像现在这样采摘它们，它们就会永远保持这个样子！至少看起来是永远保持的。其实那些花的部分会变成一种像用来制作高档枕头里的绒毛一样的东西。”啊姆里解释道。你把一朵茂密的花推到一边，露出了一条粗粗的绿色藤蔓，看起来确实和你想象中的诅咒藤很像。你从来没想过它还能长得这么漂亮。那么，半人马们是用它来做什么的呢？难道它是她提到的那些药用植物之一吗？


        
        “啊，嗯……不是的。这种植物其实并没有什么实际用途，但因为它的数量非常多，而我们这里也不太从事金属加工，所以当人们想要求婚的时候，就会用这种藤蔓来代替戒指或吊坠。”啊姆里详细地说道，她的脸颊因为害羞而变得通红，同时她的蹄子在泥土中不停地挪动。

rows.original: Ask Ahmri about these flowers on the wall. They seem quite relaxing.
rows.translation: 去问问阿姆里关于墙上这些花的事情吧。它们看起来确实能让人放松心情。
rows.raw: "Ask Ahmri about these flowers on the wall. They seem quite relaxing."

rows.original:
So what was it like growing up as the daughter of the centaur village's chieftain? What's one thing she remembers about her father from then? 

        Ahmri looks a bit embarrassed, twirling a finger through a stray lock of hair. "I mostly stayed in my room once I learned to read. It might sound bad, but I didn't spend much time outside other than getting bread from the bakers in the morning and going to see the traveling merchants who stopped by the village," she replies, sheepishly clasping her hands together.
        
        "B-but that doesn't mean I didn't do anything fun! When I was five, I tried to bake daddy a cake as big as he was! I bought this powder from a traveler that was supposed to embiggen anything you cooked with it. I thought it would just make the cake bigger at the end, but when I poured it all into the cake mix it just started growing and splashing all over the place. I got stuck in the gooey stuff as it covered everything. By the time daddy got back it had dried up and I had clumps caked on everywhere. I thought he was gonna be so mad, but daddy just laughed and tried to help me bake a regular-sized cake," Ahmri grins at the memory, stifling giggles. That's exactly the kind of thing you're looking for! Taldahs has to remember something like that.
rows.translation:
那作为半人马村首领的女儿，成长过程是怎样的呢？那时关于她的父亲，她还记得些什么吗？

        阿姆里显得有些尴尬，用手指拨弄着散落的几缕头发。“学会阅读之后，我大部分时间都待在自己的房间里。听起来可能不太好，但实际上除了早上去面包店买面包，或者去村里那些路过的商贩那里看看，我并没有太多时间在外面活动。”她羞涩地双手交叠在一起回答道。


        
        “不过，这并不意味着我没有做过任何有趣的事情！五岁的时候，我试着给爸爸烤一个和他一样大的蛋糕！我从一个商人那里买了一种粉末，据说这种粉末能让你做的任何食物都变大。我本来以为把它加到蛋糕面糊里之后，蛋糕就会变大，结果却没想到，当我把所有粉末都倒进去之后，面糊竟然开始疯狂地膨胀，溅得到处都是。那些黏糊糊的东西把我的手都粘住了，等爸爸回来的时候，那些面糊已经干掉了，我的手上还粘着一团团的东西。我以为爸爸会生气的，但他只是笑了笑，然后帮我重新烤了一个正常大小的蛋糕。”回想起这段往事，阿姆里忍不住笑了起来。这种事情，塔尔达斯肯定也会记得的吧。
rows.raw:
"
        So what was it like growing up as the daughter of the centaur village's chieftain? What's one thing she remembers about her father from then? 

        Ahmri looks a bit embarrassed, twirling a finger through a stray lock of hair. "I mostly stayed in my room once I learned to read. It might sound bad, but I didn't spend much time outside other than getting bread from the bakers in the morning and going to see the traveling merchants who stopped by the village," she replies, sheepishly clasping her hands together.
        
        "B-but that doesn't mean I didn't do anything fun! When I was five, I tried to bake daddy a cake as big as he was! I bought this powder from a traveler that was supposed to embiggen anything you cooked with it. I thought it would just make the cake bigger at the end, but when I poured it all into the cake mix it just started growing and splashing all over the place. I got stuck in the gooey stuff as it covered everything. By the time daddy got back it had dried up and I had clumps caked on everywhere. I thought he was gonna be so mad, but daddy just laughed and tried to help me bake a regular-sized cake," Ahmri grins at the memory, stifling giggles. That's exactly the kind of thing you're looking for! Taldahs has to remember something like that."

rows.original: Ask Ahmri about growing up here. Anything about her father could potentially help get through to him if he's not fully lost.
rows.translation: 可以问问阿姆里关于她在这里成长的经历。任何与她父亲有关的信息，都有可能帮助我们与他取得联系，前提是他还没有完全失去理智。
rows.raw: "Ask Ahmri about growing up here. Anything about her father could potentially help get through to him if he's not fully lost."

rows.original:
You've heard centaurs have a rich oral tradition; does Ahmri remember any stories her father told her that might be relevant? Anything that might give him some reason to take power from a demon like Kasyrra? 

        "Ugh. I don't know! Everyone loved Daddy. There haven't really been any power struggles in the ravine for a long time. It used to happen all the time if you believe the stories written by historians before the Godswar, but I don't think any of them talked with centaurs from here. All the people in the ravine trust Daddy to do what's best, and if they think something he does is off, he listens. I don't know why he would want anything that monster has to offer," Ahmri rubs her arms as if cold, looking utterly put out.
        
        Now now, you won't be having any of that. You put a reassuring hand on her shoulder. That alone is something useful. That's one less thing you have to worry about being a problem when you try to fish out what caused him to go astray. Ahmri gives you half a smile, blossoming into a full grin when you raise an eyebrow. At least she's easy to cheer up.
        
        "You're right! We can convince him to stop this silliness no problem."
rows.translation:
你应该听说过半人马拥有丰富的口述传统吧？阿姆里是否还记得她父亲讲过的那些可能与此相关的故事？有没有什么故事能让他有理由从像卡西拉这样的恶魔手中夺取权力呢？

        “呃，我不知道啊！大家都很喜欢爸爸。在山谷里，已经很久没有发生过权力斗争了。如果相信神战之前历史学家记载的故事，过去这种情况其实很常见，但我觉得他们当中没有人和这里的半人马有过接触。山谷里的所有人都信任爸爸，相信他会做出最正确的决定。如果他们觉得爸爸的做法有什么不对，爸爸也会听取他们的意见。我真不明白他为什么会想要那个怪物所提供的东西……”阿姆里搓着胳膊，看起来非常沮丧。


        
        别担心，这种事情不会发生的。你把手放在她的肩上，给了她一个安慰的眼神。这一点就已经很有用了——至少在试图弄清楚他为什么会走上这条道路时，你就不必再为这个担心了。当你挑起眉毛看着她时，她露出了半个微笑，随后笑容变得更加灿烂。至少她很容易被逗乐。


        
        “你说得对！我们肯定能说服他停止这种愚蠢的行为。

rows.original: Ask Ahmri about her favorite story her father tells.
rows.translation: 问问阿姆里，她父亲讲的哪个故事是她最喜欢的。
rows.raw: "Ask Ahmri about her favorite story her father tells."

rows.original: You appraise the wall of shifting color, admiring the contrast in the flowers' color. Which one would fit the snowy centaur best? No matter what you pick, they're sure to look good.
rows.translation: 你仔细观察着那面色彩变幻的墙壁，欣赏着花朵色彩之间的对比。哪一种颜色最适合那匹雪白的半人马呢？无论你选择哪种，它们肯定都会显得非常漂亮。
rows.raw: "\n        You appraise the wall of shifting color, admiring the contrast in the flowers' color. Which one would fit the snowy centaur best? No matter what you pick, they're sure to look good."

rows.original:
You [pc.dcb|smirk mischeviously|smile warmly|put on a big dopey grin] and pluck one of the colorful flowers from the mountainside. Twirling the blossom between your fingers, you hold it out to Ahmri. So it's used to propose, right? How do they do it? A simple "Will you marry me?" or is there more to it than that? Ahmri's jaw hangs open as she stares at you in half-comprehension for a moment. You watch the gears grind in her head as the blush that was constrained to her cheeks spreads down her neck and onto her chest.

            "They... Uhm... It's just like that. T-then they go through the m-marriage ceremony, a-and, ohh —" You see her eyes glaze over for a second as you lose her to her imagination, and her bright blonde tail juts into the air.
            
            "W-we should hurry up, so we can g-get m- I mean save my people. Come on, [pc.name]," Ahmri says, starting off down the path before you can respond. You hurry to join her, but can't help but notice the glistening excitement in her slit as her tail swishes back and forth. Perhaps you'll have to bring this up again once you bring the chief back to his senses.
rows.translation:
你[pc.dcb|坏笑着|温暖地笑着|露出傻乎乎的笑容]从山坡上摘下一朵五颜六色的花，把花在手指间转来转去，然后递给阿姆里。原来这是用来求婚的啊？他们具体是怎么做的呢？是简单地问一句“你愿意嫁给我吗”，还是还有其他仪式？阿姆里愣住了，半天才反应过来，她盯着你看，脸上渐渐浮现出红晕，那红晕从脸颊蔓延到脖颈，最终覆盖了整个胸部。



            “他们……嗯……就是这么做的。然后他们会举行婚礼仪式，还有，哦……”她的目光突然变得恍惚起来，似乎陷入了想象之中，她那亮黄色的尾巴也兴奋地摇动起来。


            
            “我们得快点，这样才能救出我的人民。来吧，[pc.name]，”阿姆里说着，便先走在了前面。你赶紧追了上去，却忍不住注意到她尾巴摆动时那闪烁着兴奋的光芒。也许等把族长救醒之后，还得再跟她谈谈这件事。

rows.original: The fiery red and orange flowers really match her carefree spirit and dedication.
rows.translation: 那些火红色和橙色的花朵，确实与她那无忧无虑的性格以及她所投入的热情十分相配。
rows.raw: "The fiery red and orange flowers really match her carefree spirit and dedication."

rows.original: The blue flowers are soft and pleasant to look at, just like her!
rows.translation: 这些蓝色的花朵柔软而美观，看起来就像她一样！
rows.raw: "The blue flowers are soft and pleasant to look at, just like her!"

rows.original: Proposing, eh? What better way to tell her how you feel?
rows.translation: 提议，对吧？还有什么比这更好的方式来告诉她你的感受呢？
rows.raw: "Proposing, eh? What better way to tell her how you feel?"

rows.original: You push a cloth-laden timber out of the path, only to leap back when it explodes into dust in a flash of blackish-green light. Stumbling backwards, you manage to not fall on your ass by catching hold of another post staked into the ground. "In a hurry, [pc.title]?" A voice echoes from behind, and you turn to see none other than the cult leader you scared away from the temple all those days ago. "I did not expect to see you again so soon, especially once again sticking your nose in our affairs! You're proving to be far too bothersome, no matter what our dark lady desires. I'll take things into my own hands while I have the chance!" Tollus is seated side-saddle on the back of a centaur strongwoman, lounging comfortably. The mare is completely tied in bondage gear, head to hoof. Her muscular arms are bound behind her back, and a thick bit has been placed between her teeth. Gear created for horse-riding bipeds is set on her lower body, and you see the glint of golden horseshoes on the hooves beneath her furred ankles. Blinders force her vision forward, but in her eyes you see nothing but depraved pleasure. She likes this, and, if anything, seems more intent on you to join in debasing her than to rescue her. You'll need to find a way to get her out of the picture, one way or another. You're fighting lustrider Tollus!
rows.translation: 你把一根缠着布的木棍拨到一边，却在这根木棍在黑绿色光芒中瞬间化为尘埃时猛地后退了一步。你踉跄着后退，幸好抓住了另一根插在地里的木桩，才没有摔倒。 “这么着急吗，[pc.title]？”背后传来一个声音，你转过头，看到的正是那天在寺庙里把你吓跑的那个邪教头目。“没想到这么快又见到你，尤其是你又一次插手我们的事情！不管我们的‘黑暗女士’有什么打算，你确实太麻烦了……趁现在还有机会，我就亲自处理你吧！” 托卢斯侧坐在一位半人马女强者的背上，显得十分悠闲。那匹马被彻底用束缚装置固定住了，从头到脚都被绑得严严实实。它的肌肉发达的四肢被绑在背后，牙齿里也被塞上了厚厚的东西。它的下半身装备着为骑马用的装置，你还能看到它那毛茸茸的脚踝下金色的马蹄在闪闪发光。眼罩让它的视线只能向前看，但从它的眼睛里，你只能读到一种病态的愉悦……它喜欢这样，而且看起来，它更希望你加入进来，一起亵渎它，而不是救它。 你必须想办法让她从这件事中消失，不管用什么方法。你现在面对的是骑马而来的托卢斯啊！

rows.original: Tollus stumbles backward, sputtering out myriad curses as you and [party.hasCompanions|your party|Ahmri] close in on him. His scowl morphs into a grin before you come close enough to grab him, and he sweeps his arm in an arc that releases a blinding flash of reddish-pink light. "A taste of the power Kasyrra has granted me! A blessing, if you will, from the dark new goddess of Savarra," he cackles, voice sounding further away with each word. When you're finally able to blink the residual spots from your eyes, there's no sign of the wriggly cultist. You clench your fist, the failure to catch him made even more humiliating when you feel what you can only assume is the effects of his "blessing." Heat courses through your veins, and you can somehow feel the vastness of your desires deepening. Whether or not that worries you is something that will have to wait. For now, it's hopefully something that will wear off. [party.has cait|"Damn!" Cait hisses, stamping the bottom of her staff on the dirt. "We had him, [pc.name]. Ohhh, the things I'll do to that bald bastard... I'll get him sooner or later! Ah, but let's not forget this poor innocent mare he's enslaved."] Remembering Tollus's mount, you spin around, rushing over to the seated mare and trying to get her attention. She stares in a blank daze, barely reacting when you snap your fingers before her. When she focuses enough to recognize you, she tries to smile around the bit, leaning forward to nuzzle against your [pc.chest]. You feel your lust stir as she looks up at you longingly, and you stare back at her rump as her tail flicks back and forth. "That's ahh... gosh. I-it smells like she's in h-heat. Did he break her mind or something?" Ahmri asks, flushed bright as a crimson star. The bound centaur sobers for a moment, snorting out a laugh and rolling her eyes at the younger woman. She falls back into her seeming stupor when she's done. Is... is she playing with you? [party.oneComp cait brint brienne etheryn berwyn arona atugia quin azyrran |"D'aww. She's like a cute, horny pony. Must be hard being into equine petplay in a village of horse people," Cait consoles, giving the bound woman a scratch behind the ear. |"Seems like a good horse," Brint says plainly. He smirks, giving the horny horse-woman a pat on the flank. |Brienne laughs and gives the roleplaying centauress a pat on the head. |"W[etheryn.lowConfidence|-w]ow, she really likes acting like that? Alissa made me act like a puppy a few times, but it wasn't that fun.[etheryn.highLibido| Maybe if it was with you, though," she ponders aloud. You see her thighs rubbing together as she daydreams.|" She frowns, sounding a little jealous despite herself.] |"Wow. Even if this is play, That confidence has got to be because of the corruption. I'd recognize that anywhere," Berwyn says, consciously stopping his hand as it reaches for his doggy-cock. |"Ha! If she wants to play horse I'd be game to play stallion," Arona grins, prompting a heady snort from the centauress. |"Good... Horsie? Ugh, I can't imagine bein' so repressed that that slimebag Tollus would look like a good time." |"Can't deny she makes a good horse," Quin smiles, giving the centauress a pat on the rump. |"So this is for play? Do all centaurs like it like this?" Azzy raises an eyebrow, inspecting the buxom centauress with [azzy.kdb|naive curiosity|hungry appraisal|wondering desire]. ] "I guess she just liked it? W-well if, uh, you want to help her out I'll just be over here. Keeping a lookout." Ahmri canters around the nearest post, standing awkwardly and watching for corrupt foes. You're left alone with the randy centauress, and she seems perfectly willing to help you vent some of the excess lust you've been afflicted with. rows.original: You're walking through the disheveled piles of tents and timber — the remnants of centaur civilization almost literally scattered to the wind — when you notice the air shift. It's subtle at first, almost imperceptible save for a slight increase in temperature, but the further you walk the worse it gets. You shiver and break out in sweat[party.solo||, [comp1.name] suffering the same,] as you approach what appears to be a clearing around the corner of the rubble. From within you hear a terrible roar and the sound of ripping earth, the clank and whoosh of a chain flying through the air. Whatever's inside is angry, stomping over the ground and trampling its surroundings, and before you can make a decision about whether to leave or fight there's a clattering crash as the chain whips through the air. It rips through your meager cover and leaves [party.som|you|the two of you|the three of you] exposed to the clearing, locking eyes with the beastly inhabitant. There's nothing in them, you realize immediately. Before you stands a monstrous centaur hybrid, rippling with muscle from barrel chest to thick haunches. With the head of an equine and the chest of a man that fades into the body of a horse, it's clear that this being has been horribly and unnaturally altered. His enormous body is surrounded by some kind of demonic aura, and you can only think of one individual who might have bestowed that upon him. "Kasyrra," you mutter. As if in response to her name, the aberration lets out an unearthly howl and rears up on its hindlegs, towering into the sky before coming down with an earthshaking rumble that sends dust flying into the air. His unnatural, empty gaze settles on you and he snarls, raising a long, sharpened pole, pawing at the ground. The heat rises around you, becoming almost unbearable as you ready your weapons. It's a fight!

rows.original: You can see the chieftain's cabin from here, much sturdier and looking mostly unharmed for the rest of the village's seemingly total ruin. Before you can get too close, you see a glint of light from inside the darkened cabin door. A thunderous sound follows, and you have just enough time to roll to one side as a flash of deep blue impacts in the dirt you were just standing on. A spear of almost wet looking glass or crystal quivers in the ground, sunk half its length onto the mountainside. As you watch, the spear slackens, wriggling like a worm as it slithers back toward the building. You watch in apprehension as a monstrosity steps through the door. It looks like a centaur, but carved from the same living crystal as the tentacle spear from before. The thing has no mouth, but you can see the smile in its eyes as it looks past you, focusing all its attention on Ahmri. It opens its arms, holding them out as if to welcome her. "You came! I knew you would, even if you spurned my escorts," it says, its voice a rich baritone. You remain defensive, but Ahmri's tenuous armor of courage deflates in an instant. "D-daddy?" She stutters, her spear clattering to the ground as she shrinks back. You look back to the monster, still holding its (his?) arms out in greeting. This is chief Taldahs? What did Kasyrra do to him? "Come, my moonlight snowball. Even you have a part in Lady Kasyrra's plans. Now that you're here we can both receive her full blessing," he says, taking a step closer down the hillside. You move to place yourself between him and Ahmri, and he finally shifts his gaze off her. "Ahh, her ladyship's hero. I am certain she will be elated to hear of your change of heart, but-" he begins, seemingly oblivious to the tension in the air, before Ahmri interrupts him. "Daddy stop! [pc.name] is here to fix this. I don't know what that witch did to you, b-but I'm sure it's not too late to fix it," she calls, clasping her hands together over her chest. For the first time the Taldahs monster's eyes narrow to harrowing needles. Ahmri lets out a timid 'eep' and falls behind you again. "Is [pc.heShe] now? No one here is in need of saving, but I am beside myself wondering what your plan is. Please enlighten me," he laughs, crossing his arms over a chest that ripples with more than just muscle.
rows.translation: 从这里你可以看到酋长的小屋，它显得格外坚固，而在整个村庄几乎被毁殆尽的情况下，这座小屋却几乎毫发无损。就在你准备靠近的时候，你注意到那扇昏暗的小屋门里透出一丝光亮。 紧接着是一声震耳欲聋的巨响，你刚好有时间向一侧滚开，只见一道深蓝色的光束击中了你刚才站立的地方，那光芒在泥土中留下了痕迹。一根看起来几乎像是湿玻璃或水晶制成的长矛深深插在地面中，它的半截长度都嵌入了山坡里。 你看着那支长矛，它逐渐松弛下来，像条蠕虫一样蜿蜒着滑向那栋建筑。 你忧心忡忡地注视着那个怪物走进门来。它看起来像半人马，但却是由与之前那根触手长矛相同的活水晶雕刻而成的。这个生物没有嘴巴，但当你看到它目光从你身上移开，将全部注意力集中在阿姆丽身上时，你能从它的眼睛里看到一种“微笑”。它张开双臂，仿佛是在欢迎她。 你来了！我就知道你会来的，即使你拒绝了我的护卫。”它用那浑厚的男中音说道。你依然保持着警惕，但阿姆里的那层脆弱的勇气之盾瞬间就崩塌了。 “爸……爸爸？”她结结巴巴地喊道，手中的长矛重重摔在地上，她吓得连连后退。你回头看向那个怪物，它依然伸出双臂在向你致意。这就是塔尔达斯首领吗？卡西拉到底对他做了什么？ 来吧，我的月光雪球。就连你也在卡西拉夫人的计划中扮演着一定的角色。现在你来了，我们就可以…… 两者都 希望她能完全赞同你的决定，”他说着，又往山坡下方走了一步。你立刻站在他和阿姆里之间，这才让他终于把目光从她身上移开。 “啊，这位夫人的英雄啊。我敢肯定，听到你改变主意的消息，她一定会非常高兴的，但是……”他开始说道，似乎完全没有察觉到空气中弥漫的紧张气氛，直到阿姆里打断了他。 “爸爸，别说了！ [pc.name] 我是来解决这个问题的。我不知道那个女巫对你做了什么，但是我相信现在还来得及补救的，”她边说边将双手交叠在胸前。这一次，塔尔达家族的怪物的眼睛竟然眯成了令人毛骨悚然的针状。阿姆里吓得发出一声怯懦的“咿呀”声，又跟在了你的身后。 [pc.heShe] 现在吗？这里没有人需要被拯救，但我实在很好奇你的计划是什么。请告诉我吧，”他笑着说，双臂交叉在胸前，那结实宽厚的胸膛显然不仅仅是肌肉在起作用。

As long as you're careful, you shouldn't push him too far, but that doesn't mean you can be reckless.

    On the other hand, it might be easy to attack while he's distracted...

rows.original:
He said that he and Ahmri would receive Kasyrra's 'full' blessing. What did he mean by that?

        "Of course we will. My lady was only willing to give me a sample of her power to further my goals in the valley. Once I completed my task I was to receive more power, and to become truly like her! Make no mistake, she has similar plans for you. Perhaps not right away, but once you prove yourself you too can stand beside her in showing Savarra her true power," he laughs heartily. You should change the topic, but you've confirmed something valuable.
        
        Whatever Kasyrra is doing to people around the Marches, Taldah's isn't fully afflicted!

rows.original:
The monster cocks an eyebrow, staring hard at you for an uncomfortable silence before speaking.

        "Want what? To be saved? Why should I need saving when I am the strongest I have ever been? Now I even have magic to back me up, something I never had the patience for!" He raises an arm, flexing as a tendril of slippery crystal wriggles into his hand. The strand straightens and solidifies until it forms a narrow pointed spear in his hand. He looks over the newly created weapon before lowering its point to the ground.
        
        "What reason could I possibly have to give all this up? I am the strongest man in the valley, the strongest being even. I can have anything I want, so why would I go back to nothing?" There's something off in his tone that you can't quite reconcile. Not a lack of confidence, but a disinterest in the very words he's speaking, as if he's trying to convince himself of the truth in them as much as boast to you. Maybe you have a shot at this after all...

那个怪物挑了挑眉毛，紧紧地盯着你，一阵令人尴尬的沉默之后，它开口说道：

“想要什么？想要被拯救吗？既然我现在是史上最强的人，为什么还需要被拯救呢？现在我甚至还有魔法作为后盾，这种东西以前我从来都没有耐心去学习过！他抬起一只手臂，肌肉一紧，一根光滑的水晶触须便蜿蜒进入了他的手中。那根水晶触须逐渐变直、固化，最终在他手中形成了一支细长的尖刺。他仔细端详着这把新制成的武器，然后将它的尖端指向地面。
        
        我究竟有什么理由要放弃这一切呢？我是这个山谷里最强的人，是最强大的存在。我想要什么就能得到什么，那么我为什么要回到一无所有的状态呢？”他的语气中有些奇怪的地方，让你无法理解其中的原因。 并不是缺乏信心，而是对他所说的话本身毫无兴趣，就好像他既在试图让自己相信那些话的真实性，又在向你炫耀一样。也许，你终究还是有机会的……

rows.original:
Ahmri blushes despite the situation when you ask about the rather unique nickname Taldahs used for her. Taldahs gives an amused harumph, raising an eyebrow.

        "Her mother was a northern star. Hers was a beauty so great that even the southern tribes heroes of old would be undeserving of her love. To this day I have no idea why she decided to stay with me long enough to produce a child. As I am now? For sure, but then I was nothing but an aging chieftain to a declining tribe." He looks away, toward the north.
        
        An interesting story for sure, but it doesn't really explain the nickname. The Taldahs monster's attention returns to you with a shake of his head.
        
        "She inherited her mother's snow white fur. When she isn't covered in the dirt and grime you seem to enjoy having her trounce around in, that is. She reminds me of her mother, the most cherished memory of her I have besides the scarce letters she sends from the north. Ahmri never shunned the cold. Even as a child she'd play in the first carpet of snow that blanketed the valley, sneaking out at night to play while the rest of the village slept. I tried to stop her for the first month, but I could no more succeed than take Khor'minos single handed. I would watch her for hours, letting her believe that no one knew she snuck out, and make sure her bedding was warm and dry when she came inside," he says, swimming in memories. His face, featureless but for the eyes, softens noticeably as he continues. Perhaps this is worth pursuing.
rows.translation:
当你问及人们给她起的那个颇为独特的绰号“塔尔达斯”时，阿姆里尽管处于那种境地，还是脸红了。塔尔达斯听后发出一声有趣的哼声，同时挑了挑眉毛。

“她的母亲是一颗北方的星辰。她本人美得如此惊人，就连古代南方部落的英雄们也配不上她的爱。直到今天，我仍然不明白她为什么愿意和我在一起，生下孩子。至于现在……当然，但她当时看到的，不过是一个日渐衰落的部落里一位年迈的酋长罢了。”他把目光投向北方。
        
        这确实是一个有趣的故事，但它并没有真正解释这个绰号的由来。塔尔达这个怪物摇摇头，又将注意力转向了你。

“她继承了母亲那雪白的毛皮。当然，前提是当她没有沾满你似乎很喜欢让她在那些尘土和污垢中打滚的时候。 她让我想起了她的母亲——除了她从北方寄来的那些为数不多的信件外，她母亲是我心中最珍贵的回忆。啊姆里从不畏惧寒冷。即使还是个孩子，她也会在山谷里第一场降下的雪中玩耍，常常在夜晚趁全村人都睡着的时候偷偷出去玩。 在第一个月里，我试图阻止她，但我的努力就像独自去攻克霍尔米诺斯一样，根本毫无成效。我会花好几个小时观察她，让她以为没有人发现她偷偷溜了出去；同时，也会确保她回到屋里时，床铺是温暖而干燥的。”他边回忆边说道。 他的面容毫无特征，唯有那双眼睛显得格外醒目。随着他继续说话，那双眼睛的神情明显变得柔和起来。或许，这条路值得去探索。
rows.raw:
"
        Ahmri blushes despite the situation when you ask about the rather unique nickname Taldahs used for her. Taldahs gives an amused harumph, raising an eyebrow.

        "Her mother was a northern star. Hers was a beauty so great that even the southern tribes heroes of old would be undeserving of her love. To this day I have no idea why she decided to stay with me long enough to produce a child. As I am now? For sure, but then I was nothing but an aging chieftain to a declining tribe." He looks away, toward the north.
        
        An interesting story for sure, but it doesn't really explain the nickname. The Taldahs monster's attention returns to you with a shake of his head.
        
        "She inherited her mother's snow white fur. When she isn't covered in the dirt and grime you seem to enjoy having her trounce around in, that is. She reminds me of her mother, the most cherished memory of her I have besides the scarce letters she sends from the north. Ahmri never shunned the cold. Even as a child she'd play in the first carpet of snow that blanketed the valley, sneaking out at night to play while the rest of the village slept. I tried to stop her for the first month, but I could no more succeed than take Khor'minos single handed. I would watch her for hours, letting her believe that no one knew she snuck out, and make sure her bedding was warm and dry when she came inside," he says, swimming in memories. His face, featureless but for the eyes, softens noticeably as he continues. Perhaps this is worth pursuing."

rows.original: What kind of a nickname is moonlight snowball?
rows.translation: moonlight snowball”这个昵称是什么意思呢？
rows.raw: "What kind of a nickname is moonlight snowball?"

rows.original: Fuck this. Attacking before you talk Taldahs down will result in the village's corruption. Ahmri will NOT like this, and will probably run.
rows.translation: 去他的。 如果你不先和塔尔达斯商量，就直接攻击他，那么村庄就会陷入腐败之中。阿姆里肯定不会喜欢这样的事情，很可能会离开。
rows.raw: "Fuck this. Attacking before you talk Taldahs down will result in the village's corruption. Ahmri will NOT like this, and will probably run."

rows.original:
"Hmph. Proud I may be, but I would not seek to challenge a god at their own game. She could just as easily smite me down as any of the gods could, but why would she do so when I have actively aided in spreading her influence through the majority of the valley? You should make sense of your words before they reach your lips."

        Drat, Kasyrra doesn't seem like the type to punish loyalty. You'll have to come at this from a different angle. [flags.AHMRI_STORIES||Something he said resonates with you, though. You'll have to remember it.]
rows.translation:
哼，虽然我挺骄傲的，但我也不会去挑战神的权威——在他们自己的游戏中与他们对抗。她完全可以像其他神明一样轻易地消灭我，但既然我一直在帮助她将她的影响力扩散到山谷的大部分地区，她为什么还要这么做呢？在说出话之前，最好先好好考虑一下自己的言辞。”

该死，卡西拉似乎并不是那种会惩罚忠诚之人的人。看来得换个角度来思考这个问题了。 [flags.AHMRI_STORIES||不过，他说的某些话确实引起了你的共鸣。你得把它们记下来。]

rows.original: He might be stronger than he's ever been, but he's fooling himself if he thinks he's stronger than Kasyrra. She could be done with him just as soon as she granted him this power.
rows.translation: 他或许比以往任何时候都更强，但如果他认为自己比卡西拉更强，那他就是在自欺欺人。只要她赋予他这种力量，她随时都有可能抛弃他。
rows.raw: "He might be stronger than he's ever been, but he's fooling himself if he thinks he's stronger than Kasyrra. She could be done with him just as soon as she granted him this power."

rows.original: Is that really all he thinks he had? He was just telling you about his antics and the fun times he had with his daughter. His friends just don't disappear, and his daughter can't be nothing if he wants her back so badly. "That is a different matter. I spoke only of myself. Of my position and its decline. I may have been hasty in the telling, but the heart of the matter remains the same. I... I made the only choice that made sense, didn't I?" It was certainly a choice, but was it the only one he had? "What would you have had me do? Ask the marefolk for help? Ask the mecians to spring from their burrows to fight against the promise of everything I ever wanted? That would be a different kind of death." [var0 |No. Stop side-tracking. These reasons are out of a storybook, and the Taldahs you've heard about wouldn't be hung up on the respect of others. There's another reason he's being so defensive, another reason he accepted this power~ "Then tell me! Tell me what I wanted, if you so insist that I do not know myself!" His words are half pleading cry and half angered shout. You have something here, but can you carry it to the end? |Rats. You can't be sure enough to push this. Perhaps if you delved a little deeper elsewhere? ]
rows.translation: 他真的只认为自己就拥有这些吗？他只是在跟你讲述他的那些趣事，以及他和女儿一起度过的快乐时光而已。他的朋友们不可能就这么消失不见，而如果他那么渴望重新得到女儿，那么女儿也不可能什么都不是。 那是另一回事了。我所说的只是我自己的情况，关于我的处境以及它的变化。我在表达时可能有些急躁，但事实的本质并没有改变。我……我所做的选择确实是当时最合理的，不是吗？这确实是一个选择，但真的是他唯一的选择吗？ “你又会让我怎么做呢？去向马人寻求帮助吗？还是让机械师们从他们的藏身处出来参与战斗吗？ 对抗 我一直以来渴望得到的一切，如果真的实现了，那反而意味着另一种形式的死亡。 [var0 |不。别再转移话题了。这些理由简直像出自童话故事，而你所说的那些塔尔达家族的人，根本不会在意别人的尊重。他之所以如此固执地维护自己的立场，一定还有别的原因……他之所以会接受这种权力，也一定有别的原因……” “那就告诉我吧！如果你坚持认为我根本不了解自己，那就告诉我我真正想要的是什么！” 他的话里既有恳求，也有愤怒。他肯定知道些什么，但你能坚持把事情做到底吗？ |老鼠们。你们实在无法确定是否应该推进这件事。或许可以在其他地方再深入调查一下？ ]

rows.translation: 你什么意思，什么都没有吗？

rows.original:
"Well? If you can't think of anything after all, then I'll be taking my daughter. I'm sure Kasyrra will call on you eventually.

        Tsk, You've got to think of something, staying silent is just going to let him wax on about himself.
rows.translation:
那又怎样？如果你实在想不出任何办法，那我就会带走我的女儿。我相信卡西拉最终会来找你的。

啧，你总得想出点办法来吧，继续保持沉默只会让他继续喋喋不休地谈论自己而已。
rows.raw:
"
        "Well? If you can't think of anything after all, then I'll be taking my daughter. I'm sure Kasyrra will call on you eventually.

        Tsk, You've got to think of something, staying silent is just going to let him wax on about himself."

rows.original: "She didn't. It was I who grew weaker in my age. No more heroic feats, no power left to save what I cared for. Did you know that I once bested five marefolk hunters in single combat? They ambushed me fishing in the river, wanting the seed of the strongest centaur. They got their seed, but I made sure it was them walking bowlegged back to their village." So his strength started to fade? It didn't seem to you like he was any less well respected... Was someone threatening to oust him? "No one had made the push, but it was only a matter of time. Lady Kasyrra offered a way for me to keep the strength of my youth and more, and take back control of my people. Of course I took the offer, anyone would in my position." He huffs, avoiding your gaze as he explains himself. There's something he's not saying, or something's off about what he's said already. [flags.AHMRI_STORIES |Hang on a second. Ahmri told you how the village works. It's not some survival of the fittest wild pack. Chieftains keep their position for life, and even when he was sick his people still looked up to him while he was being nursed to health. The Taldahs monster's eyes widen as you confront him with this conflicting info, and you see a fracture in the blue crystal of his body splinter into existence just beneath his cheek. Ahmri squeezes your arm from behind, bolstering your courage to continue on. |You don't know how the village works, so you can't really gain any footing here, but maybe you can trip him up somewhere else. [var0 |Wait a second. Just earlier he was telling you about how his people respect him enough to aid him in corrupting the known world. That's not something they would do if they thought he was weak. If anything they'd have attempted to seize power then and there if they thought they were more worthy of it. The Taldahs monster's eyes widen as you confront him with this conflicting info, and you see a fracture in the blue crystal of his body splinter into existence just beneath his cheek. Ahmri squeezes your arm from behind, bolstering your courage to continue on. |You don't know how the village works, so you can't really gain any footing here, but maybe you can trip him up somewhere else. ] ]
rows.translation: "她 并没有。其实是我在年纪渐长后变得越来越弱小。再没有那些英勇的壮举，也没有力量去保护我珍视的一切了。你知道吗？我曾经在单挑中击败过五名马人猎手。他们在我河边钓鱼时埋伏了我，因为他们想要最强壮半人马的种子。 他们得到了他们的种子，但我确保是他们一瘸一拐地回到了自己的村庄。” 那么他的势力开始衰弱了吗？在你看来，他的威望似乎并没有下降啊……是不是有人在威胁要取代他呢？ 之前没有人提出这样的建议，但这也只是时间问题而已。卡西拉女士为我提供了一条途径，让我能够保持年轻时的体力，甚至获得更多力量，同时重新掌控我的族人。我当然接受了这个提议，换作是我，任何人都会这么做。他气呼呼地解释着，避开了你的目光。显然，他有些话没有说出来，或者他所说的内容有些不对劲。 [flags.AHMRI_STORIES |等一下。阿姆里已经告诉过你这个村庄的运作方式了。这里并不是那种“适者生存”的野蛮群体。酋长们的职位是终身制的，即使他在生病的时候，他的族人们也会在他康复期间继续尊敬他。 当你用这些相互矛盾的信息去面对塔尔达斯的怪物时，它的双眼猛地睁大了，你看到它身体中那块蓝色水晶在它的脸颊下方裂开了。阿姆里从背后紧紧握住你的手臂，给了你继续前进的勇气。 |你并不了解这个村庄的运作方式，所以在这里你很难站稳脚跟，但也许在其他地方你可以抓住他的把柄。 [var0 |等一下。就在刚才，他还跟你们说过，他的族人们非常尊重他，愿意帮助他…… 破坏已知的世界如果他们认为他很弱小，就不会这么做。相反，如果他们自认为更有资格掌权，的话，当时就会试图夺取权力。 当你用这些相互矛盾的信息去质问塔尔达族的怪物时，它的双眼猛地瞪大了，你看到它身体上那块蓝色水晶在它的脸颊下方裂开了。阿姆里从背后握住了你的手臂，给了你继续前进的勇气。 |你并不了解这个村庄的运作方式，所以在这里你很难站稳脚跟，但也许在其他地方你可以抓住他的把柄。 ] ]

rows.original: When did all that change? From his own description it doesn't seem like she's changed much.
rows.translation: 这一切是什么时候开始改变的？根据他自己的描述，她似乎并没有发生太大的变化。
rows.raw: "When did all that change? From his own description it doesn't seem like she's changed much."

rows.original:
The words seem a mistake the second they leave your lips. The azure centaur's eyebrows furrow in collected rage as his glare renders you speechless.

        "My wife is alive, and my daughter is just that. She is precious to me in a different way, and vile insinuations will not aid your pleas."
        
        Yikes. It seems you misjudged how deep the corruption runs through Taldahs. It would be best to remember that.
rows.translation:
这些话刚从你口中说出来，就似乎成了一个错误。那位蓝色半人马的眉毛紧锁着，满脸愤怒，他的目光让你无言以对。

“我的妻子还活着，我的女儿也是如此。她对我来说有着不同的意义，那些卑鄙的诬陷根本无法动摇我的决心。”

哎呀，看来你低估了塔尔达斯这个地方的腐败程度。最好记住这一点。
rows.raw:
'
        The words seem a mistake the second they leave your lips. The azure centaur's eyebrows furrow in collected rage as his glare renders you speechless.

        "My wife is alive, and my daughter is just that. She is precious to me in a different way, and vile insinuations will not aid your pleas."
        
        Yikes. It seems you misjudged how deep the corruption runs through Taldahs. It would be best to remember that.'

rows.original: So what? Ahmri reminds you of your wife, and now you want her as a replacement?
rows.translation: 那又怎样？阿姆里让你想起了你的妻子，现在你就想用她来替代她吗？
rows.raw: "So what? Ahmri reminds you of your wife, and now you want her as a replacement?"

rows.original:
"The first time I told her she shouldn't play in the dark, she told me 'ok daddy' with such sincerity that I never doubted her for a second. Sure enough, she was out playing the next snowfall and I was completely dumbfounded. She told me she wasn't even cold. I thought it was magic at first but Tiki assured me it was just because the winters were warmer here in the Marches. To this day I have no interest in finding out just how cold it is up there."

        Taldahs seems to pause here, waiting on you to continue with a measured glare. It doesn't seem like you've provoked him, but there's certainly nothing more to be learned here.
rows.translation: 第一次我告诉她不要在黑暗中玩耍时，她非常认真地对我说‘好的，爸爸’，让我丝毫没有怀疑她的话。果然，下一次下雪的时候，她还是出去玩了，当时我真的惊呆了。 她告诉我她甚至都不觉得冷。起初我以为这是魔法，但蒂基向我保证，这只是因为边境地区的冬天比其他地方更温暖而已。直到今天，我依然没有兴趣去了解那里的冬天到底有多冷。塔尔达斯似乎在这里停下了动作，用一种充满意味的目光注视着你，等待你继续下一步行动。看起来你并没有惹恼他，不过这里确实也没有什么其他值得关注的事情了。

        "The first time I told her she shouldn't play in the dark, she told me 'ok daddy' with such sincerity that I never doubted her for a second. Sure enough, she was out playing the next snowfall and I was completely dumbfounded. She told me she wasn't even cold. I thought it was magic at first but Tiki assured me it was just because the winters were warmer here in the Marches. To this day I have no interest in finding out just how cold it is up there."

rows.original:
So you were right! Somewhere in there he doesn't want this after all. You have a sneaking suspicion you know the reason, but you have to bring him to the answer himself. If you try and force it right away he might lash out in denial. You'll have to trip up his reasoning.
    
    The Taldahs monster shows almost no outward reaction to the shift in tone, with his eyes showing the only measure of change. Where to press first?
rows.translation:
所以你是对的！在他内心深处，他其实并不想要这个。你隐约猜到了原因，但你必须让他自己找到答案。如果你立刻强行逼问他，他可能会予以否认。你得扰乱他的逻辑思维。

塔尔达族的怪物对外界语气的变化几乎没有丝毫反应，只有它的眼睛流露出了一丝变化。那么，该从哪里入手呢？

rows.original:
What's it like being the leader of the centaurs? You know some general things about the race from rumours and regional history, but hearing it first hand is interesting.

        "Hmm, I have no idea what you wish to find here, but I suppose it cannot hurt. Times are much less dire nowadays, and whereas the chieftains of old had much to do with battle tactics and how best to stay in charge of the valley, the current state of things left me mostly as a figurehead. Before lady Kasyrra came there were barely even any fights to break up, let alone major conflicts. It was... boring."
        
        Boring? What of the male marefolk and other dangers? 
        
        "Feh. Marefolk, male and female alike, have barely been an issue for years. Half the scouts relish the thought of running into them while out and about. In another few years we may have seen the villages mingling freely. Lady Kasyrra was very supportive of that idea, at least. I'm sure you saw an example of what our union could produce, the one she helped to create? There will be more such developments when we spread our influence through the valley."
        
        This isn't helping. Maybe you can spin the topic toward something useful.
rows.translation:
担任半人马的领袖是什么感觉呢？通过传闻和地区历史，你对这个种族了解了一些大致的情况，但亲耳听别人讲述这些经历，确实挺有意思的。

“嗯，我也不知道你在这里想了解些什么，不过我想，听听别人怎么说总没坏处吧。 如今的情况已经没有那么严峻了。与过去的那些首领们相比，他们当时主要关注战斗策略以及如何保住对山谷的控制权，而现在的状况则使得我基本上只是个象征性的存在。在卡西拉女士到来之前，那里几乎没有什么争斗需要平息，更不用说什么大规模的冲突了。 真是……无聊。”

无聊？那那些雄性马人和其他危险呢？

“哼。这些年来，无论是雄性还是雌性马人，几乎从来都不是什么问题。有一半的侦察兵都盼着在外出时能遇到他们呢。 再过几年，我们或许就能看到那些村庄彼此自由地融合在一起。至少，卡西拉女士是非常支持这个想法的。我相信你们已经看到了我们这种联合所能带来的成果，就是那个她也曾参与创建的例子吧？当我们把我们的影响力扩展到整个山谷时，还会有更多这样的发展出现。这样做并没有帮助。也许你可以把话题转向一些更有意义的内容。
rows.raw:
'
        What's it like being the leader of the centaurs? You know some general things about the race from rumours and regional history, but hearing it first hand is interesting.

        "Hmm, I have no idea what you wish to find here, but I suppose it cannot hurt. Times are much less dire nowadays, and whereas the chieftains of old had much to do with battle tactics and how best to stay in charge of the valley, the current state of things left me mostly as a figurehead. Before lady Kasyrra came there were barely even any fights to break up, let alone major conflicts. It was... boring."
        
        Boring? What of the male marefolk and other dangers? 
        
        "Feh. Marefolk, male and female alike, have barely been an issue for years. Half the scouts relish the thought of running into them while out and about. In another few years we may have seen the villages mingling freely. Lady Kasyrra was very supportive of that idea, at least. I'm sure you saw an example of what our union could produce, the one she helped to create? There will be more such developments when we spread our influence through the valley."
        
        This isn't helping. Maybe you can spin the topic toward something useful.'

rows.original: What's it like being the leader of the centaurs?
rows.translation: 担任半人马的领袖是什么感觉呢？
rows.raw: "What's it like being the leader of the centaurs?"

rows.original:
What of his family? You haven't heard much from Ahmri, given that she didn't know her mother for very long before she left. 

        The Taldahs beast's head tilts ever so slightly to one side. "Hmm, sometimes members of the various tribes in the Far North will travel into the Frost Marches. Most only end up staying for a few months at best, during the deep of winter. My wife was one such visitor. She planned to leave the moment the snows melted, but pregnancy changed her plans. It was funny, watching her complain of the 'heat' as the frost receded," he laughs to himself.
        
        "She used to love swimming in the lake, though. Every time, without fail, she'd tell me about how nice and cool it felt. Even when the water was cold enough to shrivel every part of your body, she would smile and splash. Apparently they don't swim in the Far North, or at least not for fun. The water is cold enough to kill, she said, even for them. But here, she would swim almost daily when she was pregnant. Her fuzz puffed up like a sheep every time she would dry herself."
        
        "The only time she resigned herself to the warmth was when she was sleeping. She refused to sleep apart, even when the summer warmth made her uncomfortable. It was like sleeping with a bonfire some days, or like the fever that accompanies a cold."
        
        It sounds like they got very close. What made her decide to leave again even after all that?
        
        "Decide? She never planned to stay after giving birth, and I knew that full well. She stayed only until Ahmri had weaned from her milk, and set off within the week. I was never confident enough to ask her to stay here then, though it might be different now. Perhaps she will change her mind when lady Kasyrra takes the North."
rows.translation:
他的家人情况如何？由于阿姆里在离开之前与母亲相识的时间并不长，所以我们并没有听到太多关于她的消息。

塔尔达家族的怪物微微将头部偏向一侧，说道：“嗯，有时候远北地区的各个部落会有人前往霜冻之地。 大多数人在最寒冷的冬季里，至多也只能待上几个月而已。我的妻子就是这样的访客之一。她原本打算在雪融化后就离开，但怀孕改变了她的计划。现在回想起来，看着她抱怨霜冻消退后天气“变得太热”，真是挺有意思的，他不禁暗自笑了起来。
        
        不过，她以前很喜欢在湖里游泳。每次她都会告诉我，湖水是多么的清澈凉爽。即使水冷到足以让人的身体变得僵硬，她也会微笑着在水中嬉戏。显然，在极北地区，人们是不会去游泳的，至少不是为了娱乐。她说，那里的水冷到足以致命，即使对当地人来说也是如此。但在这里，她在怀孕期间几乎每天都会去游泳。每次洗完澡后，她身上的细毛都会像羊的毛一样蓬松起来。
        
        唯一让她愿意享受温暖的时候，就是睡觉的时候。即使夏日的炎热让她感到不适，她也拒绝分开睡觉。有时候，这种感觉就像是与篝火同眠，又像是一场感冒伴随的发热。”

听起来他们之间的关系非常亲密。那么，究竟是什么原因让她在经历了这一切之后，还是决定再次离开呢？
        
        决定吗？她生完孩子后根本就没打算留下来，这一点我当时就很清楚。她只是陪着阿姆里喝完奶，然后在一周内就离开了。那时候，我从来都没有勇气要求她留在这里，不过现在情况或许不同了。也许等卡西拉夫人掌控了北方，她就会改变主意吧。

rows.original:
"Certainly! There are so many to choose from, but I'm sure I can peak your interest. Was there anything in particular you wished to hear?"

        Taldahs' seems to be overflowing with ego, but there might be something here you can trip him up with. What kind of story would he be unfamiliar with telling?
rows.translation:
当然！有太多选择，但我相信一定能引起您的兴趣。有没有什么特别的主题您特别想了解呢？”

塔尔达斯的自负之心似乎溢于言表，但或许能找到一些让他措手不及的话题。什么样的故事是他不擅长讲述的呢？
rows.raw:
"
        "Certainly! There are so many to choose from, but I'm sure I can peak your interest. Was there anything in particular you wished to hear?"

        Taldahs' seems to be overflowing with ego, but there might be something here you can trip him up with. What kind of story would he be unfamiliar with telling?"

rows.original: Is there anything more substantial he can tell you about the adventures he had?
rows.translation: 他还能告诉你关于他那些冒险经历的什么更详细的内容吗？
rows.raw: "Is there anything more substantial he can tell you about the adventures he had?"

rows.original: Fuck this. Attacking before you talk Taldahs down will result in the village's corruption. Ahmri will NOT like this, and will probably run.
rows.translation: 去他的。 如果你不先和塔尔达斯商量，就直接攻击他，那么村庄就会陷入腐败之中。阿姆里肯定不会喜欢这样的事情，很可能会离开。
rows.raw: "Fuck this. Attacking before you talk Taldahs down will result in the village's corruption. Ahmri will NOT like this, and will probably run."

rows.original:
"Why? Such things are boring and trite. Each day usually started with picking up fresh bread and fruit for breakfast for Ahmri and I, followed by checking to see if any new travelers had arrived in the village. We get more traders than most parts of the Marches, owing to the valley's hardiness and prolific growing season defying the March chill. Frequent visits from Jassiran traders were common during the summer months. They always used to find excuses to linger when the sun beat down on their home country."

        That sounds more like it. Is that where he learned to read?
        
        "It was, though mostly for Ahmri's sake. After Tiki left I tried to pick up words here and there when the traders came through. My daughter was the better reader by far, and I still need her help with some words. It's also where I picked up most of the tapestries and rugs that line my lodge." The sapphire centaur gestures back to the building behind him.
        
        "After that, I usually end up pretty aimless. Commonly I end up gossiping with the village caregivers or kicking balls around with the children they watch over. It's always much more relaxing than I anticipate."
        
        It sounds like he enjoys it very much.
        
        "I enjoyed every day of it, b-but that does not mean I regret my decisions!"
        
        Hmm. He might not be ready to crack yet, but this is good progress.
rows.translation:
为什么？这种事情既无聊又老套。每天，我通常会先为阿姆里和我准备新鲜的面包和水果当早餐，然后去看看村里是否来了新的旅行者。由于这个山谷气候宜人，生长季节也很长，能够抵御三月的严寒，所以我们这里来的商贩比边境的大部分地区都要多。在夏季，贾西兰的商人们经常会来拜访我们。每当他们家乡烈日当空的时候，他们总会找各种借口在这里多待一会儿。

        这样听起来才对。他就是在那里学会阅读的吧？

“是的，不过主要是为了阿姆里着想。提基离开后，每当有商人经过时，我就会试着学习一些单词。我的女儿阅读能力要强得多，现在有些单词还是需要她的帮助。我屋里那些挂毯和地毯，也是我在那里学会制作方法的。”蓝宝石半人马指了指身后的建筑。
        
        之后，我通常会无所事事地待着。一般来说，我会和村里的看护者们闲聊，或者和他们照看的孩子们一起踢球。这些活动总是比我预想的要轻松得多。”

听起来他真的很喜欢这些活动。
        
        我享受其中的每一天，但那并不意味着我后悔自己的决定！”

嗯，他可能还没有准备好彻底敞开心扉，但这样的进展已经很不错了。

rows.original: This is getting a little off topic. You were more interested in his daily duties than a monologue.
rows.translation: 这有点偏离主题了。你其实更感兴趣的是他的日常职责，而不是他的独白。
rows.raw: "This is getting a little off topic. You were more interested in his daily duties than a monologue."

rows.original:
"Battle tactics! What else would you think? It's up to me to plot out a way to make sure we can safely get into that deathtrap of a village the marefolk call home. They've got the place set up to break our ankles before we can take so much as a step inside. I have so much to think about with my new capabilities. Such traps are meaningless to me now."

        That's really not the path you want to go down right now. You should change the topic, and fast.
rows.translation:
战斗策略！还能有什么别的吗？制定一个方案，确保我们能够安全地进入那些马人称之为家园的死亡陷阱，这完全取决于我。他们把那个地方布置得如此巧妙，以至于我们还没踏进去一步，脚踝就会先被绊住。有了我现在的新能力，有太多事情需要考虑了……对于我来说，这样的陷阱根本毫无意义。”

现在真的不是你该谈论这个话题的时候。你应该尽快换个话题。
rows.raw:
"
        "Battle tactics! What else would you think? It's up to me to plot out a way to make sure we can safely get into that deathtrap of a village the marefolk call home. They've got the place set up to break our ankles before we can take so much as a step inside. I have so much to think about with my new capabilities. Such traps are meaningless to me now."

        That's really not the path you want to go down right now. You should change the topic, and fast."

rows.original: What kind of tactics is he talking about, precisely?
rows.translation: 他具体指的是哪一种策略呢？
rows.raw: "What kind of tactics is he talking about, precisely?"

rows.original:
"Hmm, I don't think I can give you much info there. I once helped a clan of Mecians clear a large boulder that had fallen into one of their burrow's doorways. They lacked not for stamina, but could not get a good enough angle to do much of anything. Me and a handful of foragers pulled with rope while they pushed from behind to roll the rock out of the way. They invited me to dinner, but I couldn't fit through the door, so we had to eat in the foyer! The food was delicious, though." The beast rubs his chin in thought.

        "I can't say much more than that. The other races aren't really a part of my chiefly duties. If specific families require my aid they come asking and usually receive it if we can spare the manpower. I have nothing against any of them."
        
        That's good to hear, though this hasn't really advanced your goal.
rows.translation:
嗯，我想我也没什么信息可以告诉你的。有一次，我帮助一个梅西亚人氏族清理了一块掉在他们洞穴入口处的巨石。他们并不是缺乏体力，而是无法找到合适的角度来处理这块石头。 我和几个采集者们一起用绳子拉，他们则在后面推，终于把那块石头搬开了。他们邀请我共进晚餐，但我实在挤不进门，所以我们就只能在门厅里吃饭！不过，食物确实非常美味。那只野兽若有所思地摸着下巴。

“我也就只能说这些了。其他种族的事情其实并不属于我的主要职责范围。如果有特定的家族需要我的帮助，他们会主动前来请求，而只要我们有人手可用，通常也会帮助他们。 我对他们中的任何一个人都没有意见。”

听到你这么说真是太好了，不过这其实并没有帮助你实现目标。

        That's good to hear, though this hasn't really advanced your goal."

rows.original: What about the other races in the valley? How does he interact with the Mecians and the Sheepfolk for example?
rows.translation: 山谷里的其他种族呢？他与梅西亚人以及羊人族是如何互动的？
rows.raw: "What about the other races in the valley? How does he interact with the Mecians and the Sheepfolk for example?"

rows.original:
"Ah yes, at least once every month or two I receive maybe four letters via the scant few tradesmen who visit the Far North. Imagine if [party.hasCompanions|the companions you travel with deemed it better to send you with only an artist's rendering of their weapons, and nothing else.|a mercenary you hired sent an artist's depiction of himself in his stead.] Surely the image is spectacular to behold, but it is a poor substitute for the real thing. We may have kept in touch all this time, and I would not have her stop. I simply wish to see her again, and will do so once her ladyship's power extends to the North."

        It seems like he's not going to bend on that particular tangent, perhaps something else about his family will be more effective.
rows.translation:
啊，没错，每隔一两个月，我就会收到大概四封来自那些偶尔会来到远北地区的商人的信。想象一下，如果…… [party.hasCompanions|与你一同旅行的同伴们认为，只给你提供他们武器的艺术渲染图，而不再提供其他任何东西，才是更好的选择。|你雇佣的那名雇佣兵竟然派来了一位艺术家，让这位艺术家为自己绘制了画像来代替他本人。] 那画面想必十分壮观，但终究无法替代真实的事物。虽然我们一直保持着联系，我也从未要求她停止这样做。我只是希望能再次见到她，等到她的势力能够延伸到北方的时候，我一定能够如愿以偿。

看来他在这一点上是不会让步的，或许谈谈他家庭的其他事情会更有效果。

        "Ah yes, at least once every month or two I receive maybe four letters via the scant few tradesmen who visit the Far North. rows.original: Hold on a second. You know they've been keeping in touch, Ahmri mentioned letters from her mother and learning to read because of them.
rows.translation: 等一下。你知道他们一直保持着联系，阿姆里还提到过她因为收到了母亲的来信而开始学习阅读。
rows.raw: "Hold on a second. You know they've been keeping in touch, Ahmri mentioned letters from her mother and learning to read because of them."

rows.original:
"But of course! Our first night together could have melted all the snow in the valley. I would not be surprised if my daughter was conceived that very night. Her mother was hardened by the North's harsh conditions, but soft in all the right places."
        
        Ahmri groans and covers her ears, humming to try and get the thought out of her head. 
        
        "The knowledge that we would be apart after her pregnancy was over made us rampant. We were gentle of course, until she was far enough along to return to animalistic roughness. Imagining how it will be now, once we meet again, fills me with nostalgia."
        
        An array of flared sapphire tips spreads from between his legs, dripping with excitement and throbbing with readiness. Perhaps this wasn't the best course of conversation in this instance.
rows.translation:
当然！我们在一起的第一个夜晚，简直让山谷里的积雪都融化了。如果我的女儿就是在那个夜晚怀上的，我一点也不会感到惊讶。她的母亲虽然经历了北方严酷的环境，但在该柔软的地方，她依然柔软如初。阿姆里呻吟着，捂住耳朵，哼着小曲试图把那个念头从脑海中赶走。

“知道她怀孕结束后我们就会分开，这种想法让我们变得疯狂。当然，在她怀孕初期，我们还是表现得比较温柔的；直到她怀孕到了某个阶段，我们的行为才又恢复了那种原始的粗野。 想象着我们再次相见时的情景，心中不禁充满了怀旧之情。”

他双腿之间绽放出一排宝石般闪耀的尖端，那些尖端仿佛充满了兴奋与期待，正在微微颤动。或许，在这种场合下，这种谈话方式并不是最好的选择。

rows.original: He must have been quite the stud to keep her here as long as he did.
rows.translation: 他肯定是个非常了不起的人，才能让她留在自己身边这么久。
rows.raw: "He must have been quite the stud to keep her here as long as he did."

rows.original:
"Pshh. It... It was less than you would think, actually. Thinking back on it, having her here made it easier to deal with. It pulled me out of a slump I had felt for a handful of years beforehand. She made me feel like I was still doing something that mattered. I felt like more than a figurehead for the first time since I became chief. My mother and father had me late in their lives, so I never really got to know them before I grew up. Raising my daughter was nothing like the upbringing I got."
        
        The monster's eyes soften, and his entire demeanor seems to shift to something less threatening. Was there anything hard about it?
        
        "If anything, the first months after her mother left were the hardest on both of us. And her coming of age, of course. I had the village matron help her figure out her heat cycles and other things like that. Those times made me feel less than useless. But even in my inadequacy, she found the time to thank me for finding someone to help her. Even when I did nothing myself, you still felt like I was a hero."
        
        "You've always been like that to me," Ahmri interjects.
        
        A thin network of cracks appears, threading out from the gemstone beasts human chest and [flags.AHMRI_STORIES|connecting with the other cracked lines over his body|searching for a gap to take hold of]. You're close, you can tell!
rows.translation:
哼，其实……其实没你想象中那么复杂。现在回想起来，有她在身边确实让一切变得容易多了。她帮我走出了那些持续了好几年的低谷，让我重新感受到自己还在做一些有意义的事情。 自从担任首领以来，我第一次感觉到自己不仅仅是一个象征性的人物。我的父母在晚年才有了我，因此在我成长之前，我其实并没有真正了解他们。抚养我的女儿，与我的成长经历完全不同。那只怪物的眼神变得柔和起来，它的整个姿态似乎也变得不那么具有威胁性了。其实这有什么难做的吗？

“如果说有什么特别艰难的阶段的话，那应该就是她母亲离开后的最初几个月吧，对我们两个人来说都是非常艰难的时期。 当然，还有她的成年过程。我让村里的老妇人帮她了解自己的生理周期等相关知识。那些时候，让我觉得自己并没有那么无用。但即便在我能力有限的情况下，她还是找时间感谢我，因为是我帮她找到了可以帮助她的人。 即使我什么都没做，你仍然觉得我是个英雄。”

“你对我一直都是这样的，”阿姆里插话道。

一道细密的裂纹网络从那些宝石兽类生物的胸膛处延伸开来…… [flags.AHMRI_STORIES|与他身上那些其他裂开的纹路相连|寻找可以抓住的机会]你已经很接近目标了，这一点很明显！
rows.raw:
'
        "Pshh. It... It was less than you would think, actually. Thinking back on it, having her here made it easier to deal with. It pulled me out of a slump I had felt for a handful of years beforehand. She made me feel like I was still doing something that mattered. I felt like more than a figurehead for the first time since I became chief. My mother and father had me late in their lives, so I never really got to know them before I grew up. Raising my daughter was nothing like the upbringing I got."
        
        The monster's eyes soften, and his entire demeanor seems to shift to something less threatening. Was there anything hard about it?
        
        "If anything, the first months after her mother left were the hardest on both of us. And her coming of age, of course. I had the village matron help her figure out her heat cycles and other things like that. Those times made me feel less than useless. But even in my inadequacy, she found the time to thank me for finding someone to help her. Even when I did nothing myself, you still felt like I was a hero."
        
        "You've always been like that to me," Ahmri interjects.
        
        A thin network of cracks appears, threading out from the gemstone beasts human chest and [flags.AHMRI_STORIES|connecting with the other cracked lines over his body|searching for a gap to take hold of]. You're close, you can tell!'

rows.original: It must have been hard raising Ahmri alone after she left.
rows.translation: 在她离开后，独自抚养Ahmri肯定非常艰难。
rows.raw: "It must have been hard raising Ahmri alone after she left."

rows.original:
"Oh? I like the way you think, outsider. I know just the one. After a long hunt in the summer before Tiki came down from the North, I decided to bathe in a small pool I found in a secluded clearing. The water had an eye catching luster that I took to be the intervention of velun. In reality, the lake itself was a slimy water elemental, lying in wait for just such an occasion. The slime had just reproduced, and needed just a little more energy to nurse the new core into its complete form. The thing transformed itself into the shape of a perfect centaur, swimming in the pool with only the barest hint of her slit visible." The Taldahs beasts form shimmers like liquid as he shivers in remembered anticipation.

        "At the time, that was all the reason I needed. I probably pumped her full of enough fluid to make a whole nother core besides the first. After that I helped her make her way back to the lake. I should visit the water again soon. That slime probably did a lot to influence this form."
        
        Damn, this is only getting him deeper into his current ideals. You'll have to think of something else.
rows.translation:
哦？我喜欢你的思维方式，外来者。我正好知道有这样一个地方。在提基从北方降临之前的那个夏天，经过长时间的寻找，我决定在一个偏僻的空地上找到的一个小水池里沐浴。那里的水有一种令人瞩目的光泽，我以为那是维伦的恩赐。 实际上，这个湖泊本身就是一个黏稠的水元素生物，一直在等待这样的时机。这种黏液生物刚刚完成了繁殖，只需要再获得一点点能量，就能将新的核心培育成完整的形态。于是，它变形成了一个完美的半人马形状，在湖水中游动，只有那微微张开的裂缝略微显露出来。当塔尔达族的那些生物呈现出如同液体般流动的光芒时，他不禁因回忆中的期待而颤抖起来。

“在那个时候，这就是我所需要的全部理由。我大概向她体内注入了足够的液体，这样就能生成第二个核心，而不仅仅是第一个。 之后，我帮她回到了湖边。我应该尽快再去那里看看。那种黏液很可能对这种形态的形成产生了很大的影响。

该死，这只会让他更加坚定自己目前的信念。 你得想别的办法了。

rows.original: How about another tale from his time as chief?
rows.translation: 他担任首领期间的另一个故事，怎么样？
rows.raw: "How about another tale from his time as chief?"

rows.original:
"But of course! Let me think of a story you might like. Ah! Once when I was younger a great scorpion wandered out of the Old Forest and made a nest for itself in one of the northern valley caves, interrupting the worship of a small temple to Sorra. In addition to the other residents of the valley, many people in our village offer prayers to Sorra for the winds to run free in the valley and keep the air fresh and clean."

        You can see why such a thing would be a problem.
        
        "Precisely. I, along with some other members of the village guard, set forth to clear out the beast before it could finish its nest and fill the temple with eggs. Giant scorpions are venomous, of course, but the sting is often the least worrisome factor in a fight. No, it's claws and the fact that it was already holed up in the temple were what had us at a standstill. In such close quarters, the thing acted as its very own bottleneck to keep us from surrounding it."
        
        As he talks, his own metamorphosed tail mimics the motions of a scorpions, following his story unconsciously.
        
        "Any of the back ways were too small for us, and meant for smaller creatures, but even then they were all we needed. One of my fellow guards rolled a barrel of flaming pitch down one of the narrower passageways. Dumb beast didn't even glance at it. Tried to skewer the intruder with its tail without even looking. It sure turned quick when it stabbed a sticky mess of liquid fire. That one second of surprise was enough. It tried to snap at me with a claw as it turned, but with all its focus on its burning tail it probably didn't even see my spear till it was coming out of the gap between its dark eyes. Gods, I still remember the cheers when I dumped the things charred stinger at the gathering stone. Now I could take one of those monsters alone, in my sleep even."
        
        Hmm. It doesn't seem likely you'll find something that changes his mind in this course of tales. Perhaps you should try another.
rows.translation:
当然可以！让我想一个你可能会喜欢的故事吧。啊！记得我年轻的时候，有一次有一只巨大的蝎子从老森林里出来，在北方山谷的一个洞穴里筑起了巢穴，还打扰了一座小寺庙里人们对索拉的祭祀。除了山谷里的其他生物外，我们村里的很多人也会向索拉祈祷，希望风能在山谷中自由流动，让空气保持清新洁净。

        你可以理解为什么这种事情会成为一个问题。

“正是如此。我和村卫队的其他一些成员一起，赶在那种怪物完成它的巢穴建造、在寺庙里产下大量卵之前，将其消灭掉。 巨型蝎子当然具有毒性，但它们的刺伤通常并不是战斗中最令人担忧的因素。真正让我们陷入困境的，是它们的爪子，以及它们早已躲藏在寺庙里的这一事实。在如此狭小的空间里，这些蝎子本身就构成了阻碍，使我们无法包围它们。"
        
        他说话的时候，自己那条已经发生了变化的尾巴会无意识地模仿蝎子的动作，仿佛在配合他讲述故事。

“那些偏僻的小路对我们来说都太狭窄了，那些路本来就是为体型较小的生物设计的，但即便如此，那些路也是我们所需要的全部途径。 我的一位守卫将一桶燃烧的焦油推下了其中一条较狭窄的通道。那头蠢兽甚至没有看一眼。它试图用尾巴刺穿入侵者，却连看都没看一眼。当它的尾巴刺中那团黏稠的火焰时，它的动作确实快得惊人。 那一瞬间的惊慌已经足够了。它在转身时试图用爪子攻击我，但由于它的全部注意力都集中在那条燃烧的尾巴上，直到我的长矛从它那双漆黑的眼睛之间的缝隙中刺出来，它可能才注意到我的存在。 天啊，我至今还记得当初把那些烧焦的怪物残骸扔到聚集石上的时候，人们发出的欢呼声。现在，我甚至能在睡梦中独自去对付那些怪物。
        
        嗯，在这个故事情节中，你似乎不太可能找到什么能改变他主意的东西。或许你应该尝试别的方法。

rows.original: What about a story from his youth, surely he has some tales from before he became chieftain.
rows.translation: 他年轻时的故事怎么样？想必在他成为首领之前，一定有一些有趣的故事吧。
rows.raw: "What about a story from his youth, surely he has some tales from before he became chieftain."

rows.original: "Ahh... F-from then? Let me see... I don't think there was really anything exciting in those times, surely nothing you'd want to have my opinion on." [flags.AHMRI_CHILDHOOD |What about the cooking mishap with the cake for his birthday? Ahmri made it sound very entertaining, but you'd love to hear his side of it. The monster's expression softens, then he rolls his eyes amusedly. "Ahh, that damned cake. I had forgotten about it. I'm sure she undersold just how much batter she'd spilled over the entirety of my lodge. I swear I still smell that sweet scent on occasion, in the cracks in the wood. I felt like I should have been angry, but at the time I could only laugh. The whole lodge was as white as she was! Gods, I had never laughed so hard." That is certainly a bigger spill than Ahmri had mentioned. "I'm sure she only mentioned the one cake. After she spilled the first one she tried again, and again, and... you get the picture. Would that I could go back to those times, find some reason to arrive home early from my daily duties, and help her fail to bake a cake." A splitting crack juts out from the Taldahs beast's belly button, spreading up a few inches toward his chest before stopping. A little more like this and you'll have him right where you need him! |Rats, you don't have any specific examples to ask about. Maybe there's another way to trip him up. ]
rows.translation: 啊……从那以后？让我想想……那时候应该没有什么特别有趣的事情发生吧，肯定没有什么值得我发表意见的事情。 [flags.AHMRI_CHILDHOOD |他生日时做的蛋糕出了什么岔子呢？Ahmri把这件事描述得好像非常有趣一样，但你肯定也很想听听他自己的说法。那个家伙的表情缓和了一些，然后他好笑地翻了个白眼。 “啊，那个该死的蛋糕……我完全把这件事给忘了。我敢肯定，她肯定低估了自己把面糊弄得到处都是的程度…… 全部内容 我发誓，我属于我的团队。我发誓…… 仍然 偶尔，我还能在木头的裂缝中闻到那种甜美的气味。我本应该感到愤怒的，但当时，我只能笑出来。整个小屋都和她一样洁白无瑕！天啊，我真是笑得前仰后合。 这确实是一次比阿姆里所说的更严重的失误。 “我敢肯定，她当时只提到了那一个蛋糕。在第一次失败后，她又尝试了一次又一次……你应该能理解我的意思吧。要是我能回到那些日子，想办法提前完成日常工作，帮她避免再次烤坏蛋糕该多好啊。一道巨大的裂口从塔尔达斯怪物的肚脐处延伸出来，向上延伸了几英寸，最终在靠近胸部的地方停了下来。再这样继续一点，就能把它放到你需要的位置了！ |老鼠们，你们并没有具体的例子可以请教。或许还有其他办法可以让他陷入困境。 ]

rows.original: What about a story from Ahmri's youth?
rows.translation: 讲讲Ahmri年轻时的故事怎么样？
rows.raw: "What about a story from Ahmri's youth?"

rows.original:
This is it. It's time to take on the monster, whether you can talk him down or not.

    "Well? Now that we've talked a bit, have you reached some mystical conclusion? What reason had I to take power, if not to regain the strength of my glory?"
    
    The beast stamps in anticipation, waiting for an excuse to push him in either direction. You swallow your trepidation, staring into his glowing eyes before offering him a disarming smile. For his daughter, of course!
    
    "What?" All the fight seems to drain from Taldahs as he comprehends your words.
    
    Of course that's the reason. The times he talked about her were some of the only times when he sounded relaxed. It makes sense too, his feeling weak. It's not that he wants to relive his glory days, but rather that he feels like he can't keep his daughter safe. Kasyrra was able to delude him into almost giving up his soul with the promise of keeping his daughter safe. 
    
    "I-" 
    
    All the power was for a better future for Ahmri! Maybe at first he even thought he could turn the power around on the demon witch, but underestimated his own tolerance. Either way, you're here now, and it's time for him to make his decision. Protect the daughter he gave everything for, or become an obstacle to her safety.
    
    [var0
        |The sapphire sentinel recoils as if struck, cracks lancing out from his chest to connect with the brief splinters that appeared during your conversation. The great beast seems to shrink before your eyes, toppling to its knees before the crystalline material that makes up its legs crackles and disintegrates.
    
        Where corrupt false-flesh falls away, Ahmri's father is revealed in piecemeal. Beneath the masked shell is the beleaguered face of a middle aged centaur, just starting to gray at the edges of his rich blonde hair. He looks the part of his boastful stories, if a little pale from the lack of sun since he adopted his facade. When his arms are free he begins to actively claw at the remaining patches of deep blue that writhe on his body.
        
        "Get off me, damn you! I'll keep my daughter safe without your lies!" he shouts, stamping the blue clumps as they take worm-like forms and attempt to slither away. The section covering his rump falls away wholesale, the bevy of tentacles racing away like snakes fleeing in every direction. In the end, he's left standing on shaky legs, staring with fresh eyes at the ruined state of his village.
        |The sapphire sentinel narrows its eyes, beginning to take a step toward you before pausing with one hoof in the air. His eyes shoot open wide as a lancing network of cracks issues from the center of his chest, as if he'd been hit by the stone from a catapult. He staggers, but stands, glaring at you as he takes a jerking step forward. It seems like some part of the chieftain is responding to your words. Unfortunately it's not enough to fully free him, but perhaps you can beat him into enough of a stupor that his true self can get through!
    ]
rows.translation:
就是现在了。是时候去面对那个怪物了，不管你能不能说服它。

“那么？既然我们已经聊了这么久，你是不是得出了什么神秘的结论呢？如果我不是为了恢复我昔日的辉煌与力量，那我为什么要夺取权力呢？那只野兽迫不及待地踏着步子，等待着一个机会，将他推向任何一个方向。你强压下心中的恐惧，凝视着它那发光的眼睛，然后露出一个让人放松的微笑。当然，这一切都是为了它的女儿！
    
    什么？”当塔尔达听到你的话时，他身上的所有斗志似乎都瞬间消失了。

当然，这就是原因。他那些谈论她的时刻，也是他唯一显得放松的时候。这也说得通，他的情绪确实很低落。 并不是他想重温过去的辉煌岁月，而是他觉得自己无法保护女儿的安全。卡西拉用承诺会保护他的女儿这一理由，成功欺骗了他，几乎让他放弃了自己的灵魂。 
    
    我——”

所有这些力量，都是为了让阿姆里拥有一个更美好的未来！也许一开始，他甚至认为自己能够利用这些力量来对抗那个恶魔女巫，但他低估了自己的承受能力。无论如何，现在你已经来到了这里，是时候让他做出决定了。 保护他为之付出一切的女儿，否则就会成为威胁她安全的障碍。
    
    [var0
        |那名身着蓝宝石色铠甲的守卫仿佛受到了重击，身体向后仰去，他的胸膛上裂开了裂缝，这些裂缝与你刚才谈话时出现的那些碎片相连。这只巨大的怪物似乎在你眼前逐渐缩小，最终双膝跪地，而构成它腿部的那些晶体物质也开始发出噼啪声，最终逐渐分解消失。
    
        当那些腐朽虚假的外表逐渐脱落时，阿姆里的父亲的面容才逐渐显露出来。在那层伪装的面具之下，是一张饱经风霜的中年半人马的面孔——他那浓密的金发边缘已经开始泛白。他的外貌与自己那些夸夸其谈的故事十分相称，只不过因为长期隐藏真实面目而显得有些苍白。 当他的双臂终于得以自由活动时，他开始拼命抓挠那些还残留在他身上的深蓝色斑块——那些斑块正像蠕虫一样在他的身上扭动。

“从我身上滚开，该死的！没有你的谎言，我也能保护好我的女儿！”他大声喊道，同时狠狠踩踏那些正在试图滑开的蓝色斑块。 他的臀部那一部分完全脱落了，那一丛触手像逃窜的蛇一样四散奔逃。最终，他只能用摇摇欲坠的双腿站立着，用全新的目光凝视着自己村庄所遭受的毁灭。
        |那头蓝宝石色的哨兵眯起了眼睛，正准备向你迈出一步，却突然停住了，一只蹄子悬在半空中。它的双眼猛地睁得大大的，只见一道道裂纹如同箭一般从它的胸膛中央迸发出来，仿佛它被一台弹射装置发射出的石头击中了。 他踉跄着站了起来，瞪着你，然后猛地向前迈出了一步。看来，这位首领的某些部分正在对你的话语产生反应。可惜，这种反应还不足以彻底解放他，但也许你可以把他打昏，让他的真实自我得以显现出来！
    ]

    Of course that's the reason. The times he talked about her were some of the only times when he sounded relaxed. It makes sense too, his feeling weak. It's not that he wants to relive his glory days, but rather that he feels like he can't keep his daughter safe. Kasyrra was able to delude him into almost giving up his soul with the promise of keeping his daughter safe. 
    
    "I-" 
    
    All the power was for a better future for Ahmri! Maybe at first he even thought he could turn the power around on the demon witch, but underestimated his own tolerance. Either way, you're here now, and it's time for him to make his decision. Protect the daughter he gave everything for, or become an obstacle to her safety.
    
    [var0
        |The sapphire sentinel recoils as if struck, cracks lancing out from his chest to connect with the brief splinters that appeared during your conversation. The great beast seems to shrink before your eyes, toppling to its knees before the crystalline material that makes up its legs crackles and disintegrates.
    
        Where corrupt false-flesh falls away, Ahmri's father is revealed in piecemeal. Beneath the masked shell is the beleaguered face of a middle aged centaur, just starting to gray at the edges of his rich blonde hair. He looks the part of his boastful stories, if a little pale from the lack of sun since he adopted his facade. When his arms are free he begins to actively claw at the remaining patches of deep blue that writhe on his body.
        
        "Get off me, damn you! I'll keep my daughter safe without your lies!" he shouts, stamping the blue clumps as they take worm-like forms and attempt to slither away. The section covering his rump falls away wholesale, the bevy of tentacles racing away like snakes fleeing in every direction. In the end, he's left standing on shaky legs, staring with fresh eyes at the ruined state of his village.
        |The sapphire sentinel narrows its eyes, beginning to take a step toward you before pausing with one hoof in the air. His eyes shoot open wide as a lancing network of cracks issues from the center of his chest, as if he'd been hit by the stone from a catapult. He staggers, but stands, glaring at you as he takes a jerking step forward. It seems like some part of the chieftain is responding to your words. Unfortunately it's not enough to fully free him, but perhaps you can beat him into enough of a stupor that his true self can get through!
    ]"
