rows.original: You don't have time for this. You bark at Ahmri to go hide. The old centaur is clearly too corrupt to save, and you should put him out of his misery. Besides, this village will be better off in your hands. "Yes, come straight to me. I'll take both you and my daughter to her ladyship and she'll grant us all the full extent of power the demons have to offer," he laughs, preparing himself for a fight. Like hell he will, maybe if he survives your onslaught you can have him show you where Kasyrra is hiding so you can give her the full extent of your power. "Ha! Perhaps you are right, or perhaps I will keep you as my personal relief," he snipes as his eyes narrow. The color drains out of Ahmri, and she timidly tugs at your arm. "W-wait, I know he's still in there somewhere. It's not too late! It can't be! P-please don't kill him, he's all I have here," She sobs, her voice shaking as she goes quiet. Look, you're sorry, but it's plain to see. If you don't kill him now he's going to catch her and turn her into some kind of equally slimy monster. Can't she see there isn't any humanity left in him? Ahmri deflates as you look her in the eye, fidgeting with her fingers before turning and dashing off into the debris of the village. You'll have to find her afterwards, but for now you have more pressing matters to attend to. Taldah's narrows his eyes when you return your attention to him, and he puffs himself up to look intimidating. [silly|You face the true power of Tall Dan|You're fighting the monstrous form of Taldahs]!

rows.original:
By the time the last of the gunk is vanquished, you're left looking at a much shorter, much less demonic, and much more exhausted-looking male centaur.
    
        Ahmri's father has the look of a man in his prime, or just past it. His human half has the subtly defined muscles of a working man, and he has grays just at the edges of his thick blonde hair. He looks like he should have the same sunkissed tan his daughter has, but his skin is pale, on the verge of sickly. But even as you watch him huff and look toward you, you can see the color start to come back to him. Ahmri practically bowls him over when she tackles into him for a hug.
    
        "Easy, easy girl, I'm still a little sore," he says, patting the sobbing snowball on the back. He smiles weakly in your direction, but his new mirth fades as he takes in the desolate state of his village. "Gods, how blind have I been?"
        
        This ruin was caused by Kasyrra, not him. Under the delusion of her "blessing," he probably thought this would benefit his people, but it's not too late! He was the farthest gone, and if it was not too late to save him, then it's not too late to save the rest of his people, starting with the ones still in the village.
        
        "Aye. I don't know if I'll ever believe my mistake was entirely caused by that demon witch, but I'll most certainly talk some sense into those who followed in my misguided foolery. Come, hero. It would be best if I had you there in case any of them are unconvinced." He gestures, leaning on Ahmri for support as he sets off down the path into the village. You follow close behind, ready to retrace your path through the chaotic jumble.
        
        With less chaos going on in the village, it's easier to gauge just how much damage has been done. Surprisingly, the 'buildings' themselves seem hardly affected by being tossed to the floor or piled into heaps. Aside from the chieftain's hut itself, the majority of buildings seem to be flexible tents designed for easy movement. A great deal of the posts have been snapped like twigs, but it's all repairable. The greater damage comes in the form of personal belongings that have been drug through the dirt or otherwise ransacked and stomped upon. Cloth dolls, shattered mirrors, torn dresses — all harder to replace than a simple tent post.
rows.translation:
当最后一点黏稠物也被清除干净时，你眼前呈现的，是一个体型大大缩小、不再那么凶猛、而是显得疲惫不堪的雄性半人马。

啊姆里的父亲，看起来还像是处于壮年时期，或者刚刚过了那个阶段。 他的人类部分拥有劳动者那种线条分明的肌肉，浓密的金发边缘也泛着灰白。他看起来本应该像女儿一样拥有那健康的古铜色肌肤，但实际上他的皮肤却显得苍白，甚至有些病态。 但当你看到他气呼呼地朝你走来时，你会发现他的脸色已经开始恢复过来。当阿姆里突然扑过来拥抱他时，他差点被她撞倒。
    
        别担心，别担心，姑娘，我还有点疼呢，”他一边说，一边轻拍着那个正在抽泣的小雪球的后背。他朝你的方向虚弱地笑了笑，但当他看到自己村庄的凄凉景象时，那笑容立刻消失了。“天啊，我之前真是太盲目了……这场灾难其实是卡西拉造成的，而不是他。在那种“神恩”的错觉驱使下，他或许以为这样做会对自己的族人有益，但现在还为时不晚！他才是受影响最深的人，如果现在还能拯救他，那么拯救他族人中的其他人也完全来得及，尤其是那些还留在村子里的族人。
        
        是啊。我不知道自己是否能够相信，自己的错误完全是由那个恶魔女巫造成的，但我一定会劝那些跟着我犯下同样愚蠢错误的人认清事实。来吧，英雄。有你在场会更好，万一还有谁不肯相信的话……”他边说边依靠着Ahmri的手臂，沿着小路向村庄走去。你紧随其后，随时准备再次穿过那片混乱的迷宫。
        
        由于村庄里的混乱状况有所减轻，人们也就更容易判断出究竟造成了多大的破坏。令人惊讶的是，那些“建筑物”本身似乎几乎没有受到被推倒或堆成一堆的影响。除了族长的小屋之外，大多数建筑似乎都是为便于移动而设计的可折叠帐篷。 很多帐篷的支柱都被折断了，但这些都是可以修复的。更严重的损失在于个人物品——那些被扔进泥里、遭到破坏或被踩得粉碎的物品。布制玩偶、破碎的镜子、撕破的裙子……这些东西可比一根简单的帐篷支柱要难替换得多。

rows.original:
Taldahs does his best to avoid looking at the wreckage, his jaw set despite obvious fatigue as you approach the field where you fought the unicorn. Sure enough, she's right where you left her, though she seems to have recovered from her wallowing. Her followers still lie in passed out heaps, sleeping off the orgy that grounded them in the first place. She frowns when she sees you coming, talking before she sees who accompanies you.
        
            "Back for more? You could always just admit that you want to give in. I'm certain lady Kasyrra and chieftain... chieftain Taldahs!? B-but, your body," she balks, genuine confusion and worry flashing in her eyes. 
            
            "Is this how you imagined yourself, Genova? This is the fantasy of a naive colt! Where is the beauty I entrusted to nurse the village youth?" Taldahs frowns, gesturing to the unicorn's current appearance. She raises her chin indignantly, not daring to look him in the eye.
            
            "Lady Kasyrra needs me. She said I was fit to breed a conqueror's army," she jeers proudly.
            
            "What she needs from you is your womb! That demon harlot couldn't have children of her own no matter what she wanted. Without other creatures to subjugate, she couldn't make anything more creative than those horrid imps she spawned from our people's seed," Taldahs rebukes. You can see the fight drain out of the unicorn, her pride being replaced with defeated acceptance.
            
            "B-but..." she offers, staring down at her chest as she trails off.
            
            "Nova, come now. This isn't you, and you know it. The witch twisted a desire in your head for something you already had: the village's adoration, and every reason to have it. Come back to us, please," Taldahs pleads. His desperation melts the last of her resistance, and you see the unicorn's form flicker. For a few seconds it flits between light and dark, and then melts away entirely, leaving a very tired-looking centaur matron. She looks almost nothing like the lithe warrior or comely seductress from before, but she does have a certain motherly charm that shines through even the exhaustion.
rows.translation:
塔尔达斯竭力不去看那些残骸，尽管明显很疲惫，但他的下巴依然紧绷着。当你来到你们与那头独角兽交战的场地时，果然，她还在你之前放置她的地方——不过她似乎已经从之前的状态中恢复过来了。她的追随者们仍然昏昏沉沉地躺着，正在从那场导致他们陷入困境的狂欢中恢复过来。当她看到你走过来时，她皱起了眉头，甚至在看清与你同行的人之前就开口说话了。
        
            还想继续吗？你大可以直接承认自己想放弃了。我敢肯定，卡西拉女士和塔尔达斯酋长……塔尔达斯酋长！？可、可你的身体状况……”她结结巴巴地说道，眼中流露出真正的困惑与担忧。

“这就是你想象中的自己吗，杰诺瓦？这不过是一个天真幼稚的少年的幻想罢了！我托付给她去照顾村里的年轻人的，那个美丽的女孩现在在哪里？”塔尔达斯皱着眉头，指着独角兽现在的样子说道。她愤然地抬起下巴，却不敢直视他的眼睛。
            
            卡西拉女士需要我。她说我有能力培育出一支能够征服一切的军队，”她骄傲地宣称。

“她真正需要的其实是你的子宫！那个恶魔般的荡妇无论如何都想自己生孩子，但却无法如愿。既然没有其他生物可以奴役，她就只能从我们人类的种子中培育出那些可怕的半兽人作为替代品，”塔尔达斯严厉地指责道。你可以看到，那头独角兽身上的傲气已经消散，取而代之的，是沮丧与无奈。
            
            但是……”她低着头，声音渐渐变小。

“诺娃，快过来。这不是你真正的样子，你心里也明白这一点。那个女巫在你心中植下了一个欲望——对你已经拥有的东西的渴望：村民们的敬仰，以及拥有这一切的所有理由。 请回到我们身边吧，”塔尔达斯恳求道。他的绝望终于消融了她最后的抵抗，你看到那头独角兽的身影开始闪烁。在短短几秒钟内，它的形象在光明与黑暗之间不断变换，最终彻底消失了，只留下一位看起来疲惫不堪的半人马女长。 她已经完全不同于从前那个身手敏捷的战士或迷人的诱惑者了，但即便在疲惫之下，她依然散发着一种母性的魅力。

rows.original:
"There. More beauty in a single hoof than in the whole of those silly disguises. Perhaps if you keep any of that magic we can see about putting it to good use. Find you something to break the monotony. I trust you can corral these folks while we sort out the rest of the mess?" Taldahs asks after a sigh of relief. Genova gives an amused huff in response, slumping to the ground and leaning against a pair of her sleeping compatriots.

                "That wasn't nearly as bad as I thought. I'm feeling better about this already. If I was the one she sunk her claws deepest into, we shouldn't have much trouble," Taldahs smiles. His spirits seem much higher compared to when you first rescued him.
rows.translation:
看吧，一只蹄子上所蕴含的美，远比那些愚蠢的伪装要丰富得多。或许，如果你能保留那些魔法，我们就能找到好好利用它们的方法。想办法打破这种单调吧。我相信，在我们解决其他问题的同时，你一定能管好这些人，对吧？塔尔达松了口气后问道。热诺瓦则笑着哼了一声，然后瘫倒在地，靠在几位正在睡觉的同胞身上。

“其实并没有我想象中那么糟糕。现在我感觉好多了。 如果我是她最依赖、最依赖的人，我们应该不会遇到太多麻烦吧，”塔尔达斯微笑着说。与你们第一次救他时相比，他的精神状态似乎好多了。

rows.original:
As you approach the entrance to the village, the bondage-clad centaur from before is still tied much as you left her, investigating a patch of dirt by scratching at it with a hoof. She half-glances up at your approach, and then jolts to attention, her eyes wide as she recognizes who you're walking with.

                    "Eubicha? My dear woman, what have they done to you? How could I let that conniving mage shackle one of my subjects like a common animal?" Taldahs laments, his hands clenching into fists. The bound centaur, Eubicha assumedly, shakes her head in concern at first. She glances at you momentarily and then instantly changes, nodding vigorously enough to show off her deep brown eyes and acting very much like her restraints are on against her will.
rows.translation:
当你接近村庄的入口时，那个之前被绑着的半人马依然保持着你离开时的样子，用蹄子刨着地上的那块泥土。她偶尔抬头瞥见你的方向，然后突然警觉起来，当她认出与你同行的人是谁时，她的双眼顿时睁得大大的。

                    尤比查？我亲爱的女人，他们对你做了什么？我怎么能让那个阴险的法师把我的子民当作普通动物一样束缚起来呢？”塔尔达斯悲痛地喊道，双手紧紧握成拳头。那个被捆绑着的半人马——想必就是尤比查——起初似乎也在担忧地摇着头。 她短暂地瞥了你一眼，随即立刻改变了态度，用力地点头，那深棕色的眼睛在阳光下闪闪发光，她的举止仿佛是在违抗自己的意愿，强忍着某种束缚般行动着。
rows.raw:
'
                    As you approach the entrance to the village, the bondage-clad centaur from before is still tied much as you left her, investigating a patch of dirt by scratching at it with a hoof. She half-glances up at your approach, and then jolts to attention, her eyes wide as she recognizes who you're walking with.

                    "Eubicha? My dear woman, what have they done to you? How could I let that conniving mage shackle one of my subjects like a common animal?" Taldahs laments, his hands clenching into fists. The bound centaur, Eubicha assumedly, shakes her head in concern at first. She glances at you momentarily and then instantly changes, nodding vigorously enough to show off her deep brown eyes and acting very much like her restraints are on against her will.'

rows.original:
Taldahs undoes the equine-themed bondage gear in short order, freeing her arms first so she can help with the rest. If you didn't explicitly know better, you'd think she'd felt tortured with how dramatically she tears away the bit from between her teeth. The lie shows in the subtleties, though. She stops just short of tossing the whole halter to the ground, instead stuffing it into one of the rubber saddle's pouches before gingerly dropping the whole apparatus to the ground.

                        "There! We have our work cut out for us, but I'm sure things can get back to some semblance of normal. All that's left now is... the rest of my people," Taldahs sighs, looking through the narrow ravine entrance toward the valley as a whole.
                        
                        "Come, champion. I may not be able to run if they don't listen, but I'm certain to buy you some time."
rows.translation:
塔尔达很快解开了那些以马为主题的束缚装备，首先解开了她的手臂，这样她就能帮忙解开其他的束缚了。如果你不是事先知道真相的话，一定会以为她是在忍受极大的痛苦，才会那样用力地将咬在牙齿间的嚼子扯掉。 不过，这个谎言在细节上还是暴露了出来。她并没有把整个缰绳扔到地上，而是将其塞进了橡胶马鞍的一个口袋里，然后小心翼翼地将整个装置放到了地上。

                        看吧，我们面前还有许多工作要做，但我相信一切最终都会恢复到正常的状态。现在剩下的，就是……找到我的其他同伴了。”塔尔达斯叹息着，透过狭窄的峡谷入口望向整个山谷。
                        
                        来吧，冠军。如果他们不听我的话，我可能无法逃跑，但我一定能为你争取一些时间。

rows.original:
It doesn't take long for the centaur warband to find you. Another hour and you wouldn't have even reached Taldahs before they arrived. A hundred or so centaur warriors, mostly males but with a good number of women, march over the hills. Each one stops short when they see their chieftain waiting at the gates.

                            "People of the harvest tribes, since when do accursed witches and arrogant mages order us about like brainless fools? Have we forgotten the last time mages experimented so heavily with the state of the world? Our ancestors would be sick." The wall of sneering faces wilts as Taldahs speaks, raised weapons drooping or returning to their holsters. 
                            
                            "But they could not fully break me, as this young hero made me realize, and they'll not break our people while I stand. Now come! Much has happened in my stupor, and we will be needing our homes back in livable order!" Taldahs shouts in a booming voice that belies his exhaustion. He turns round to return to the village, fully expecting the horde to join him. To your surprise, nearly every centaur does. Many of those who do begin to turn lose heart when they see how many of their fellows are excitedly returning to the village. In fact, most look relieved as they follow their leader through the large wooden gates. Of the few who do leave, most are wearing cultist regalia or following others who are.
rows.translation:
半人马战团没用太长时间就找到了你。再晚一个小时，等你赶到塔尔达斯的时候，他们早就到了。大约有一百名半人马战士，其中大部分是男性，但也有一些女性。他们翻过山丘赶了过来。当每个人都看到自己的首领正在城门口等候时，他们都停下了脚步。

                            收获部落的同胞们，从什么时候起，那些该死的女巫和傲慢的法师就开始像指挥没有头脑的傻瓜一样对我们发号施令了？我们难道已经忘记上一次法师们对世界秩序进行如此大规模的干预了吗？我们的祖先要是知道了，一定会感到愤怒的。”当塔尔达斯说出这些话时，那些充满讥讽的面孔立刻收敛了起来，举起的武器也都纷纷放下了，或者被收进了枪套。 
                            
                            但他们无法彻底击垮我，因为这位年轻的英雄让我明白了这一点——只要我还在，他们就无法伤害我们的人民。现在，让我们行动吧！在我陷入昏迷的这段时间里，发生了许多事情，我们必须尽快让我们的家园恢复到可以居住的状态！”塔尔达斯用充满力量的声音喊道，尽管他的声音中透露出疲惫之情。 他转身准备返回村庄，满心期待着那些半人马会跟随着他。令他惊讶的是，几乎所有的半人马都跟上了他。然而，当那些跟上的半人马看到有这么多同伴正兴奋地返回村庄时，他们中的许多人开始感到灰心失望。 事实上，当他们跟随领导者穿过那扇巨大的木门时，大多数人看起来都松了一口气。在那些选择离开的人中，大多数要么穿着邪教徒的服饰，要么是在跟随其他同样穿着此类服饰的人。

rows.original:
As soon as the returning procession makes it back into the village, Taldahs begins dividing them into teams to restore the many wrecked tents that make up the village. A subset of the warband is devoted to fetching lumber from the valley to replace the supports and splintered posts that currently stand. Some are fixable, but most will need to be entirely replaced. 

                                Much of the canvas that makes up the tents seems to be in decent condition, barring places where they were pierced by breaking supports. A trio of splendid centaur seamstresses [silly|(say that ten times fast) ]work to convert the unsalvageable lengths of tenting into patches for those that have less damage. They work with surprising swiftness and efficacy, flying through their work with excited diligence. 
                                
                                While the rest of the village is in the midst of the hustle and bustle, you [party.som||and [companion1.name]|and your allies] assist Taldahs and Ahmri with cleaning up the large matron's hut near the village entrance. It's where the centaurs whose homes aren't fixed before the workers grow tired will be sleeping. It doesn't take long to clear the building, with most of the effort going to pure cleanup. 
                                
                                Once you've finished clearing out the matron's tent, you split off from the main group to assist with sifting through the discarded belongings of centaurs who didn't go along with the corrupted plots. You learn that the cult orchestrated much of the ransacking, though admittedly the villagers who became the warband were caught up in the fervor and didn't question things.
                                
                                [party.has cait|Cait takes over babysitting some of the younger taurs so their parents can help with the reconstruction. You see her heft a foal off the ground and princess carry her in a short circle while other toddlers flock around her legs. Later, she playfully tips another child on his side, blowing a raspberry into his fluffy flanks and tickling his belly till he nearly passes out from laughter.]
                                
                                [party.has atugia|Atugia helps with babysitting and woodcutting all at once, letting the young centaurs give her head horseback rides while her body chops wood. Each time she finishes chopping a log, she pauses to chase down whichever one has her noggin in tow. The toddlers scream with delight as she tackles them to the ground and tickles them all over, giving her head to the next kid nearby. Her body has no trouble chopping the wood with perfect accuracy, even while her head has no line of sight to what she's doing.]
                                
                                [party.has azyrran|Azzy looks after some of the smaller centaurs, staking her spear in the ground and letting the little ones tire themselves out by running races around it to return to her. She starts off giving the winners tiny honey candies, but after enough running and exhausted-hungry looks even the slower foals get a treat. In addition, each one gets [azzy.kdb|a celebratory double hi-five|a rough hair ruffle|a big ol' hug of congratulation].]
                                
                                [party.has brienne|Brienne sits awkwardly as tired centaur toddlers snuggle up against her and fall asleep. At first it's just one, curled up in her lap, but more and more of them join the pile as the day's activities tucker them out. The next time you look, she's all but buried in fuzzy cuddlers. She gives an exasperated sigh when she sees you looking, but smiles when you laugh at her predicament.]
                                
                                [party.has brint|Brint assists with building, hauling the felled trees that are brought back to a more organized pile. From there, the craftsmen cut and carve the wood into the posts and support structures they need for repairs. When the stacks get high enough, Brint helps chop the trees into manageable sections. With both him and the centaurs working, the tasks get done with expert swiftness.]
                                
                                [party.has etheryn|The seamstresses delight in scooping Ryn up into the mess of sewing patches. She's... not very good at it, but that doesn't seem to deter her from trying to help them. After enough pricks on her fingers, one of the centaurs scoots up behind her, guiding her hands with the kind of grace only a long-time teacher could manage. The consternation drains out of Ryn's brow, and you see her face light up as her patches begin to look more like a finished product than a novice's failures. Sure, she's being held along the way, but it doesn't seem to bother her in the slightest.]
                                
                                [party.has arona|Arona wields the centaurs' woodcutting maul like a fell lumberjack, cleanly splitting logs at twice the rate of her competition. She grins wide when she sees you staring, flexing her biceps with the axe over her shoulders. Pride exudes from her every pore, at least until the maul's wooden handle splinters and snaps in half. She barks out an apology through tears of laughter, but luckily the other woodcutters find it just as hilarious as she does.] 
                                
                                [party.has berwyn|Berwyn takes a seat near a smoothed stump, reading from a book while his stone golem hoists entire trees two at a time to carry them as they arrive at the village gates. You catch his eye after it completes one such round trip, cocking an eyebrow. He gives you an exaggerated stretch in response, lounging back against his backrest and tilting his hat down. Well, at least he's technically helping. The elemental makes the transportation process go multitudes faster than it otherwise would.]
                                
                                [party.has kiyoko|Kiyoko assists the seamstresses in repairing tents. She matches their work with surprising, or perhaps unsurprising, speed. Maybe the first two patches are noticeable, but she watches the centaurs do their work and by the third time she makes much of the canvas look newly made. The other women look in surprise, offering awed praise. She grins proudly when she sees you appraising her work, her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails flitting about behind her.]
                                
                                [party.has viviane|Viviane joins you in sifting. The witch, true to her nature, uses her magic to pick through everything. She's methodical in her work, too, and uses her years of experience in the matter to sort through the items with a mindless focus and efficiency that you rarely see from her.]

                                That night, you sleep in the matron's hut, surrounded by the warmth of an entire village of centaurs. Those whose tents were restored busy themselves with making the new structures home again, but there are still thirty or so centaurs sharing the spacious bedding of the much larger tent. Still, a staggering amount of work got done in such a small amount of time. As consciousness fades, you think about what the village will look like, and if it will be anything like it was before.
rows.translation:
当返回的队伍重新回到村庄后，塔尔达斯立即开始将他们分成几个小组，以便修复那些被毁坏的帐篷，从而恢复村庄的正常面貌。其中有一部分人被派去山谷中采集木材，用来替换那些目前还在使用的支撑架和断裂的柱子。 有些问题是可以解决的，但大多数情况下，这些部件都需要被完全更换。

构成帐篷的帆布大部分看起来状况还不错，只有那些被损坏的支撑结构刺穿的地方除外。 三位技艺高超的半人马裁缝 [silly|快说十遍！ ]他们努力将那些无法修复的帐篷残片重新利用，为那些受损程度较小的帐篷制作补丁。他们的动作出奇地迅速而高效，满怀热情地投入到工作中去。

而此时，村里的其他人都还在忙碌着，你…… [party.som||以及 [companion1.name]|以及你的盟友们] 帮助塔尔达斯和艾姆里清理村庄入口附近的那间大房子。那些那些住所尚未修缮完毕、等工人忙完活后还没有地方住的半人马们，就会在那里睡觉。清理这间房子并不需要花费太多时间，大部分工作其实只是简单的打扫而已。 
                                
                                当你完成清理女主持人的帐篷后，你便从主队中分离出来，协助整理那些没有参与那些邪恶阴谋的半人马们丢弃的物品。你发现，这场劫掠活动在很大程度上是那个邪教组织策划的；不过也必须承认，那些后来加入了战帮的村民们也被这种狂热情绪所影响，根本没有质疑这些事情的真实性。
                                
                                [party.has cait|凯特负责照看一些年幼的牛犊，这样它们的父母就可以帮忙进行重建工作。你会看到她把一只小牛犊从地上抱起来，公主则在一旁带着它绕着圈子走动，而其他的小孩则围在她脚边玩耍。后来，她还开玩笑地把另一个孩子推倒在地，对着他那柔软的侧腹吹气，挠他的肚子，把他逗得几乎笑得晕过去。]
                                
                                [party.has atugia|阿图吉亚既能帮忙照看孩子，又能进行伐木工作。小半人马们可以骑在她的头上玩耍，而她的身体则负责砍伐木材。每当她砍完一根原木，就会停下来去追那些骑在她头上的小家伙们。当她把它们捉到地上并挠它们痒痒时，那些幼小的半人马们会开心地尖叫起来；然后她又会把头部让给附近的其他孩子。尽管她的头部无法看到自己正在做什么，但她的身体依然能够准确无误地完成伐木任务。]
                                
                                [party.has azyrran|阿齐负责照顾那些体型较小的半人马们。她把长矛插在地上，让这些小家伙们围绕长矛奔跑来消耗体力，然后才回到她身边。起初，她只会给那些跑得最快的半人马们一些小小的蜂蜜糖果作为奖励，但经过一段时间的奔跑后，那些跑得慢一些的半人马们也因为跑得累而饿了，于是它们也都得到了奖励。此外，每一个半人马都会…… [azzy.kdb|一场庆祝性的双击掌|一阵凌乱的毛发骚动|一个热情洋溢的祝贺拥抱].]
                                
                                [party.has brienne|布蕾妮尴尬地坐着，那些疲惫的半人马幼崽一个个依偎在她身边睡着了。一开始只有一只蜷缩在她的腿上，但随着一天的活动让它们越来越疲惫，越来越多的半人马幼崽加入了这个“队伍”。下次你再看时，她几乎被这些毛茸茸的“小家伙”埋住了。当你看到她这个样子时，她会无奈地叹了口气；但当你因为她的处境而发笑时，她又会露出笑容。]
                                
                                [party.has brint|布林特协助进行木材的搬运工作，将那些被砍下来的树木整理成整齐的堆放。随后，工匠们会将这些木材切割成所需的柱子和其他支撑结构，用于维修工作。当这些木材堆得足够高时，布林特会帮忙把它们切成便于处理的段。在布林特和半人马们的共同努力下，这些任务总是能够以极其高效的方式完成。]
                                
                                [party.has etheryn|那些缝纫女工们都很乐意让瑞恩参与到补缝的工作中。她……其实并不擅长这个活计，但这一点似乎并没有阻止她想要帮忙。在她的手指被针扎了好几次之后，其中一位半人马走到她身后，以只有经验丰富的老师才能拥有的那种娴熟手法，引导她的双手进行操作。 瑞恩脸上的忧虑渐渐消失了，你可以看到她的表情变得明亮起来，因为她那些拼凑起来的作品开始看起来更像是一件完成品，而不是一个初学者的拙劣尝试。当然，在这个过程中她得到了一些帮助，但这一点似乎丝毫没有影响到她。]
                                
                                [party.has arona|阿罗娜像一位熟练的伐木工一样挥舞着半人马的伐木斧，切割原木的速度是其他人的两倍。当你看到她盯着你看时，她咧开嘴笑了起来，将斧头扛在肩上，展示着自己强健的二头肌。她的脸上洋溢着自豪之情，至少在斧头的木柄突然裂开、断成两截之前都是如此。她含着笑意道歉，但幸运的是，其他伐木工们也觉得这件事非常有趣。] 
                                
                                [party.has berwyn|伯温坐在一根被打磨光滑的树桩旁，一边看书，一边指挥他的石像鬼一次搬运两棵整树，将这些树木运送到村庄的入口处。当石像鬼完成这样一次运输任务后，你的目光被他吸引了，他挑了挑眉毛。作为回应，他也夸张地伸了个懒腰，靠在椅背上，把帽子往下拉了拉。嗯，至少从技术上来说，他确实在提供帮助——这种由元素力量驱动的运输方式，让整个过程的速度快了无数倍。]
                                
                                [party.has kiyoko|清子协助女裁缝们修补帐篷。她以惊人的速度完成自己的工作，这种速度或许并不令人意外。刚开始缝制的两个补丁确实有些显眼，但当她观察那些半人马们工作的过程后，到第三次修补时，她已经让大部分帆布看起来就像是新做的那样。其他女人们都惊讶地看向她，纷纷赞不绝口。当你看到她对自己的工作感到自豪时，她也露出了骄傲的笑容。 [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] 她的尾巴在身后不停地摆动着。]
                                
                                [party.has viviane|薇薇安也加入了你们的筛选工作。这位女巫秉承着她的天性，运用魔法来仔细检查每一件物品。她的工作方式也非常有条理，凭借自己多年积累的经验，以一种你很少见到的专注与高效来整理这些物品。]

                                那个夜晚，你睡在女主持人的小屋里，周围环绕着整个半人马村庄的温暖。那些帐篷被修复的人们正忙着把新搭建的住所重新布置成适合居住的地方，不过仍有大约三十头半人马共享着那顶宽敞的大帐篷。尽管如此，在如此短的时间内，他们还是完成了大量的工作。当意识逐渐模糊时，你开始思考这个村庄未来会变成什么样子，以及它是否还会恢复到以前的模样。

It's where the centaurs whose homes aren't fixed before the workers grow tired will be sleeping. It doesn't take long to clear the building, with most of the effort going to pure cleanup. 
                                
                                Once you've finished clearing out the matron's tent, you split off from the main group to assist with sifting through the discarded belongings of centaurs who didn't go along with the corrupted plots. You learn that the cult orchestrated much of the ransacking, though admittedly the villagers who became the warband were caught up in the fervor and didn't question things.
                                
                                [party.has cait|Cait takes over babysitting some of the younger taurs so their parents can help with the reconstruction. You see her heft a foal off the ground and princess carry her in a short circle while other toddlers flock around her legs. Later, she playfully tips another child on his side, blowing a raspberry into his fluffy flanks and tickling his belly till he nearly passes out from laughter.]
                                
                                [party.has atugia|Atugia helps with babysitting and woodcutting all at once, letting the young centaurs give her head horseback rides while her body chops wood. Each time she finishes chopping a log, she pauses to chase down whichever one has her noggin in tow. The toddlers scream with delight as she tackles them to the ground and tickles them all over, giving her head to the next kid nearby. Her body has no trouble chopping the wood with perfect accuracy, even while her head has no line of sight to what she's doing.]
                                
                                [party.has azyrran|Azzy looks after some of the smaller centaurs, staking her spear in the ground and letting the little ones tire themselves out by running races around it to return to her. She starts off giving the winners tiny honey candies, but after enough running and exhausted-hungry looks even the slower foals get a treat. In addition, each one gets [azzy.kdb|a celebratory double hi-five|a rough hair ruffle|a big ol' hug of congratulation].]
                                
                                [party.has brienne|Brienne sits awkwardly as tired centaur toddlers snuggle up against her and fall asleep. At first it's just one, curled up in her lap, but more and more of them join the pile as the day's activities tucker them out. The next time you look, she's all but buried in fuzzy cuddlers. She gives an exasperated sigh when she sees you looking, but smiles when you laugh at her predicament.]
                                
                                [party.has brint|Brint assists with building, hauling the felled trees that are brought back to a more organized pile. From there, the craftsmen cut and carve the wood into the posts and support structures they need for repairs. When the stacks get high enough, Brint helps chop the trees into manageable sections. With both him and the centaurs working, the tasks get done with expert swiftness.]
                                
                                [party.has etheryn|The seamstresses delight in scooping Ryn up into the mess of sewing patches. She's... not very good at it, but that doesn't seem to deter her from trying to help them. After enough pricks on her fingers, one of the centaurs scoots up behind her, guiding her hands with the kind of grace only a long-time teacher could manage. The consternation drains out of Ryn's brow, and you see her face light up as her patches begin to look more like a finished product than a novice's failures. Sure, she's being held along the way, but it doesn't seem to bother her in the slightest.]
                                
                                [party.has arona|Arona wields the centaurs' woodcutting maul like a fell lumberjack, cleanly splitting logs at twice the rate of her competition. She grins wide when she sees you staring, flexing her biceps with the axe over her shoulders. Pride exudes from her every pore, at least until the maul's wooden handle splinters and snaps in half. She barks out an apology through tears of laughter, but luckily the other woodcutters find it just as hilarious as she does.] 
                                
                                [party.has berwyn|Berwyn takes a seat near a smoothed stump, reading from a book while his stone golem hoists entire trees two at a time to carry them as they arrive at the village gates. You catch his eye after it completes one such round trip, cocking an eyebrow. He gives you an exaggerated stretch in response, lounging back against his backrest and tilting his hat down. Well, at least he's technically helping. The elemental makes the transportation process go multitudes faster than it otherwise would.]
                                
                                [party.has kiyoko|Kiyoko assists the seamstresses in repairing tents. She matches their work with surprising, or perhaps unsurprising, speed. Maybe the first two patches are noticeable, but she watches the centaurs do their work and by the third time she makes much of the canvas look newly made. The other women look in surprise, offering awed praise. She grins proudly when she sees you appraising her work, her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails flitting about behind her.]
                                
                                [party.has viviane|Viviane joins you in sifting. The witch, true to her nature, uses her magic to pick through everything. She's methodical in her work, too, and uses her years of experience in the matter to sort through the items with a mindless focus and efficiency that you rarely see from her.]

                                That night, you sleep in the matron's hut, surrounded by the warmth of an entire village of centaurs. Those whose tents were restored busy themselves with making the new structures home again, but there are still thirty or so centaurs sharing the spacious bedding of the much larger tent. Still, a staggering amount of work got done in such a small amount of time. As consciousness fades, you think about what the village will look like, and if it will be anything like it was before.
                                
                                "

rows.original: You awake to the smell of baking bread and the subtle scent of honey. Rubbing the sleep from your eyes, you see a pair of centaur bakers handing out chunks of the stuff: handmade loaves with a thin spread of raw honey. You take a piece when offered, relishing the savory-sweet taste as you rise and stretch. It would seem work has started without you! Already, the village looks like a place people live rather than a scattering of rubble. People mill about in the village square, setting up places of business and offering encouragement to the builders restoring the last few sections of town. You seek out Taldahs and find him at the edge of the village, assisting with the final curve of the construction. A touch of the haggard exhaustion from before is still visible, but the difference last night's sleep made is unmistakable. Seeing you, he rises from clearing dirt for a post, joining you on the walking path while another centaur takes his place. "I never got the chance to thank you, but I don't think something so simple would convey how much I mean it," he says, looking out over the finished work of the last twenty-four hours. "So I'm throwing a party." You cock an eyebrow at the suddenly jovial centaur patriarch. Not that you [pc.dcb|don't appreciate a party|don't think it's a good idea|don't want to be a part of an awesome horsey party], but is it really the first thing he wants to do after such a difficult situation? "I would be straight up lying if I said the party was even mostly for your benefit. My people are swift to change their minds, but we need reason to stay content. I shudder to think of how things would have gone if that terrifying woman had stayed to keep us in line. Things might have gone differently," he says, shaking a shiver of disgust out of his arms before returning to his bright smile. "No. We have much to celebrate, so celebrate we will! You are one such thing, but fear not, for in revelry we are all equal. If dancing does not stoke your passions, then perhaps a feast? The cooks and bakers are itching to provide something more wholesome than a spitroast of beast meat," he continues. [pc.dcb|A party where you're being celebrated, with not only dancing but a feast as well? He drives a hard bargain, but you might be able to find time.|All of that makes you sound far too important for someone who was just doing the right thing, but if he insists, you suppose you can stay for a feast.|Hold on. So, like, just, he's really telling you right now that all these horsies not only love you, but they want to have a big ol' party for you with dancing and food!? Heck yessssss you'll be there!] "Perfect! But there is still some work left to do. Preparation as well, if we are to make this a party worth remembering..." The gruff centaur is already lost in thoughts of party planning, and you can see the excitement spreading through the crowd. As the afternoon rears its head, you watch the construction continue all the way to its conclusion. An immediate roar of cheers starts up when the final tarp is strung to its posts, so full of delight that you feel your spirits lifting from being there to witness it. Besides a few scorch marks that are swiftly being erased by footprints, and maybe the odd splinter, the village looks nothing like it did the morning before. Many workers look exhausted from the effort, but news of the revelry perks them up enough to obliterate the tired looks. Everyone wants to be a part of breaking in the new village. The space that had been cleared for the fighting arena has been repurposed into a village square of sorts, with a newly lit bonfire blazing in the center. Stronger than the heady scent of burning wood is the sweet smell of pastries, enough of them to feed the village twice over. The party is about to begin! Though... something is missing. There are far too many pastries here for Ahmri to not be all about it. In fact, you haven't seen her all day. You should probably check up on her, but then she's probably just getting used to having her life back.
rows.translation: 你醒来时，闻到了正在烘烤的面包香气以及淡淡的蜂蜜味。揉了揉睡眼，你看到一对半人半马的面包师正在分发那些面包：那些都是手工制作的面包，表面还涂了一层新鲜的蜂蜜。有人递给你一块，你接过来，一边享用那香甜可口的味道，一边伸了个懒腰。看来，即使你没有参与，工作也已经开始了！ 如今，这个村庄已经完全恢复了它作为人类居住地的面貌，而不是那一片片废墟。人们在村庄的广场上忙碌着，纷纷摆摊经营，同时也鼓励那些正在修复城镇剩余部分的施工者们继续努力。 你找到了塔尔达斯，发现他正在村庄的边缘帮忙完成最后的施工工作。虽然他身上仍能看出之前那种疲惫的神情，但昨晚的睡眠显然让他精神状态有了明显的改善。 看到你后，他便停止了清理柱子基座的工作，来到小路上与你会合，而另一位半人马则接替了他原来的工作。 我从来没有机会感谢你，但我觉得，再简单的话语也无法表达我内心的感激之情，”他说着，望着过去二十四小时里完成的这些工作。“所以，我打算举办一个派对。” 你不禁挑了挑眉毛，看着这个突然变得如此开朗的半人马族长。其实，你并不…… [pc.dcb|不喜欢参加聚会|我觉得这不是个好主意。|不想成为这场热闹非凡的马术派对的一部分]但在经历了这样的困境之后，这真的是他最想做的事情吗？ “如果我说这次聚会主要是为了你的利益，那我就是在撒谎。 我的族人很容易改变主意，但我们需要理由才能保持满足。一想到如果那个可怕的女人留下来管束我们，事情会变成什么样，我就不寒而栗——结果可能会完全不同。”他说着，身体不由自主地颤抖着，仿佛在驱散内心的厌恶，随后又恢复了那灿烂的笑容。 不，我们有很多值得庆祝的事情，所以我们就庆祝吧！你也是其中之一，不过别担心，在欢乐的聚会中，我们都是平等的。如果跳舞不能激发你的热情，那么或许一场盛宴会更适合你？厨师和面包师们都非常乐意准备一些比烤肉更美味的食物。”他继续说道。 [pc.dcb|一个专门为你举办的庆祝派对，不仅有舞蹈表演，还有丰盛的美食？他提出的条件确实有些苛刻，但你应该还是能找到时间的。|所有这些话听起来，对于一个只是在做自己应该做的事的人来说，你未免太重要了……不过既然他坚持邀请，我想你还是可以去参加这场宴会的吧。|等一下。所以，他的意思其实是，这些马不仅非常喜欢你，而且还想为你举办一场盛大的派对。 舞蹈 以及 食物!? 太棒了，你一定能成功的！] 太好了！不过还有一点…… 一些 还有许多工作要做，准备工作也同样重要，如果我们想让这次聚会成为值得纪念的经历的话……这个粗犷的半人马已经开始思考如何策划这场聚会了，你可以看到人群中渐渐弥漫起来的兴奋气氛。随着下午时间的到来，你看到施工工作一直在持续进行，最终终于完成了。 当最后一块防水布被挂到柱子上时，人群中立刻爆发出一阵欢呼声，那种喜悦之情如此强烈，以至于你在现场目睹这一幕时，也会感到自己的心情为之一振。除了那些被脚步踩得很快就被抹掉的烧焦痕迹，以及偶尔出现的木刺外，这个村庄已经完全变了样，与前一天的样子截然不同。许多工人看起来因为劳累而疲惫不堪，但听到关于这场庆祝活动的消息后，他们的脸上立刻露出了欢欣的神情，那些疲惫的神情瞬间消失了。每个人都想成为这个新村庄诞生过程中的一部分。 原本为战斗竞技场腾出的空间，现在被改成了一个类似村庄广场的地方，中间燃着一堆新点燃的篝火。比起燃烧木头散发出的浓烈气味，更令人陶醉的是那些香甜可口的糕点——数量之多，足以让整个村庄的人吃上两顿。派对马上就要开始了！ 不过……似乎少了点什么。这里的糕点实在太多了，Ahmri肯定不可能对它们视而不见。事实上，你一整天都没见到她。或许应该去看看她，不过她应该只是在重新适应自己的生活吧。

rows.original: Find Ahmri. She deserves this party as much as you do.
rows.translation: 找到阿姆里。她和你们一样，都值得参加这个派对。
rows.raw: "Find Ahmri. She deserves this party as much as you do."

rows.original: You're sure Ahmri will be just fine. She's probably feeling overwhelmed by all the sudden changes, and she might get the wrong impression if you come rushing to %"save" her. You're sure you'll be seeing her plenty in the future. For now you enjoy the party, dancing and singing with [party.solo|the centaurs in their first hours of freedom.|your friends in the centaurs' first hours of freedom.] The festivities go on well into the night, but eventually even the centaurs' collective stamina runs dry. Now that the party's over, you can return to your quest at your leisure, only with one less army of centaurs to worry about!
rows.translation: 你确定Ahmri会没事的。她可能只是因为这些突如其来的变化而感到不知所措，如果你急着去“拯救”她，反而可能会让她产生误解。你相信以后还有很多机会见到她，所以现在就好好享受这场派对，和大家一起跳舞、唱歌吧。 [party.solo|那些在获得自由后的最初几个小时里……|在半人马们获得自由的最初时刻，你们就是他们的朋友。] 庆祝活动一直持续到深夜，但最终就连半人马的体力也耗尽了。现在派对已经结束，你可以随时继续你的任务了——只不过再也不用担心会有半人马军队来打扰你了吧！
rows.raw: "\n                                        You're sure Ahmri will be just fine. She's probably feeling overwhelmed by all the sudden changes, and she might get the wrong impression if you come rushing to %\"save\" her. You're sure you'll be seeing her plenty in the future. For now you enjoy the party, dancing and singing with [party.solo|the centaurs in their first hours of freedom.|your friends in the centaurs' first hours of freedom.] The festivities go on well into the night, but eventually even the centaurs' collective stamina runs dry. Now that the party's over, you can return to your quest at your leisure, only with one less army of centaurs to worry about!"

rows.original: You aren't that interested in centaur romance.
rows.translation: 你对半人马的浪漫故事其实并没有那么感兴趣。
rows.raw: "You aren't that interested in centaur romance."

rows.original:
The Taldahs beast [lastStanding.resDefeated|recoils as if physically struck|reels back dramatically], clawing at his body like a man possessed. That might not be too far off, to some extent.
    
        "Foul magic! Begone, damn you. I'll keep my daughter safe without your trickery!" he shouts, throwing clumps of demonic detritus to the ground. The blueish globs he doesn't manage to splatter with his hooves turn into sinuous snake-like shapes and slither away to the north. Ahmri manages to stomp one fat worm, and shudders when the resulting goo cakes her ankles.
rows.translation:
塔尔达族的野兽 [lastStanding.resDefeated|仿佛真的受到了撞击一般，身体向后仰去。|大幅退缩]那些东西像附了身一样紧紧抓住他的身体。在某种程度上，这种描述或许并不为过。

“邪恶的魔法！快滚开，该死的！我不会让你用诡计伤害我的女儿！”他大声喊道，同时将那些恶魔的残渣扔向地面。那些被他蹄子未能击中、落在地上的蓝灰色团块，会变成蜿蜒如蛇的形态，然后向北方滑去。阿姆里终于踩死了一条肥大的虫子，但当那些黏稠的物质粘在她的脚踝上时，她还是不禁打了个寒颤。

rows.original: [party.som||After telling [companion1.name] where you're going, you set off to find her. |After telling your friends where you're going, you set off to find her. ]Meandering through the crowd, you make it all the way to the chieftain's cabin atop the hill. Ducking inside with a knock, you can hear the scuffle of hooves before you make it through the entryway. Ahmri canters from room to room, though she looks more fretful than excited to be back. She doesn't notice you at all as she sorts her belongings, mostly a vast array of novels strewn messily about the stone floor. It's only when she turns to hang a dress by the doorway that she finally sees you. She lets out an 'eep' of surprise, dropping the outfit and becoming suddenly unsure of what to do with her hands. "[pc.name]? I-um, hi. Aren't you going to the big party out there?" she asks, averting her eyes. Her fingers finally find purpose in fiddling nervously. Funny, you could ask her the same question. What is she doing cooped up inside? There are sweets to be eaten, and the cleaning can surely wait till tomorrow. "I don't- I'm not hiding on purpose or anything like that. It's just... a little overwhelming, you know? I never thought it would be so easy! And the village is back to normal in under a week! I couldn't sleep last night 'cause I was worried I'd wake up as a slave to some monster and this would be the happy dream she was forcing me to live out." She grows ever more fretful as she speaks, stressing herself out with the explanation of her living nightmare. She's beginning to hyperventilate by the time you cross the center room and wrap your arms around her [pc.heightRange 0 68|waist|shoulders]. You are not a nightmare! You aren't sure how easy you made it look, but you did have to fight your way through not only her father's doubts made manifest, but the rest of the mess Kasyrra's corruption left. [pc.isDK|She should know all that, because she was there!|She was there with you the whole time, so she knows how rough it was!] The overtaxed centaur still doesn't seem to be relaxing, so you pull back and let her gather herself. Surely something will get her spirits up.
rows.translation: [party.som||在说完之后…… [companion1.name] 无论你要去哪里，都会出发去寻找她。 |在告诉朋友们你要去哪里之后，你就动身去寻找她了。 ]你穿梭在人群之中，最终来到了位于山顶上的酋长小屋。你轻敲门扉后迅速钻了进去，还没等门完全打开，就听到了马蹄的奔跑声。 啊姆里在房间里来回奔跑，不过她看起来更像是忧心忡忡，而不是因为重获自由而兴奋。 她在整理自己的物品时根本没有注意到你——那些散落在石地板上的，大多是各式各样的小说。直到她转身准备把一件连衣裙挂在门边时，才终于看到了你。她惊讶地“哎呀”了一声，手中的衣服掉在了地上，一时不知该把双手放在哪里才好。 "[pc.name]呃，嗨。你不是要去参加外面那个大型派对吗？”她问道，同时将目光移开了。她的手指开始紧张地摆弄着什么。有趣的是，你也可以反过来问她这个问题——她为什么要把自己关在房间里呢？ 有糖果可以吃，清洁工作当然可以等到明天再做。 “我并不是故意躲起来，也不是什么别的原因。只是……这一切有点让人应接不暇，你知道吗？我从来没想过会这么简单！ 不到一个星期，这个村庄就恢复了正常秩序！昨晚我根本睡不着，因为我在担心自己醒来后会变成某个怪物的奴隶，而这一切其实只是她强行让我经历的一场“幸福梦”而已。她边说边变得越来越焦虑，对自己所经历的这场噩梦描述得越详细，就越让自己感到紧张不安。 当你穿过中央房间并搂住她的时候，她已经开始出现呼吸急促的现象了。 [pc.heightRange 0 68|腰部|肩膀]你是 不是 一场噩梦！你可能没有意识到自己做这件事其实有多容易，但实际上你不得不克服她父亲的种种怀疑，还要处理卡西拉的腐败行为所留下的种种麻烦。 [pc.isDK|她应该知道这一切，因为她当时就在现场！|她一直都在你身边，所以她知道那段日子有多艰难吧！] 这个负担过重的半人马似乎仍然没有放松下来，于是你退后一步，让她自己调整一下状态。肯定会有什么事情能让她重新振作起来的。
rows.raw: " [party.som||After telling [companion1.name] where you're going, you set off to find her. |After telling your friends where you're going, you set off to find her. ]Meandering through the crowd, you make it all the way to the chieftain's cabin atop the hill. Ducking inside with a knock, you can hear the scuffle of hooves before you make it through the entryway. Ahmri canters from room to room, though she looks more fretful than excited to be back. She doesn't notice you at all as she sorts her belongings, mostly a vast array of novels strewn messily about the stone floor. It's only when she turns to hang a dress by the doorway that she finally sees you. She lets out an 'eep' of surprise, dropping the outfit and becoming suddenly unsure of what to do with her hands. "[pc.name]? I-um, hi. Aren't you going to the big party out there?" she asks, averting her eyes. Her fingers finally find purpose in fiddling nervously. Funny, you could ask her the same question. What is she doing cooped up inside? There are sweets to be eaten, and the cleaning can surely wait till tomorrow. "I don't- I'm not hiding on purpose or anything like that. It's just... a little overwhelming, you know? I never thought it would be so easy! And the village is back to normal in under a week! I couldn't sleep last night 'cause I was worried I'd wake up as a slave to some monster and this would be the happy dream she was forcing me to live out." She grows ever more fretful as she speaks, stressing herself out with the explanation of her living nightmare. She's beginning to hyperventilate by the time you cross the center room and wrap your arms around her [pc.heightRange 0 68|waist|shoulders]. You are not a nightmare! You aren't sure how easy you made it look, but you did have to fight your way through not only her father's doubts made manifest, but the rest of the mess Kasyrra's corruption left. [pc.isDK|She should know all that, because she was there!|She was there with you the whole time, so she knows how rough it was!] The overtaxed centaur still doesn't seem to be relaxing, so you pull back and let her gather herself. Surely something will get her spirits up."

rows.original:
Now, you can't guarantee that you can dance like a centaur, but you can guarantee that actually being at the party will be enough to show her that no demon illusion could match the real thing. Or at least you think it will. You've never actually seen a centaur party... Ahmri's stress breaks into a snort of laughter, and then into a shaky, but full laugh. She wipes her eyes, drying them on a nearby towel.

        "I don't know if you're right, but I could show you how centaurs dance. I-if you want," she offers, blushing as she giggles the last of the worry out of her system. If she's as good at teaching as she is at laughing, you don't see how you can refuse. The muted sound of drums and singing wafts in through the open doorway, and Ahmri listens for a moment, tapping one of her hooves in time with the beat. The rest of her feet catch the tune in turn, carrying her in a short twist that lets her dance hoof over knee in a repetition of movement that does wonderful things to her chest. 
        
        Her gaze never leaves you, even as she twists and canters to the beat of the music, rocking and pivoting till the percussive melody reaches a crescendo. As the next round of song begins, she holds out her arms in an offer to join her. Leaving your spot by the door, you [pc.bgMulti courtesan noblescion|fall into her rhythm without difficulty, matching her infectious smile as well.|match her pace with symmetry befitting the princess that she is, and watch her smile grow wider in happy surprise.|[pc.presenceRange 50|join her in dance. You may not be a perfect dancer, but you match her steps well enough to follow along.|attempt to follow her lead. You stumble more often than not, but the both of you laugh it off with wide smiles.]] Excitement beams in the snow white centaur's eyes as you let her twirl you around under her hand, and the fresh wonder on her face silently begs you to let her see it again. You oblige, twirling and dancing in her arms till the next song winds down outside. 
        
        "I think I'm ready, and that you're right. A monster wouldn't know how to fake these kinds of things," she says, walking with you as you tug her out the door and toward the festivities. Ahmri's shoulders tense as you approach the cheering crowd, and you give her hand a reassuring squeeze. The next song has started up by the time you reach the crowd, letting you and your encouraged equine partner sneak in almost unnoticed. Her example proves fruitful, as the two of you fit right in with the rest of the dancing centaurs. Or she fits in, at least. You don't stay unnoticed for long as [party.solo|the only|one of the only] dancers with two legs. A bevy of dancers make way for you, cheering you on as they pause their own dancing to watch the two of you. 
        
        Ahmri huffs to keep her breath, but still she dances, face aglow with laughter as you swing by the bakers to grab a handful of small sweetcakes. Ahmri fills her cheeks and grins, almost spilling the food when a laugh bubbles out of the ridiculous expression. She swallows, threading her fingers through yours as your dance slows for a brief moment. In the glow of the firelight and the lull of the melody, she leans in to kiss you.
        
        Her lips taste of the salty sweat of dance and exertion, but her tongue is as sweet as the sugary icing from the cakes. Heat rolls off her body like an extension of her dress, billowing around you and drawing you further in. Deeper into blissful ignorance of the crowd, and the unfathomable magic of love. She pulls back, blushing as the small entourage that's gathered around you begins cheering and whistling. You break into a guffaw, which breaks the onset of her nerves before it can begin. 
        
        The difference is unmistakable as you fall back into dance, closer and more personal than before. Somehow brighter, almost glowing. No, literally glowing! The sinuous patterns of her dress catch the light of the fire in a way that makes them pulse with light that draws your eyes every which way. You find yourself staring, struggling to return to the brightness of her eyes. It isn't as if she's any more innocent. As if your kiss broke some kind of dam, her eyes sweep over your body and a flush creeps into her cheeks. You still dance, and probably put up a damn convincing facade, but, to each other, it's obvious where your minds are.
        
        The music drops to a slow ballad, as if the universe itself conspires to bring you closer together. Closer you get, hands held together as you sway gently in the tide of dancing bodies. Chest to chest, you're all too aware of how stiff her normally shy nips are getting. The heaviness of her breath is no longer from the effort of dance alone. This position does not afford you the opportunity to admire each other's bodies at leisure, and beyond that first fated gambit you're denied any real chance to explore her lips. Nevertheless, you swim in the ocean of her eyes while you tango in the bonfire's gleam.
        
        The party winds down while you're lost to time, but the change in movement brings you back to reality. Couples and lone dancers alike disengage from the group to return to their homes. Ahmri pulls back a little, but her fingers stay locked tightly in yours for a moment. Your moment alone in the crowd has passed, but she still smiles brightly.
        
        "You should, ah... come see me later. I'll be in my house, of course."
        
        Ahmri turns away with some effort, looking back over her shoulder and twirling a finger through her hair as she saunters off. Her tail is jutted firmly upward, and you see her equine love buzzer wink once or twice as the sunny blonde duster swishes in the wind. Yeah... see her indeed. You'd like to see even more of her.
rows.translation:
现在，你虽然不能保证自己能跳得像半人马一样出色，但你可以肯定的是，只要真正去参加那个派对，就足以让她明白：没有任何幻觉能比得上真实的体验。至少你是这么认为的。 你其实从来没真正见过半人马的聚会……阿姆里压抑着紧张情绪，突然爆发出一阵轻笑，随后笑声逐渐变得稳定而响亮。她用旁边的一块毛巾擦了擦眼睛。

“我不知道你说的对不对，但我可以让你看看半人马是怎么跳舞的。 如果你愿意的话……”她红着脸说道，同时轻声笑了出来，把心中的担忧都赶走了。如果她教学的能力和她的笑声一样好，的话，你真的想拒绝吗？微弱的鼓声和歌声从敞开的门口传来，Ahmri听了一会儿，然后用她的蹄子有节奏地敲打着地面，跟着那节奏跳动起来。 她的双脚也依次跟上节奏，使她身体微微扭转，进而以一种重复性的动作跳舞——这种动作让她的胸部呈现出美妙的动态。即便她在音乐的节奏中不断扭转身体、快速移动，她的目光始终没有离开你，她不断地摇晃身体、转动方向，直到那富有节奏感的旋律达到高潮。 当下一轮歌唱开始时，她伸开双臂，邀请你加入她的行列。你离开门边的位置，走了过去…… [pc.bgMulti courtesan noblescion|她毫不费力地进入了状态，她的笑容也充满了感染力。|她的步伐与那种与公主身份相称的优雅韵律相匹配，看着她因惊喜而笑容愈发灿烂。|[pc.presenceRange 50|和她一起跳舞吧。你可能不是个专业的舞者，但你的动作和她很协调，完全能够跟上她的节奏。|试着跟随她的步伐。虽然你经常会跌跌撞撞，但你们总会开怀大笑，把这一切都当作趣事。]] 当你在雪白半人马的手掌中旋转时，她眼中闪烁着兴奋的光芒；她脸上那纯真的惊奇之情，仿佛在无声地请求你再让她体验一次这种感觉。你满足了她的愿望，在她怀里继续旋转、跳舞，直到外面的歌曲声渐渐消失。 
        
        我想我已经准备好了，而且你说得对——怪物根本不可能伪造这类东西，”她说着，跟着你一起走出门，朝着庆典现场走去。当你们渐渐接近那群欢呼的人群时，阿姆里的肩膀不由得绷紧了，你便轻轻握了握她的手，以示安慰。 当你赶到人群中时，下一首歌已经开始了，这使得你和你的马匹伙伴几乎在无人注意的情况下悄悄融入了其中。她的榜样起到了很好的作用，你们俩很快就融入了那些正在跳舞的半人马们之中。 或者，至少她能够融入其中。因为如果你不能长时间保持默默无闻的话…… [party.solo|唯一的|为数不多的几个之一] 那些有着两条腿的舞者们。一群舞者们为你让开道路，他们暂停自己的舞蹈，观看你们两个的表演，同时为你欢呼加油。

阿姆里努力屏住呼吸，但她仍然继续跳舞，脸上洋溢着笑容，而你则从那些面包师身边经过，抓了一把小甜饼。 阿姆里鼓起脸颊，咧开嘴笑了起来，那滑稽的表情让食物差点从她嘴里溢出来。她咽下食物，将手指与你的手指交织在一起，此时你们的舞蹈也暂时放慢了节奏。在火光的照耀下，伴随着悠扬的音乐，她倾身吻了你。
        
        她的嘴唇带着舞蹈和努力带来的咸涩汗水味，但她的舌头却像蛋糕上那甜腻的糖霜般甜美。热气从她身上散发出来，仿佛是她裙摆的延伸，层层包围着你，将你吸引得更加深入。在人群的喧嚣与爱情的神奇力量中，你沉浸在无尽的幸福与无知之中。当周围聚集的小圈子开始欢呼鼓掌时，她害羞地退了回去。你突然放声大笑，这场突如其来的笑声及时缓解了她紧张的情绪。 
        
        当你再次投入到这种舞蹈中时，其中的差别是显而易见的——这种舞蹈比以往任何时候都更加亲密、更具个人色彩。它的光芒似乎更加明亮了，甚至可以说是真正地在发光！她裙子上那些蜿蜒的图案在火光的照耀下仿佛开始跳动，那种闪烁的光芒会吸引你的目光，让你无法将视线从它们身上移开。 你发现自己呆呆地望着她，努力想要回想起她眼中那明亮的神采。她其实并不比以前更天真无邪了。仿佛你的吻打破了一道屏障，她的目光缓缓扫过你的身体，她的脸颊上也浮现出了一抹红晕。 你依然在跳舞，或许也在极力伪装自己，但彼此之间，其实都很清楚你的真实想法在哪里。
        
        音乐转为缓慢的抒情曲调，仿佛整个宇宙都在合力让你们更加靠近。你们越走越近，手牵着手，在舞动的人群中轻轻摇摆。胸贴着胸，你们清楚地感觉到，她平时那么害羞的指尖，此刻已经变得多么僵硬了。 她呼吸的沉重，已不再仅仅是因为跳舞而产生的。这个姿势根本无法让你有机会悠闲地欣赏彼此的身体；而在那第一次命运的安排之后，你也再没有机会去探索她的嘴唇了。 然而，你在她那深邃的目光中畅游，同时也在篝火的光芒中跳着探戈。
        
        当你在时光中沉浸时，派对已经渐渐接近尾声，但动作的变化让你重新回到了现实。情侣们和独自跳舞的人们都纷纷从人群中离开，准备回家。阿姆里稍微退后了一些，但她的手指仍然紧紧地握着你的手，那一刹那。在人群中属于你们的独处时光已经结束，但她依然面带灿烂的笑容。
        
        你应该，啊……晚点来找我吧。我当然会在家里。”

阿姆里费了些劲才转身离开，她一边走一边回头张望，还用手指拨弄着自己的头发。她的尾巴高高翘起，在阳光的照耀下，那金色的长发随风飘动，看起来真是美极了。没错……你确实很想多看看她。你甚至会想要更多关于她的信息。

rows.original: She should come back to the party with you. You'll be there the whole time, and you can dance the nightmares away.
rows.translation: 她应该和你一起回到派对上。你会一直在她身边，这样就能把那些不愉快的回忆都跳掉吧。
rows.raw: "She should come back to the party with you. You'll be there the whole time, and you can dance the nightmares away."

rows.original: If the party will only make her more stressed, then perhaps there's a place she can go to relax? Ahmri furrows her brow, thinking so hard you worry your suggestion has only made things worse. Then, the pent-up anxiety floods out in a sudden flush of realization. She looks at you, her bewildered stare replaced by an excited grin. "There is a place! Come on, come on, I'll show you," the snow white centaur urges, pushing you out the door in her hurry. You content yourself to be guided, letting her pull you at her side when you get out onto even ground. She probably doesn't need to be sneaky with the party as a distraction, and, to be honest, it's a good thing. There's no way she could sneak anywhere without [pc.cunningRange 90|your|a master's] assistance. The two of you skirt the edge of the village, and then leave it through the same path you entered from. Ahmri leads you up through paths she's obviously internalized, taking turns with more blind confidence than any memory can provide. You're completely lost after the first set of turns, but her excitement is infectious. Rather than worry about getting lost, you wonder about where she's taking you. Luckily, it doesn't take much longer to find out. Cresting a large incline, your travels bring you face-to-face with a towering cavern entrance. In the tenebrous twilight, the ingress has every reason to be terrifying, but the soft blue glow coming from within gives such thoughts pause. Your enthusiastic partner pulls you right on through, closing in on the light's source. At first you're blind to anything but the dim sapphire light, but you begin to notice details as your eyes adjust. The cave stone around you is threaded with luminescent streaks, though too dim to provide full vision. As soon as you round the first corner you're forced to cover your eyes from sudden brightness. A pool of bright cyan fills itself from a small bubbling waterfall along the caveside. Where the new water strikes the pool's surface, ripples of vibrant color dance out, softening to smooth stillness as they reach the edges. "I found this place as a kid one winter. Daddy was mad when I came back in the morning, but I never told him where I went. Remember when we first met, and I told you I had a place to hide? This is it," Ahmri explains, trotting over to the water's edge. Rich moss lines the stone nearest the bank, looking like deep green throw pillows in the dim glow. A cursory inspection reveals the natural blanket is just as soft as it looks, providing plenty of cushion for you to sit and relax by the poolside. 游泳总能帮助我放松身心，虽然这里的水有点……呃，有点凉啊！”你的马朋友边说边颤抖着跳进了水中。就在她入水的瞬间，那些让水体发光的物质突然亮了起来。你赶紧脱掉了自己的…… [pc.footwear] 然后蘸一下…… [pc.feet] 被冰冷的空气冻得直打哆嗦。虽然阿姆丽从她母亲那里继承了北方地区的耐寒基因，但这样的寒冷还是让她感到难以忍受。 那个被阳光照得金光闪闪的半人马游到了你所在的那边泳池，她将身体浸入水中，只有头部和肩膀还露在水面上。 她那件轻薄的夏季连衣裙材质柔软，漂浮在水面上，随着水波轻轻晃动，却出人意料地有效地保护了她的隐私。当水波平静下来后，可以清楚地看到她身体的下半部分在光线的照射下呈现出蓝色。 她自信地站在水面的下方，从水中朝你微笑。 rows.original:
Taldahs reels from your final blow, staggering and then falling to his knees as he loses his footing. He lets out a snarl, but it comes out as little more than a sputtering croak as the great monster collapses. He lets out a final rage-fueled sigh of defiance before his head hits the ground for a final time. It seems like he's going to have the decency to stay down, too. Good, now you just have to get the rest of these centaurs in line.

    You set off toward the village gates, storming past the unicorn, who still sits in a mopey stupor. You'll have to make sure she knows who's boss later. She could be useful for keeping the crowds in check. For now there are more important issues at hand.
rows.translation:
塔尔达在你最后一击的重创下摇摇晃晃，踉跄着跪倒在地，彻底失去了平衡。他试图发出怒吼，但那声音只不过是些断断续续的嘶哑声而已，随后这个巨大的怪物便彻底倒下了。在生命终结之前，它还发出了一声充满愤怒的反抗叹息，然后它的头终于重重地砸在了地上。 看来他也会乖乖地待在原地不动。很好，现在你只需要把剩下的这些半人马们也管教好就行了。

你朝着村庄的大门走去，径直冲过了那只仍然闷闷不乐地呆着的一角兽。 你以后得确保她明白谁才是老板。让她来控制人群或许会很有用。不过目前还有更紧迫的事情需要处理。

rows.original: On your way to the gates, you stop by the post where the bondage clad centaur is tied up. She cocks an eyebrow when she sees you approaching, and you put a firm hand on her flank. Her legs spread automatically as your fingers dig into her rump, showing off the goods to her new master as if she expected this all along. You'll have time for that later if you so desire, but for now... "I need a good steed to show the rampaging horde out there how to stay in check[pc.dcb|. You'll be the perfect example, won't you?|. Will you be that for me?|, and you're just the cutest, most horsey steed in the village! Isn't that right?]" you ask, kneading the bound centaur's tight asscheek. She nods with manic enthusiasm, grunting as she lowers her front end to ease your ascent into the saddle. Once you're seated comfortably, she prances giddily in the direction of the gates, eager to show off her submission to the returning pillagers. You can hear hoofbeats thundering in the distance even from the base of the arching ravine path. You reach the top just as the warband is cresting the hill. Blatant surprise is the most common expression as they see you riding through the gates, with wary apprehension being a close second. You give them time to get situated before calling out across the plain. "Chieftain Taldahs is dead! Kasyrra fed him lies to turn him into her pet, and made him into nothing but a monster! A monster whose demonic strength still didn't protect him when someone with real power came knocking. I'm going to defeat Kasyrra, and I don't need to turn you all into abominations to do it. What I do need is for you to come back here and %"behave." At least act the part until I'm in a better spot to strike the final blow. And if you even think about playing Kasyrra's spy, I'll make sure you end up in that unicorn's harem," you say, looking back over your shoulder as you steer your steed back westward. To your surprise, a decent number of centaurs follow you immediately, with expressions ranging from unease to outright excitement. More join in as they see their allies moving, but easily a quarter of them remain in place, turning to leave when the rest have finished moving. Among them you see a majority wearing cultist regalia or similar garments. It would seem some favored Kasyrra over the chieftain. No matter, they'll realize their mistake in time. [flags.EUBICHA_FUCKED|"You know all about playing the part, don't you? How long did you have to behave like you were prim and proper until that sleaze Tollus came along? Maybe when we get back to the village I can -" you say, twirling a finger around one of her nipples.|"Alright, back we go. You can drop me off just past the gate, and I'll come to you if I need anything el-" you command, swinging a leg over to sit side saddle.] You stop halfway through the last thought. Something important is missing here. What, no, who are you forgetting? As you survey the crowd, it comes to you. Ahmri is what's missing! You rack your brain, trying to remember the last place you saw her. It was before you fought Taldahs; was she there during the fight? No, you told her to go and hide, but surely she should have returned once you finished the fight. As you reenter the village, you ask the entering centaurs if any have seen her. "Aye, I saw that rat Tollus leading her off in chains with some of the other slaves. Probably for breeding more of us to serve the demoness," one of them comments. If only you had the chance to get rid of Tollus for good... You'll have to get her back. Next time you see that sleazy cultist you'll beat her location out of him. For now, though, you have a village to attend to. You'll have to inspect your new territory before you return to your adventure, or at least some of it.

        |You approach Eubicha [atCamp|at her post|in her [flags.TAUR_PURE|tent|den]], and she perks up as soon as she notices you. Her ears flit excitedly, and her eyes dart toward the bondage gear she has tucked in one of her boxes. 
        |You make your way towards the clearing where you remember finding the bound centaur during your incursion. [flags.TAUR_PURE
            |Instead of the crude pole from before, Eubicha now has a tent like any other. It's a little more out of the way than the rest of the village, and the rest of the dwellings nearby face inward rather than outward, but it's no less a respectable home. You duck under the entry flap and find a quaint and simple den. The hearty horse-woman stiffens when she hears someone enter her home unannounced, but as soon as she recognizes you she trots over to embrace you in a tackle hug that stops short of knocking you off balance. 
            
            "Thank you," She whispers as close to your ear as possible. After that, she pulls back with her hands still resting on your shoulders and a gentle smile on her face. Meanwhile, you're still trying to reconcile the surprise of such a soft voice coming from this beautiful workhorse. Without waiting for a response from you, she canters to a box near the edge of the tent, rummaging inside till she finds what she was looking for. She pulls out the black rubber bondage gear from before, cocking her head in your direction and smirking hopefully.
            
            Right to the point, isnt she?
            |Sure enough, you find her in the same spot, though a little less tied up. She has a stockpile of food and other amenities tucked into a corner, and several boxes stacked into a loose approximation of a fence. Her post has a crude cloth tarp to block the rain, and keep the food dry. When the busty brunette sees you approaching her countenance lightens, and she trots excitedly up to you.

            "Whoa girl. If I'm going to be coming back to see you I'll need a name to call you. You do have one, don't you?" You ask. It won't do to just call her %"horse" or %"hey you." The sturdy centaur looks frustrated, but leans over to whisper in your ear.
            
            "Eubicha," she says. Judging solely by tone you think she may have, in fact, preferred "horse." Too bad this isn't about her. Now that you have a name you can get to more important things.
        ]
    ]

“真是个乖巧的好孩子！有你这样的‘坐骑’，任何人都会感到幸运，更不用说还能让你帮忙携带东西了。 但你并不属于任何人，我想，我真正想要的是将你只留给自己，”你轻声在她耳边说道，同时用嘴唇轻轻触碰她的耳垂。她突然发出一声轻喘，你的尾巴也跟着高高翘了起来。你微笑着，取出了那把柔软的刷子。
    
    你重复着之前用梳子所做的动作，将那些污垢一一刷掉，直到尤比查的皮毛变得光滑整洁。虽然可能还需要再洗一遍才能彻底清除所有的污垢，但她似乎并不在意这些小细节。完成了。[eubicha.pregStage 0 1 3| 你轻轻拍拍她的背，然后揉揉她马肚子的两侧。| 你轻轻抚摸她逐渐隆起的腹部，然后给予她一个安慰性的轻拍。| 你轻轻抚摸着她隆起的腹部，当感受到胎儿轻轻踢动时，你会露出灿烂的笑容。] 你几乎能看到她脑海中那些想法正在疯狂旋转，而当你转身去收拾那些美容用品时，会感觉到背后有轻轻的压力。那头强壮的驮马低下头，用它的胸膛紧紧抱住你，将它的身体紧紧压在你的背上。
    
    谢谢，”她轻声说道。

你转过身，与她对视，然后吻了她一下，接着帮她把马鞍包重新挂好。她精神焕发，准备出发了，便回到了营地，开始忙于各项维护工作。 看她一两分钟，就能让你充满精力，足以应对一天中可能遇到的各种挑战。
rows.raw:
'
    [flags.EUBICHA_GROOM
        |You pull the equine curry comb and other cleaning gear out of your things and dangle it in the air, patting the quiet equine woman on her flank before arching an eyebrow in her direction.
    
        "Is my [pc.dcb|Pack horse|good girl|cutie pony pie] ready for more [silly|brushies|[pc.isBimbo|brushy wushies|grooming]]?"
        |"Now then, what other stuff do you have in here?" you ask. While she looks on in curiosity, you sift through her saddlebags in search of new things to try. Instead of something lewd, however, the first thing you find is a thin metal comb, followed quickly by a brush, and a hoof cleaning spike.

        "Hmm. We've been hiking for a while. Are you up for [silly|sum brushies|a good scrub]?"
    ]
    
    Eubicha nods vigorously enough to shake her gear.
    
    You help undo the straps and slide it off before she shakes it into pieces. Freed from the trappings of civilisation, she paws at the ground expectantly while you get ready. First things first, you take her one hoof at a time and use the dull curved spike to clear out the debris of travel. Her hooves are surprisingly easy to clean, and she holds each one up for you in turn. They don't exactly look clean, per se, but they do look to be cleared of any major accumulation.
    
    Next, you use the comb to brush the dirt and dust from her coat. Short strokes from her fore-shoulder all the way to her rump leave the grime on the outer layers where it will be easy to brush away. [eubicha.pregStage 0 1 3||It's taking a little longer to comb now that she's getting rounder, but that just means you have more time together. |You take your sweet time brushing her gravid belly. Every extra second of relaxation is precious. ]She grins and stretches while you rotate to her other side, providing the same treatment. When you're finished, but before scrubbing the dirt away, you stop to give her a kiss on the cheek.
    
    "So well behaved! Anyone would be lucky to have you as a prize riding mare, let alone to carry their things. But you aren't owned by just anyone, and I think I like you all to myself," you say, whispering the words directly into her ear and chasing them with a nibble. She lets out a halting gasp, and you see her tail rise into the air as you smile to yourself and pull out the soft brush.
    
    Repeating the same motions you made with the comb, you brush the grime away till Eubicha's coat is smooth and clean. She'll probably need to wash to get every last bit, but she doesn't seem to mind the little stuff. Finished,[eubicha.pregStage 0 1 3| you give her a pat and rub on the side of her equine stomach.| you rub her growing belly and give her a comforting pat| you rub her gravid belly, grinning wide when you feel the gentle bump of a kick.] You can practically see the hearts swirling around her head, and when you turn to put away the grooming supplies you feel a light pressure on your back. The powerful packhorse leans down to hug you around the chest, pressing into your back with a tight embrace.
    
    "Thank you," she whispers.
    
    You turn to meet her face and give her a kiss, and then pick up the saddlebags to help her back into them. Refreshed and ready to go, she heads back into the camp to flit about doing general maintenance. A minute or two of watching her helps energize you enough to face the days perils.'

rows.original: [eubicha.isFollower |You're heading into a place you think might not be the best fit for centaur travel, so for now you'd like Eubicha to return to her village. [eubicha.pregStage 0 4||Especially with how pregnant she is, you don't want her doing anything that would hurt the baby.] The quiet workhorse looks a little dejected, but nods in understanding. She trots over to scoop you up into one last hug. "Come get me later," she whispers, setting you down and giving you a pat on the head. With that, she begins trekking off toward the centaur village. You have no issues believing she can take care of herself on the way back. |You know, you could use a strong draft horse on your adventures. There's a lot of equipment to carry, and it might make the trips a little more comfortable if you had someone else to carry it. Perhaps someone workhorse sized. Eubicha shoots to attention when she fully parses what you're saying, pointing to herself with an excited bubbliness you'd expect from a woman half her size. She jumps with her forelegs, kicking the air and giving you a toothy smile as she spins to start pulling open one of her many boxes. She pulls out a heavy duty saddle bag, dusting it off and placing it atop a separate box before prancing over to embrace you. "Yes!" she exclaims. Her hug lifts you clean off the ground, reminding you of just how much a workhorse she is. Technically you hadn't actually asked her yet, but now you don't need to! Even after she finishes stuffing the packs with extra clothing and a plethora of bondage gear, they still have an ungodly amount of space. Whoever designed this saddle must have been ready for intercontinental travel! Your storage capacity has increased by 10, and can now be accessed from Camp! ]
rows.translation: [eubicha.isFollower |你即将前往一个你认为可能并不适合半人马族活动的地区，因此目前你希望尤比查能回到她的村庄去。 [eubicha.pregStage 0 4||尤其是她现在怀孕的这种情况，你肯定不希望她去做任何可能会伤害到胎儿的事情。] 这只安静而勤劳的小动物看起来有些沮丧，但它还是理解地点了点头。然后它快步走过来，把你抱在怀里，给了你最后一个拥抱。 “晚点再来找我吧，”它轻声说道，然后把你放下，轻拍着你的头。说完，它便开始朝半人马村庄的方向走去。你完全相信，它在回程的路上一定能够照顾好自己。 |你知道，在你的冒险旅程中，使用一匹强壮的驮马会非常方便。需要携带的装备很多，如果有其他人帮忙搬运，这些旅途就会变得舒适许多。也许，找一匹体型像工作马那样的动物会是个不错的选择。 当尤比查完全理解了你的话后，她立刻引起了大家的注意。她兴奋地用手指着自己，那种活力十足的神情，完全符合一个体型只有她一半大小的女孩子的特点。她用前腿跳起来，踢打着空气，同时露出灿烂的笑容，然后开始转动身体，拉开了她那些众多箱子中的一个。 她拿出了…… 沉重 她拿出了那款 duty saddle bag，仔细擦拭干净后，把它放在一个单独的盒子上，然后才跑过来拥抱你。 “太好了！”她兴奋地叫道。她的拥抱让你整个人都离地面悬了起来，这让你不禁意识到，她其实是一头多么“勤劳”的“工作马”啊。其实你还没真正问她要帮忙呢，但现在看来，你已经不需要问了！即使她在包里塞进了额外的衣物和各种各样的束缚用品，包里仍然还有大量的空间。设计这个马鞍的人，肯定是为长途旅行准备的吧！ 你的存储容量增加了10单位，现在可以从营地中访问这些存储空间了！ ]

rows.original:
[eubicha.numKids 1
        |While you work on setting up camp, Eubicha approaches you from behind and just about bowls you over with a hug that turns into a sensual rubbing of your chest. She nuzzles right up to your cheek before saying anything at all.
    
        "I'm having another baby," She murmurs, making sure you feel the imprint of her nipples on your back. With that knowledge delivered, she trots off to help set up camp. As she leaves you can't help but notice the upward curve of her tail giving you a plain view of her chocolate brown slit.
        
        Looks like you'll have another child soon!
        |While you work on setting up camp, Eubicha approaches from behind, tugging on your sleeve and looking a tad more serious than she usually does. She's whispering something you can't quite catch, and seems particularly flustered about it.
    
        "[pc.dcb|Speak up! I can't help you if I can't hear you,|Is something wrong? If it's something I can help with I will,|Oh no, what's happened? I can't leave a cutie like you looking so glum,]" you say, hugging her around the waist and rubbing her back till she calms down a little.
        
        "[pc.name]. I'm pregnant," she says. Oh.
        
        "Oh... That's wonderful! [pc.dcbc|I knew you were a good girl,|We're gonna have a baby,|There's gonna be a little baby horsie running around!|Looks like you're carrying more than just my gear now,]" you reply, [pc.isBimbo|bouncing in place|hugging her even tighter]. Her eyes go wide for a moment before she grins cheek to cheek and [pc.isBimbo|joins you with a gentle bounce|hugs you right back]. 
        
        "Don't you worry about a thing. [var0|We have a nice nursery in Hawkethorne and Gwyn knows exactly how to deal with tauric [silly|babbys|babies]|We have a nice nursery in Hawkethorne and I'm sure Gwyn will be able to handle some little taurs]. Whenever you feel it coming just head straight over there. It'll be fine here without you while you're delivering," you say, trying to think of anything else you can do to comfort her.
        
        She wipes the halted beginnings of tears from her eyes and gives you a long kiss. In an instant, the worried look she had is replaced by her familiar pride. After that she happily returns to patrolling the camp, looking significantly more spritely than usual.
        
        Looks like you're going to have a centaur child!
    ]
rows.translation:
[eubicha.numKids 1
        |当你正在搭建营地时，尤比查从背后走了过来，她给了你一个拥抱，这个拥抱几乎让你整个人都失去了平衡，随后她开始轻轻地抚摸你的胸部。在她开口说话之前，她还把脸贴在了你的脸颊上。
    
        我又要生一个宝宝了，”她轻声说道，同时确保你的后背能感受到她乳头带来的触感。说完这些，她就快步走去帮忙搭建营地了。当她离开后，你不禁注意到她尾巴向上翘起的姿态，这使得你能够清楚地看到她那巧克力棕色的阴部。
        
        看来你很快就要再添一个孩子了！
        |当你正在搭建营地时，尤比查从背后走了过来，拉了拉你的袖子，神情比平时要严肃许多。她低声说了些什么，你没能听清楚，但她看起来显得非常慌乱。[pc.dcb|大声说出来！如果我听不见你的声音，我就无法帮助你。|出什么问题了吗？如果是我能帮忙解决的，我一定会尽力帮忙的。|哦不，发生了什么？我可不能让像你这么可爱的孩子看起来这么难过。]你说得对，于是我搂住她的腰，轻轻拍她的背，直到她稍微平静下来。[pc.name]我怀孕了，”她说。“哦。”

“哦……太好了！ [pc.dcbc|我就知道你是个好女孩。|我们就要有宝宝了。|会有一个小马驹在周围奔跑哦！|看来你现在携带的不仅仅是我的装备而已……]你回复吧。 [pc.isBimbo|在原地弹跳|将她抱得更紧了一些]她的双眼先是一阵瞪大，随即露出了灿烂的笑容， [pc.isBimbo|以轻柔的弹跳动作与你相聚|也会紧紧回抱你]你完全不必担心任何事情。 [var0|我们在霍克索恩有一间很棒的托儿所，而格温也非常擅长照顾那些属于“金牛座”的孩子。 [silly|婴儿们|婴儿们]|我们在霍克索恩有一间很棒的托儿所，我相信格温肯定能够照顾好那些小牛犊。]每当你觉得快要哭出来的时候，就直接去那边吧。你去送东西的时候，这里没有你也会没事的，”你说道，努力想着还能做些什么来安慰她。

她擦去了眼眶里那些即将流出的泪水，然后给了你一个长长的吻。 转眼间，她脸上原本的担忧神情又被那熟悉的骄傲取代了。之后，她开心地继续在营地周围巡逻，看起来比平时精神焕发了许多。

看来你就要生一个半人半马的孩子了！
    ]

rows.original:
Eubicha approaches you while you're planning your next move, squeezing your hand and looking slightly concerned. 

    "[pc.name]! [eubicha.numKids 1|T|I think t]he baby's coming!"
    
    You take the urgency in her tone at face value, and turn to head in the direction of [var0|the nursery|Hawkethorne]. By the time you arrive, Eubicha is straining and obviously uncomfortable. Gwyn meets you at the door with her tail wagging, but shifts to a more serious look when she sees the pregnant mare. She ushers her into another room while [party.yall] wait patiently. The whole process takes less than an hour, and before long you hear the canine caregiver's instructions taper off to gentle praise.
    
    Gwyn ushers you inside the birthing room a few minutes later, where you find an exhausted Eubicha leaning on some pillows. Her bulk is offset by the warm smile and the constant tiredness in her amber eyes. Long equine ears droop down and almost melt into her neck-length brown hair, hiding away until they perk up to listen carefully. She wears no makeup, and her hair has some wild tufts in places, but no part of her looks messy or unclean. It's the disheveledness that comes from hours of wrangling children, rather than from neglect.
    
    Your gaze travels lower, and you can't help but be drawn to her chest. The matron wears heavy duty cloth wraps, but out of necessity she can't tie them too tightly in case she needs to nurse in an emergency. Because of that, she constantly needs to mop up a steady trickle of milk that leaks from underneath them. It doesn't help that her hefty M-cups defy every attempt to keep them contained. They spill out from around her wraps as if begging to be freed at any possible opportunity. [nova.isPregnant
        |Though pregnancy has not increased the size of her breasts, the flow of milk has increased to the point where she needs to drain herself often if not given outside help.
    ]
    
    Lower down, her human belly is shockingly trim for so motherly a figure, probably owing to tauric children being carried in the lower half. Still, there's a considerable softness to her that's impossible to ignore. Her waistline gives way to light brown hair, lighter than that atop her head. It's here that the effects of back-to-back motherhood are most visible, but she carries the extra softness with bashful grace. [nova.isPregnant
        |Since she got pregnant, she glows even brighter, and her equine tummy swells with life.[nova.pregStage 0 1 2 3
            |
            | It's not that big yet, but it's definitely noticeable. She's begun to grow wider, and so has the smile on her face.
            | She's started to grow noticeably now, and has to be careful making quick turns while moving. Still, she grins wider by the day.
            | She's round enough now that it's hard to stay balanced, and it's quite obvious that she doesn't have long left before the baby comes. Still she glows with happiness, but it's also a tiring thing to deal with.
        ] The large tent is built to be accommodating, so she has no trouble in her daily life.
    ]
    
    All in all, the matronly woman evokes all the best aspects of motherhood, and you can't fathom why she'd ever have doubted herself enough to use illusions to turn herself into a monster. Still, it's good to see the confidence creeping back into her eyes when she sees you looking. If that's all it takes to help, you'll gladly provide aid.
    "
