rows.original:
"How are you doing these days? [flags.GENOVA_TALK_HERSELF
            |Still holding up ok?
            |Are you feeling any lingering effects of the demonic taint?
        ]" you ask.
        
        "[flags.GENOVA_TALK_HERSELF
            |I'm doing wonderfully now, thank you. Better than before, even. Some of the people I caused trouble for have been coming by regularly to talk about it and help out,
            |No, nothing so dreadful. The bolstering effect on my magic is all gone, and I don't feel any after effects if that's what you mean. M-maybe I get hot and bothered a bit more often, but nothing that would have me trying to take control of people,
        ]" she says with a laugh.
        
        "I'm glad. You're far too kind to worry about things like that. What about personal time, are you getting enough time to relax? Not that I can do much if you aren't, but I'd still like to know."
        
        "Just talking like this is plenty much, but yes. I've been taking time after my duties to just, well, do things! I've gone fishing a couple of times, and [flags.GENOVA_TALK_HERSELF
            |learned more intricate weaving techniques
            |learned to weave
        ]," she explains. "I wouldn't have even thought of doing any of this before. Despite caring for their children, I hadn't really gotten to know anyone besides chieftain Taldahs in years. Even then, it was only because he put forth the effort."
        
        "[pc.dcb
            |Sounds like you've turned that 'secluded' lifestyle on its head,
            |Well, well! It sounds like you left that social seclusion thing in the past,
            |Wow! You, like, started doing lots! I'm glad you left that gloom behind,
        ]" you say.
        
        "[pc.isBimbo
            |Me too. It's like a huge blanket of stress has lifted off my back.
            |I certainly have, and it's like I lifted a huge blanket of stress off my back in the process.
        ] If only I could act on hindsight and have this knowledge sooner, you know?"
        
        "No sense in fretting about that. Worrying about things that you should have or could have done is a good way to stay in a rut. I think it's wonderful that you're learning new things and not getting stuck in a constant flood of worries."
        
        "Thanks... Gosh, I'm like a broken record of gratitude when it comes to this line of conversation... Hmm, what else can I tell you? Mars and his wife taught me some new baking techniques. I've never been much of a baker, but ever since Ahmri was young I've enjoyed making simple pastries just to see the happy look on her face when she ate them. I kept up with that even after she was older, and some of the new generations enjoy them just as much."
        
        The two of you talk for a little while longer, though you're thoroughly convinced that she's doing much better from the start. She tells you about the most recent outings she's gone on, and the most recent gossip she's heard around the village, till you reach things you already know. From there, the small talk continues till neither of you have anything more to say.
        
        "Thank you once more for talking with me like this," she says as your conversation dwindles. "It helps a lot. Is there anything else you wanted while you're here?"

            |不，并没有那么糟糕。对我的魔法能力而言，那种增强效果已经完全消失了，如果你指的是这个的话，我也没有任何后遗症。嗯……也许我会更频繁地感到一些燥热不安，但并没有严重到让我想要去控制别人的地步。
        ]她笑着说：“我很高兴。你这么好心，竟然会为这种事情担心，真是太体贴了。那你的个人时间呢？有没有足够的时间来放松一下呢？虽然如果你没有休息，我也无能为力，但我还是想知道的。”

“光是像这样聊天就已经很让人满足了，不过确实如此。在完成工作之后，我也会抽时间去做一些自己喜欢的事情！有几次我还去钓鱼了呢…… [flags.GENOVA_TALK_HERSELF
            |掌握了更为复杂的编织技艺
            |学会了编织技术
        ]我是这么想的，”她解释道，“之前我根本不会想到要去做这些事情。尽管我很关心那些孩子，但多年来，除了塔尔达斯首领之外，我其实并没有真正认识过其他人。而那也是因为他主动采取了行动。”[pc.dcb
            |听起来你把那种“隐居”的生活方式彻底颠覆了啊。
            |哎呀，看来你已经把那种与世隔绝的生活方式抛到脑后了啊。
            |哇！你真的开始做了很多事情啊！我很高兴你摆脱了之前的那种忧郁情绪。
        ]你是这么说的。[pc.isBimbo
            |我也一样。感觉就像有一层沉重的压力从我的背上卸了下来。
            |我确实做到了，而且在这个过程中，我感觉自己仿佛卸下了沉重的压力负担。
        ] 要是我能事后诸葛亮，早点拥有这些知识该多好啊。”

“为此懊恼也没什么意义。总是纠结那些本应该或本可以做到的事情，只会让自己陷入固有的思维模式中。我觉得你能够不断学习新东西，而不是被各种烦恼所困扰，这真的很棒。谢谢……天啊，每当谈到这个话题，我就像一台反复播放着感谢之词的录音机一样……嗯，我还能告诉你们什么呢？Mars和他的妻子教了我一些新的烘焙技巧。我本来就不太擅长烘焙，但自从Ahmri还小的时候，我就喜欢做一些简单的点心， just为了看到她吃到那些点心时脸上洋溢的幸福表情。 即使在她年纪再大的时候，我依然会继续关注这些事情，而且有些新一代的人也同样喜欢它们。

你们俩又聊了一会儿，不过你心里非常确信，从一开始，她的状况就已经好多了。 她向你讲述她最近参加过的各种活动，以及她在村里听到的最新八卦，直到你说到一些你早已知道的事情。之后，这种闲聊就会一直持续下去，直到你们俩都没有什么可说的了。
        
        再次感谢你这样与我交谈，”当你们的对话逐渐结束时，她说道，“这真的帮了大忙。你在这里还有其他想要做的事情吗？

rows.original:
"I'm hoping it's not too much of a sore spot, but you seem to be quite skilled in illusion magic. Have you always had that talent, or was it[pc.dcb
            | brought out by Kasyrra's twisting
            | kickstarted by the demonic taint
            |, um, just from the bad stuff
        ]?" you ask.
        
        "Ah, [pc.isDK
            |not at all
            |there's no need to worry
        ]. The stronger aspects have all but slipped away from me now. I've always had a little bit of a knack for it, but nothing quite so grandiose. I still do put on small shows for the kids, and that used to be all I did with it," she explains, twirling a finger through the air between you and creating a line of twinkling lights that hang for a moment before fading. "Oh, and I find it much easier to cover up with minor illusions than make-up."
        
        "Taldahs made it sound like that's what the demoness tempted you with. Are you feeling any better about it?"
        
        "Um... I don't know, I guess. It's not like hearing 'don't worry' always banishes the worries, but I don't think I'd fall for another trick like that again. Her power bolstered my magic, but it was still just faking it. Although, hmm, I guess it's easier having the kids back. That always made me feel less stressed about, well, anything I was stressing about! When they tell me about their days and their small worries, it makes mine seem so insignificant. It's nice to have that again."
        
        "I'm glad. What kind of shows do you do with your magic? Is it mostly just light shows for the kids?" you ask, happy to keep the conversation on the parts of her talent that she's more excited about.
        
        "No, not just that. That's usually just to get their attention or to put them to sleep with more soothing lights for nap times. When I'm trying to teach them something or show them something, I can make tiny illusory things to show them off. They love seeing trees and desert oases, but the more courageous ones like seeing dragons and knights," she says, showing examples for each statement. They appear before her hands and follow them as she moves. It's not nearly the same level of grandiosity as the dragon you saw before you fought her, but it's wonderful nonetheless.
        
        "Amazing. I'll bet Ahmri was in that latter group," you say, watching her illusory knight and dragon dissolve into a flowing waterfall.
        
        "Oh definitely. She'd beg for me to show more fantastical things like towers with princesses and knightly processions. I often had to disappoint her, because I don't know nearly enough about fancy clothes or courtroom etiquette to create the kinds of fanciful things that girl dreams of at night. Still, she would be enraptured even by the simple adventures I could create. It might have helped her better if I'd encouraged her to run and play more, but I don't think Taldahs would have appreciated it as much as she would."
        
        "I think it's great that you were there for her, and that you're still here for all of them. If your magic helps with your job, then that's all the better."
        
        "Thank you, [pc.name]. I appreciate it. I don't know that I can explain it any more in depth, though. Was there anything else you wanted?" she says, flashing a brief question mark between both hands and smirking slightly.
rows.translation:
希望这不会成为一个让你感到尴尬的话题，但你的幻术技巧似乎相当高超。你是天生就具备这种天赋的，还是后来才学会的？[pc.dcb
            | 这是由卡西拉的巧妙设计所促成的。
            | 这一运动是由那股邪恶的力量引发的。
            |嗯，就那些不好的事情来说吧……
        ]你问：‘这是怎么回事？’”
“啊， [pc.isDK
            |一点也不
            |不必担心。
        ]现在，我那些原本擅长的能力几乎都消失了。我以前确实有点天赋，但也没达到那种令人瞩目的程度。现在我还是会为孩子们表演一些小节目，而这曾经就是我做这些事情的全部目的。”她一边说，一边用手指在空中划过，形成一道闪烁的光芒，那光芒在空中停留了片刻后便消失了。“哦，而且我发现，用一些简单的幻术来遮盖自己的缺陷，要比化妆容易得多。
        
        塔尔达斯说得好像就是那个女恶魔用这种方式引诱你的。现在你感觉好一些了吗？”

“嗯……我也不确定。虽然听到‘别担心’并不能完全消除忧虑，但我想我不会再上当受骗了。 她的力量增强了我的魔法，但那终究只是伪装而已。不过，嗯，有孩子们在身边确实让我感觉轻松了许多。他们的日常生活和那些小烦恼总能让我自己面临的那些问题显得微不足道。当他们向我讲述他们的经历和烦恼时，我的那些烦恼也就似乎不再那么重要了。 能够再次拥有这样的体验，真是太好了。
        
        我很高兴。你用魔法表演一些什么样的节目呢？主要是为孩子们表演一些灯光秀吗？”你问道，很乐意继续探讨她那些让她感到最兴奋的才能表现。

“不，并不只是这些。 通常这样做只是为了吸引他们的注意力，或者在他们小睡时使用更柔和的光线帮助他们入睡。而当我想要教他们某些东西或向他们展示某些内容时，我就可以利用这些微小的、虚幻的图像来辅助讲解。 他们喜欢观赏树木和沙漠绿洲，但那些更勇敢的人则更喜欢看到龙和骑士，”她说道，同时为每一句话举出了例子。这些形象会出现在她的手掌前，随着她的动作而移动。虽然这些景象远没有你在与那条龙战斗时所看到的那么壮观，但依然非常美妙。
        
        太神奇了。我敢打赌，阿姆里肯定属于那群喜欢这类东西的人，”你边说边看着她想象中的骑士和巨龙渐渐化作流淌的瀑布。

“哦，那肯定是的。她肯定会缠着我再展示一些更奇幻的东西，比如有公主和骑士队伍出现的城堡之类的。 我常常让她失望，因为我对那些花哨的衣服或法庭礼仪了解得实在太少了，根本无法创造出那个女孩在梦中才会出现的那些奇妙的东西。不过，即便是我所能编造的那些简单的冒险故事，她也会听得入迷。 如果我当时鼓励她多去跑步、多玩耍，或许会对她有所帮助，但我觉得塔尔达斯们可能不会像她那样感激我的这个建议。
        
        我觉得你一直在她身边支持她，现在依然在为他们所有人提供帮助，这真的太好了。如果你的这种能力能帮助你更好地完成工作，那就更好了。”

“谢谢你。 [pc.name]我很感激。不过，我也不知道还能不能再详细地解释一下了。还有其他你想了解的吗？”她说道，同时双手比划出一个小小的问号，脸上带着一丝微笑。

rows.original: "So what exactly does being the village matron entail? I can imagine the basics pretty easily: taking care of the kids while their parents are working, keeping them entertained, and teaching them basic things. Is there anything more to it than that?" you ask. "You got it mostly right, but those things are the core of the duty rather than just the basics. I'm both daycare and teacher here, making sure the children know the history of our people as well as the world we live in. Or at least the parts of it closest to us. I couldn't hope to explain the intricacies of world politics in Jassira or Kitsuhon. If the children are interested in such things, I try to make sure they talk with traveling merchants who might have visited or come from those nations," she explains. "It's amazing that you've been able to keep up with it. I hope the sudden influx of children from the demonic influence won't overwhelm you!" "Ha! Me too... But if I could handle Ahmri, I don't think anything will shake me too hard. I've not had anyone quite as raring to get out and see the world as she was," Nova says with a smile. "[ahmri.fucked |She still is, trust me |She still is, from what I've seen ], but she took your teaching to heart. To have an oral history passed down for so long is a marvel." "I'm glad you think so. It's not really my job to know all the stories, but I find the children really like hearing them. It's an easy way to get the younger ones relaxed before a nap, and also a way to get the older ones excited for learning." "Do your duties include anything not related to the children?" you ask. "[ahmri.married |You know they do! I officiated your marriage," Nova laughs. |Oh yes! Several things, in fact," Nova says. ] "Assisting with marriages is also a responsibility of mine. Besides taking care of children, I also assist in their delivery[var1|, which you also know about]. Helping young mothers learn to rear and take care of their children when I'm unable to is another, and nursing if they can't for whatever reason." "That makes sense. Rolling teacher and midwife into one works well with a village this size." "There's, um, also a voluntary duty I can take to carry a child for someone who is infertile. But that hasn't come up while I've been the matron. The matron from when I was younger did it once, though," Nova says, blushing a little. "[var0|That sounds similar to the maternity duties the valkyries choose to partake in! How selfless, though I suppose it's good that you've never had to worry about it,|How selfless! I'm glad you've never had to make a choice like that, it sounds like it could be tough,]" you reply. "Yeah. I'm kind of glad I haven't needed to, but I also can't think of a single person in the village I wouldn't have done it for should they have asked," Nova says. "It's not something I'd seek out, but I love them all enough to give them that opportunity. That's starting to stray a little from your original question, though. Was there anything else you were wondering about?"

rows.raw: ' "So what exactly does being the village matron entail? I can imagine the basics pretty easily: taking care of the kids while their parents are working, keeping them entertained, and teaching them basic things. Is there anything more to it than that?" you ask. "You got it mostly right, but those things are the core of the duty rather than just the basics. I'm both daycare and teacher here, making sure the children know the history of our people as well as the world we live in. Or at least the parts of it closest to us. I couldn't hope to explain the intricacies of world politics in Jassira or Kitsuhon. If the children are interested in such things, I try to make sure they talk with traveling merchants who might have visited or come from those nations," she explains. "It's amazing that you've been able to keep up with it. I hope the sudden influx of children from the demonic influence won't overwhelm you!" "Ha! Me too... Besides taking care of children, I also assist in their delivery[var1|, which you also know about]. Was there anything else you were wondering about?" '

rows.original: "So what's it like weaving for the village? Do you do all the clothes and tents and the like?" "Gods no, that would be impossible. I'm one of... three weavers in the village? Yeah, three. We all share the burden, but I handle mostly bedding and rugs and repair work for the great festival streamers! Even that gets pretty overwhelming at times. I dunno if you can imagine how rough hooves are on rugs, but it's one of the things that need to be made sturdiest. There are always people needing replacements, so I've always got work to do. Especially if lotsa kids are born in a year, though, I sometimes help with clothes so there's a variety!" "That sounds pretty nice, actually." "Yeah! The worst part is carrying the hugest kind of rugs, or when the bigger tents need repairs. Those times we all work together, though. I'm no good with carrying the heavy stuff, but being light enough to stand on somebody's back without breaking it means I'm great at reaching the tops of tents! Nobody assumes I'm the one who fixes that kind of stuff, so it's a big point of pride." "As it should be," you say. "Good on you all for handling an entire village with three people." "My favorite work is when people ask for specific stuff, or like give me a theme. Flowers are my favorite kinds of things to weave. Ahmri has had me do lots of blankets over the years, and her requests are always some flower she found pressed in a book from some far off place I've never heard of. She's also the only reason I've ever gotten to work with silk, which is tough but so great after it's done." "That sounds a lot like her," you laugh, imagining Ahmri rushing to show the smaller woman flowers to weave into patterns on her blankets or pillows. "Parents also come to me to get their kids favorite foods or animals on a pillow. Those are fun too. Can be annoying if Ahmri's showed them a picture of some bird from Jassira with sticks for legs or something silly like that. With the jolt of your stretch, it doesn't take her long to wake herself, stretching all six limbs at once and then flopping back into a tight hug and a handful of squeezes. Then she looks up at you, freeing your face from its curly prison, and gives you an adoring grin. "Gosh, it's so good having you to wake up to. Like a big wall of pillow. You really know how to fill a void," she says, peppering your neck with smooches. You intercept one of them with your lips, cupping her chin and kissing her deep till she coos happily. "Careful. You're gonna give a girl ideas with a kiss like that. [var0|and she's got a long day of work ahead of her|and she's still got some work to do today.]" "I wouldn't dare keep you from your work," you say, transitioning the smooch to her forehead as you push up onto your knees and help her to her hooves. "By all means, do. Well, sometimes anyway. Whenever your magic 'always-right' senses tell you I need a break," she says with a laugh. The two of you redress, refreshed from your tranquil moment and ready to face the world. "

rows.original: As soon as you walk through the door, Periwinkle tackles you in a [pc.heightRange 0 60|big hug|hug around the waist and thighs.] She stays there for a good while, and then pulls away with a beaming smile. "Hey big [pc.mf|guy|gal], guess what?" she asks, resting her chin against you. "What? Been missing me?" you ask right back. "You could say that. Or I guess now you could say we've been missing you instead," she replies. "We? Who do you m- Oh. Oh!" you say, finally noticing the taut roundness of her belly. "Uh-huh! I'm pregnant! I'm gonna get soooo round, haha!" she laughs, giving you another squeeze. "Yes you are! [peri.pregStage 0 3|Maybe even till your tummy touches the ground,|You already are, even!]" you say, hoisting her up onto her hind legs so you can hug her and rub her belly at the same time. She brushes her nose against yours, hugging tight before dropping back down and humming happily. "So what else do I, we, owe you the pleasure for today, [pc.name]?"
rows.translation: 你一进门，紫罗兰就扑上来抱住了你。 [pc.heightRange 0 60|紧紧拥抱一下|紧贴腰部和大腿。] 她在那里待了很长时间，然后带着灿烂的笑容离开了。 “嘿，大块头…… [pc.mf|伙计|gal]你猜怎么着？”她问道，将下巴靠在你的肩上。 “什么？想我了？”你立刻反问。 “也可以这么说吧。或者，现在你应该这么说才对。 我们已经 其实我一直都很想你呢，”她回答道。 “我们？你说的我们是谁……哦，原来如此！”你终于注意到了她那逐渐凸起的腹部。 “没错！我怀孕了！等我生完孩子，肯定会变得圆滚滚的，哈哈！”她笑着说，又轻轻捏了捏你的胳膊。 “真的吗？太好了！”你高兴地说道。 [peri.pregStage 0 3|也许甚至要让你肚子贴到地上才行。|你其实已经做到了啊！]你就这样把她抱起来，让她用后腿站立，这样你就可以一边拥抱她，一边抚摸她的肚子了。 她会用鼻子轻轻蹭你的鼻子，紧紧地抱住你，然后又放松下来，开心地哼着小曲。 “那么，我还能做些什么呢？ 我们今天能与你共度这段时光，我感到非常愉快。 [pc.name]?"

rows.original:
[flags.PERI_VISIT
        |Peri is upon you as soon as you enter her tent, hugging and kissing and bouncing in place. You immediately notice her tummy is distinctly smaller than it's been for a while. The only logical assumption is that her baby has been born! Given that knowledge, you match her hug with equal enthusiasm, and squeeze her right up till she can't handle any more squeezing. Only then do you let her go, smiling proudly.

        "We had a baby!" she laughs, stamping her hooves in excitement. "Nova and I can take care of everything, but I'm glad you were here to pamper me."
        
        "And I'll keep being here, too. You're just so easy to pamper," you say.
        
        "Good. And if you knock me up again I'll expect the same amount of pampering," she says, proudly raising her chin.
        
        "There's no way you won't get it," you say, planting a big kiss right on her nose.
        
        "Heheheh," she giggles, hugging you tighter. "So what were you actually coming for today, then? More pampering?"
        |Peri turns to see you as you enter her tent, but she's got a frustrated pout on her face that only deepens when she recognizes you.

        "You big meanie! Now you show up?" she asks, coming over to give you a half-hearted punch on the thigh.
        
        "What? What did I do?" you ask right back.
        
        "You knocked me up, idiot! And then you weren't even around to see me get so round my tummy touched the ground!" she says, and can't help but crack a smile. Even still, there's obvious real frustration in her voice.
        
        "I'm sorry," you say, wrapping your arms around her shoulders and squeezing tight.
        
        You stay there for a good ten minutes, holding her tight and keeping her secure. When the tension in her body finally relaxes, you loosen the hug enough to let her look you in the face.
        
        "I know you mean it. The baby's all taken care of between me and Nova, but I was really looking forward to the pampering part. Promise you'll come around to pamper me next time?" she asks.
        
        "I will. Wait, next time?"
        
        "Yeah next time, you think I wouldn't do that again? It was awesome! I don't want you to miss out!" she says, bushy tail flitting over her hindquarters. "In the meantime though, what fun have you come for today?"
    ]
rows.translation:
[flags.PERI_VISIT
        |你一走进佩里的帐篷，她立刻扑上来，抱着你、亲吻你，还开心地跳来跳去。你立刻注意到，她的肚子明显比之前小了很多。唯一的合理解释就是，她的宝宝已经出生了！ 知道了这个消息后，你也同样热情地回抱了她，把她紧紧搂在怀里，直到她再也无法承受这种挤压为止。直到那时，你才笑着放开她。

“我们有孩子了！”她兴奋地笑着，高兴得直跳脚。 诺娃和我可以处理所有事情，不过能有你在这里宠爱我，我真的很开心。”

“我也会一直在这里的。你实在太容易让人宠爱了，”你说。

“太好了。要是你再让我怀孕的话，我也希望得到同样多的宠爱，”她骄傲地抬起下巴说道。
        
        你肯定能得到它的，”你说着，然后在她的鼻子上亲了一口。

“嘿嘿嘿，”她笑着，把你的手臂搂得更紧了。“那么，你今天到底来这里是干什么的？是想得到更多的宠爱吗？
        |当你走进佩里的帐篷时，她转过头来看你，但她的脸上带着沮丧的表情，而当她认出你时，这种表情变得更加明显了。

“你这个大坏蛋！现在才出现啊？”她边说边走过来，半心半意地朝你的大腿打了一拳。
        
        什么？我做了什么？”你立刻反问道。

“你让我怀孕了，白痴！之后你甚至都不在身边，让我肚子大到几乎碰到地面了！”她说道，说着忍不住笑了出来。不过，她的声音里依然能明显感受到一丝沮丧。
        
        对不起，”你说道，将手臂环绕在她的肩上，紧紧地抱住她。

你这样抱着她，足足过了十分钟，紧紧地守护着她，让她感到安心。直到她身体里的紧张情绪终于消退，你才稍微松开怀抱，让她能够看着你的脸。
        
        我知道你是认真的。宝宝的事情有我和诺娃在照顾，但我真的很期待你能来宠溺我一下。下次一定要来陪我哦？”她问道。

“我一定会的。等等，下次吗？”他回答道。是啊，下次你以为我不会再这么做了吗？那真是太棒了！我可不想让你错过这个机会！”她说道，蓬松的尾巴在身后欢快地摆动着。“那么，你今天到底是来这儿做什么玩的呢？"
    ]

rows.original: Now's as good a time as any to pick flowers from the mountain.
rows.translation: 现在正是从山上采花的最佳时机。
rows.raw: "Now's as good a time as any to pick flowers from the mountain."

rows.original: Eubicha is recovering from her ride with you.
rows.translation: 尤比查正在从与你一起的那次冒险中恢复过来。
rows.raw: "Eubicha is recovering from her ride with you."

rows.original: The crates appear to be stocked with stoppered ceramic jars. Most of them lie open and spent, with trace amounts of oliban oil seeping into the dirt around them. Luckily, two of the jars are untouched. You take both, stowing them in your pack. These could prove useful going ahead.
rows.translation: 这些箱子里似乎装满了塞有塞子的陶瓷罐。其中大多数都已经打开使用过了，少量的橄榄油渗了出来，弄脏了周围的泥土。幸运的是，还有两个罐子完好无损。你把它们都拿了起来，放进了背包里——这些东西以后可能会派上用场。
rows.raw: "\n        The crates appear to be stocked with stoppered ceramic jars. Most of them lie open and spent, with trace amounts of oliban oil seeping into the dirt around them. Luckily, two of the jars are untouched. You take both, stowing them in your pack. These could prove useful going ahead."

rows.original: There appear to be a number of crates near a particularly thick tree.
rows.translation: 在那一棵特别粗的树附近，似乎有一些箱子。
rows.raw: "There appear to be a number of crates near a particularly thick tree."

rows.translation: 去和半人马女院长谈谈。

rows.original: It's time to rile up the horde.
rows.translation: 是时候召集那些族人了。
rows.raw: "It's time to rile up the horde."

rows.original: [silly|Approach the chonkpone|[ahmri.married|Approach your wife|Talk to Ahmri]].
rows.translation: [silly|靠近那个胖墩儿吧。|[ahmri.married|去和你妻子谈谈吧。|与阿姆里交谈]].
rows.raw: "[silly|Approach the chonkpone|[ahmri.married|Approach your wife|Talk to Ahmri]]."

rows.translation: 去看看你那个恶魔般的马友吧。

rows.original: Where is he, and more importantly how do you get him for yourself?
rows.translation: 他在哪里？更重要的是，你该如何把他据为己有？
rows.raw: "Where is he, and more importantly how do you get him for yourself?"

rows.original:
As you walk through the sparse crop of trees near the village, you happen upon a clearing in their midst. Inside, a huge statue looms almost to the treetops. It's hard to make out the statue's features, as it's covered top to bottom in nasty brambles. However, you can make out two figures as you approach, each a member of the Savarran pantheon. On one side, the god Velun stands tall and proud. On the other the goddess Lumia, depicted here as a centaur, clasps her fingers before her stomach. Each is holding half of a gemstone that looks like it would be about the size of your head. 

        There's something about the gems that looks important...
        
        [var0
            |This must be one of the portals to the ways between! You hold up your own gem, watching as the two halves begin to glow. They flash bright for a moment, and then return to their dull states. You can feel this place's connection to the ways now, like a gentle tug at the back of your mind.
            |Unfortunately you aren't quite sure what it is. You'll have to come back later when things become more clear.
        ]
rows.translation:
当你穿过村庄附近稀疏的树林时，偶然发现了一片空地。在空地的中央，有一座巨大的雕像，它的顶部几乎触到了树梢。由于雕像全身都被茂密的灌木丛覆盖着，因此很难看清它的面貌。 然而，当你靠近时，可以清楚地看到两个神像——他们都是萨瓦兰神话中的神明。其中一侧，神维伦巍然矗立，显得庄严而骄傲；而在另一侧，女神卢米娅以半人半马的形态出现，她将双手交叠放在腹部前。 每个人手中都握着半颗宝石，那些宝石的大小大概有你的头那么大。 

这些宝石看起来似乎非常重要……
        
        [var0
            |这肯定就是通往那些神秘通道的入口之一！你举起自己手中的宝石，看着那两半宝石开始发光。它们短暂地闪烁着明亮的光芒，随后又恢复了黯淡的状态。此刻，你能感受到这个地方与那些神秘通道之间的联系，就像有一种微妙的力量在轻轻牵引着你的思绪。
            |不幸的是，你目前还不太清楚那到底是什么。等情况变得更加明朗之后，你再回来吧。
        ]

rows.original:
You return to the clearing where you found the way portal, holding your gem aloft in front of the statue to the paired gods. Their dual gemstones begin to glow as soon as you get close, the light inside them growing till you need to avert your eyes before flashing and fading back to their previous dimness.

        It looks like you've unlocked another destination for the wayportals!
rows.translation:
你回到了那个发现传送门的地方，将手中的宝石举到那对神像面前。当你靠近时，他们手中的宝石开始发光，光芒逐渐增强，直到你不得不移开视线——随后光芒又会减弱，恢复到之前的昏暗状态。

看来，你又为这些传送门解锁了一个新的目的地！
rows.raw:
"
        You return to the clearing where you found the way portal, holding your gem aloft in front of the statue to the paired gods. Their dual gemstones begin to glow as soon as you get close, the light inside them growing till you need to avert your eyes before flashing and fading back to their previous dimness.

        It looks like you've unlocked another destination for the wayportals!"

rows.original:
You find the tribal chief at the bakery, chatting with some of the bakers about how they're dealing with the recent turmoil. He waves when he sees you, and breaks off his conversation politely to meet you just outside.

    "[pc.name]! I hope all is well with you. It feels quite odd to adjust to normalcy, but living in the village is helping, I think. It's easier to help any left over doubters when I can talk with them face-to-face, and it's harder to fall back into that bad place I was stuck in when I can see what's happening firsthand. It's better than being cooped up." He gives you an exaggerated shudder and accompanying look of disgust that just as swiftly breaks into a grin that matches his daughter's.
rows.translation: 你在面包店找到了部落首领，他正在和一些面包师聊天，讨论他们是如何应对最近发生的这些动荡的。当他看到你时，便向你招手，然后礼貌地结束谈话，走到外面与你见面。[pc.name]希望你一切都好。重新适应正常生活确实有点奇怪，但住在村子里，我觉得倒有帮助。当能够与那些仍然抱有疑虑的人面对面交谈时，就更容易说服他们；而当能够亲眼看到发生的一切时，也就更不容易重新陷入那种糟糕的状态了。总比闷在屋里要好得多。”他说着，夸张地耸了耸肩，脸上露出厌恶的表情，但很快又露出了和女儿一样的笑容。
rows.raw:
"
    You find the tribal chief at the bakery, chatting with some of the bakers about how they're dealing with the recent turmoil. He waves when he sees you, and breaks off his conversation politely to meet you just outside.

    "[pc.name]! I hope all is well with you. It feels quite odd to adjust to normalcy, but living in the village is helping, I think. It's easier to help any left over doubters when I can talk with them face-to-face, and it's harder to fall back into that bad place I was stuck in when I can see what's happening firsthand. It's better than being cooped up." He gives you an exaggerated shudder and accompanying look of disgust that just as swiftly breaks into a grin that matches his daughter's."

rows.original:
Taldahs is relatively easy to find. The village chief is as loud as he is outgoing, and you track him by voice to find him conversing with some of the other villagers. He breaks away when he sees you, trotting over to greet you with a brief hug. 

    "[pc.name]! Good to see you! What brings you here today?"
rows.translation: 塔尔达斯村相当容易找到。村长性格开朗，声音也很响亮，你可以通过他的声音找到他——他会和其他村民们聊天。当他看到你时，会立刻走过来，与你简短地拥抱一下表示问候。[pc.name]很高兴见到你！今天是什么事让你来到这里呢？
rows.raw:
'
    Taldahs is relatively easy to find. The village chief is as loud as he is outgoing, and you track him by voice to find him conversing with some of the other villagers. He breaks away when he sees you, trotting over to greet you with a brief hug. 

    "[pc.name]! Good to see you! What brings you here today?"'

rows.original: Take a look at the chieftain.
Ask about the whereabouts of the behemoth. It's not like he could have gone far without being noticed.
rows.translation: 去打听一下那个巨人的下落吧。他不可能在不被人注意的情况下走得太远。
rows.raw: "Ask about the whereabouts of the behemoth. It's not like he could have gone far without being noticed."

rows.original: Speak to Taldahs about marrying Ahmri.
rows.translation: 去和塔尔达斯谈谈关于和阿姆里结婚的事情吧。

rows.original: You've got the flowers, what's next?
rows.translation: 你都已经拿到了那些花，接下来该做什么呢？

rows.original:
The chieftain of the centaurs is a large and powerfully built man. Visible muscle meshes with just enough softness to relieve any feelings of intimidation you'd get from his nearly nine foot frame. Perhaps he might be scarier if it weren't for his perpetual smile and open demeanor. 
    
    His blonde hair is usually combed backwards, and falls to his neck in thick locks. His face is creased with years of smile lines, and his bright blue eyes are full of a curiosity that belies his age.
    
    Usually, the chieftain can be found shirtless, with nothing but a set of saddlebags adorning his equine shoulders. All in all the ensemble combines to create a very %"fatherly" figure.
rows.translation:
半人马的族长是一个身材高大、体格强健的男子。他身上明显的肌肉线条中透着一丝柔韧性，这使得他近九英尺的身高并不会让人感到恐惧。如果他没有那始终挂在脸上的微笑和开朗的性格，或许会显得更加令人生畏。 
    
    他的金发通常被梳向后方，浓密的发丝垂落在脖子上。多年的微笑在脸上留下了痕迹，而他那双明亮的蓝眼睛中充满着好奇心，这种好奇心与他实际年龄并不相符。

通常，这位首领会赤裸上身，只在马背上背着一副马鞍包。 总的来说，这些元素共同塑造出了一个极具“父亲般”形象的人物。
rows.raw:
"
    The chieftain of the centaurs is a large and powerfully built man. Visible muscle meshes with just enough softness to relieve any feelings of intimidation you'd get from his nearly nine foot frame. Perhaps he might be scarier if it weren't for his perpetual smile and open demeanor. 
    
    His blonde hair is usually combed backwards, and falls to his neck in thick locks. His face is creased with years of smile lines, and his bright blue eyes are full of a curiosity that belies his age.
    
    Usually, the chieftain can be found shirtless, with nothing but a set of saddlebags adorning his equine shoulders. All in all the ensemble combines to create a very %"fatherly" figure."

rows.original:
"So, where did the behemoth end up?" you ask.
    
    "Ah... yes," Taldahs says. "The behemoth. We've had our shamans keeping him sedated since he fell."
    
    "You didn't kill him?" you ask.
    
    "It just didn't seem right," he says, grimacing. "Though it might be a mercy, there's no-one among us who could put him to the sword while he lays sleeping."
    
    [pc.dcb

rows.original: Sooo how do centaur weddings work? Ahmri did tell you that he was the person to ask. Taldahs lets out a relieved huff. "Phewwww, thank the gods. I thought for sure you were going to think she's too clingy or too brazen, or find some other problem with her. She used to sit inside reading every hour of the day, and I feel like you could get her out more," he says, trying his best to be nonchalant. You can hear the hint of desperation in his plea, but there's no need for him to worry. That's why you're asking in the first place! But, what do you do? "O-oh, right? Well that's easy. There are some flowers up in the mountains, pretty blue or red things depending on where the light touches them. I think they're called some kinda vine or weed out in the rest of the Marches, but here they're real pretty. Just pick one, whichever you like the best. Ahmri probably already has one picked out... after that, you just choose a date. Give her the flower whenever you feel like it, though sooner is better than later, I imagine. The whole affair is pretty simple once you kick it off. Nothing as fancy as what all they do off in the big cities, " he explains, waving his hand in the direction of the mountains. It was simple enough reaching the wall of flowering plants the last time you were up in the mountains, and nowadays there are centaurs picking herbs in the mountains who can help if you do get lost. "Also, because I know it's different elsewhere in the world..." he pauses, thinking at length before continuing, "A wedding for us is a promise between two people, rather than to a god or a church or any other power. Don't feel like loving Ahmri will tarnish any commitments you've already made, and don't feel bound to her alone. It'd be a source of endless worry for her if she knew she was putting some kind of 'cap' on your love by being with you. Keep that in mind if she finds another love, as well. Seeing her look at you, I doubt it will happen, though. She's got the same look in her eye that I'm sure I did when her mother came to visit. Still, keep an open mind, eh?" You nod. It's something to think about. "Come and get me after you ask her for certain. I don't know that I'll be much help personally, but I can set you up with some of the best wedding preppers in the Marches." He gives you a wink. It looks like you've got some flower picking to do.
rows.translation: 那么，到底该怎么做呢？ 做 半人马族的婚礼真的可行吗？阿姆里确实告诉过你，应该由他来提出这个请求。塔尔达松了一口气，说道： “呼……谢天谢地。我本来还担心你会觉得她太黏人或者太放肆，又或者会找出她其他的缺点呢。 她以前一整天都待在屋里读书，我觉得应该多让她出去走走才对，”他尽量表现得若无其事。不过从他的话语中，还是能听出一丝急切之情。不过，他其实没必要担心这些。 这就是你一开始要问这个问题的原因吧！但是，你到底该怎么做呢？ 哦，对吧？那很简单。在山上有一些花，根据光线照射的角度，它们的颜色会变成蓝色或红色。我想在其他的地区，人们可能会把它们叫做某种藤本植物或杂草，但在这里，它们真的非常漂亮。 随便选一个你最喜欢的吧。嗯，阿姆里可能已经选好了一个……之后你只需要选一个日期就行了。只要你想送花给她的时候就送吧，不过我觉得越早送越好。其实整个过程一旦开始，就会变得相当简单了。 没有什么比大城市里那些奢华的东西更高级的了，”他解释道，同时朝山的方向挥了挥手。上次你去山里的时候，找到那些开满花的植物并不难；而现在，山上还有半人马在采药，如果你迷路了，他们可以帮你指路。 另外，因为我知道在世界的其他地方，情况有所不同……”他停顿了一下，仔细思考后才继续说道，“对我们来说，婚礼意味着两个人之间的承诺，而不是对神明、教会或任何其他力量的承诺。不要觉得爱上阿姆里会影响到你已经做出的任何承诺，也不要觉得自己必须只对她负责。 如果她知道自己和你在一起会在某种程度上限制你的爱，那么这一定会成为她永远的烦恼。如果她找到了另一段爱情，也请记住这一点。不过，从她看你的眼神来看，我觉得这种事情不太可能发生。 她的眼神里带着和我母亲来探望我时一样的神情。不过，还是保持开放的心态吧，嗯？ 你点了点头。这确实是个值得考虑的问题。 “等你问过她之后再来找我吧。虽然我个人可能帮不上太大忙，但我可以帮你介绍一些马奇地区最专业的婚礼筹备专家。”他朝你眨了眨眼。看来，你还有不少事情要处理呢……
rows.raw: " Sooo how do centaur weddings work? Ahmri did tell you that he was the person to ask. Taldahs lets out a relieved huff. "Phewwww, thank the gods. I thought for sure you were going to think she's too clingy or too brazen, or find some other problem with her. She used to sit inside reading every hour of the day, and I feel like you could get her out more," he says, trying his best to be nonchalant. You can hear the hint of desperation in his plea, but there's no need for him to worry. That's why you're asking in the first place! But, what do you do? "O-oh, right? Well that's easy. There are some flowers up in the mountains, pretty blue or red things depending on where the light touches them. I think they're called some kinda vine or weed out in the rest of the Marches, but here they're real pretty. Just pick one, whichever you like the best. Ahmri probably already has one picked out... after that, you just choose a date. Give her the flower whenever you feel like it, though sooner is better than later, I imagine. The whole affair is pretty simple once you kick it off. Nothing as fancy as what all they do off in the big cities, " he explains, waving his hand in the direction of the mountains. It was simple enough reaching the wall of flowering plants the last time you were up in the mountains, and nowadays there are centaurs picking herbs in the mountains who can help if you do get lost. "Also, because I know it's different elsewhere in the world..." he pauses, thinking at length before continuing, "A wedding for us is a promise between two people, rather than to a god or a church or any other power. Don't feel like loving Ahmri will tarnish any commitments you've already made, and don't feel bound to her alone. It'd be a source of endless worry for her if she knew she was putting some kind of 'cap' on your love by being with you. Keep that in mind if she finds another love, as well. Seeing her look at you, I doubt it will happen, though. She's got the same look in her eye that I'm sure I did when her mother came to visit. Still, keep an open mind, eh?" You nod. It's something to think about. "Come and get me after you ask her for certain. I don't know that I'll be much help personally, but I can set you up with some of the best wedding preppers in the Marches." He gives you a wink. It looks like you've got some flower picking to do."

rows.original:
Alright, you've got the flower. What's the next step?

    "Well, that's it! Mars, would you and yours be so kind as to tell Genova to prepare for a wedding? Our [pc.mascFem|dashing|graceful] hero and I need to go fetch my daughter," Taldahs asks, gesturing to the baker and his wife. They grin to each other, trotting out the door in an excited rush. The chieftain laughs as they pass him, gesturing for you to follow as he turns toward the chieftain's abode.
    
    "Alright, so all you have to do is show her the flower. Then you might want to brace yourself. Proposals usually result in hugs, and you have one less pair of legs to brace with." He grins apologetically, leading you up the path till you reach the halfway point. From there, [party.som|y|he stops and motions for [companion1.name] to keep him company, staying behind as well. Y|he stops and motions for your companions stay behind to keep him company. Y]ou hike the rest of the way up alone, shifting the flower in your hand as you pull aside the drape over the doorway. Ahmri peeks around the archway leading to her room, trotting around the corner when she recognizes you.
rows.translation:
好了，你已经得到了那朵花。接下来该做什么呢？

“嗯，就是这个了！马尔斯，你和你的家人能否好心地告诉热那亚，让她为婚礼做好准备呢？我们…… [pc.mascFem|潇洒的|优雅的] 我和英雄得去接我们的女儿了，”塔尔达斯说道，同时指向那位面包师和他的妻子。两人相视而笑，兴奋地匆匆跑出了门。当他们经过酋长身边时，酋长笑了起来，示意你也跟着他们走，然后他自己便朝着酋长的住所方向走去。
    
    好吧，你只需要把花给她看就行了。不过你最好做好心理准备——提出求婚通常会伴随着拥抱，到时候你就少了一条腿可以用来支撑自己了。”他边说边不好意思地笑了笑，然后带着你沿着小路走，直到走到中途的位置。 从那里开始， [party.som|y|他停下来，示意别人过来。 [companion1.name] 为了陪他，我也留了下来。|他停下来，示意你的同伴们留下来陪他。]你独自继续向上攀登，手中始终握着那朵花，一边拉开门廊上的帘子。阿姆里从通往她房间的拱门后探出头来，当她认出你时，立刻快步绕过拐角走了过来。

rows.original:
"[pc.name]! What can I... help you with..." she trails off as she notices the flower in your hand, standing stunned and silent in the shaft of daylight. She takes a step forward, and another, and her father's advice comes in handy when you brace for impact a moment later. Her tackle still carries you into the wall, a tight hug that takes the air out of you. She stays there, like that, hugging you close and pinning you in place, doing nothing but breathing and burying her head in your chest. You hug her back, rubbing her shoulder and holding your flower at arm's length like a prize. You don't think it's too fragile, but you'd rather not test it out this close to... whatever it's used for.

        "I don't want to go. Can we just stay in and already be married?" Ahmri asks, rocking in your arms. 
        
        That sounds wonderful, but based on what Taldahs said, you don't quite think that's how it works. He did also say it wasn't a huge affair, though. Come on, you're sure it won't be too much. 
        
        With some hesitation, she peels her vice grip open and looks at you. Her fingers stay tightly laced in yours, never fully breaking contact. "Yeah. You're right. Everyone else should get to see us, too," she smiles, letting you take the initiative as you both walk out hand in hand. Taldahs is nowhere to be seen when you reach the path, so you take your time walking together through the village on your way to the matron's tent.
rows.translation:
"[pc.name]我……能帮您什么忙呢……”她的话渐渐停住了，因为她注意到了你手中的那朵花。她站在那里，被阳光照得睁不开眼睛，沉默不语。她向前迈了一步，又迈了一步，而这时，你父亲曾经给你的建议派上了用场——就在片刻之后，你做好了迎接冲击的准备。 她的擒抱依然会让你撞上墙壁，那种紧紧的拥抱会让你喘不过气来。她就那样抱着你，把你牢牢固定在那里，什么也不做，只是静静地呼吸，把头埋在你的胸前。 你回抱她，轻抚她的肩膀，同时将手中的花举在适当距离外，就像在展示一件珍贵的礼物。你并不觉得这朵花太脆弱，但在这种近距离的情况下，你还是宁愿不冒险去测试它的耐受力……毕竟，你并不知道它究竟是用来做什么的。

        我不想去。我们能不能就待在家里，然后直接结婚呢？”阿姆里依偎在你的怀里问道。

这听起来确实很美好，但根据塔尔达斯的说法，你并不认为事情会这么简单发展。不过，他也说过这件事并不复杂，不会带来太多麻烦。放心吧，肯定不会有什么问题的。 
        
        她有些犹豫，才慢慢松开紧握着你的手，抬头看着你。她的手指依然紧紧地缠着你的，丝毫没有分开。“对，你说得对。其他人也应该看到我们在一起。”她微笑着，让你主动牵着她的手一起走出去。当你们走到小路上时，塔尔达斯已经不见了，于是你们便慢慢地沿着村庄的道路，朝着女主持人的帐篷走去。

rows.original:
When you do finally arrive, Genova pops out and whisks the two of you apart; Ahmri is ushered behind one side of a hanging tarp, and you the other. Outside, you can see [party.som|Taldahs sitting with the baker and his wife. The chieftain gives you a good luck wink when he sees you looking.|[companion1.name] conversing with a small group of centaurs. [companion1.heShe] gives you a wave when you catch [companion1.hisHer] eye.|your companions conversing with a small group of centaurs. They wave when they see you looking, wishing you well from afar.]

            "Ah, the lucky groom! Before I start ordering you around, have you been told how this works?" Genova asks, trotting around the back end of the hanging tarp. 
            
            Taldahs told you it was a comparatively simple affair, but beyond the proposal he didn't actually explain much...
            
            "I thought not, but don't worry. He wasn't lying. Once we finish up here, we'll head just under the arch that leads out to the field. Then I'll say a few words, you'll present Ahmri with that wonderful flower you're holding there, and she will present you with hers. After that I'll say a few more words, and then you'll rub noses. With that, you'll be married!" she explains, circling you as she speaks and sizing you up. 
            
            That doesn't sound tough at all, but what does %"finishing up" entail?
            
            "Hehe, well first I'm going to need you out of those clothes. Nothing out of the ordinary, I promise. I'll fit you with these flowers to cover the important parts of your body. Ages ago, I was told, these things were done naked. The everblossoms never die once they've been picked, so they built up over the decades. Now the unions of our ancestors join in welcoming new happiness, and these old things experience the light of each new era," she explains, pulling out clusters of flowers woven together at the vine. 
            
            You strip slowly out of your clothes. Despite your experience, the chasteness of your nudity in preparation for the ceremony makes you a little embarrassed. Genova measures you with the kind of toolless expertise that only comes from years of experience. You are redressed in vibrant flowers, a mix of both day and night colors. The covering is just enough to be considered modest... if you don't look too closely, anyway. That matters little. Genova beckons, and you follow her outside, passing the veil of the curtain and coming face to face with Ahmri.
rows.translation:
当你终于到达那里时，热那亚突然出现，将你们两人分开；阿姆里被带到一块悬挂的防水布的那一侧，而你则被带到另一侧。在外面，你可以看到…… [party.som|塔尔达斯正和面包师及其妻子坐在一起。当酋长看到你在看他们时，他还向你眨了眨眼，祝你好运。|[companion1.name] 正在与一小群半人马进行交谈。 [companion1.heShe] 当你抓到它的时候，它会向你挥动一下。 [companion1.hisHer] 眼睛。|你的同伴们正在与一小群半人马交谈。当他们看到你在注视他们时，便挥手向你致意，从远处祝愿你一切顺利。]

            啊，幸运的新郎！在我开始指挥你做事之前，有人告诉你这是怎么运作的吗？”杰诺瓦边说边绕到悬挂的防水布后面走去。

塔尔达斯说过这其实是一件相对简单的事情，但在求婚环节之外，他其实并没有详细解释太多……
            
            我本来也这么想，但别担心，他并没有撒谎。等我们在这里的事情办完，就会走到那座通往田野的拱门下方。然后我会说几句话，你会把你手里拿着的那朵美丽的花送给Ahmri，而她也会把她的花送给你们。之后我还会再讲几句，然后你们就可以亲吻彼此了。这样，你们就结婚了！”她一边说着，一边绕着你转圈，仔细打量着你。 
            
            这听起来一点也不难，但是“用鲜花遮盖身体的重要部位”具体指的是什么呢？

“呵呵，首先你得脱掉那些衣服。我保证不会做什么特别过分的事情。我会用这些鲜花来遮盖你身体上那些需要遮盖的地方。 很久以前，人们告诉我，这些传统都是人们在赤裸状态下完成的。那些‘常开不败的花’一旦被采摘下来，就不会再凋谢，因此这些传统才得以代代相传，历经数十年而不断发展。如今，我们祖先留下的传统与现代的新幸福融为一体，而这些古老的习俗也再次在每一个新时代中焕发出新的生机。”她边说，边从藤蔓上摘下那些被编织在一起的花簇。 
            
            你慢慢地脱掉衣服。尽管你经验丰富，但在仪式开始前裸露身体的这种纯真状态还是让你感到有些尴尬。热那亚以一种只有经过多年经验才能掌握的、无需任何工具的技巧来观察你。 你身着色彩鲜艳的花朵装饰服饰，这些色彩融合了白天与夜晚的色调。这种装束刚好足以被视为端庄得体……至少在你不仔细观察的情况下是如此。不过这其实并不重要。热那亚在召唤你，于是你跟随她走了出去，穿过帘幕的遮掩，与阿姆里面对面相见。

rows.original: There's no safe place to look, bar her face, but you still risk a glance at the rest of her. She's clad head to hoof in blossoms similar to yours, but each shares the color palette of the single flower in your hand. The chunky centaur is hard to contain, and you can see the rich caramel discs of her areolae peeking out from above the twisting vines and colorful blooms. Clusters of color are intertwined in her fluffy equine end, braided into her tail and draped over her back. Her tail gives a joyful swish when she sees you, and she doesn't hesitate for a second in checking out your flower clad form. Warmth and brightness emanates from her, and the smile on her face is fit to banish the most anxious of doubts. She holds out both of her hands, and you lace the fingers of your free hand in hers. Genova pushes the thick partition out of the way, standing in its place just inside the tent, and a natural quiet descends on the field as the gathered crowd hushes up. The matronly centaur gives you a warm smile, indicating the bloom in your hand. "[pc.name]. Without a doubt, you are the reason we are able to continue traditions like this. Now you honor us by becoming part of them. Present your flower in a way you deem fit," she says, sweeping her hand over to Ahmri. A way you deem fit, eh? Sweeping aside thoughts of all other enticing places to look, you brush a lock of Ahmri's hair out of the way. A little adjustment is necessary, prompting some giggles from the fair haired horse-woman, but with minor effort you fit the flower snugly behind her ear. You choose not to step back, staying close enough that your chests almost touch. "Ahmri, dear daughter of the centaurs. We all know how long you've been waiting for your hero, but not a day longer. Present [pc.himHer] with your flower," She sweeps her arm back in your direction. Ahmri puffs up proudly, giving one sheepish look to the crowd, and reaches behind her back. Shuffling for a moment, she withdraws an entire crown of bright and soft colors alike. Blue, red, purple, orange, every color you saw on the wall tied in unison! She sees your eyes widen and scrapes at the dirt with one of her hooves. "I mean. I saw this blue one and it reminded me of how caring and gentle you were, but then this red one reminded me of how you fought off those beasts who were trying to capture me, and then... well, I couldn't pick just one!" she explains as best she can, lifting the makeshift crown and placing it atop your head. It feels much sturdier than it looks, like a comforting hug around your skull. The soothing weight leaves you feeling at ease, as warm inside as you feel outside. "There. Now each of you has a place in our story. May your tale add wonders of its own to tell many years from now," Genova finishes, ducking back a step. At the same time Ahmri steps forward, closing the last tiny gap between you and pulling you into a tight embrace. You [pc.heightRange 0 48 72|stretch on [pc.hasToes|your tiptoes|the tip of your hooves],|step into it without effort,|lean down to meet her,] closing your eyes and rubbing your nose gently against hers. Heated breaths tickle your lips as the two of you rock gently together, forgetting the world for the briefest of moments. Then it's over, and Ahmri slips in a chaste kiss to your lips before stepping back from the hug. You keep hold of one hand, not wanting to let the moment die entirely, and turn to the crowd. The baker and her husband erupt in excited claps, rushing up to congratulate the two of you. [atugia.recruited|Atugia whistles loudly between her fingers, cheering loudly alongside them. ]The ceremony itself may have been short and sweet, but many more villagers hear the commotion and come to laud your union. [brint.recruited |[brint.isBrienne |"Congratulations!" Brienne exclaims, tackling Ahmri head on in a hug. The sturdy pony staggers at the impact, but laughs whole heartedly. "You look so beautiful! Aaah, you have to come to my wedding. I just want to dress you up in all kinds of traditional Khor'minoan outfits!" She continues, cupping Ahmri's cheeks in both hands and giving them a wholesome squeeze. "I-I'd love to! I'll have to visit Khor'minos anyway, so maybe you can show me around while I'm there," your blushing bride gushes, grinning as the busty cow pampers her. ] ] [etheryn.recruited |While moving between a group of conversing villagers, you bump headfirst into Etheryn. She lets out a surprised eep before recognizing the two of you. [etheryn.lowConfidence |"U-uhm, congratulations. rows.translation: 除了她的脸庞，没有其他地方是安全的——但你仍然有可能瞥见她的其他部位。她全身都覆盖着与你手中那朵花相似的花朵，而这些花朵都采用了与你手中那朵花相同的色彩搭配。那个魁梧的半人马实在难以被完全遮挡住，你可以看到她乳晕上那浓郁的焦糖色圆斑正从缠绕着的藤蔓和五颜六色的花朵中露出来。 她那蓬松的马尾上交织着五颜六色的色彩，这些颜色被编成辫子垂在她的尾巴上，同时也覆盖在她的背上。每当她看到你时，她的尾巴就会欢快地摆动起来，而她也不会丝毫迟疑地仔细观察你那身着花朵图案服饰的身影。 她身上散发着温暖与光芒，她脸上的笑容足以消除人们心中最焦虑的疑虑。她伸出双手，你将空闲的那只手与她的手指紧紧相握。杰诺娃将那道厚厚的隔板推到一边，站在帐篷内侧的位置，顿时，聚集在场的众人都安静了下来，一片自然的宁静笼罩了整个场地。 那位慈祥的半人马向你露出了温暖的微笑，同时指了指你手中的花朵。[pc.name]毫无疑问，正是你们让我们能够延续这样的传统。现在，你们也加入了这一传统，从而给予了我们荣誉。请以你们认为合适的方式献上你们的花吧，”她说着，同时将手伸向了Ahmri。 用你认为合适的方式吧，嗯？将其他所有吸引人的地方都抛到脑后，你把阿姆里的一缕头发拨到一边。稍微调整了一下位置，这个金发的女马人忍不住笑了起来，但经过一番小努力，你终于把那朵花稳稳地别在了她的耳后。 你选择不退缩，站得如此之近，以至于你们的胸膛几乎要碰到一起。 “啊姆丽，半人马族亲爱的女儿。我们都知道你等待你的英雄已经等了多久，但不能再等一天了。 当前 [pc.himHer] 带着你的花吧，”她将手臂朝你的方向一挥。阿姆里骄傲地挺起胸膛，羞涩地瞥了人群一眼，然后从背后拿出了一个花环——那是由色彩鲜艳、质地柔软的花朵组成的花环。 蓝色、红色、紫色、橙色——墙上出现的每一种颜色仿佛都在和谐地交织在一起！她看到你的眼睛瞪得大大的，于是用其中一只蹄子开始刨弄地上的泥土。 “我是说，看到这种蓝色时，我想起了你是多么细心、多么温柔；而看到这种红色时，我又想起了你是如何与那些试图抓走我的野兽搏斗的……嗯，我实在选不出一个来！”她尽力解释着，将那个临时制作的王冠戴在你的头上。它看起来虽然简单，但实际上却非常结实，仿佛给你的头骨带来了一种温暖的拥抱。这种沉甸甸的感觉让人感到安心，让你的内心和外在都变得温暖起来。 好了，现在你们每个人都在我们的故事中占有一席之地。愿你们的故事在未来多年里继续创造奇迹，带给人们更多的惊喜。”杰诺瓦说完后，向后退了一步。与此同时，阿姆里向前迈出一步，填补了你们之间最后的距离，然后将你紧紧拥入怀中。 你 [pc.heightRange 0 48 72|拖延时间 [pc.hasToes|踮着脚尖|蹄尖],|毫不费力地就能上手。|他俯下身子与她对视。] 你闭上眼睛，轻轻地将鼻子贴在她的鼻子上。你们轻轻摇晃着身体，彼此呼出的热气轻拂着你们的嘴唇，在这一刹那，你们完全忘记了周围的世界。 然后这一切都结束了，阿姆里在轻轻吻了你的嘴唇一下后，便从拥抱中退了出来。你紧紧握住他的手，不愿让这一刻就这样消失，然后转身面向人群。面包师和她的丈夫兴奋地鼓起掌来，冲上来祝贺你们俩。 [atugia.recruited|阿图吉亚用手指吹出响亮的口哨声，为他们大声加油助威。 ]这场仪式虽然简短而温馨，但许多村民听到了动静，纷纷前来祝贺你们的结合。 [brint.recruited |[brint.isBrienne |恭喜你！”布蕾妮兴奋地叫道，冲上前去紧紧拥抱了艾姆里。那匹结实的矮种马被这一抱弄得有些踉跄，但依然开心地笑了起来。 “你看起来真是太漂亮了！啊…… 拥有 一定要来参加我的婚礼啊！我就想让你穿上各种各样传统的科尔米诺亚服装呢！”她一边说，一边用双手捧住阿姆里的脸颊，轻轻捏了捏。 “我、我非常愿意！反正我也得去科尔米诺亚，到时候也许你可以带我四处逛逛吧。”你的新娘红着脸，满脸笑容地说道，而那位身材丰满的女子也在温柔地照料着她。 ] ] [etheryn.recruited |凯特从两位半人马客人的身后走出来，突然跳过来拥抱了你们三人。她狡黠地笑了笑，在拥抱中故意加了一些暧昧的举动。 “我们得找个时间再聚一聚。 我可以教你们各种新婚夫妇在贾西拉会喜欢的仪式哦，”她一边说，一边眨了眨大眼睛，露出友好的笑容。 “呃……也许我们应该学学。不过……等会儿再学吧，”阿姆里支支吾吾地回答，同时移开了视线。 当然啦，傻瓜！你们先需要一些独处的时间，”凯特一边说，一边亲了亲那个慌乱的小马驹的脸颊，然后迅速走开，试图转移一些多余的注意力。 ]
rows.raw: ' There's no safe place to look, bar her face, but you still risk a glance at the rest of her. She's clad head to hoof in blossoms similar to yours, but each shares the color palette of the single flower in your hand. The chunky centaur is hard to contain, and you can see the rich caramel discs of her areolae peeking out from above the twisting vines and colorful blooms. Clusters of color are intertwined in her fluffy equine end, braided into her tail and draped over her back. Her tail gives a joyful swish when she sees you, and she doesn't hesitate for a second in checking out your flower clad form. Warmth and brightness emanates from her, and the smile on her face is fit to banish the most anxious of doubts. She holds out both of her hands, and you lace the fingers of your free hand in hers. Genova pushes the thick partition out of the way, standing in its place just inside the tent, and a natural quiet descends on the field as the gathered crowd hushes up. The matronly centaur gives you a warm smile, indicating the bloom in your hand. "[pc.name]. Without a doubt, you are the reason we are able to continue traditions like this. Now you honor us by becoming part of them. Present your flower in a way you deem fit," she says, sweeping her hand over to Ahmri. A way you deem fit, eh? Sweeping aside thoughts of all other enticing places to look, you brush a lock of Ahmri's hair out of the way. A little adjustment is necessary, prompting some giggles from the fair haired horse-woman, but with minor effort you fit the flower snugly behind her ear. You choose not to step back, staying close enough that your chests almost touch. "Ahmri, dear daughter of the centaurs. We all know how long you've been waiting for your hero, but not a day longer. Present [pc.himHer] with your flower," She sweeps her arm back in your direction. Ahmri puffs up proudly, giving one sheepish look to the crowd, and reaches behind her back. Shuffling for a moment, she withdraws an entire crown of bright and soft colors alike. Blue, red, purple, orange, every color you saw on the wall tied in unison! She sees your eyes widen and scrapes at the dirt with one of her hooves. "I mean. I saw this blue one and it reminded me of how caring and gentle you were, but then this red one reminded me of how you fought off those beasts who were trying to capture me, and then... well, I couldn't pick just one!" she explains as best she can, lifting the makeshift crown and placing it atop your head. It feels much sturdier than it looks, like a comforting hug around your skull. The soothing weight leaves you feeling at ease, as warm inside as you feel outside. "There. Now each of you has a place in our story. May your tale add wonders of its own to tell many years from now," Genova finishes, ducking back a step. At the same time Ahmri steps forward, closing the last tiny gap between you and pulling you into a tight embrace. You [pc.heightRange 0 48 72|stretch on [pc.hasToes|your tiptoes|the tip of your hooves],|step into it without effort,|lean down to meet her,] closing your eyes and rubbing your nose gently against hers. Heated breaths tickle your lips as the two of you rock gently together, forgetting the world for the briefest of moments. Then it's over, and Ahmri slips in a chaste kiss to your lips before stepping back from the hug. You keep hold of one hand, not wanting to let the moment die entirely, and turn to the crowd. The baker and her husband erupt in excited claps, rushing up to congratulate the two of you. [atugia.recruited|Atugia whistles loudly between her fingers, cheering loudly alongside them. ]The ceremony itself may have been short and sweet, but many more villagers hear the commotion and come to laud your union. [brint.recruited |[brint.isBrienne |"Congratulations!" Brienne exclaims, tackling Ahmri head on in a hug. The sturdy pony staggers at the impact, but laughs whole heartedly. "You look so beautiful! Aaah, you have to come to my wedding. I just want to dress you up in all kinds of traditional Khor'minoan outfits!" She continues, cupping Ahmri's cheeks in both hands and giving them a wholesome squeeze. "I-I'd love to! I'll have to visit Khor'minos anyway, so maybe you can show me around while I'm there," your blushing bride gushes, grinning as the busty cow pampers her. ] ] [etheryn.recruited |While moving between a group of conversing villagers, you bump headfirst into Etheryn. She lets out a surprised eep before recognizing the two of you. [etheryn.lowConfidence |"U-uhm, congratulations. You look really pretty with those flowers, a-and I'm happy that you two are so happy, and uh, ohhh that just sounds dumb," she flusters. Ahmri looks to be on the verge of laughing the whole time she talks, but instead she pulls her into a big hug. "I'm happy you came! I'll come visit [flags.WC_CLEAR |you sometime soon, now that you're totally a queen and all. |when you kick that dumb sister of yours off the throne and become queen yourself. I know you'll get there, ]" she says, gently brushing the back of Ryn's head. The pale elf melts, and for a second you're worried she'll start sobbing, but when she pulls back from the hug she looks more determined than you've ever seen her. "You're right, a-and I'll be there to let you in!" she nods, bowing a little and going back to the festivities with a little more pep in her step. |"Congratulations!. You look very pretty with those flowers. I'd love to have you make me something that pretty when I get married," she says, sighing wistfully. "Certainly. I'll have to get to know the royalty if I'm going to be chieftain someday," Ahmri replies, and the two of them stare at each other for a beat, prim and proper but with smiles a little too wide. And then they burst into [silly|flames|laughter], embracing and giving each other the real congratulations they intended. They part with genuine smiles, and Ryn darts off to join the festivities. ] ] [cait.recruited |Cait appears from behind two centaur guests, jumping into a hug that pulls all three of you together. She gives you a sly grin, putting more than a little suggestive squeezing into her hug. "We'll have to get together sometime soon. I can teach you all kinds of rituals favored by honeymooners visiting Jassira," she finishes with a big wink and a friendly smirk. "U-uhm, m-maybe we should. But... later," Ahmri fumbles, averting her eyes. "Of course, silly! You guys need some alone time first," Cait says, kissing the flustered pony on both cheeks before bouncing off to try and divert some of the excess attention. ]'

rows.original: While the gathered crowd converses, Ahmri pulls you away, up and toward the hut on the hill. She prances giddily, rushing up the incline with vivacious intent. The unrestrained movement practically bounces her right out of the flowery coating of her wedding attire, but the makeshift garment defies common sense to keep the frolicking centaur clothed. Cheeky things, soon you'll get them off yourself. "Come onnn. [flags.AHMRI_VAG|I know we did it before, but it feels like my first time all over again!|I already waited once! I don't know if I can take it any longer,]" she groans, pulling you toward the secluded safety of the chieftain's cabin. No flowers obscure the glimpses you get of her winking slit, the veil of blossoms lifted by her tail as it curls up and over her fluffy cheeks. She looks as ready as she sounds, and [pc.isCorrupted|all|much] of your restraint goes to not taking her right there on the hill. No, you hike the last few steps up to the doorway. You look to your flushed bride as you reach the threshold, huffing for air from the climb and covered in a thin sheen of sweat. You want to do something significant. She's your wife now, and that means something. Even if it's not so big a spiritual deal you still want to make her feel like she's the most important woman in the world. It all starts with getting inside. [pc.strengthRange 95|Feeling the surge of [pc.hasBoon RyeBeer|temporary|natural] power in your body, you know just how to start things off. Cracking your knuckles, you hug Ahmri around the legs. She gives you a confused look over her shoulder, transitioning to a shocked smile when you grunt with effort and hoist her clean off the ground. She claps excitedly, but otherwise tries her best to stay still as you begin to take shuffling steps through the doorway. "Oh-oh gods. Is this a custom in your land? C-careful of the di-eeeep!" The warning comes too late to stop you from tumbling Ahmri-first onto the center room's first rug.|It may not be quite as grandiose as literally carrying her over the threshold, but you have an idea. Taking a length of vine from your flowery garment, you tie it around both your and Ahmri's ankles. She gives you a confused but intrigued look as you explain that you can now walk into the house for the first time as one. It sounds kinda stupid when you say it out loud, but... "No! I don't know if this is a tradition where you come from, but I wanna try it even if you just thought it up on the spot. We just have to go one step at a time," she says, hugging you around the shoulder as you begin lift-stepping your way inside. It's easier than you thought, on account of Ahmri still having three unhindered legs. Unfortunately, neither of you account for the dip at the end of the stoop, and Ahmri tumbles side-first onto the center room's first rug.] The hefty horsie laughs the whole way down, cushioning your fall with a muffled thump. Both of you are unhurt, laughing off the easy landing with giddy enthusiasm, but that's not to say the fall was without casualties. Loose threads are all that's left of the vines containing your sun-kissed spouse's breasts, and her caramel brown nipples have just begun to peek out. You tug the last few strands out of the way, replacing them with a hand as you lean in for a kiss.
rows.translation: 当周围的人群正在交谈时，阿姆里拉着你往山上那间小屋走去。她兴奋地蹦蹦跳跳，充满活力地跑上山坡。她那毫无顾及的动作几乎让她身上的婚礼礼服上的花朵装饰都脱落下来，但这件临时制作的衣服却出人意料地让她保持整洁。这些调皮的东西……很快你就会自己把它们脱掉的。 “快来吧。 [flags.AHMRI_VAG|我知道我们以前也做过这件事，但这次的感觉却就像第一次一样！|我已经等了一次了！我不知道自己还能不能再忍受下去了。]她呻吟着，将你拉向酋长小屋那隐蔽而安全的地方。没有花朵遮挡你的视线，你可以看到她那微微眯起的双眼；当她的尾巴卷曲起来，盖住她那蓬松的脸颊时，那些花朵也被掀开了。她的神情，和她的话语一样，显得已经做好了准备…… [pc.isCorrupted|所有|很多] 你的克制力体现在没有在山坡上就与她拥吻。不，你而是走完最后几步才来到门口。 当你走到门槛前，看着满脸通红的新娘，因为攀爬而气喘吁吁，身上还带着一层细薄的汗珠。你想要做些什么特别的事情。她可是你的…… 妻子 现在，这一点非常重要。即使这并不是一种什么重大的精神层面的举动，你仍然应该让她感受到自己才是这个世界上最重要的人。而这一切，都始于真正去了解她的内心。 [pc.strengthRange 95|感受到那种强烈的冲动…… [pc.hasBoon RyeBeer|临时的|自然] 你身上蕴含着强大的力量，你知道该如何开始行动。你活动着手腕，然后把阿姆里抱起来，让她坐在你的腿上。她转过头来，一脸困惑地看着你，而当你费力地将她举到空中时，她的脸上立刻露出了震惊的笑容。 她兴奋地拍手叫好，但在你开始拖着脚步穿过门口时，她却尽力保持静止。 “哦天啊，这是你们国家的习俗吗？当心那深坑啊！这个警告来得太晚了，已经无法阻止你首先跌倒在中央房间的第一块地毯上。|虽然这可能没有真正把她抱过门槛那么隆重，但你应该能理解我的意思。你从自己那件花哨的衣服上取下一段藤蔓，将它系在自己的脚踝和Ahmri的脚踝上。当你解释说现在你们可以作为一个整体一起走进房子时，她露出了既困惑又好奇的表情。 当你把这句话大声说出来的时候，听起来有点傻，但是…… “不！我不知道这是否是你们那里的传统，但即使这只是你临时想出来的，我也想试试看。 我们只需要一步一步来吧，”她边说边搂着你的肩膀，帮你一起走进屋里。其实这比你想象的要容易得多，因为阿姆里还有三条可以自由活动的腿。 不幸的是，你们两人都没有注意到楼梯尽头那个凹陷的地方，结果Ahmri整个人侧着身子摔在了中央房间的第一块地毯上。] 那匹庞大的马一路上都在欢笑，让你的下落变得柔和，只传来一声轻闷的撞击声。你们俩都没有受伤，都兴奋地笑着，把这次轻松的坠落当作一场有趣的游戏。不过，这次坠落也确实带来了一些“后果”：那些曾经包裹着你那位肌肤如太阳般娇嫩的伴侣胸部的藤蔓，现在只剩下一些松散的纤维了，而她那焦糖色的乳头也刚刚开始露出来。你把最后几根藤蔓拨开，然后用手将它们重新整理好，接着俯身吻了她。

She takes it all surprisingly well, giving you a stupified grin and nodding as you explain that you want to make good on your promises before you turn her into a moaning ponyslut. You'll need her to explain how centaur weddings work, though. She gives you another hug and nuzzle when you finish talking, lacing her fingers behind your back.

    "I'm sorry, [pc.name]... could you say it again? Couldn't hear you over how good you smell, heheh..." She continues to rub her nose against your chest, growing more flush by the second. You can almost see the tiny hearts fluttering like butterflies about her face as she giggles in uncomprehending heat. Perhaps you'll need that bucket of cold water after all, or at least to get her some fresh air.
    
    You lead the amorous mare out of the hut and into the open air of the mountainside. You explain again, slowly, that you don't know how centaur marriage works. You're going to need her to tell you what to do, or point you to someone who knows better. Now that she's out of her musky feedback loop, Ahmri looks a little more understanding. She still looks utterly smitten, but the flush has receded and her eyes are less glazed.
    
    "R-right. Gotta pick flower... mountains. Oooh, you should come back later. I'm going to go, uh, cool off a bit. I thought this was going someplace else!" she exclaims, breaking contact and sprinting off toward the village proper, she half turns back after ten meters, remembering you still don't know for sure what to do. "You can, um, talk to Daddy. He knows what the men do[pc.mf||, err. The proposer? The other side]!"
    
    And with that vague promise, she's gone. Well, guess you'd better find Taldahs."

rows.original: Soooo... you've been meaning to ask about the whole getting married thing, but you don't actually have any idea how marriage works between centaurs. Ahmri stops dead in her tracks, dropping the books she'd been carrying back to the storeroom. She whirls on you, rushing over in a huff. Your eyes widen as she stops in front of you, eyebrows furrowed and fists clenched at her side. "You've been meaning to what!? Why all of a sud- b-because you don't... S-stupid! Dumb stupid hero!" she cries, beating on your chest as she progresses from anger to bewilderment to a tearful mess in a matter of moments. You hold up your hands in an effort to appease her, letting her cry it out before hugging her around the shoulders[pc.heightRange 0 54|, or at least her equine shoulders]. Hey now, this may not have been the best way to drop the info, but you figure it's better now than never. "When you didn't come after me at the party, I figured you decided I was more trouble than I was worth. I guess that's kinda dumb with how you treated me back when we first met," she mumbles, rocking back and forth in your arms as she tries to stifle her own tears. You pat her back, sighing at the absurdity of what happened. You sure as hell didn't mean to come across that way, but thinking back on it she definitely isn't the type to sit out on a party with food and dancing. "I'm sorry, [pc.dcb|I really just did think you needed some time to rest,|I should've come and partied up here with you,|like super duper double bubble sorry,]" you apologize, pulling Ahmri back by the sides of her head and giving her a quick kiss. She grins, her tears mostly gone by now, and wipes her eyes with her hands. "Good, cause I don't know if I could keep up that sad act for long. I-I don't really know what the proposing party does. Daddy could probably tell you, though! I'll be waiting," she says, turning back to her usual excited self on the fly. It looks like you'll need to find Taldahs. You think you've seen him around town, but where is he now...
rows.translation: 所以……你其实一直想问关于结婚这件事，但你对半人马之间的婚姻制度根本一无所知。阿姆里突然停住了脚步，把她原本拿回储藏室的书籍都掉在了地上。她猛地转过身来，气呼呼地朝你冲了过来。当她站在你面前时，你的眼睛瞪得大大的，她的眉毛紧锁在额头上，双手也紧紧地握在身侧。 “你其实一直想问…… 什么！？ 为什么啊……就因为你不……真蠢！愚蠢至极的英雄！”她边哭边捶打着你的胸口，她的情绪在短短几分钟内从愤怒变成了困惑，最终彻底崩溃了。你举起双手试图安抚她，让她把情绪发泄出来，然后搂住了她的肩膀。[pc.heightRange 0 54|至少是她那像马一样的宽肩膀……]嘿，虽然这种方式可能不是传达这个消息的最佳方式，但至少现在总比永远不告诉你要好。 “在派对上你没有来找我，我就想，你应该是觉得我带来的麻烦比我本身的价值还要大吧。 我想，当初我们刚认识的时候你对我的态度，确实有点太愚蠢了……”她低声说道，身体在你怀里轻轻摇晃着，努力忍住泪水。你轻拍着她的背，对发生的一切感到无奈和荒谬。 你绝对不是故意要给人那种印象的，但仔细想想，她确实不是那种会坐在派对一旁，一边吃着东西一边跳舞的人。 “对不起…… [pc.dcb|我确实是觉得你需要一些时间来休息。|我本应该来这里和你们一起狂欢的。|真的非常非常抱歉。]你道个歉吧，然后牵着阿姆里的手，轻轻吻了她一下。她笑了，眼泪也差不多流干了，用手擦了擦眼睛。 “太好了，因为我不知道自己还能不能长时间保持这种悲伤的表情。其实我并不太清楚求婚的一方应该做些什么……不过爸爸应该能告诉你吧！我会在这里等你的，”她说着，立刻恢复了往常那种兴奋的样子。看来你得去找找塔尔达斯了。你觉得自己之前在城里见过他，但他现在到底在哪里呢……

rows.original: You make your way up into the mountains, hiking up to the curve of the mountainside that Ahmri led you past on your first time into the village. The cliff is just like you remember it, with colorful flowers swaying gently in the breeze. Now, which one do you pick? Putting aside the more simple choice of color, each flower has a pattern of markings and whorls that look to be wholly unique. How do you decide which one to give? [party.solo |You don't have anyone nearby to affect your opinion, so all you have to do is choose. |[party.comp viviane cait atugia brint brienne kiyoko etheryn azyrran |"Having trouble deciding?" Viv says. "I can see it on your face." You turn to face her and find her leaning on her [viv.weapon], looking over the flowers intently. Indeed. What does she think? "Honestly? That Ahmri will be ecstatic either way. She's a girl who has been raised on romance novels and this is right out of one. Frankly, I just hope you survive the hug that comes after." |You turn to Cait, finding her already sifting through the flowers along the cliff. It seems like she's rather excited about this already, eh? "Are you kidding!? This thing sounds like a blast! I can't wait to see Ahmri in a dress or whatever passes for one here! I bet she'll look super adorable. Mallachite training includes all kinds of popular wedding rituals, whether it be for serious officiating or someone who wants to roleplay a nuptial breeding night," she sighs wistfully, leaning on her staff. "I have no idea how you're supposed to pick just one of these, though. If it were up to me I'd pick a whole armload of them and dump them all over her like a shower. Now I wanna do that anyway, ugh," Cait ruffles the flowers in frustration, settling back after letting out her tension. |You turn to Atugia for help, giving her an exasperated smile. You suppose you should ask what she thinks of the wedding in general as well, and not just ask blindly for her help with this one aspect. She shrugs, the corners of her mouth twisting into a grin as she brushes a finger through the wall of flowering vines. "Weddings were new to me, way back then. In Teiglach, the act of bein' together itself is considered enough to tie people's souls together. The more you do together, the more fated your pairin' becomes. For better or worse, but usually for better. When Carmen told me they have rituals for such things here I thought it was weird at first. Then I learned to read, and read the historical accounts of marriages and unions throughout Savarra and old Belhar. The particularly extravagant examples made my head swim," she giggles, rubbing a shining blue flower between her fingers. "I'm sure Ahmri had the same experience, except it seems she's read nothin' but cheesy adventures and nigh smutty romance novels. I think it's amazin' that you were there for her, and you [QUEST_NIGHTMEMORY.isCompleted |have enough love to make any union its own, I can vouch for that. |don't seem like the type to burn out on love. ] Even if her father said it wasn't so big a deal, I'm sure she'll be brimmin' with excitement. I wanna be there for it either way!" She adds, looking at the wall of flowers. "Any of these that come from you would be the prettiest one she's ever seen," she concludes, taking a seat on a rotund boulder. |"These are nice," Brint says, inspecting the flowers. "Real pretty 'n all.[brint.fucked | In fact..." He plucks one and turns, taking your head in one hand and gently sliding the stem of the flower behind your [pc.ear] before standing back to inspect his handiwork. He smiles. "Lookin' good, [pc.name]," he says. "Thanks, Brint," you say, smiling despite yourself. "Bend down a moment." He proffers his horned head and you take the opportunity to slide a flower behind his unbroken horn, patting him before he rises. "How do I look?" Brint asks with a grin. "Great!" you say. "It's a different look, but I like it. Now help me out with picking which one's good for Ahmri — these flowers are for her, you know." "Ah, Ahmri's gonna look cute no matter which flowers we pick," Brint says, shrugging before turning back to the cliffside. "But I s'pose we should take it serious. Hmm..." |" "They are, aren't they?" you say, skimming your hand along the tops of the flowers. "They smell nice, too." "Yup. Whatcha reckon?" he asks. "Well, I dunno yet," you say. "It's an important decision, you know?" "Yeah, but Ahmri's gonna look pretty no matter which one you pick," Brint says, nodding at the flowers. "Ah, heck." He crouches down, looking at the flowers more closely. "Hmm..." ] |Brienne bends down and sniffs the flowers, carefully plucking one and then another. Rising back to her feet, she gives you a smile as she places one behind her horn and the other behind your [pc.ear], sliding it into place and leaving it adorning your head. "You look [pc.mf |great |so pretty ]," she says, satisfied. "I'm looking forward to this, you know." "Yeah?" you ask. "Uh huh," Brienne says, nodding. "Seeing Ahmri happy will be nice. Plus, well, I know you can make her happy." She smirks. "Just don't be surprised when I ask the same of you." You'll keep that in mind. |[kiyoko.married |You look to Kiyoko, running her fingers through the flowers with an amused smile. Is she ok with you getting married again? She regards you with a mix of curious affection. "Why should I not be? If the emperor does not limit himself for such trivial reasons, why should I expect my husband to do so? If he finds another girl he fancies, he takes her as a concubine. Whether it be love or a political gambit, the result is the same. This centaur fits both without question. Affection is as plain on your face as the sun in the sky each day, and there's no denying the practicality of marrying the next tribal chief," Kiyoko rubs a soft flower between her fingers. "I also cannot deny some interest, even, in seeing more of what makes my husband happy. If having an entire harem of lovers makes you more passionate the next time you take me to bed, then she will be a welcome addition," she continues with a smirk. "The middle ground of these flowers transition is quite the beautiful shade of pink. It is not entirely unlike a cherry blossom," she finishes, offering her opinion on color to conclude her thoughts. |You look to Kiyoko, watching her brush her fingers through the colors and waiting till you catch her eye. rows.translation: 你沿着山路向上攀登，最终来到了阿姆里第一次带你进入这个村庄时所经过的那处山崖。悬崖的样子与你记忆中的一模一样，五彩缤纷的花朵在微风中轻轻摇曳。现在，你应该选择哪一朵呢？抛开颜色这个较为简单的选择标准不谈，每一朵花上都有着独一无二的纹路和花环图案。你该如何决定该送哪一朵呢？ [party.solo |你身边没有人会影响你的决定，所以你只需要做出选择而已。 |[party.comp viviane cait atugia brint brienne kiyoko etheryn azyrran |还在犹豫吗？”薇薇说道，“我都能从你的脸上看出来。”你转过身去面对她，发现她正靠在…… [viv.weapon]她正专注地凝视着那些花朵。 确实……她大概在想什么呢？ 他低下那颗长着角的头，你趁机将一朵花插到他那未折断的角后面，然后轻拍了他一下，让他站了起来。 “我看起来怎么样？”布林特笑着问道。 “很棒！”你说，“虽然看起来有点不一样，但我很喜欢。现在帮帮我吧，看看哪朵花适合阿姆里——这些花…… 是 对她来说，你知道的。” You really wouldn't have expected so many, even knowing her. "W-well yeah! It's the only way I could learn to read. Each book only has so many words, so I needed to keep getting new ones if I wanted to learn all of them. Did you know some people even have their own alphabets? I tried making my own one time, but it's a lot easier to just use the one I know, so it didn't last long. I still sometimes find words I don't know in new books, but now I guess I can just ask you!" [ahmri.married|She sure can, and you'll tell her every one.|Sure she can, any time you're around.]"

rows.original:
"No, I like cooking too! Or, well, eating is more fun, but getting to make what you eat somehow makes it even tastier. One time I helped Daddy make pemmican for a hunt, and he let me pick the berries they used. I thought that batch was better than any of the stuff they made before," She says, puffing up proudly.

    "[flags.AHMRI_TALK_COOK
        |I always ask for some to keep whenever they make it. Since it keeps so long it's always good to have if I'm feeling extra hungry some days. That stuff usually keeps me full of energy for the whole day! It's amazing. I don't know how they pack so much foodness into such a small package, but I love it. If only they could do that with cake...
        |Oh! Pemmican is like a meat brownie. You take the meat and you dry it out sooo much that you can crumble it into a powder, and then you dry the fruits so they can crumble into a different powder, and then you smash those powders together with fat, and it makes this chunk of... stuff. It sounds kinda gross when I say it that way, but I promise it's not. It lasts basically forever so they use it on long hunts. I only wish cake were that easy to make.
    ]"
    
    Speaking of cake, does Ahmri prefer cooking or baking. You know she has a proclivity for sweets, but what does she prefer when it comes to making them?
    
    "Hmm, I think I'd still pick sweets, but it is fun making something like stew. It's easier to know if somethings good when you can add things to it one by one. If I wanted to know whether blueberry or strawberry muffins were better I have to make both, but if I want to know whether the stew could use some onions, I can just pour some stew over a bit of chopped onion!"
    
    So really what she's saying is both options are good. You can't imagine her turning down the opportunity to have both blueberry and strawberry muffins.
    
    "Well yeah, I'd never do that if I had the option. If we have enough to make a whole stew and then have muffins for dessert, then why not make it all!"[ahmri.isPregnant
        | Especially now that I'm eating for two!"
    ]
rows.translation:
不，我也喜欢做饭哦！或者说，吃饭本身就很有趣，但能够自己动手制作食物，会让食物变得更加美味。有一次，我帮爸爸为狩猎准备食物，他还让我挑选他们用来制作食物的浆果呢。我觉得那次做的食物比他们之前做的任何一次都要好吃。”她自豪地说道。[flags.AHMRI_TALK_COOK
        |每次他们制作这种东西的时候，我总会让他们多给我留一些。因为这种东西可以保存很长时间，所以有时候当我特别饿的时候，吃上它就再好不过了。这种东西真的能让我一整天都充满活力！太神奇了。我不知道他们是怎么把这么多的营养成分装进这么小的包装里的，但我真的很喜欢。要是可以把这种技术应用到蛋糕上该多好啊……
        |哦！佩米坎其实就像一种肉质布朗尼。你先把肉弄干，弄得完全干透，然后把它碾成粉末；接着把水果也弄干，碾成另一种粉末；最后把这些粉末和脂肪混合在一起，就能做出这种食物来。这么一说听起来有点恶心，但我保证其实并不难吃。这种食物可以保存很长时间，所以人们在长途狩猎时会用到它。我只希望蛋糕也能这么容易制作就好了。
    ]说到蛋糕，Ahmri更喜欢烹饪还是烘焙呢？你知道她对甜食很有兴趣，但当涉及到制作甜食的时候，她更喜欢哪种方式呢？

“嗯，我想我还是更喜欢制作甜食吧，不过制作像炖菜这样的食物也挺有趣的。 当你能够逐一添加各种成分时，就更容易判断某样东西是否合适了。如果我想知道蓝莓松饼和草莓松饼哪个更好吃，我就必须两种都做一遍；但如果你想看看这道炖菜是否需要加些洋葱，那就只需要在炖菜里加入一些切碎的洋葱就可以了！所以，她实际上想说的是，这两个选择都很好。你根本无法想象她会拒绝同时拥有蓝莓松饼和草莓松饼这样的机会。

“嗯，没错，如果我有这样的选择，我也绝对不会拒绝的。 如果我们有足够的材料来做一整锅浓汤，然后再用松饼作为甜点，那么为什么不把它们都做出来呢？[ahmri.isPregnant
        | 特别是现在，我得同时照顾两个人的饮食了！
    ]

rows.original: [flags.AHMRI_READING |"Wanna read some more stories?" you ask. "Do I!? Of course I do! You just get situated here while I go get the book," she replies, starting off toward her room. You continue to hear her voice as you take a seat by the table. "And remember to think of which kinda stories you wanna read!" She returns a few minutes later with the same monstrous tome from before, chock full of ribbons marking which stories are which. Cuddling in beside you, she puts her chin in her palms and awaits your choice with excitement. |"Do you have any stories you'd like to read together? I'd love to sit down and read some of them with you now that we have some time to relax," you ask. "Really!? You'd want to? I have just the thing, so you wait right there! Or, err, take a seat," Ahmri says, starting off toward her room before twirling back and patting the seat and then heading back again. You still hear her voice from through the doorway as you sit down at the table. "I have a big collection of stories from all over that I got a couple years back! There's a lot of good ones in there, and most are really short." She comes back wielding an absolute [silly |heckin' chonker |beast ] of a tome, one that's threaded full with brightly colored ribbons. The book must have at least two hundred or so large pages, and just under half that many ribbons! Ahmri sets the book down on the table, and sees you looking at the markers. You quirk an eyebrow and wait for her to explain. "Okay, so, these are all to mark the different kinds of stories there are," she explains, pointing to each in turn. "Red ones are stories with lots of action, like battles and expeditions and stuff like that. Purple is for short poems. Pink is for romantic stories, like rescuing princesses from evil dragons or rescuing dragons from evil princesses. And black are [silly |the shitty ones |the boring dumb ones ], like tactical summaries of battles or stories that just kinda suck. You can feel free to pick one of those last kind, but I'll probably spoil it or tune it out." ]
rows.translation: [flags.AHMRI_READING |想再读一些故事吗？”你问道。 “当然想啦！你先在这里等着，我去把书拿过来。”她边说边朝自己的房间走去。你坐在桌子旁，继续听着她的声音。 记得要想想自己想读哪类型的故事哦！” 几分钟后，她拿着之前那本厚厚的书回来了，书上用丝带标记出了不同故事的位置。她依偎在你身边，双手托着下巴，满怀期待地等待你的选择。 |你有没有什么故事想一起读呢？现在我们有时间放松一下了，我真的很想和你一起坐下来读一些故事。”你问道。 “真的吗！？你愿意吗？我确实有一些故事……”她回答道。 只是 等等，你就在那儿等着吧！或者，呃，先坐下来吧，”阿姆里边说边朝自己的房间走去，然后又转回来，拍拍椅子，接着又继续往前走。当你坐在桌子旁时，还能听到她的声音从门口传来。“几年前，我收集了很多来自各地的故事！里面有很多不错的故事，而且大多数都非常短。” 她拿着一些东西回来了…… [silly |真是个巨大的东西啊…… |野兽 ] 那是一本厚厚的书，书页上穿满了色彩鲜艳的丝带。这本书至少有两百页，而那些丝带的数量更是差不多达到了书页总数的一半！阿姆里把书放在桌子上，看到你正在看着那些丝带。 你挑了挑眉毛，等待她继续解释。 “好吧，这些标记都是用来区分不同类型的故事的，”她一边说，一边依次指着那些标记。“红色的标记代表那些充满动作场面的故事，比如战斗、探险之类的内容。 紫色用于短诗；粉色则适用于浪漫故事，比如拯救被邪恶巨龙囚禁的公主，或者将邪恶的公主从巨龙手中解救出来。至于黑色……则用于其他类型的故事吧。 [silly |那些糟糕的东西 |那些无聊又愚蠢的东西 ]比如那些对战斗过程的战术性总结，或者那些实在乏味的故事。你可以随意选择其中一种，不过我可能会把剧情剧透掉，或者直接跳过不看。 ]
