rows.original: "[var0 |I've seen fish in the local markets. Is there a local fishing spot, or does each fisher have their own spot?" you ask. "I'd love to see it, either way." "Yes! To both, actually! There's a spot everyone goes to, but some fishermen and women also have their own special family spots," Ahmri explains. "Daddy has a really pretty one out along one of the lakes, but it's kinda far. We can make it a picnic!" She canters back into her home, returning a few minutes later with a packed basket and a long fishing pole. Handing the pole off to you, she loops the basket under one arm while hooking the other around your elbow. "I actually have no idea how to use this thing, but Daddy made it for me in case I needed it someday. Now I'm happy to have it!" "I've got some idea. [pc.isBimbo |Working poles is my specialty, after all! |[pc.bgMulti barbarian scholar |I'm more used to spearfishing, but a pole is ok too, |I don't have much practical experience, but I know how to use a pole. |I've used a pole before, and it's really not that difficult. ] ] It can be a learning experience either way!" "I can't wait! But it's quite a walk, though, so I guess I'll have to for a little bit longer," Ahmri says. With that, she's all ready to go. |We should go fishing again!" you say. "Last time was great. Your dad's fishing spot is breathtaking, and the food you brought was just as good. It'd be nice to make it a picnic again as well." "I'd love to! Let me grab the rod and get some stuff together for the picnic!" She does just that, trotting back into her home and returning after a few minutes with the fishing pole over her shoulder and a large picnic basket tucked under one arm. Hooking her free arm around your elbow, she's all ready to go. ] The two of you set off at a brisk pace, leaving the village and taking a well trodden path that leads toward the distant mountain lakes. Most of your walk is through the hilly plains of the westernmost side of the valley. There aren't any homes here, but there are several patches of trees. One of them is an apple orchard, and you see a few centaurs gathering apples to bring back to the village. Ahmri waves as you pass, and your route takes you down a deeper trail. Out this far, the main path is still well trodden enough that Ahmri doesn't need to take any extra precautions. You keep a lookout for loose stones, but never see anything bigger than the palm of your hand. The mountains become grassier again as you approach the lake, but you don't quite make it all the way there before Ahmri tugs your arm. You can see the lakeshore in the distance, but she's directing you towards a side path that leads a bit further up into the mountains. "That's the local spot, but Daddy's spot is up a bit further this way," she says. As you walk along the path, she points out other, even smaller nooks. "These are all family spots. There's technically nothing stopping anyone from using them, but it's common courtesy to move if the person or their family show up." Some of the spots are very cozy, with room for maybe one or two people, but others are large enough to throw parties with several families. Ahmri leads you to the very end, where a large tree leans close to horizontal over the lake. Around that corner, she stops and holds her hands out like an eager showman. [var0 |"Tada! We made it! I'll set stuff up while you get a good look!" Ahmri says, cantering over toward the beach and setting down her picnic basket. You do just that, staring in awe at the secluded view. Blocked by that gigantic tree, the space Taldahs picked out is the very definition of idyllic. Mountain flowers thrive this close to the lake, and they frame the entire site like a natural fence. Bright colors abound, and all of it only serves to draw your eyes to the lake. That in itself is an entirely different spectacle. From where you are, the water is fantastically clear, and you can see the lakefloor out to what must be twenty feet! Past that, the [dayNight |glare of the sun |reflection of the night sky ] stops you from seeing any further. After taking in the view of a lifetime, you wander over to start helping Ahmri get things ready. |"We made it! I'll set up the blanket!" Ahmri says, cantering over to the beach and setting down the picnic basket. You briefly take another look at the beautiful flowers and the scenic view of the mountains, whistling at the hanging moss on the bent tree. Some people never get the chance to see a place this pretty, so you count yourself blessed to have consistent access to it. After that, you wander over to start helping Ahmri get things ready. ] By the time you reach the beach, Ahmri has already pulled the large blanket out from within the picnic basket. You help her spread it out on the ground, after which she happily plops down to kneel atop it. Once she's settled, she hands the fishing pole off to you, and waits patiently for you to take a seat next to her. She's also taken a handful of [rand |strawberries |grapes |apple slices |nuts and raisins ] to snack on while she waits. "[var0 |What should we use as bait?" you ask, taking a seat and holding up the hook. "Oh! People like using..." she starts, ruffling around in the basket to find something. "These!" |Would you mind grabbing some of that cheese for me?" you ask, holding up the hook. "Certainly! Just let me find it," she replies, ruffling around in the basket. ] She comes back up with a handful of tiny blocks of cheese. Grabbing the hook at its base, she slides one of them succinctly around its curve. Then she sets the rest down on top of the basket, but not before tossing one into her mouth. "[var0 |I love 'em cause you can also just eat them! Unlike with worms or grubs or minnows. |I can see why the fish love this stuff! You want one? ]" "[var0 |Makes sense," you say, grabbing one for yourself |Yes please," you reply, opening your mouth for her to place one on your tongue ] and then trying to decide what the best method is to go about the actual fishing. [var0 |The rod is a long length of bamboo, with a line made of horsehair or perhaps drider silk with a small enchantment to keep it solid. |You know a good way to work the rod, but where to cast is an ever-changing thing. ] Because the water is so clear, you can see a number of fish swimming around close to the shore. Just casting the line directly atop them will only serve to scare them away, so you have to find a spot that's far enough not to startle them, but close enough that you don't need to wave the rod like a greatsword just to move your bait. "What about that one?" Ahmri says, pointing excitedly at a blur of color weaving its way through the water. "Right near the weeds there!" "I see it," you reply, gauging the distance in your head. It's definitely close enough, and you think you have a good path along the side to entice it without getting caught in the weeds yourself. Pulling back carefully to avoid getting the hook caught on anything between the two of you, you cast it a little to the side of your target area. It lands atop the water with an innocuous sploosh, and you begin gently tugging to keep it from sinking straight to the bottom. At first, it seems like you might have to cast again, but then your bait catches the fish's interest. You spy it change course, cautiously approaching the dangling morsel of cheese. It hovers for a second, and then darts forward to nibble a little bit. It's second nibble is much more brave, and you give one hard tug when you feel it pull the line. This snags it fully, and the flexible bamboo bends as it tries to escape. Jumping to your feet, you begin to back slowly away from the shore while making sure to hold tight to the rod. "Ah! You've got it!" Ahmri shouts in excitement, clapping her hands together and jumping up from her seated position. As soon as you've pulled the fish all the way to the shore, she grasps the line and holds it up with a toothy smile. On the hook, a speckled little panfish lists lazily from side to side, occasionally twisting with a burst of resistance. "A little small for eating, but it's a pretty one," you say, joining her by the shore. "Yeah! I love how colorful these ones are, and the shiny scales on their tummies look just like gemstones! We can put this one back and hope he grows some more, cause they taste really good when they've got more meat on them." You do just that, getting a good grip on the fish itself while she holds the line, and easing the hook out of its lip. The puncture was clean enough that there shouldn't be any trouble with its recovery, so you simply [silly |yeet that aquatic bitch back into the deep. |underhand toss the fish back into the water. ] After a second of sinking, it jolts back to lively motion and zooms off into the shelter of the depths. Its motion unfortunately spooks the few other fish who were close enough to reach reliably, so the two of you retire to the blanket. "So, what did you bring for the picnic?" you ask, leaning back on your hands. "All kinds of stuff!" Ahmri says, barely able to hold back her excitement as she pops open the top of the picnic basket. "I've got some apples, the rest of that cheese, some grapes, these little sandwiches with baked fish inside that the baker made today! The possibilities are en... well, those are the possibilities!" She lays everything out on the blanket, pushing the basket out of the way so you can scoot closer next to her. Before you can sit, however, her eyes go wide and she opens the top again. Stretching to reach inside without pulling it closer, she pulls out two cloth-wrapped packages. After setting them down with the rest, she scoots the basket out of the way with her back hoof. "I almost forgot! Two pieces of fresh pumpkin pie for dessert!" she says, beaming with glee. You sit down beside her, [ahmri.married |cuddling in close so you can both reach the food. |scooting close enough for both of you to reach the food. ] Firstly, you take one of the sandwiches. Each one is only enough for two or three bites, but there's maybe twelve to fourteen of them on the plate. Even cool, the fresh baked fish is delicious, and the bread it's on is equally appetizing. You eat some of the cheese alongside it, delighting in its creamy softness as an accent to the savory taste of the fish. Ahmri also takes a sandwich, but she takes a sprig of grapes to eat first. There are a good twenty-something red-purple grapes on the bit of vine she takes, and she devours them two at a time. She sees you looking about half way through, and holds out a grape for you to [ahmri.married |eat. You lean over and take it right between your front teeth. |take. You pluck it right from her fingers and plop it in your mouth. ] A burst of sweet juice washes through your mouth, refreshing and delightful as the crisp air rolling over the lake. The fruit here is wondrous, and the glory of the view doesn't falter in the slightest as you continue to gaze upon it. The sky is clear enough and the [dayNight |sun |moon ] is bright enough that you can see the snowy caps of distant mountain peaks. It wouldn't be a stretch to describe it as Idyllic. [var0 |"Ahh!" Ahmri shouts suddenly, batting at the edge of the blanket and scooting the two pie plates further toward you. "Ants!" You don't see them at first, but sure enough, a line of tiny insects were making their way toward the plates. They've since been scattered by your eagle-eyed [ahmri.married |taur-wife |companion ], but you can still see them scurrying around the edge of the blanket and toward a pebbly anthill near the brush. Ahmri folds the edge of the blanket up a little to make a lip that's harder for them to climb. |"Ugh. Every time we come now, I'm gonna be worried about ants getting at the pie!" Ahmri says, pouting and scooting the pie closer to you. There are no ants to be seen this time, but it's an understandable worry given the location. You help her curl up the edge of your blanket just in case, and make a lip that would be harder for any [silly |nasty bugoids |creepy crawlies ] to scale. Looking around, you spot an anthill, but it seems to be dormant for now. ] With the safety measures out of the way, you can finish your meal in peace. The cautious centaur nibbles on one more sandwich, and then unwraps both pie plates. The pie looks decadent, and smells fantastic. One bite reveals that it tastes exactly as good as it looks and smells. It's rich and sweet, melting on your tongue into a tasty mush. That first taste is enough to banish the thought of ants from Ahmri's mind, and she grins wide. She really tries to take her time, but her pie is finished by your third bite! You [ahmri.married |offer her a piece of yours, prompting a big hug and an even brighter smile. |finish yours as quickly as you can so she doesn't have to wait and watch you eat it. ] Once you've both finished, you pack the smaller things up into the basket and pause for some final minutes to appreciate the scenery. There are [dayNight |birds flitting about over the lake, skimming the water before flying back up to nests in mountain trees. |bats flitting about over the lake, collecting water skimming insects before flying back to mountain caves. ] "Well? Shall we head back?" Ahmri asks, holding out a hand.
rows.translation: "[var0 |我在当地的市场上看到过鱼。是这里有固定的捕鱼点，还是每个渔民都有自己固定的捕鱼区域呢？”你问道，“不管怎样，我都很想看看。” “没错！两者都有！确实有一个大家都会去的捕鱼点，但有些渔民也有自己家人常去的固定区域。”阿姆里解释道。 爸爸在其中一个湖边有一条非常漂亮的鱼竿，不过地方有点远。我们可以去那里野餐吧！” 她快步跑回家里，几分钟后拿着一个装满食物的篮子和一根长鱼竿回来了。 她把竹竿递给你，一只手把篮子挂在胳膊下，另一只手则搭在你的肘部上。 “其实我完全不知道该怎么使用这个东西，但爸爸是专门为我制作的，就怕有一天我会需要它。 现在我得到了它，真是太开心了！” “我有个主意。 [pc.isBimbo |毕竟，制作工作杆才是我的专长！ |[pc.bgMulti barbarian scholar |我更习惯使用鱼叉捕鱼，不过用鱼竿也行。 |我虽然没有太多实际经验，但至少知道如何使用棍子。 |我以前用过杆子，其实真的没那么难。 ] ] 不管怎样，这都是一次学习的机会吧！” “我等不及了！不过路途有点远，所以我想还得再等一会儿才行，”阿姆里说道。 说完，她就准备出发了。 |我们应该再去钓鱼吧！”你说，“上次真的很开心。你爸爸选的钓鱼地点太棒了，而且你带的食物也非常好吃。如果还能再举办一次野餐，那就太好了。” “我非常愿意！ 让我去拿钓竿，再准备一些野餐所需的东西吧！” 她果然这么做了，快步跑回家里，几分钟后便回来了，肩上扛着钓竿，一只手臂下夹着一个大野餐篮。 她把空出来的手臂搭在你的肘部上，准备出发了。 ] 你们俩快步出发，离开了村庄，沿着一条人迹频繁的小路向着远处的山间湖泊走去。大部分路程都是在山谷最西侧的丘陵平原上穿行的。这里没有房屋，但分布着几片树林，其中有一片是苹果园，你们看到有几个半人马正在采摘苹果，准备把它们带回村庄。当你们经过时，阿姆里向你们挥了挥手，而你们的路线则转向了一条更加幽深的小径。 走了这么远，这条主路仍然被很多人踩过，因此Ahmri并不需要采取任何额外的防范措施。你不时留意那些松动的石头，但从未看到过比手掌还大的石头。当你接近湖泊时，山路又重新变得草木繁茂起来，但还没等你走到湖边，Ahmri就拉住了你的手臂。远处可以看到湖岸，但她却指引你走向一条通往山腹的侧路。 那就是那个常去的地方，不过爸爸常去的地方再往这边走一点。”她说道。当你沿着小路前行时，她还会指出来其他一些更隐蔽的小角落。“这些地方都是我们家人常去的地方。严格来说，没有人能阻止别人使用这些地方，但如果有人或他们的家人来了，主动让开才是基本的礼貌。 有些地方非常舒适，只能容纳一两个人，而有些地方则足够大，可以容纳几户家庭一起举办聚会。阿姆里带你来到了路的尽头，那里有一棵大树几乎横跨在湖面上。到了那个拐角处，她停了下来，像一个热切的表演者一样伸出双手。 [var0 |太好了！我们成功了！我去把东西布置好，你好好欣赏这个美景吧！”阿姆里边说边快步走向海滩，然后将野餐篮放在地上。 Most of your walk is through the hilly plains of the westernmost side of the valley. There aren't any homes here, but there are several patches of trees. One of them is an apple orchard, and you see a few centaurs gathering apples to bring back to the village. Ahmri waves as you pass, and your route takes you down a deeper trail. Out this far, the main path is still well trodden enough that Ahmri doesn't need to take any extra precautions. You keep a lookout for loose stones, but never see anything bigger than the palm of your hand. The mountains become grassier again as you approach the lake, but you don't quite make it all the way there before Ahmri tugs your arm. You can see the lakeshore in the distance, but she's directing you towards a side path that leads a bit further up into the mountains. "That's the local spot, but Daddy's spot is up a bit further this way," she says. As you walk along the path, she points out other, even smaller nooks. "These are all family spots. There's technically nothing stopping anyone from using them, but it's common courtesy to move if the person or their family show up." Some of the spots are very cozy, with room for maybe one or two people, but others are large enough to throw parties with several families. Just casting the line directly atop them will only serve to scare them away, so you have to find a spot that's far enough not to startle them, but close enough that you don't need to wave the rod like a greatsword just to move your bait. "What about that one?" Ahmri says, pointing excitedly at a blur of color weaving its way through the water. "Right near the weeds there!" "I see it," you reply, gauging the distance in your head. It's definitely close enough, and you think you have a good path along the side to entice it without getting caught in the weeds yourself. Pulling back carefully to avoid getting the hook caught on anything between the two of you, you cast it a little to the side of your target area. It lands atop the water with an innocuous sploosh, and you begin gently tugging to keep it from sinking straight to the bottom. At first, it seems like you might have to cast again, but then your bait catches the fish's interest. You spy it change course, cautiously approaching the dangling morsel of cheese. It hovers for a second, and then darts forward to nibble a little bit. It's second nibble is much more brave, and you give one hard tug when you feel it pull the line. This snags it fully, and the flexible bamboo bends as it tries to escape. Jumping to your feet, you begin to back slowly away from the shore while making sure to hold tight to the rod. "Ah! You've got it!" Ahmri shouts in excitement, clapping her hands together and jumping up from her seated position. As soon as you've pulled the fish all the way to the shore, she grasps the line and holds it up with a toothy smile. You do just that, getting a good grip on the fish itself while she holds the line, and easing the hook out of its lip. rows.original: "[pc.name]! Come feel! Quick!" Ahmri shouts excitedly as you walk through the door. She's grown big enough now that her tauric tummy is nearly as wide as her lower body is tall! That doesn't stop her from cantering with her usual energy to get closer to you, pausing only once to let out an 'ah' of mild discomfort that briefly slows her advance. You cross the room to meet her half way, rubbing your nose against hers. Letting her guide your hand, you caress her fluffy tummy till you feel the slightest bump from within. Your eyebrows raise, and Ahmri beams with motherly pride. Waiting a little longer, you feel another few kicks before the baby's period of excitement settles down. "[ahmri.numKids 0 1 |Nova says there's only a little while left before I'm ready. It feels kinda weird, now that it's big enough to actually feel like there's a little person growing inside me. Gosh, I hope they like me," the sunny-blonde centauress says. "Of course they will. Don't even think about things like that. They'll love us both, and we'll make sure they're safe and sound," you reply, giving her a tight hug. You can feel her relax in your arms. "Mmm, It sounds way more convincing when you say it than when I think it," she says. "Thanks, [pc.name]." |In most of the stories I read, most of the princesses complained a bunch at this point, but I don't think it's that uncomfortable!" she says, her tail giving a swish behind her. "Most princesses don't have four sturdy legs to help balance things out," you say, standing to give her a hug. "I guess you're right, but I still expected it to be harder than this. Even if I've done it before, it's not any worse than it was the first time!" ] With that, she breaks the hug and returns to what she was doing with a bit more pep in her step.

rows.original:
Out of the corner of your eye, you catch a flash of moving color. When you focus on it, you see what looks like a butterfly, weaving to and fro as it moves in your direction. You can't place why, but it draws your eyes with a mysterious gravity. A brief panic in the back of your might startles you. While you don't think a butterfly is that much of a cause for alarm, you nonetheless ready your weapons and brace yourself. Unfazed, the sparkling insect alights on a surface nearby, and then poofs into a flash of dust.

    When it settles, you see words form in place of the dust.
    
    "[pc.name]. It's Genova. Would you mind checking on Ahmri? It's getting really close to her due date and I'd like someone to be there to make sure she gets here when the time comes."
    
    That's right! You hadn't realized just how close she was getting. Stowing your weapons, you prepare to head for the [var0
        |chieftains hut
        |centaur village
    ].

你眼角的余光瞥见一道移动的彩色光影。当你仔细注视时，发现那似乎是一只蝴蝶，正在来回飞舞，朝着你的方向飞来。你说不出为什么，但那种神秘的力量却牢牢吸引了你的视线。 你背后突然涌起的一阵恐慌可能会让你吓一跳。虽然你认为一只蝴蝶根本不值得大惊小怪，但你还是拿好了武器，做好了准备。然而，那只闪闪发光的昆虫却若无其事地落在了附近的某个表面上，然后瞬间化作了一阵尘埃消失了。

    当尘埃沉淀下来，你会看到文字取代了那些尘埃，出现在原本的位置上。[pc.name]是热那亚。你能去看看阿姆里吗？她的预产期已经快到了，我希望有人能在她需要的时候陪在她身边。

没错！你之前可能没意识到她的预产期已经这么接近了。你收好武器，准备前往那里。 [var0

        |半人马村庄
    ].

rows.original: "Hey, [pc.name]. Im, ow, just feeling a little out of sorts. This has been happening more and more, recently, but it's longer this time. I hope it goes away soon so I'm not such a downer, but I'm glad you're here," she says, still trying to distract herself as you see her tail shoot up and stick there without falling back down. She seems to be struggling to move right, and her pregnant belly looks distinctly different from the usual roundness. It's gone from wide to low, and she looks about ready to pop. "That[var0 | | probably ] means the baby is coming, doofus!" you say, rushing to her side. "Huh? N-no, I've read stories, and Genova told me I'd know when it was time. She said it'd feel natural, and this just feels uncomfortable. Or was she talking about after the baby was born when she said that..." she trails off. Before she can focus enough to remember, she grunts with pain again, and then her eyes go wide when she looks at you again. "Oh gosh, I'm having the baby, aren't I? [pc.n]-[pc.name]!? I've gotta get to Nova. C-can you help me get my things together?" "[pc.dcb|Fuck that, I'll come back and get them later. We need to get you to the matron,|I'll get your things after we make sure you're nice and safe with Genova,|Nuh-uh! We gotta get you to Genova, like, pronto! I'll come back and get your stuff later,]" you say, already guiding her out the door. "N-no, I've gotta have my... my..." she struggles to protest, unable to think of exactly what it was she wanted before you have her out the door and walking toward the matron's tent. It's slow going, and you're worried she's going to drop and start actually having the baby at any moment. It doesn't happen, though, at least not by the time you make it where you need to be. Genova is tending to some small potted plants with a smile on her face. When she sees the two of you enter through the door, she looks over to greet you, and then immediately drops the pail she'd been using to water the plants. "Oh gods, Ahmri. I told you, daily check-ins! We could've had you ready hours ago and there wouldn't be nearly this much discomfort. Dear me, I can see it on your face! [pc.name], grab those pillows and pile them up evenly here," she says, directing you to lay the pillows at a spot near the center of the tent's rear door. She pulls the string to close the curtains over both doors, rushing back and forth as you pile the pillows. When she's done with that, she drapes a fluffy blanket over the stack and grabs another large pad of what looks like wool. Ahmri looks on with a dejected frown while the older woman works, kicking one of her forehooves at the ground and occasionally grunting with discomfort. "Oh, sweetie. It's not your fault. Sorry if I sounded frustrated. Come here, and let's get you nice and comfortable before the baby comes." Ahmri looks mildly mollified by that, cantering over as best she can and taking a seat. It's obviously more comfortable for her to be on the ground, but she doesn't look any less restless. Genova ensures that the padding is in place just behind the fatigued pony, and then begins to pull the exit curtain over her flank. It's the same curtain that separated the two of you on your wedding day, you note, except now it's being used to separate Ahmri's front and rear ends. "Please keep Ahmri company up there, [pc.name]. I'll make sure everything goes as smoothly as possible," Genova says before completely disappearing behind the drape. You can still hear her shifting around, but you can't see a single thing behind the heavy cloth. On your side, however, your wife gives you the bravest smile she can manage. "So... soon I'll be a mom, and you'll be a [pc.mf|dad|mom][pc.hasKids| again.|.] I thought it'd be scarier, but it just feels kinda exciting now. Can't wait for this part to be over, though. Easily the worst part so far," she says, pouting at the end as she shifts uncomfortably to try and find a better position. "I'm sure it won't be long. I'm just as excited to see our kid as you are," you promise, kneeling in front of her and offering your hand. She smiles and squeezes it, filled with new determination as simply as that. Unfortunately, there's no storybook moment as far as the baby coming at a dramatic time, but your presence does seem to help relieve some of her pains. She uses your hand like a stress toy, squeezing when the discomfort grows and relaxing as it ebbs. The cycle continues for what must be half an hour before something changes. Then, suddenly, Ahmri lets out a gasp and averts her gaze sheepishly. "Ah! Um. I feel like I, uhh, Ooooh," she starts, blushing and squeezing your hand as her face contorts in effort. You hear a liquid gush, and then a much longer series of splashes behind the heavy curtain. [var1 |You'd recognize that noise anywhere! Her water |It doesn't take a genius to guess that her water must have ] just broke! "Oh! Good job Ahmri! Keep it up! I can see the feet and the head coming already!" you hear Genova say from the other side. Ahmri has her face scrunched up in concentration, entirely focused on the effort of birth. Her hand squeezes yours in a death grip, and her face is turning rose red. You wait while she pushes, but when she doesn't stop pushing you put your other hand on her cheek. "Hey now. Breathe. Come on, breathe, then push," you say, rhythmically squeezing to demonstrate in case she's too focused. She follows your lead, exhaling roughly and then taking a deeper breath. No one could call the state she reaches anything close to zen, but it looks surprisingly peaceful. Some very vulgar squelching issues from beyond the barrier, but you do your best to ignore it in favor of offering your support. Ahmri occasionally pauses her pushing to readjust herself, leaning into you and rubbing her face against your[pc.heightRange 0 74|s| chest]. After each time, she gives a little bit more effort in pushing. "That's it, sweetie. Just keep pushing. You're almost there. It's just the hindquarters left. I know that's the toughest part but you've almost got it," Nova continues, directing from afar. Ahmri buries herself in your embrace, pushing with all she has. She takes great deep breaths, straining until finally you hear a final wet splorch from the other side of the curtain. Then, she relaxes utterly, squirming more with relief than discomfort. Her forelegs test the ground, but wobble too much for her to move at all. Her lips purse in concern as she looks back over her shoulder in both directions, fidgeting with your hand and giving you a pleading look. "Can't see them, can you bring them?" she asks, her voice quiet with weariness. "Nova, is it safe to come back?" you ask, taking her in a calming hug. "Almost! Just cleaning up a little," she replies. An agonizing minute of waiting later, she pipes up again. "Ok! You should be good now." Ahmri tries and fails to stand again, frowning and looking at you once more. This time, you're free to stand, holding her hand till you absolutely have to let it go, and then circling around the far side of the divider. Is it normal for there to be no noise? You try not to fret, but stop in surprise when you get a good look. Nova is knelt on a fresh pad of wool, wiping the forehead of a tiny baby centaur who appears to be trying their best to sit up. Baby might be a little bit of a misnomer. The centaur child's upper half looks easily on par with the development of a two-year-old human toddler. "Come on, come see your child. He's a boy," she says, patting the padding beside her. You join her, kneeling beside him on the other side and helping her to wipe off what little remains of the afterbirth. The little boy's coat is the same fluffy white as Ahmri, and without the time spent in the sun, his hair is an even brighter blonde. At the moment his eyes are kind of glazed, but within a minute they're focusing on you with mild curiosity. There's still a little bit of bleariness there, but it doesn't hamper him too harshly. He reaches out with one hand, brushing against you and gripping at your clothing with that same incredulity. His expression shifts to mild frustration as he tries to sit up again, using you as leverage and trying to pull himself up. You put one hand under his other arm, helping him the rest of the way. There's one wobble, but he swiftly gets his balance, and finally makes a noise. It's a simple happy murmle, but it brings a grin to your lips. He looks up at you, his gaze still suffering from that slight loss of focus, and gives you a smile that [silly|really activates your almonds.|[pc.isDK|instantly melts the ice around your heart.|threatens to make your heart boil over.]] His legs flop around, hooves sheathed in a natural coat of rubbery strands, and try ineffectually to push him forward. When they don't work, he gives a frustrated huff and starts to tip over in the other direction. Genova catches him, scooping him up by the legs. He looks surprised to be up in the air, looking around with mild concern before she hands him off to you. "Whoa there, little one, no need to rush things before you've even seen your mom," you say, turning slowly to walk back around the curtain. In your arms, the kid's head swivels around the room, taking in every sight for the first time with wide-eyed awe. Ahmri is resting her eyes when you approach, still looking exhausted from the ordeal. She rouses when you get close enough to hear, and her eyes light up. For a moment, all that fatigue disappears, and you kneel with the baby between you. He regards her curiously, reaching out to touch her arm when she reaches out for a hug. You hold him aloft, letting her focus on just holding in general. "Oh gosh. He really is six times as cute as I was," she says, struggling not to tear up as she smiles. At the sound of her voice, the small centaur's attention snaps to her face, and he grins so wide his eyes near to close. Ahmri makes a choked happy noise, and pulls him into a tight hug. When she pulls him away, it's to pull up her summer dress and give him a teat to suckle. The little thing still seems more wobbly than hungry, but begins drinking in earnest once he latches on. Your similarly wobbly wife laughs, holding him in place as she looks back up to you. "It feels weird. Different from when you do it," she giggles, and then leans forward to kiss you. You hold her steady, kissing her back till she needs to take a breath. Even then, she leaves her forehead resting on yours. "I would hope so, my intentions are quite different," you say with a happy smirk, brushing the little colt's hair while he drinks his first meal. "I wanted to ask you earlier, but I never found the time. I think you should choose the name. I have an idea, if you want to hear it, but none of this would have been possible without you," she says, eyes closed.
rows.translation: 嘿， [pc.name]我，呃，就是感觉有点不舒服。最近这种情况越来越频繁了，但这次持续时间比较长。希望它能尽快消失，这样我就不会这么闷闷不乐了。不过，很高兴你在这里。”她说着，仍在试图转移自己的注意力。你可以看到她的尾巴突然竖了起来，然后就保持着那个姿势没有再放下。她似乎在努力调整自己的动作，而她那怀孕的肚子也与平时的圆润形态明显不同——原本宽大的肚子现在变得低垂下来，看起来她随时都可能…… 弹出那个……[var0 | | 大概吧 ] 这意味着宝宝要出生了，笨蛋！”你一边说，一边冲到她身边。 “啊？不……我读过一些相关故事，Genova也告诉我，到了那个时候我就会知道。她说那种感觉会很自然，但现在我只是觉得非常不舒服……还是说，她当时说的其实是宝宝出生之后的情况……”她的话渐渐变得支支吾吾。还没等她想清楚，一阵剧痛再次袭来，当她再次看向你时，眼睛已经瞪得大大的：“天啊，宝宝真的要出生了，对吧？ [pc.n]-[pc.name]？！我必须去诺瓦。你能帮我把东西收拾好吗？[pc.dcb|去他的，我晚点再回来把它们拿走。我们现在得带你去见护士长。|等我们确认你和热那亚在一起，安全无恙之后，我会去取你的东西。|不行！我们必须马上把你送到热那亚去！我稍后会回来取你的东西。]你说得对，我已经开始带她出门了。” “不……不，我还需要拿我的……我的……”她挣扎着想要抗议，但却想不出自己到底想要什么，就在这时，你已经把她带出了门，朝着女管家的帐篷走去。 进展得很慢，你担心她随时可能会突然开始分娩。不过，至少在你到达需要去的那个地方之前，这种事情并没有发生。杰诺瓦正面带微笑地照料着一些小盆栽植物。 当她看到你们两个人从门口走进来时，她立刻转身过来迎接你们，然后立刻放下了她用来给植物浇水的桶。 “哦，天哪，阿姆里。我不是早就告诉过你吗？每天都要来检查一下！如果我们早点这么做了，现在就不会有这么麻烦了。 天啊，我都能从你脸上看出来！ [pc.name]把那些枕头拿过来，把它们均匀地堆在这里，”她说道，同时指示你把枕头放在帐篷后门附近的一个位置。 你正在把枕头堆放好的时候，她拉了一下绳子，把两扇门的帘子都拉上了，然后来回忙碌着。 当她完成这些后，便用一条柔软的毯子盖在那堆东西上，然后又拿了一大块看起来像羊毛的材料。老妇人忙碌着的时候，阿姆里则沮丧地皱着眉头看着她，不时用前蹄踢踢地面，偶尔还会因为不适而发出哼声。 哦，亲爱的。这不是你的错。如果我听起来有些烦躁，真的很抱歉。过来吧，等宝宝出生之前，我们先让你舒服地待着。” 阿姆里听后似乎稍微安心了一些，她尽力走过去，坐了下来。 对她来说，躺在地上显然更加舒适，但她看起来依然焦躁不安。杰诺娃确保在那匹疲惫的小马身后放置好了垫子，然后开始将出口帘拉到它的身体侧面。 就是那块在你们婚礼当天用来将你们分开的帘子，只不过现在它被用来分隔Ahmri的前部和后部了。 “请在上面陪陪Ahmri吧。 [pc.name]我会确保一切都能顺利进行，”杰诺瓦说道，然后便完全消失在了那块厚布之后。 你仍然能听到她在那里活动的身影，但透过那块厚重的布料，你却什么也看不见。然而，站在你身边的妻子，却露出了她所能做出的最勇敢的微笑。 “所以……不久之后，我就会成为一名妈妈，而你也会…… [pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈][pc.hasKids| 再次。|.] 我原本以为会更可怕，但现在反而觉得有点刺激。不过真希望这一部分能快点结束——这绝对是目前最糟糕的部分了。”她说着，撅着嘴，还不停地调整姿势，试图找到一个更舒服的坐姿。 我相信不会太久的。我和你一样，都非常期待看到我们的孩子出生，”你这样说道，然后跪在她面前，伸出了手。她微笑着握住了你的手，仅仅因为这个举动，她的内心似乎重新充满了决心。 遗憾的是，孩子的出生并没有像童话故事中那样充满戏剧性，但你的陪伴确实似乎帮助她缓解了一些痛苦。 她把你的手当作一个减压工具：当不适感加剧时，她会紧紧握住它；而当这种不适感减轻时，她又会松开手。这个循环持续了大概半个小时，直到终于发生了变化。突然间，阿姆里倒吸了一口凉气，然后羞涩地移开了视线。 啊！嗯……我觉得我，呃，哦……”她红着脸开始说道，一边紧紧握着你的手，一边努力地表达自己的意思。这时你听到有液体涌出的声音，紧接着在厚重的帘子后面传来一连串更剧烈的水花声。 [var1 |在任何地方你都能认出那种声音——那就是她喝水的声音。 |不用费什么脑筋就能猜到，她的水肯定出问题了。 ] 终于成功了！” “哦！干得好，Ahmri！继续加油！我已经看到小宝宝的脚和头了！”Genova在另一边说道。 Ahmri紧紧地皱着眉头，全神贯注地完成这个分娩的过程。 她的手紧紧握住你的手，脸色渐渐变得通红。你等待着她继续用力，但当她没有停止推挤时，你便将另一只手放在她的脸颊上。 “喂，现在停下来，先呼吸一下。来，先呼吸，然后再继续推吧。”你一边有节奏地轻轻按压她的手，一边说道，这样做的目的是为了让她注意到这一点，以防她太过专注而忽略了呼吸。 她跟着你的动作，粗声地呼出一口气，然后又深吸一口气。虽然没人能说她现在的状态接近于“禅境”，但看起来确实非常宁静。屏障的另一边传来一些非常刺耳的声响，但你还是尽力忽略这些噪音，选择给予她支持。 阿姆里偶尔会停下推的动作，调整自己的姿势，然后靠向你，把脸贴在你的身上。[pc.heightRange 0 74|s| 箱子]每次之后，她都会更加用力地推动。 “就这样，亲爱的。再坚持一下，你就快成功了。只剩下最后那一部分了。我知道那是最困难的部分，但你已经快要做到了，”诺娃在远处继续鼓励道。 阿姆里紧紧依偎在你的怀里，用尽全力挣扎着。她深深地吸了几口气，不断用力，直到最后，你听到帘子另一边传来“扑通”一声。随后，她彻底放松了下来，因为解脱而非不适而不停地扭动身体。她的前腿试探着地面，但却摇摇晃晃，根本无法移动。她担忧地回头张望四周，同时还不停地摆弄着你的手，用充满恳求的眼神望着你。 看不见他们，你能把他们带过来吗？”她问道，声音因疲惫而显得十分轻柔。 “诺娃，回来安全吗？”你问道，然后轻轻地拥抱了她。 “差不多了！只是还需要再清理一下而已，”她回答道。在等待了令人煎熬的那一分钟后，她又说道：“好了！现在应该没问题了。 阿姆里试图再次站起来，但失败了。她皱着眉头，再次看着你。这一次，你可以自由地站起来，握住她的手，直到真的不得不放开为止，然后绕过分隔栏的另一侧。这里竟然没有任何声音，这正常吗？ 你努力让自己不要过于焦虑，但当你仔细看去时，还是忍不住感到惊讶：诺娃正跪在一块新鲜的羊毛上，轻轻擦拭着一个小半人马婴儿的额头，而那个婴儿似乎正在努力尝试坐起来。其实，称它为“婴儿”或许有点不太准确。 这个半人半马的孩子的上半身发育程度，完全可以与两岁的人类幼儿相媲美。 快过来，看看你的孩子吧。他是个男孩呢，”她边说边轻拍着自己身旁的软垫。 你跟着她一起跪到他的身边，帮她擦去那些残留的胎衣。这个小男孩的毛发和阿姆里一样，都是那种柔软的白毛，只不过因为没有晒到太阳，他的头发显得更加金黄明亮。 此刻，他的眼神有些呆滞，但一分钟后，他就会带着一丝好奇的目光注视着你。虽然视线还是有些模糊，但这并没有对他造成太大的影响。他伸出一只手，轻轻触碰着你，然后用同样充满疑惑的眼神抓住你的衣服。 当他再次试图坐起来时，他的表情变得有些沮丧。他利用你作为支撑，试图用力将自己拉起来。 你将一只手放在他的另一只手臂下方，帮助他完成剩下的路程。有那么一刻他有些摇晃，但很快就恢复了平衡，最终发出了声音——那只是一个简单而快乐的呢喃，却让你露出了笑容。他抬头看着你，目光中仍然带着那种轻微的茫然，但依然对你露出了微笑…… [silly|真的能刺激你的脑部活动。|[pc.isDK|立刻融化你心中那块坚冰。|这种感觉简直会让人心烦意乱，怒火中烧。]] 它的双腿无力地摆动着，那些覆盖着天然橡胶状纤维的蹄子也试图推动它前进，但却毫无效果。当这些努力都失败后，它会发出沮丧的哼声，然后开始朝另一个方向倒去。 吉诺瓦及时抓住了它，将它抱了起来，抓住了它的腿。 他看起来很惊讶，悬在半空中，环顾四周，脸上带着些许担忧，直到她将他交到你手中。 “等等，小家伙，还没见到妈妈呢，就别急着行动。”你说道，然后慢慢转身，绕过帘子走了回去。 当你走近时，孩子把头转来转去，睁大眼睛充满敬畏地打量着周围的一切，这是他第一次看到这些景象。 当你靠近时，阿姆里正在休息，看起来仍然因为刚才的经历而疲惫不堪。但当你走到她附近，她立刻睁开了眼睛，目光中充满了兴奋。 有那么一刻，所有的疲惫都消失了，你跪在地上，把宝宝抱在怀里。他好奇地打量着她，而当她伸出手想要拥抱他时，他也伸出手去触碰她的手臂。你把他举得高高的，让她能够专注于这个简单的动作——拥抱。 哦天啊，他真的…… 是 比我小时候可爱六倍呢，”她边说边努力忍住泪水，脸上却挂着笑容。 听到她的声音，那个小半人马立刻将注意力转向她的脸，他笑得眼睛都快闭上了。阿姆里发出一声高兴的叫声，然后紧紧地将他抱在怀里。 当她把他拉过来时，其实是想掀起自己的夏季连衣裙，让他能够吮吸乳头。那个小家伙看起来更像是摇摇晃晃的，而不是真的饿了，但一旦他开始吮吸，就会认真地喝起奶来。你那同样摇摇晃晃的妻子也笑了起来，一边把他固定好，一边抬头看着你。 感觉有点奇怪……和以前做的感觉不一样，”她轻声笑着说，然后向前倾身吻了你。你紧紧握住她的手，回吻着她，直到她不得不喘口气。即便如此，她的额头依然紧贴着你的额头。 但愿如此，我的想法其实完全不同，”你笑着说，一边轻轻抚摸着那匹小马驹的毛发，一边看着它享用第一顿食物。 “我之前就想问你，只是一直没有找到机会。我觉得这个名字应该由你来决定。 我有个主意，如果你愿意听的话……不过如果没有你，这一切都不可能实现。”她闭着眼睛说道。
rows.raw: " "Hey, [pc.name]. Im, ow, just feeling a little out of sorts. This has been happening more and more, recently, but it's longer this time. I hope it goes away soon so I'm not such a downer, but I'm glad you're here," she says, still trying to distract herself as you see her tail shoot up and stick there without falling back down. She seems to be struggling to move right, and her pregnant belly looks distinctly different from the usual roundness. It's gone from wide to low, and she looks about ready to pop. "That[var0 | | probably ] means the baby is coming, doofus!" you say, rushing to her side. "Huh? N-no, I've read stories, and Genova told me I'd know when it was time. She said it'd feel natural, and this just feels uncomfortable. Or was she talking about after the baby was born when she said that..." she trails off. Before she can focus enough to remember, she grunts with pain again, and then her eyes go wide when she looks at you again. "Oh gosh, I'm having the baby, aren't I? [pc.n]-[pc.name]!? I've gotta get to Nova. C-can you help me get my things together?" "[pc.dcb|Fuck that, I'll come back and get them later. We need to get you to the matron,|I'll get your things after we make sure you're nice and safe with Genova,|Nuh-uh! We gotta get you to Genova, like, pronto! I'll come back and get your stuff later,]" you say, already guiding her out the door. "N-no, I've gotta have my... my..." she struggles to protest, unable to think of exactly what it was she wanted before you have her out the door and walking toward the matron's tent. It's slow going, and you're worried she's going to drop and start actually having the baby at any moment. It doesn't happen, though, at least not by the time you make it where you need to be. Genova is tending to some small potted plants with a smile on her face. When she sees the two of you enter through the door, she looks over to greet you, and then immediately drops the pail she'd been using to water the plants. "Oh gods, Ahmri. I told you, daily check-ins! We could've had you ready hours ago and there wouldn't be nearly this much discomfort. Dear me, I can see it on your face! [pc.name], grab those pillows and pile them up evenly here," she says, directing you to lay the pillows at a spot near the center of the tent's rear door. She pulls the string to close the curtains over both doors, rushing back and forth as you pile the pillows. When she's done with that, she drapes a fluffy blanket over the stack and grabs another large pad of what looks like wool. Ahmri looks on with a dejected frown while the older woman works, kicking one of her forehooves at the ground and occasionally grunting with discomfort. "Oh, sweetie. It's not your fault. Sorry if I sounded frustrated. Come here, and let's get you nice and comfortable before the baby comes." Ahmri looks mildly mollified by that, cantering over as best she can and taking a seat. It's obviously more comfortable for her to be on the ground, but she doesn't look any less restless. Genova ensures that the padding is in place just behind the fatigued pony, and then begins to pull the exit curtain over her flank. It's the same curtain that separated the two of you on your wedding day, you note, except now it's being used to separate Ahmri's front and rear ends. "Please keep Ahmri company up there, [pc.name]. I'll make sure everything goes as smoothly as possible," Genova says before completely disappearing behind the drape. You can still hear her shifting around, but you can't see a single thing behind the heavy cloth. On your side, however, your wife gives you the bravest smile she can manage. "So... soon I'll be a mom, and you'll be a [pc.mf|dad|mom][pc.hasKids| again.|.] I thought it'd be scarier, but it just feels kinda exciting now. Can't wait for this part to be over, though. Easily the worst part so far," she says, pouting at the end as she shifts uncomfortably to try and find a better position. "I'm sure it won't be long. I'm just as excited to see our kid as you are," you promise, kneeling in front of her and offering your hand. She smiles and squeezes it, filled with new determination as simply as that. Unfortunately, there's no storybook moment as far as the baby coming at a dramatic time, but your presence does seem to help relieve some of her pains. She uses your hand like a stress toy, squeezing when the discomfort grows and relaxing as it ebbs. The cycle continues for what must be half an hour before something changes. Then, suddenly, Ahmri lets out a gasp and averts her gaze sheepishly. "Ah! Um. I feel like I, uhh, Ooooh," she starts, blushing and squeezing your hand as her face contorts in effort. You hear a liquid gush, and then a much longer series of splashes behind the heavy curtain. [var1 |You'd recognize that noise anywhere! Her water |It doesn't take a genius to guess that her water must have ] just broke! "Oh! Good job Ahmri! Keep it up! I can see the feet and the head coming already!" you hear Genova say from the other side. Ahmri has her face scrunched up in concentration, entirely focused on the effort of birth. Her hand squeezes yours in a death grip, and her face is turning rose red. You wait while she pushes, but when she doesn't stop pushing you put your other hand on her cheek. "Hey now. Breathe. Come on, breathe, then push," you say, rhythmically squeezing to demonstrate in case she's too focused. She follows your lead, exhaling roughly and then taking a deeper breath. No one could call the state she reaches anything close to zen, but it looks surprisingly peaceful. Some very vulgar squelching issues from beyond the barrier, but you do your best to ignore it in favor of offering your support. Ahmri occasionally pauses her pushing to readjust herself, leaning into you and rubbing her face against your[pc.heightRange 0 74|s| chest]. After each time, she gives a little bit more effort in pushing. "That's it, sweetie. Just keep pushing. You're almost there. It's just the hindquarters left. I know that's the toughest part but you've almost got it," Nova continues, directing from afar. Ahmri buries herself in your embrace, pushing with all she has. She takes great deep breaths, straining until finally you hear a final wet splorch from the other side of the curtain. Then, she relaxes utterly, squirming more with relief than discomfort. Her forelegs test the ground, but wobble too much for her to move at all. Her lips purse in concern as she looks back over her shoulder in both directions, fidgeting with your hand and giving you a pleading look. "Can't see them, can you bring them?" she asks, her voice quiet with weariness. "Nova, is it safe to come back?" you ask, taking her in a calming hug. "Almost! Just cleaning up a little," she replies. An agonizing minute of waiting later, she pipes up again. "Ok! You should be good now." Ahmri tries and fails to stand again, frowning and looking at you once more. This time, you're free to stand, holding her hand till you absolutely have to let it go, and then circling around the far side of the divider. Is it normal for there to be no noise? You try not to fret, but stop in surprise when you get a good look. Nova is knelt on a fresh pad of wool, wiping the forehead of a tiny baby centaur who appears to be trying their best to sit up. Baby might be a little bit of a misnomer. The centaur child's upper half looks easily on par with the development of a two-year-old human toddler. "Come on, come see your child. He's a boy," she says, patting the padding beside her. You join her, kneeling beside him on the other side and helping her to wipe off what little remains of the afterbirth. The little boy's coat is the same fluffy white as Ahmri, and without the time spent in the sun, his hair is an even brighter blonde. At the moment his eyes are kind of glazed, but within a minute they're focusing on you with mild curiosity. There's still a little bit of bleariness there, but it doesn't hamper him too harshly. He reaches out with one hand, brushing against you and gripping at your clothing with that same incredulity. His expression shifts to mild frustration as he tries to sit up again, using you as leverage and trying to pull himself up. You put one hand under his other arm, helping him the rest of the way. There's one wobble, but he swiftly gets his balance, and finally makes a noise. It's a simple happy murmle, but it brings a grin to your lips. He looks up at you, his gaze still suffering from that slight loss of focus, and gives you a smile that [silly|really activates your almonds.|[pc.isDK|instantly melts the ice around your heart.|threatens to make your heart boil over.]] His legs flop around, hooves sheathed in a natural coat of rubbery strands, and try ineffectually to push him forward. When they don't work, he gives a frustrated huff and starts to tip over in the other direction. Genova catches him, scooping him up by the legs. He looks surprised to be up in the air, looking around with mild concern before she hands him off to you. "Whoa there, little one, no need to rush things before you've even seen your mom," you say, turning slowly to walk back around the curtain. In your arms, the kid's head swivels around the room, taking in every sight for the first time with wide-eyed awe. Ahmri is resting her eyes when you approach, still looking exhausted from the ordeal. She rouses when you get close enough to hear, and her eyes light up. For a moment, all that fatigue disappears, and you kneel with the baby between you. He regards her curiously, reaching out to touch her arm when she reaches out for a hug. You hold him aloft, letting her focus on just holding in general. "Oh gosh. He really is six times as cute as I was," she says, struggling not to tear up as she smiles. At the sound of her voice, the small centaur's attention snaps to her face, and he grins so wide his eyes near to close. Ahmri makes a choked happy noise, and pulls him into a tight hug. When she pulls him away, it's to pull up her summer dress and give him a teat to suckle. The little thing still seems more wobbly than hungry, but begins drinking in earnest once he latches on. Your similarly wobbly wife laughs, holding him in place as she looks back up to you. "It feels weird. Different from when you do it," she giggles, and then leans forward to kiss you. You hold her steady, kissing her back till she needs to take a breath. Even then, she leaves her forehead resting on yours. "I would hope so, my intentions are quite different," you say with a happy smirk, brushing the little colt's hair while he drinks his first meal. "I wanted to ask you earlier, but I never found the time. I think you should choose the name. I have an idea, if you want to hear it, but none of this would have been possible without you," she says, eyes closed."

rows.translation: 你可以自己选择一个名字。

rows.original:
"What did you have in mind?" you ask, raising an eyebrow. Ahmri doesn't hesitate, opening her eyes to look down at the half-bundle of fur.

        "I always wanted to name a kid Aster. It was the name of the hero in a story my mom used to tell me. I barely remember it, and I don't even remember if that Aster was a boy or a girl, but it's the first story I remember hearing. I didn't really become a hero like that, but I definitely married one, so it just kinda feels right. You know?"
        
        "I do, and I think Aster is a wonderful name," you say, without a second thought. 
        
        Ahmri smiles, and her gaze falls back to the supping babe. "I love you. Both of you, so much."

Ahmri微笑了，她的目光再次落在正在喝汤的婴儿身上。“我爱你，你们两个，都非常爱。"

rows.original:
You both stay there until he falls asleep, and then stay a little longer, keeping your wife company while she recovers her strength. Eventually, Genova comes over and relieves you. She has a number of bundles, and a larger bag full of child rearing goodies. Placing a hand on your shoulder, she bids you rise. Leaving the baby with Ahmri, you stand and stretch.

    "I know it's a big ask, but could I trouble you to set some of this stuff up at home? If I remember right, there's a spare room in the Chieftain's hovel that would be about the right size. I need to finish washing [aster.name] once he's done eating, and Ahmri could probably use a wash as well after all that."
    
    "Sure. Is it just baby stuff?"
    
    "Yeah, mostly stuff for Ahmri like milk jugs and cloth pads, and a few sets of baby clothes, but there's also a sling in there that should make it much easier for you to carry him when he zonks out," she says, sorting through the bag.
    
    "Thank you. For being here to help out, too. She'd have been utterly lost without you," you say, hushing the last words.
    
    "Oh, it's not all that," Nova muses, chuckling lightly. "You're very welcome, but after any initial confusion the only thing she would have had trouble with is the mess. Centaur birthing is actually surprisingly easy as long as there aren't any complications, but I knew she'd feel just awful if any of those fancy pillows she's stockpiled over the years were ruined." 
    
    You leave her alone with Ahmri and the baby, heading back to the chieftains hut and emptying the bag of baby things. The milk jugs and cloth pads go in Ahmri's room, and the baby clothes and sling go in the spare room. Though, it's probably not going to be the spare room for much longer. This room will be [aster.name]'s, but you can decorate it with more than just this handful of things later. It's currently stuffed full of things Ahmri has gotten from traders and other visitors.
    
    There are a lot of particularly interesting things here. Nothing particularly fantastic, but interesting nonetheless. You flip through some folders of art, some landscapes and some that will definitely need to be hidden away before [aster.name] can get his hands on them. Apart from those, there isn't anything that would be an issue. Mostly it's piles and piles of books, with titles[pc.bg scholar
        | even
    ] you don't recognize. Fantasy epics and raunchy romances. More relevant to current events, you find a number she must have had Taldahs trade for when she was young. The kind of stories that are used to teach youngsters to read in the larger cities of Savarra, and the ones that likely taught Ahmri herself. 
    
    You're still looking, sorting the latter variety of books into a separate pile, when you hear the clip clop of hooves coming through the door. You exit the side room, finding a still somewhat tired looking, but markedly cleaner looking, Ahmri standing near the door. She has a sleeping [aster.name] in a sling like the one Genova was mentioning. It lets him hang right near her foreleg hips, out cold and breathing softly as his legs hang just above the ground. His hooves give the occasional kick when she moves, but he's mostly still.
rows.translation:
你们俩就留在那里，直到他睡着，之后再多待一会儿，陪你的妻子一起，让她慢慢恢复体力。最终，杰诺瓦会过来替你们接手。她带了很多包裹，还有一个装满育儿用品的大袋子。 她把手放在你的肩上，示意你站起来。把婴儿交给阿姆里后，你站起身来活动了一下身体。

“我知道这个请求有点麻烦，但能不能请你把这些东西搬回家去安置一下？如果我没记错的话，酋长的小屋里应该有一间大小合适的空房间。 我需要完成清洗工作。 [aster.name] 等他吃完饭，嗯，阿姆里也可能需要洗个澡了。”

“好的。需要准备的都是婴儿用品吗？”

“是的，主要是阿姆里需要的东西，比如奶瓶、布尿布，还有几套婴儿服装。另外，里面还有一条背带，等他睡着后，用它来抱着他会方便很多。”她一边说，一边在包里翻找着这些东西。
    
    谢谢你们，也感谢你们能来帮忙。如果没有你们，她肯定会陷入困境的。”你说道，最后几个字的声音逐渐低了下去。

“哦，其实也没什么大不了的。”诺娃轻笑着说道，“不用谢啦。不过在最初的混乱阶段，她唯一会遇到麻烦的就是那些杂乱的东西了。 半人马的分娩过程其实出奇地简单，只要没有出现任何并发症就行。但我知道，如果这些她这些年来囤积下来的各种婴儿用品有任何损坏，她肯定会感到非常难过。

于是你让她和阿姆里以及婴儿待在一起，自己则回到了酋长们的小屋，把装满婴儿用品的袋子里的东西都倒了出来。 牛奶罐和布垫被放进了Ahmri的房间，而婴儿服装和背带则被放在了备用房间。不过，这个房间可能很快就不会再被称为备用房间了——因为它很快就会被改作其他用途。 [aster.name]是的，不过之后你还可以用很多其他东西来装饰它。目前里面塞满了Ahmri从商贩和其他访客那里得到的各种东西。

这里有很多特别有趣的东西。虽然没有什么特别惊人的，但确实很有趣。你翻动了一些画作文件夹，里面有些风景画，还有一些东西，肯定需要先藏起来才行…… [aster.name] 他可以拿到那些东西。除此之外，没有什么会构成问题。主要是堆积如山的书籍，还有那些书名……[pc.bg scholar
        | 甚至
    ] 你可能认不出来。这些奇幻史诗与激情浪漫的故事，其实与当前发生的事件有着密切的联系。你找到了一串数字——她肯定是在年轻时用塔尔达斯换来的。这类故事在萨瓦拉的大城市里，常常被用来教孩子们阅读；而阿姆里自己，很可能也是通过这类故事学会阅读的。 
    
    你还在继续整理那些书籍，把它们分成不同的堆放时，突然听到门外传来有蹄子踩在地面上的声音。你走出侧室，看到阿姆里站在门口附近，他看起来仍然有些疲惫，但身上的污垢已经明显被清理干净了。 她有一个睡觉的地方。 [aster.name] 就像热那亚提到的那种吊带一样。它将他悬挂在她的前腿靠近髋部的位置，让他处于冰冷的环境中，呼吸也变得微弱，而他的双腿则悬在离地面不远的地方。每当她移动时，他的蹄子会偶尔踢一下，但大多数时间里，他都保持静止不动。

rows.original: "Hey, [pc.name]," Ahmri says, smiling and walking over to give you a big tired smooch. She smells like lilac and honey, and the mess from before is gone. "Nova says he's gonna need glasses, but she thinks we have some somewhere. It's happened before, and people grow out of the ones they used as kids. In the meantime, I think I'm gonna go lie down till he wakes up. Wanna join me?" "Of course," you reply, leading the way into her room and setting up her blankets to better allow for all three of you to lie down. It's a bit of a puzzle, but you lie down first. Then Ahmri sets [aster.name] down between you, letting him rest with his head near your chest. She then lies down on the other side, scooping his equine form in her arms and nuzzling his fluff with a happy smile. [dayNight |Despite the hour |With how late it is ], you have no trouble dozing off with your wife and child. It's more of a nap than full sleep, but it still feels good. Such a simple pleasure seems so foreign with all the dangers that threaten the world, but a moment like this makes anything the demons can throw at you seem insignificant. [aster.name] is the first one up, and you only realize it when you feel him stand, wobble, and then attempt to begin exploring. He swiftly loses his footing on the gathered pillows, and falls atop you with a noise of frustrated surprise. You do your best not to startle, and help him get to his feet. Your centaur child, on the other hand, does startle at your touch, but once his head swivels around and then down to look at you, he breaks into a giggle. His hooves do a happy little stomp, and he's all smiles as you lead him off the pillows to where he can effectively stand. It feels weird, having a kid standing so soon after being born. It can't have been more than two hours, but you half expect him to start talking! That, at least, is probably impossible. Not without Ahmri or Genova, or both, teaching him, anyway. Speaking of, your pony-wife is up a minute or two later, pulling [aster.name] into a hug and then letting him walk around a little more. He explores the room, or at least the parts of it you let him, and seems content to be guided around a small space for now. The longer that lasts the better, giving his moms precedent... "His little hoof things are already crumbling off! To be honest I think they look kinda creepy, so I'm happy. They crumble off so fast so I only ever saw them super briefly when newborns were running around. That's not weird to think, is it? The creepy thing?" Ahmri asks, watching [aster.name] trot around with a whimsical smile on her face. "I don't think so. Besides, I agree. They look like funky rubber tentacles," you say, keeping your tone light. When he's finished, the energetic colt runs straight to his moms arms. He's wide awake for now, and she stands to join you as you walk into the main room. From there, she lets him wander for a moment as she hugs you around the back. "It's starting to sink in that this is real. It's gone from feeling like a dream that can be snatched away to feeling like my own personal fuck you to that red witch. The good kinda dream that gives me hope that you can beat her. If [aster.name] learns half as fast as I do, he should have some basic words down really soon, so come back and check in soon. Kick twice the demon butt for both of us!" she says, nuzzling your back and then spinning you around to pull you into a kiss. "I plan to. You two stay safe here while I'm gone," you say. "I'm gonna let him walk outside a bit before he needs to eat again. Good luck," she says, letting you go with one final kiss on the cheek before scooping up a giggling armful of [silly |honse-bab |baby horse ] and carting him right out the door behind you. You leave the two of them to their walk, waving back before heading off to resume your questing.
rows.translation: 嘿， [pc.name]啊姆里笑着说，然后走过来给了你一个热情的吻。她身上散发着丁香和蜂蜜的香味，之前那些凌乱的东西也都不见了。“诺娃说他可能需要戴眼镜，但我觉得我们应该还留着一些吧。这种事情以前也发生过，人们长大后往往就不需要小时候戴的眼镜了。 在这期间，我想我先去躺下休息，等他醒来再说。你想一起来吗？” “当然，”你回答道，然后带着她走进她的房间，把毯子铺好，这样你们三个人就可以一起躺下了。 这有点像是个谜题，但首先你需要躺下来。然后Ahmri就会开始操作。 [aster.name] 你轻轻地将他的头放在自己的胸前，让他安静地休息。然后你也躺下来，将他那像小马一样的身体抱在怀里，开心地笑着轻抚他的毛茸茸的毛发。 [dayNight |尽管已经过了这个时间…… |都这么晚了…… ]和你妻子、孩子一起躺下小睡时，你根本不会觉得有什么困难。那更像是一种短暂休息，而不是真正的睡眠，但那种感觉依然很惬意。 不错在这样一个充满危险的世界里，这样简单的快乐似乎显得如此珍贵。但这样的时刻会让恶魔们所能施加的一切威胁都显得微不足道。 [aster.name] 它是第一个行动起来的，只有当你感觉到它站了起来、摇摇晃晃地试图开始探索时，你才会注意到它的存在。它在那些堆叠起来的枕头上很快就失去了平衡，然后带着一声沮丧而惊讶的声音落在了你的身上。 你尽量不要让他受到惊吓，然后帮助他站起来。而你的半人马孩子，虽然会在你触碰他的时候受到惊吓，但一旦他转过头来看你，就会立刻笑起来。他的蹄子会开心地轻踏着地面，当你带着他离开那些枕头，让他能够真正站立起来的时候，他的脸上满是笑容。 孩子出生才两个多小时，就已经能站在那里了，这种感觉真是有点奇怪。你甚至会忍不住期待他马上开始说话呢！ 那个至少，这可能是不可能的。除非有Ahmri或Genova，或者他们俩一起来教导他，否则根本不可能实现。说起来，你的那个小妻子过了一两分钟才出现，然后就开始拉…… [aster.name] 他紧紧拥抱了妈妈，然后被允许在房间里稍微活动一会儿。他探索着房间，至少是那些你允许他进入的区域，目前看来，他在这样一个小空间里活动似乎让他感到很满足。这样的状态持续得越久越好，因为这也能让他的妈妈放心。他的小蹄子已经开始脱落了！说实话，我觉得那些脱落下来的东西看起来有点吓人，所以我还挺高兴的。它们脱落得太快了，我只在它们刚出生、还在到处跑的时候瞥见过它们一眼而已。 这么想并不会觉得奇怪吧？其实挺诡异的……”阿姆里边看着边问道。 [aster.name] 她脸上带着一丝顽皮的微笑，蹦蹦跳跳地走着。 “我不这么认为。不过，我同意你的看法——它们看起来确实像一些奇怪的橡胶触手，”你轻声说道。 当他说完之后，那只充满活力的小马驹立刻跑到了妈妈的怀里。 他现在已经完全清醒了，而当你走进主房间时，她也会加入你。在那里，她会从你背后抱住你，让他自己独自走一会儿。 “我开始意识到，这一切都是真的了。 它从原本只是一个可能瞬间消失的梦境，变成了我对那个红女巫的愤怒与反抗的象征，也成了给我带来希望的、让我相信你们一定能够打败她的美好梦境。 [aster.name] 他学习的速度只有我的一半，应该很快就能掌握一些基础词汇了，所以请尽快回来看看他吧。为我们俩一起把那个恶魔打得落花流水吧！”她一边说，一边轻抚着你的后背，然后转身吻了你一下。 “我会的。我不在的时候，你们两个一定要注意安全。”你说。 “等他再过一会儿需要吃饭之前，我会让他到外面去走走。祝你好运！”她说，在最后再吻了你一下脸颊，然后抱起那个咯咯笑着的孩子，离开了。 [silly |笨蛋 |小马驹 ] 然后你带着他一起走出了大门。 你让他们俩继续他们的散步，朝他们挥了挥手，然后继续去继续你的任务了。
rows.raw: " "Hey, [pc.name]," Ahmri says, smiling and walking over to give you a big tired smooch. She smells like lilac and honey, and the mess from before is gone. "Nova says he's gonna need glasses, but she thinks we have some somewhere. It's happened before, and people grow out of the ones they used as kids. In the meantime, I think I'm gonna go lie down till he wakes up. Wanna join me?" "Of course," you reply, leading the way into her room and setting up her blankets to better allow for all three of you to lie down. It's a bit of a puzzle, but you lie down first. Then Ahmri sets [aster.name] down between you, letting him rest with his head near your chest. She then lies down on the other side, scooping his equine form in her arms and nuzzling his fluff with a happy smile. [dayNight |Despite the hour |With how late it is ], you have no trouble dozing off with your wife and child. It's more of a nap than full sleep, but it still feels good. Such a simple pleasure seems so foreign with all the dangers that threaten the world, but a moment like this makes anything the demons can throw at you seem insignificant. [aster.name] is the first one up, and you only realize it when you feel him stand, wobble, and then attempt to begin exploring. He swiftly loses his footing on the gathered pillows, and falls atop you with a noise of frustrated surprise. You do your best not to startle, and help him get to his feet. Your centaur child, on the other hand, does startle at your touch, but once his head swivels around and then down to look at you, he breaks into a giggle. His hooves do a happy little stomp, and he's all smiles as you lead him off the pillows to where he can effectively stand. It feels weird, having a kid standing so soon after being born. It can't have been more than two hours, but you half expect him to start talking! That, at least, is probably impossible. Not without Ahmri or Genova, or both, teaching him, anyway. Speaking of, your pony-wife is up a minute or two later, pulling [aster.name] into a hug and then letting him walk around a little more. He explores the room, or at least the parts of it you let him, and seems content to be guided around a small space for now. The longer that lasts the better, giving his moms precedent... "His little hoof things are already crumbling off! To be honest I think they look kinda creepy, so I'm happy. They crumble off so fast so I only ever saw them super briefly when newborns were running around. That's not weird to think, is it? The creepy thing?" Ahmri asks, watching [aster.name] trot around with a whimsical smile on her face. "I don't think so. Besides, I agree. They look like funky rubber tentacles," you say, keeping your tone light. When he's finished, the energetic colt runs straight to his moms arms. He's wide awake for now, and she stands to join you as you walk into the main room. From there, she lets him wander for a moment as she hugs you around the back. "It's starting to sink in that this is real. It's gone from feeling like a dream that can be snatched away to feeling like my own personal fuck you to that red witch. The good kinda dream that gives me hope that you can beat her. If [aster.name] learns half as fast as I do, he should have some basic words down really soon, so come back and check in soon. Kick twice the demon butt for both of us!" she says, nuzzling your back and then spinning you around to pull you into a kiss. "I plan to. You two stay safe here while I'm gone," you say. "I'm gonna let him walk outside a bit before he needs to eat again. Good luck," she says, letting you go with one final kiss on the cheek before scooping up a giggling armful of [silly |honse-bab |baby horse ] and carting him right out the door behind you. You leave the two of them to their walk, waving back before heading off to resume your questing."

rows.original:
"Ah! [pc.name]! I think the baby is coming soon!" Ahmri says, shooting to attention.
    
    "Does it feel like last time?" you ask. You'd noticed her increasing discomfort in the last hour, but hadn't wanted to worry her.
    
    "Yeah... feels like the kind that's not gonna stop."
    
    "Do you want me to help you get to Nova?"
    
    "No, that's fine. I can make it this time. Would you [aster.around
        |keep looking after [aster.name] till I get back, though? I know you can get busy but if it's not too much trouble I mean," she asks, and you meet her at the door to put a relaxing hand on her back.
        
        "Of course I will, and we'll be waiting when you get back," you promise, brushing a hand through her fluff.
        
        Your reassurance works, and she leaves significantly more relaxed than that first time you went with her. After she stops turning back to wave at you, you do a dramatic spin that leaves you facing [aster.name]. The snow-haired [silly
            |honse
            |foal
        ] startles at the suddenness of it, but smiles happily when he sees you smiling. 
        
        "[pc.mf
            |Ba!
            |Ma!
        ] Wa do?" he asks, trotting closer.
        
        "Well, [silly
            |I've always wanted to take up applied particle physics, what about you?
            |I think a few hours of playtime are in order, don't you?
        ]"
        
        "[silly
            |Oki!
            |Play!
        ]" he replies, clapping his hands together in excitement.
        
        [silly
            |The next two hours are spent pouring over mathematical texts and diagrams till your brains turn to mush. The little guy understands it all about as well as you do, which is to say not at all because these concepts are very much outside the understanding that is common in the setting. Maybe Nareva will grasp them in, like, 2000 years, but good luck getting them from her. Still, it's a good solid bonding experience between you and the jolly little juvenile, and it whiles away the time like a real mofo.
            |You spend the next two hours entertaining the little colt in the best way you know how. About half the time is spent reading with him, practicing words he's just on the cusp of grasping. Single syllable words and simple two syllable words are the ones he latches onto the quickest, and you're sure it won't be long before he can tackle larger ones. The other half of your time is spent tiring him out. He loves running half circles around the central room, and he loves even more when you lie on your back and attempt to balance him on your [pc.hasFeet
                |feet
                |hooves
            ]. That physical bonding whiles the time away even faster, making the last hour feel like a matter of minutes.
        ]
        
        Ahmri wanders in after about the two hour mark, looking tired and bedraggled but fresh and clean. [aster.name] rushes to greet her, and then manages a hug so gentle that you have to hold back a [pc.isBimbo
            |giggle
            |laugh
        ]. You join him, hugging her around the middle and kissing her when she turns her head to face you.
        
        "How did it go?" you ask, giving her a squeeze.
        
        "Wonderfully. It's much easier the second time over. [ahmri.numKids 2 3
            |I was also kinda worried I'd end up loving them too much to let Nova take care of them full time, but I was happy to find it didn't feel like giving them up. Like, super happy.
            |It keeps getting easier, and I get so happy seeing them running around the village.
        ] Gods I'm so glad you're here," she says, wrapping her arms around you in a tired hug. "Would you stay here tonight with me and [aster.name]."
        
        "I was just about to ask if you wanted to come to bed with us," you tease, eliciting a huff of a laugh from the exhausted mare. 
        
        [aster.name] follows along as the three of you enter Ahmri's room and collapse into an awkward but comfortable jumble atop the piles of pillows. The three of you fade together into something approximating a nap. The blissful half-sleep lasts for a handful of hours, till Ahmri stretches with wakefulness and hugs you even tighter. She looks up at you with a smile that's still bleary but much more rested looking, and gives you a smooch on the chest.
        |wait for me? Just till I get back. I like having you here, and I don't wanna come home to an empty house after while [aster.name] is staying with Genova," she asks.
        
        "Of course I will" you say, not hesitating for a second as you give her a reaffirming squeeze.
        
        That's enough to visibly relax her, and she only waves over her shoulder twice before setting off to the matron's hut with determined purpose.
        
        You wait around the house, sorting through some of Ahmri's books and checking through the pages she has marked with bookmarks. Everything gets left exactly where you found it, but some haphazard piles get straightened or stacked more evenly. Eventually, you wander into her room and lie on the pillows with a book from the top of one such stack while you wait for her to return. The little comforts of plush softness and her scent blend the hours till you hear the telltale clop of hooves at the door.
        
        Ahmri wanders in after what must have been around two hours, looking tired and bedraggled but fresh and clean. She wraps her arms around you when you greet her at the door, just standing there for a moment and hugging you and rocking gently. There's a smile on her face when she pulls back to give you a smooch.
        
        "How did it go?" you ask when you pull back from the kiss.
        
        "Wonderfully. Much easier than the first time. [ahmri.numKids 2 3
            |I was also kinda worried I'd end up loving them too much to let Nova take care of them full time, but I was happy to find it didn't feel like giving them up. Like, super happy.
            |It keeps getting easier, and I get so happy seeing them running around the village.
        ] Gods I'm so glad you're here," she says, brushing her nose all over your chest as she nuzzles in. "Would you stay here with me while I get some rest?"
        
        "Of course," you reply, already leading her to her room.
        
        The two of you plop down on her pile of pillows, and you gently rub her back till she falls asleep. You follow soon after, drifting into a light nap while you relax in the arms of your lover. The blissful half-sleep lasts for a handful of hours, till Ahmri stretches with wakefulness and hugs you even tighter. She looks up at you with a smile that's still bleary but much more rested looking, and gives you a smooch on the chest.
    ]
    
    "Mmm, that's so much better. I love you."

    "I love you, too. Every little bit of you."
    
    "The big bits too?"
    
    "Just as much or more."
    [aster.around
        |"Big luv!" [aster.name] says, joining the conversation from between you as he wakes enough to comprehend it.
        
        "That's right, and we love you lots too!" you say, scooting him up further on the blankets so you can give him a smooch on the head. 
        
        He giggles, and that makes Ahmri laugh, which makes him giggle even harder. That leaves all three of you thoroughly awakened, and you help each other to stand.
        |That prompts a fit of giggles, and you punctuate your statement with a bevy of boob-smooches that elicit even more. That leaves the both of you thoroughly awakened, and you help each other to stand.
        
    ]Heading back into the main chamber, you're left to decide what to do.

        |超级爱你！ [aster.name] 他说着，从你们中间加入谈话，此时他已经清醒到能够理解这些话了。

“没错，我们也非常爱你！”你说道，把他在毯子上往上挪了挪，然后亲了亲他的脑袋。

他咯咯笑了起来，这让阿姆里也笑了，而阿姆里的笑声又让他笑得更加厉害。这样一来，你们三个人都彻底清醒了，于是你们互相帮助着站了起来。
        |这引发了一阵阵阵的笑声，而你用一连串的亲吻来为你的话画上句号，这些亲吻更是惹来了更多的笑声。这样一来，你们俩都彻底清醒了过来，然后你们互相帮助站了起来。
        
    ]回到主厅后，你必须决定接下来该做什么。
rows.raw:
'
    "Ah! [pc.name]! I think the baby is coming soon!" Ahmri says, shooting to attention.
    
    "Does it feel like last time?" you ask. You'd noticed her increasing discomfort in the last hour, but hadn't wanted to worry her.
    
    "Yeah... feels like the kind that's not gonna stop."
    
    "Do you want me to help you get to Nova?"
    
    "No, that's fine. I can make it this time. Would you [aster.around
        |keep looking after [aster.name] till I get back, though? I know you can get busy but if it's not too much trouble I mean," she asks, and you meet her at the door to put a relaxing hand on her back.
        
        "Of course I will, and we'll be waiting when you get back," you promise, brushing a hand through her fluff.
        
        Your reassurance works, and she leaves significantly more relaxed than that first time you went with her. After she stops turning back to wave at you, you do a dramatic spin that leaves you facing [aster.name]. The snow-haired [silly
            |honse
            |foal
        ] startles at the suddenness of it, but smiles happily when he sees you smiling. 
        
        "[pc.mf
            |Ba!
            |Ma!
        ] Wa do?" he asks, trotting closer.
        
        "Well, [silly
            |I've always wanted to take up applied particle physics, what about you?
            |I think a few hours of playtime are in order, don't you?
        ]"
        
        "[silly
            |Oki!
            |Play!
        ]" he replies, clapping his hands together in excitement.
        
        [silly
            |The next two hours are spent pouring over mathematical texts and diagrams till your brains turn to mush. The little guy understands it all about as well as you do, which is to say not at all because these concepts are very much outside the understanding that is common in the setting. Maybe Nareva will grasp them in, like, 2000 years, but good luck getting them from her. Still, it's a good solid bonding experience between you and the jolly little juvenile, and it whiles away the time like a real mofo.
            |You spend the next two hours entertaining the little colt in the best way you know how. About half the time is spent reading with him, practicing words he's just on the cusp of grasping. Single syllable words and simple two syllable words are the ones he latches onto the quickest, and you're sure it won't be long before he can tackle larger ones. The other half of your time is spent tiring him out. He loves running half circles around the central room, and he loves even more when you lie on your back and attempt to balance him on your [pc.hasFeet
                |feet
                |hooves
            ]. That physical bonding whiles the time away even faster, making the last hour feel like a matter of minutes.
        ]
        
        Ahmri wanders in after about the two hour mark, looking tired and bedraggled but fresh and clean. [aster.name] rushes to greet her, and then manages a hug so gentle that you have to hold back a [pc.isBimbo
            |giggle
            |laugh
        ]. You join him, hugging her around the middle and kissing her when she turns her head to face you.
        
        "How did it go?" you ask, giving her a squeeze.
        
        "Wonderfully. It's much easier the second time over. [ahmri.numKids 2 3
            |I was also kinda worried I'd end up loving them too much to let Nova take care of them full time, but I was happy to find it didn't feel like giving them up. Like, super happy.
            |It keeps getting easier, and I get so happy seeing them running around the village.
        ] Gods I'm so glad you're here," she says, wrapping her arms around you in a tired hug. "Would you stay here tonight with me and [aster.name]."
        
        "I was just about to ask if you wanted to come to bed with us," you tease, eliciting a huff of a laugh from the exhausted mare. 
        
        [aster.name] follows along as the three of you enter Ahmri's room and collapse into an awkward but comfortable jumble atop the piles of pillows. The three of you fade together into something approximating a nap. The blissful half-sleep lasts for a handful of hours, till Ahmri stretches with wakefulness and hugs you even tighter. She looks up at you with a smile that's still bleary but much more rested looking, and gives you a smooch on the chest.
        |wait for me? Just till I get back. I like having you here, and I don't wanna come home to an empty house after while [aster.name] is staying with Genova," she asks.
        
        "Of course I will" you say, not hesitating for a second as you give her a reaffirming squeeze.
        
        That's enough to visibly relax her, and she only waves over her shoulder twice before setting off to the matron's hut with determined purpose.
        
        You wait around the house, sorting through some of Ahmri's books and checking through the pages she has marked with bookmarks. Everything gets left exactly where you found it, but some haphazard piles get straightened or stacked more evenly. Eventually, you wander into her room and lie on the pillows with a book from the top of one such stack while you wait for her to return. The little comforts of plush softness and her scent blend the hours till you hear the telltale clop of hooves at the door.
        
        Ahmri wanders in after what must have been around two hours, looking tired and bedraggled but fresh and clean. She wraps her arms around you when you greet her at the door, just standing there for a moment and hugging you and rocking gently. There's a smile on her face when she pulls back to give you a smooch.
        
        "How did it go?" you ask when you pull back from the kiss.
        
        "Wonderfully. Much easier than the first time. [ahmri.numKids 2 3
            |I was also kinda worried I'd end up loving them too much to let Nova take care of them full time, but I was happy to find it didn't feel like giving them up. Like, super happy.
            |It keeps getting easier, and I get so happy seeing them running around the village.
        ] Gods I'm so glad you're here," she says, brushing her nose all over your chest as she nuzzles in. "Would you stay here with me while I get some rest?"
        
        "Of course," you reply, already leading her to her room.
        
        The two of you plop down on her pile of pillows, and you gently rub her back till she falls asleep. You follow soon after, drifting into a light nap while you relax in the arms of your lover. The blissful half-sleep lasts for a handful of hours, till Ahmri stretches with wakefulness and hugs you even tighter. She looks up at you with a smile that's still bleary but much more rested looking, and gives you a smooch on the chest.
    ]
    
    "Mmm, that's so much better. I love you."

    "I love you, too. Every little bit of you."
    
    "The big bits too?"
    
    "Just as much or more."
    [aster.around
        |"Big luv!" [aster.name] says, joining the conversation from between you as he wakes enough to comprehend it.
        
        "That's right, and we love you lots too!" you say, scooting him up further on the blankets so you can give him a smooch on the head. 
        
        He giggles, and that makes Ahmri laugh, which makes him giggle even harder. That leaves all three of you thoroughly awakened, and you help each other to stand.
        |That prompts a fit of giggles, and you punctuate your statement with a bevy of boob-smooches that elicit even more. That leaves the both of you thoroughly awakened, and you help each other to stand.
        
    ]Heading back into the main chamber, you're left to decide what to do.'

rows.original:
Ahmri canters over as soon as you walk through, tackling you in a hug and pulling you into a deep kiss. When she pulls back, she's beaming with happiness.

    "Hey, [pc.name]. Notice anything different?" she asks, raising an eyebrow.
    
    You give her a casual look-over, immediately noticed the lack of baby-bump, and [pc.isCunning
        |grin mischievously
        |smile warmly
    ].
    
    "[pc.isCunning
        |New highlights?" you ask, smirking.
        |I'm sorry I missed it. Are you feeling ok?
    ]"
    
    "[pc.isCunning
        |I saw you looking, you goof! Don't joke about that," she says, laughing despite herself.
        |Wonderful! It feels good to be light on my feet again, or at least light-er," she says with a giggle.
    ] "I love you."
    
    "I love you, too. I'm glad everything's ok."
    
    "Did you come for anything specific today, or just to hang out?"

啊姆丽一看到你走进来，就快步跑过来，紧紧地拥抱你，然后深深地吻了你一下。当她拉开距离时，脸上洋溢着幸福的笑容。

“嘿， [pc.name]有没有注意到什么不同之处？”她挑了挑眉毛问道。

你随意地打量了她一眼，立刻注意到了她身上没有怀孕的迹象。 [pc.isCunning
        |调皮地咧嘴一笑
        |温暖地微笑
    ].
    
    "[pc.isCunning
        |新的亮点吗？”你笑着问道。
        |很抱歉，我错过了那件事。你现在感觉还好吗？
    ]"
    
    "[pc.isCunning
        |我看到你在看了，笨蛋！别开这种玩笑，”她边说边忍不住笑了起来。
        |太好了！能够再次轻松地行走，或者至少是感觉轻松了一些，真是太开心了。”她笑着说。
    ] 我爱你。”

“我也爱你。很高兴一切都好。”

“你今天来是有什么特别的事情吗，还是只是想一起来玩而已？
