rows.original: You look over at [aster.name], and suppress a smirk when you see him slowly moving some toys around. He rubs his eyes, yawns hard enough that he almost tips over, and then continues wearily playing with his toys. You wander over, and he gives you a sleepy smile as you plop down next to him. "Hey, [pc.isBimbo |honey |kiddo ]. Ready for bed?" you ask, rubbing his back. He shakes his head with a little frown, clutching his toys tight. "Are you sure? [pc.mf |Mommy and Daddy are going to bed |Your mommies are going to bed ], and you can cuddle with us till you fall asleep. Your toys can come too." You watch him struggle with the decision, but being able to bring the plush toys seems to be the deal-maker. He nods, hugging his arms around himself so you can more easily scoop him up. Kiddo in hand, you walk over to Ahmri. "Ready for bed? I think he should be out pretty quickly," you say, brushing her arm. "Gods, yeah, I could use some sleep," she says with a smile, standing, stretching, and slipping [aster.name]'s glasses off before she moves to the dresser and changes into her pajama top. The three of you move to the bedroom in unison, a procession of weariness that ends at Ahmri's pile of soft pillows. She lies down first, opening her arms and lifting one foreleg so you can kneel and fit [aster.name] between you before lying down yourself. Wrapped up tight and snug between his parents, the tired tyke begins to doze off immediately. Ahmri is right behind him, drifting into a deep sleep as her body exudes warmth. You soon join them, consciousness fading till there's nothing but comforting blackness. [rand |The whole night, you dream of nothing but fluffy clouds and what it would be like to sleep on them. They're extra comfy, and even when you toss in your sleep and fall, another cloud is there to catch you. You don't even wake from the impact, but simply grin in your sleep and rub your face against the plush surface. More and more clouds join your night-time weather front, creating a storm of blissful softness that carries you safely through the dark nothingness. |Your rest is full of plush, faceless sheep that jump over high fences and drop into your lap. Once they've landed, the sheep waddle around you and settle into a supportive cushion of softness. Their wool is so silky you can't distinguish between them when they bunch up together! You stop trying to count them after the first minute of searching, letting new sheep pile on top of you till you're covered in blissful pillowy darkness. |You dream of nothingness, just an empty void that surrounds and encases you. What should be terrifying to see isn't frightening at all. You can feel the softness all around you. Warmth and gentleness rather than cold and loneliness. Adrift in comfort, you don't so much as toss, let alone turn, for the entire night. There are no stars to count, no sights to see, but you need none of that. Just the intimate, instinctive knowledge that you're safe. ] You and [aster.name] wake first, and the little centaur stretches and rubs his eyes. He looks around with adorable morning confusion till his eyes settle on you. Without a further thought, he falls atop you with a hug, and then nuzzles your [pc.hasHair |hair |head ] before using you to push himself to a seated position. You use him right back, bracing on his equine back to push yourself up. "[pc.mf |Ba! |Ma! ] Goo morm," he says, groggily wiping the tiredness from his eyes. "Good morning to you too, little one!" you say, giving him a smooch on the cheek and prompting a giggle. "Mmn? Good morning!" Ahmri says, stretching all her limbs with her eyes still closed. She pulls [aster.name] back down as she rolls over. Much to his amusement, she brushes and squeezes him just like a pillow. After that, she helps him up as she stands herself, and then trots over to help you to your feet. The three of you walk into the common room together, and you give Ahmri plenty of morning nose rubs along the way. "Thanks. It's always nice to have you to keep us warm," she says, rubbing her thumbs together. It's very much the other way around, but you're always glad to help the both of them sleep well.
rows.translation: 你看向那边。 [aster.name]当你看到他慢慢地移动那些玩具时，你强忍住想要笑出来的冲动。他揉了揉眼睛，打了个哈欠，差点儿摔倒，然后又疲惫地继续玩他的玩具。你走过去，他困倦地对你笑了笑，然后你就在他旁边坐了下来。 “嘿， [pc.isBimbo |亲爱的 |小家伙 ]该睡觉了吗？”你一边问道，一边轻抚着他的背部。 他微微皱着眉头，摇摇头，同时紧紧握住自己的玩具。 “你确定吗？ [pc.mf |爸爸妈妈要睡觉了。 |你们的妈妈们要睡觉了。 ]你可以和我们一起依偎着，直到睡着为止。你的玩具也可以一起来哦。” 你看着他为这个决定而犹豫不决，但能够带上那些毛绒玩具似乎成了决定他是否同意的关键。他点了点头，双臂紧紧抱住自己，这样你就更容易把他抱起来。抱起孩子后，你走向了Ahmri。 “准备睡觉了吗？我觉得他应该很快就能睡着的。”你一边说，一边轻抚着她的手臂。 “天啊，是啊，我确实需要睡一觉了。”她笑着说，站起身来，伸了伸腰，然后走了过去。 [aster.name]她摘下眼镜，然后走到梳妆台前，换上了睡衣上衣。 你们三个人一起走进卧室，这一群疲惫的人最终在阿姆里那一堆柔软的枕头旁停了下来。她先躺了下来，张开双臂，还抬起一条前腿，这样你们就可以跪在她身边，靠近她。 [aster.name] 在你自己躺下之前，先看看周围的情况。这个疲惫的小家伙被紧紧地搂在父母怀里，立刻就开始打起了瞌睡。阿姆里紧跟在他身后，她的身体散发着温暖，她也渐渐进入了沉睡。不久之后，你也加入了他们的行列，意识逐渐模糊，最终只剩下那令人感到舒适的黑暗。 [rand |整晚，你梦到的只有蓬松的云朵，以及躺在它们上面该是怎样的感觉。那些云朵格外柔软，即使你在睡梦中翻来覆去，总会有另一片云朵在下面接住你。你甚至不会因为这种触感而醒来，只会会在睡梦中露出微笑，然后用脸蹭那些柔软的云朵。越来越多的云朵加入你的梦境，形成一场由幸福与柔软构成的“风暴”，它们会安全地带你穿越那黑暗的无边虚空。 |你的休息空间里充满了那些柔软、毫无个性的绵羊，它们会跳过高高的围栏，落在你的怀里。一旦落下来，这些绵羊就会在你周围蹒跚行走，然后安顿下来，形成一层柔软的垫子。它们的羊毛如此丝滑，当它们挤在一起时，你根本无法分辨出它们到底有几只！在尝试数了它们一分钟之后，你就放弃了这个念头，任由新的绵羊不断叠加在你身上，直到你被这片幸福的、像枕头一样的柔软所覆盖。 |你所看到的只是一片虚无，一个无边无际、将你完全包围的空洞。本该令人恐惧的场景，却丝毫没有带来恐惧感。你可以…… 感受到 你周围的一切都充满了柔软与温暖，而非寒冷与孤独。沉浸在这种舒适之中，你整晚都不会翻身或转动身体。没有星星可供数数，也没有风景可供观赏，但你根本不需要这些。你只需要那种内心深处、与生俱来的安全感，就能知道自己是安全的。 ] 你和 [aster.name] 他先醒了过来，那个小半人马伸了个懒腰，揉了揉眼睛。他带着清晨特有的迷糊神情环顾四周，直到他的目光落在你身上。他想了想，然后毫不犹豫地扑到你身上，给了你一个拥抱，接着还在你耳边轻轻蹭了蹭…… [pc.hasHair |头发 |头部 ] 在使用他之前，你先让自己坐到他的背上。然后你再反过来利用他，依靠他的背部来帮助自己站起来。[pc.mf |哇！ |妈！ ] 早安，小家伙，”他迷迷糊糊地说着，一边揉着眼睛消除疲劳。 “你也是早安啊，小宝贝！”你说道，然后在她的脸颊上亲了一下，惹得她咯咯笑了起来。 “嗯？早安！”阿姆里闭着眼睛，伸了个懒腰说道。 她拉了拉…… [aster.name] 当她翻过身来时，你便退了回去。令你感到好笑的是，她竟然像揉枕头一样轻轻揉搓着你、挤压着你。之后，她站起身来，也帮你站了起来，然后快步走过来帮你站起来。你们三个一起走进了公共房间，在路上你还不停地揉搓着阿姆里的鼻子。 “谢谢。有你在身边为我们保暖，真是太好了。”她一边说，一边把拇指相互搓着。其实应该是我们一直在帮助她们俩睡个好觉才对，但你总是很乐意这么做。

rows.original:
As you walk through the door to Ahmri's home, you're greeted by a rush of white fluff and tan skin. [aster.name] notices you entering right away, and rushes forward to greet you. A slender pair of glasses hooks over his ears, fitting snugly in place. He has a look of utter excitement on his face, and soon you find out why.

    "[pc.mf
        |Ba! Ba! Ba!
        |Ma! Ma! Ma!
    ]" he shouts, running a few laps around you before pointing excitedly between you and Ahmri. "[pc.mf
        |Ba! Ma! Ba! Ma!
        |Ma! Ma! Ma! Ma!
    ]"
    
    You scoop him up on his next lap, prompting a fit of giggles as you blow a raspberry onto his fluffy equine back. He stills his legs, letting you hold him there as Ahmri approaches the two of you. His tail swishes against your shoulder, and he busies himself running his hands through your hair and hugging your head before she arrives. The limber flexibility with which he turns his human half nearly all the way around makes you wince a little, but you're glad it doesn't hurt him.
    
    "Are you showing off for [pc.mf
        |Daddy?
        |Mommy?
    ] Showing off how smart you are?" Ahmri says, tickling his tummy while you have him trapped. "We were able to find a pair of glasses that fit from prior trade with Khor'minos. rows.original:
[aster.name] rushes into the central room from the bedroom to investigate as soon as he hears someone coming through the entryway. When he sees it's you, he brightens and holds his arms open in preparation for a tackle hug.
    
    "[pc.mf
        |Ba! Ba! B-
        |Ma! Ma! M-
    ]" he shouts along the way, eyes closed and mouth open in a smile. And then his hoof slips on the smooth dirt.
    
    There's a moment of pure panic as his eyes shoot wide while he's sailing through the air, and then he falls upper body first to the ground with an audible 'whomp.' His glasses skid across the dirt floor, luckily staying intact despite the fall. It takes him a second to pick himself up, and his lower lip is already trembling by the time he meets your eyes. You reach him just as the tears start coming, and wipe some dirt off his chin as they streak down his cheeks.
    
    "[pc.isBimbo
        |Oh no, honey! It's ok! Let mommy hug it better!
        |Oh no, kiddo, it's ok! Come here,
    ]" you say, scooping his front end up into your lap. He starts bawling just as Ahmri trots into the room behind him, dropping to the ground beside you and rubbing his back.
    
    "Oh, honey! Are you ok?" she asks. After a minute more of tears and cuddles, he sniffles and nods.
    
    "Mhm, but owie," he burbles, rubbing his chin and arms and sniffling some more.
    
    "Oh! I know just how to fix that," you say, tipping his face up to look at you. He raises his eyebrows, a curious expression on his face, and giggles happily when you give him a big smooch on the chin.
    
    "Me too! I know a magic spell that helps you get rid of ouchies!" Ahmri says, patting her hands on his equine tummy. That alone banishes the sniffles, and he gives her an excited look over his shoulder with his arms still hugged around you.
    
    She gets a mischievous grin on her face, tracing her fingers in intricate[pc.isMage
        |—though effectively meaningless—
        | 
    ]patterns in his fur. This is enough to wipe away the thoughts of pain, replacing them with childish curiosity. When his attention is fully drawn to her, she simply begins ferociously tickling his tummy. Taking that cue, you tickle his human end as well, focusing on his belly and under his arms.
    
    He's caught completely off guard by the double ended attack, and snorts out a laugh that doesn't stop coming till he runs out of air. You both leave off long enough for him to get some air, and then double down till he's fallen from your lap and flailing on the ground. After a minute more, he's laughed all the hurt out, and you let him sit up. A big sheepish smile coats his features, and he gives each of you a big hug.
    
    "All better? Are you good?" Ahmri asks, brushing some leftover dust out of his hair.
    
    "Good. Luv you," he says, nuzzling you both and squeezing tight.
    
    "[pc.isBimbo
        |Ahhh you're such a cutie!" you say, startling him as you sweep
        |Gods, you're so adorable," you say, sweeping
    ] him back up into your arms. After a big squeeze, you set him down so he can stand by himself once more.
    
    "Phew. Thanks for helping me out there," Ahmri says, turning her attention to you as you take her hands and help her to stand.
    
    "Well, I caused it, so it's only right that I helped fix it," you say, pulling her up into a hug.
    
    "True enough. Did you just stop in to say hi, or did you have something else planned?"

[aster.name] 他一听到有人从入口处走过来，就立刻从卧室冲进中央房间去查看情况。当他看到是你时，他的脸上立刻露出了笑容，然后张开双臂，准备给你一个热情的拥抱。[pc.mf
        |巴！巴！B-
        |妈！妈！妈——
    ]他边跑边喊，双眼紧闭，嘴角挂着笑容。然而，他的马蹄在光滑的泥土上打滑了。

就在那一瞬间，他整个人悬在半空中，眼睛猛地睁大，脸上露出了惊恐的表情。随后，他的上半身先着地，发出“咚”的一声。他的眼镜在泥泞的地板上滑行，幸运的是，尽管摔倒了，眼镜却完好无损。他花了一秒钟才站起身来，当他的目光与你的眼睛相遇时，他的下唇已经开始颤抖了。就在泪水开始涌出的那一刻，你伸出手去扶他，同时擦去了他下巴上那些顺着脸颊流下来的泥土。
    
    "[pc.isBimbo
        |哦不，亲爱的！没关系的！让妈妈再抱抱它吧！
        |哦不，孩子，没关系的！过来吧。
    ]你说得对，”你把他的小身子抱到自己腿上。就在这时，阿姆里快步走进房间，来到你身边，趴在地上开始揉他的背。

“哦，宝贝！你没事吧？”她问道。又过了几分钟，他终于止住了哭声，点了点头。
    
    嗯，但是好疼啊……”他边说边揉着下巴和手臂，又抽抽搭搭地哭了起来。

“哦！我知道该怎么解决这个问题的！”你说道，然后把他的脸抬起来看着你。他挑了挑眉毛，脸上露出好奇的表情，而当你在他下巴上亲了一下时，他开心地咯咯笑了起来。
    
    我也知道！我有一个魔法咒语，可以帮助你消除那些疼痛哦！”阿姆里一边说，一边用手轻轻拍着它的马肚子。这个简单的动作就让它的鼻子不再抽动，它仍然双臂环抱着你，从肩膀后面兴奋地望着你。
    
    她脸上露出调皮的笑容，用手指仔细地描绘着那些复杂的图案。[pc.isMage
        |—尽管实际上毫无意义—
        | 
    ]他毛皮上的那些花纹……这些足以让疼痛的思绪烟消云散，取而代之的，是孩子般的好奇心。当他的注意力完全被她吸引时，她就会开始疯狂地挠他的肚子。看到这个信号，你也可以开始挠他的人体部位，重点放在他的肚子和腋下。
    
    这种双重攻击完全让他措手不及，他忍不住大笑起来，笑声一直持续到他喘不过气来为止。你们俩暂时停下来，让他喘口气，然后再次发起攻击，直到他从你们的怀里掉下来，在地上挣扎不已。 又过了一分钟，他终于把所有的伤痛都通过笑声发泄了出来，于是你让他坐了起来。他脸上浮现出一丝尴尬而羞涩的笑容，然后依次拥抱了在场的每一个人。

“好多了吧？你现在没事了吧？”阿姆里一边问道，一边帮他把头发上残留的灰尘拂掉。
    
    好啦，爱你。”他说着，把你们俩都搂在怀里，紧紧地抱住。[pc.isBimbo
        |啊，你真是个可爱的人！”你说道，一边说着一边突然靠近他。
        |天啊，你们真是太可爱了，”你一边说着，一边轻轻抚摸着他们。
    ] 你把他重新抱进怀里，紧紧地抱了一会儿，然后把他放下来，让他能够再次自己站立。

“呼，谢谢你帮了我。”阿姆里说着，将注意力转向你，你握住她的手，帮助她站了起来。

“嗯，毕竟这是我造成的麻烦，所以由我来帮忙解决也是理所应当的。”你说着，将她拉进怀里拥抱起来。

“说得对。你只是顺路过来打个招呼，还是还有其他事情要办？

rows.original: "Ah, [pc.name]! Welcome!" comes a voice from within the home as you walk through the entryway. It's Taldahs! Ahmri's father stands in the central room with a huge smile plastered on his face. Ahmri stands next to him, also turning to greet you. [aster.name] is balanced on his back, legs at his sides and a big smile on his face. He hugs Taldah's back, shifting to the sides when the taller centaur tries to get a look at him. When he sees you, however, he abandons that pretext in favor of pointing excitedly in your direction. "[pc.mf |Ba |Ma ]!" he says, shifting his pointing finger to Taldahs. "BaBa!" "Yes, I suppose I am, now. Makes me feel old," the man says with a guffawing laugh that threatens to unseat your son and send him toppling to the ground. Before that can be an issue, Ahmri lifts him down, where he promptly runs a single lap around you and then wanders back toward the paired taurs. When you close the distance, Taldahs gives you a big hug with a powerful pat on the back. It turns into a squeeze that lifts you [pc.heightRange 0 68 |off the ground |onto your tiptoes ], and you start to realize who your wife inherited her hugs from. "Ahmri's just been telling me how good she has it. I'm glad to have a [pc.mf|son|daughter]-in-law who not only takes such good care of her, but gives me such an adorable grandson!" he says, wincing a little at the latter end. "Oof, I'm going to have to get used to the whole grandfather thing. It's easy to hide since my hair has always been this white, but saying it myself makes it feel more real than I like." "Nonsense! You're still [pc.dcb |quite formidable, I'm sure! |quite the catch for someone out there, I'm sure! |a hot daddy! You just gotta get back on the market! ]" you say with a grin. "Yeah, Daddy! I know Mom wouldn't mind either! She's said as much in several of her letters," Ahmri says with a smirk, bumping him with her elbow. "O-oh, ah... Gosh, wouldn't you know, I just remembered I promised to help Mars move some of his cupboards around. It's been wonderful speaking with you, but I'm afraid I'll have to catch you next time," he replies. He stops just short of actually fleeing the hut, turning to you with a more genuine smile. "And thank you. Thank you for everything you've done, for my daughter and for me. I'm glad to call you family." While you're still blushing at that, he leaves. Ahmri comes up behind you and pulls you into a hug. "So, what have you come for today? Anything fun?"
rows.translation: 啊， [pc.name]欢迎来到这里！”当你走进大门时，屋内传来这样的声音。那是塔尔达斯！ 阿姆里的父亲站在中央房间里，脸上洋溢着灿烂的笑容。阿姆里也站在他身边，同样转身向你打招呼。 [aster.name] 他仰面躺着，双腿伸向两侧，脸上挂着灿烂的笑容。他搂着塔尔达的背部，当那位身材较高的半人马试图看看他时，他会微微侧身避开。然而，当看到你时，他立刻放弃了这个借口，兴奋地指向你的方向。[pc.mf |巴 |马 ]就是我！”他说着，将手指指向塔尔达斯。“爸爸！” “是啊，现在想来确实是我吧。这让我觉得自己老了……”男人哈哈大笑起来，那笑声大得差点把你的儿子震得从你怀里掉出去。 不过还没等这种情况发生，阿姆里就把他抱了下来。你的儿子立刻绕着你跑了一圈，然后又跑回了那些成对出现的牛群身边。当你靠近他们时，塔尔达斯紧紧地拥抱了你，同时还用力拍了拍你的背。那个拥抱的力量之大，简直把你整个人都举了起来。 [pc.heightRange 0 68 |正式启动 |踮起脚来 ]然后你开始意识到，你的妻子是从谁那里学会了这样的拥抱方式的。 “啊姆里一直在跟我夸她这个拥抱有多棒。能有一个这样的妻子，我真的很高兴。 [pc.mf|儿子|女儿]我的岳父不仅对她照顾得无微不至，还给了我一个这么可爱的孙子！”他说着，说到后面时不禁微微皱起了眉头。“哎呀，我得慢慢习惯当祖父这个身份了。因为我的头发一直都是这么白的，所以以前很容易隐藏这个事实，但现在一旦有人这么称呼我…… 我自己 这让整个体验显得比我希望的还要真实。” “胡说！你还是…… [pc.dcb |肯定相当厉害吧！ |对于某些人来说，这可真是个不容错过的机会，我敢肯定！ |真是个魅力十足的男士啊！你绝对应该重新进入“恋爱市场”啊！ ]你笑着说。” “没错，爸爸！我知道妈妈也不会介意的！她自己也这么说过。 几个 她的那些信啊，”阿姆里笑着用肘子轻碰了他一下。 “哦……天哪，你难道不记得吗？我刚才想起来，我答应过要帮马斯把一些橱柜搬动位置的。和你聊天真是太愉快了，不过下次再聊吧。”他回答道。 他差点真的跑出小屋，但最终停了下来，转过身来，脸上带着更加真挚的微笑对你说：“谢谢你。感谢你为我和我女儿所做的一切。能够称你为家人，我感到非常高兴。” 而你还在为他的话而脸红时，他已经离开了。 阿姆里从你身后走过来，将你搂进怀里。 “那么，你今天来这里是有什么事吗？有没有什么有趣的事情发生呢？
rows.raw: ' "Ah, [pc.name]! Welcome!" comes a voice from within the home as you walk through the entryway. It's Taldahs! Ahmri's father stands in the central room with a huge smile plastered on his face. Ahmri stands next to him, also turning to greet you. [aster.name] is balanced on his back, legs at his sides and a big smile on his face. He hugs Taldah's back, shifting to the sides when the taller centaur tries to get a look at him. When he sees you, however, he abandons that pretext in favor of pointing excitedly in your direction. "[pc.mf |Ba |Ma ]!" he says, shifting his pointing finger to Taldahs. "BaBa!" "Yes, I suppose I am, now. Makes me feel old," the man says with a guffawing laugh that threatens to unseat your son and send him toppling to the ground. Before that can be an issue, Ahmri lifts him down, where he promptly runs a single lap around you and then wanders back toward the paired taurs. When you close the distance, Taldahs gives you a big hug with a powerful pat on the back. It turns into a squeeze that lifts you [pc.heightRange 0 68 |off the ground |onto your tiptoes ], and you start to realize who your wife inherited her hugs from. "Ahmri's just been telling me how good she has it. I'm glad to have a [pc.mf|son|daughter]-in-law who not only takes such good care of her, but gives me such an adorable grandson!" he says, wincing a little at the latter end. "Oof, I'm going to have to get used to the whole grandfather thing. It's easy to hide since my hair has always been this white, but saying it myself makes it feel more real than I like." "Nonsense! You're still [pc.dcb |quite formidable, I'm sure! |quite the catch for someone out there, I'm sure! |a hot daddy! You just gotta get back on the market! ]" you say with a grin. "Yeah, Daddy! I know Mom wouldn't mind either! She's said as much in several of her letters," Ahmri says with a smirk, bumping him with her elbow. "O-oh, ah... Gosh, wouldn't you know, I just remembered I promised to help Mars move some of his cupboards around. It's been wonderful speaking with you, but I'm afraid I'll have to catch you next time," he replies. He stops just short of actually fleeing the hut, turning to you with a more genuine smile. "And thank you. Thank you for everything you've done, for my daughter and for me. I'm glad to call you family." While you're still blushing at that, he leaves. Ahmri comes up behind you and pulls you into a hug. "So, what have you come for today? Anything fun?" '

rows.original: [aster.name] is just outside as you approach the chieftains hut, looking a little tired and surprisingly contemplative. You approach, taking a seat next to him and looking out across the village. He hardly seems to acknowledge you at first, his eyes following something on the field off in the direction of the lake. Before you can look closer, he raises his hand and points. "[pc.mf |Ba! |Ma! ] Purp!" he says, and indeed you see that he's pointing at a purple butterfly weaving listlessly through the air from flower patch to flower patch. "That's right! It's a purple butterfly!" you reply. "Wao," he says, and you have to suppress a giggle at the wonderment in his voice. He continues surveying the village, and you watch his face as his eyes scrunch to see the details from afar. His eyes stop on something, and he points again, waiting for you to follow before he speaks again. "Baba! Baba!" he shouts, pointing at Taldahs walking and chatting with some of the other centaurs. "Good catch, but I don't think he can hear us," you say. Unperturbed, [aster.name] gives him a little wave before resuming his search. There's no telling whether he's looking for anything specific, but you sit with him till the next time he notices something. He points at a patch of dirt, a cloud, the mountains, really just anything that captures his attention. Then, finally, he startles a little and points at you. "[pc.mf |Ba! |Ma! ]" he says, his eyes wide. "I've been here almost the whole time, silly," you say, not bothering to stifle the [pc.isBimbo |giggle |laugh ] this time. He runs forward and gives you a hug, as well as a big smooch on the cheek before galloping back into the house. Was that all just a ploy? If it was, it succeeded in lifting your spirits in leaps and bounds. There wasn't even anything he really did, per se, but the childish excitement filled you with warm fuzzies. Standing up, you wander in after him, running into Ahmri. "[pc.name]! [aster.name] said you were here. Did you just come to hang out?"
rows.translation: [aster.name] 当你走近酋长的小屋时，他正好站在屋外，看起来有些疲惫，但出人意料地显得若有所思。你走过去，在他旁边坐下，一起望着村庄外的景色。起初，他似乎并没有注意到你的存在，他的目光一直盯着田野里、朝向湖泊方向的某个地方。还没等你仔细看去，他就抬手指了指那个方向。[pc.mf |哇！ |妈！ ] 紫色蝴蝶！”他说道，果然，你看到他正指着一只紫色蝴蝶，那蝴蝶懒洋洋地飞过空中，从一片花丛飞到另一片花丛。 “没错，就是一只紫色蝴蝶！”你回答道。 “哇哦，”他说道，听到他语气中的惊奇，你差点忍不住笑出来。 他继续观察着这个村庄，你可以看到他的眼睛在远处努力地寻找细节。他的目光突然停在了某个地方，他又指了指那个方向，等待着你跟上来，才继续说话。 “爸爸！ 爸爸！”他喊道，同时指向正在和其他半人马们聊天、走动的塔尔达斯。 “发现得真快，不过我觉得他听不见我们说话的。”你说道。 塔尔达斯却毫不在意，…… [aster.name] 他朝你挥了挥手，然后继续他的搜寻。谁也不知道他到底在寻找什么，但你就陪在他身边，直到他再次注意到什么为止。他会指着一片泥土、一朵云朵、群山——总之，任何能吸引他注意力的东西。最后，他突然惊了一下，指着你说道：[pc.mf |哇！ |妈！ ]他是这么说的，眼睛都瞪得大大的。” “其实我差不多一直都在这里啊，傻瓜。”你说道，甚至都懒得掩饰自己的心情。 [pc.isBimbo |轻声笑 |笑 ] 这一次。 他跑过来拥抱了你，还在你的脸颊上亲了一下，然后又飞快地跑回了屋里。这一切难道只是个计谋吗？如果是的话，这个计谋确实让你的心情变得无比愉悦。其实，他并没有真正做些什么…… 做了这种感觉本身并不复杂，但那种孩子般的兴奋感确实让你感到一阵温暖。 你站起身，跟着他走了进去，然后碰到了Ahmri。[pc.name]! [aster.name] 听说你在这里，是专门过来找我玩的吗？

rows.original: You wander into the spare room, acutely aware of the tiny taur following behind you at a curious distance. Turning around, you plop down on his bedding and give him a happy smile. He smiles back, approaching further and waiting patiently.
rows.translation: 你走进闲置的房间，清楚地感觉到有个小小的家伙正以一种好奇的距离跟在你身后。你转过身，坐在它的床上，对着它露出了开心的笑容。它也回以微笑，慢慢靠近你，耐心地等待着。

rows.original: "Actually, do you wanna go play with aunty Genova and some of the other kids?" you ask. [aster.name] perks up, nodding excitedly and stamping a hoof in anticipation. "Ok, ok, settle down. We can go, then!" you laugh, scooping him up into your arms and exiting the spare room. Ahmri gives you a curious look when she sees you. "We're headed to the matron's tent so [aster.name] can play with some of the other kids!" "Oh! I'll come too! We can have a picnic after!" she says, clapping her hands together. "You go first, I'll need to stop by the bakers and make sure I have enough for everybody." She gives you and [aster.name] both a smooch on the cheek, and then heads out ahead of you while you start off toward the matron's tent. As you get closer, you can hear the sound of children playing and laughing. [aster.name] squirms in your arms till you set him down, and rushes slightly ahead so he makes it through the door first. He looks back over his shoulder once in an impatient and unvoiced question, and runs off with a smile when you nod your head. "[aster.name]! Hello, little one! Are you here with-" Genova begins, seeing you coming right behind him before she can finish asking. "[pc.name]! Go play, little one! I'll keep your [pc.mf |dad |mom ] company." The little colt doesn't need any more excuse than that, running out to join the other children in the field behind the tent. You watch as he rushes up to a small group and joins them in kicking a ball around. Genova wanders up alongside you, watching the kids to make sure none of them are left out or doing anything that would get them hurt. "I'm glad they can entertain themselves so well," she says after a few minutes, "I can keep up with two or three of them at a time, but this generation of mother's have been so fertile that I can't hope to give them equal attention." "Sorry for adding to that problem," you say with a smirk. "No, don't apologize. It would never be that kind of issue. If anything I'm happy. It's overwhelming sometimes, but it feels good." "That's exactly how I feel!" Ahmri says, approaching from behind and coming up along your other side with a basketful of bread. "I sometimes feel like it's way too much for me, but then I squeeze [aster.name]'s little cheeks and it's like a stress-ball." "I don't know if it's quite the same," Nova says with a soft giggle. "But I'm glad to hear you're [var0 |taking so well to motherhood. Your mother was only here in the village for a short time, all things considered, but I'm sure she'd be proud of you. |still taking motherhood so well. I know many whose first time is not nearly so graceful. ]" "[var0 |Thanks. I only hope I can see her again someday so she can meet [pc.name] and [aster.name], |Thanks, but I don't think I'm really that special. I had lots of help, ]" Ahmri says, letting the basket sway in her arms. You put an arm around her back and give her a comforting squeeze. "[var0 |When all these troubles are resolved, maybe we can go visit her. No need to wait for her to come when the Far North is... at least relatively close, |Hey, I'm here to help because you're so special to me, ]" you say, kissing her on the cheek. "[var0 |I'd like that, |Thanks, [pc.name], ]" she replies, rubbing her nose against yours. The three of you stand at the edge of the field, watching the children run races and play together. [aster.name] flits between groups, gathering the younger kids into a group that's large enough to make sure no one is left out. Whenever one foal takes a fall, the others rush to make sure they're ok. Often it's more out of curiosity than care, or a desire to be helpful for Nova, but they still make sure none of the other kids are too rough. They continue playing for upwards of an hour before the group as a whole begins to tire. Some slow down earlier than others, and some are quite exhausted by the time the most energetic among them are winding down. They lean on each other to stop from falling over as they try to keep up with the group. [aster.name] rounds out the middle of the group, rubbing his eyes but trying to stay on his feet. Nova clears her throat when they look to be on the verge of collapsing. "Children! Would any of you like some bread? Miss Ahmri was kind enough to bring some for everyone!" That's enough to revitalize even the most tired [silly |among us |among them ], and they rush in a small stampede to get a share of the food. Ahmri doles it out with laughs and giggles, making sure every kid there gets a big portion. They wander off and split into small groups, eating and resting before they have to come back in for more learning. [aster.name] stays with you, nibbling on his bread and watching the others. "You wanna stay and play? I'm sure Nova wouldn't mind if you want to stay while she's teaching even though it's not one of your normal days," you ask. He looks around one more time, and then turns up and nods. "You can nap in here if you want," Nova says. "I'll wake you up when everyone is up and about again." He nods again, giving you and Ahmri big hugs around the legs before wandering off and plopping down on a pillow. After saying your goodbyes, you wander back to the chieftains hut. As you're walking through the door, Ahmri wraps you in a tight hug from behind. "Thank you, [pc.name]. I'm glad you're here," she says, kissing the nape of your neck and then walking around you to find a place at the table.
rows.translation: 其实，你想去和杰诺瓦阿姨还有其他一些孩子一起玩吗？”你问道。 [aster.name] 它立刻精神起来，兴奋地点头，还迫不及待地跺着蹄子。 “好了好了，别闹了，我们可以出发了！”你笑着把它抱进怀里，然后带着它走出了备用房间。当阿姆里看到你时，她好奇地看了你一眼。“我们要去女管家的帐篷里，所以…… [aster.name] 可以和其他一些孩子一起玩呢！” “哦！我也去吧！之后我们可以一起去野餐哦！”她一边说，一边拍手高兴地表示同意。“你先去吧，我得先去面包店买些东西，确保每个人都有足够的食物。” 然后她对你说…… [aster.name] 他先在你脸上亲了一下，然后走在你前面，而你则朝着女主持人的帐篷方向走去。当你靠近时，你能听到孩子们玩耍和欢笑的声音。 [aster.name] 它在你的怀里扭动，直到你把它放下，然后会稍微跑在前面，这样它就能先穿过门。它会不耐烦地回头看一眼，仿佛在无声地提问，而当你点头同意时，它就会笑着继续跑开。[aster.name]! 喂，小家伙！你是和……一起来的吗？——杰诺瓦话还没说完，就看到你已经跟在他身后了。[pc.name]去玩吧，小家伙！我会帮你照看的。 [pc.mf |爸爸 |妈妈 ] 好啦，可以一起去玩了。” 这只小马驹根本不需要再别的理由，立刻跑出去，加入了帐篷后面田野里其他孩子们的一群。你可以看到它冲向其中一个小团队，和他们一起踢起球来。 热诺娃跟在你身边，时刻留意着那些孩子们，确保没有一个人被忽略，也没有人做出可能会让自己受伤的事情。 “我很高兴他们能自己找到这么好的玩乐方式，”几分钟后她说道，“我一次最多能照看两三个孩子，但这一代母亲们的生育能力实在太强了，我根本不可能给每个孩子都同样的关注。真抱歉又给你们添麻烦了，”你带着一丝笑意说道。 “不，别道歉。这根本不是什么麻烦事。相反，我还很高兴呢。虽然有时候这些事情会让人感到压力很大，但这种感觉其实也挺好的。我正是这么想的！”阿姆里从后面走过来，手里拿着一篮子面包，从你的另一侧走了过来。“有时候我觉得这一切对我来说实在太过沉重了，但后来我又会鼓励自己坚持下去…… [aster.name]它那圆圆的小脸蛋，简直就像一个减压球。” “我不确定是否完全一样，”诺娃轻声笑着说道，“但听到你这么说，我真的很高兴。 [var0 |你适应母亲的角色得非常好。考虑到你母亲在村里待的时间其实并不长，但我相信她一定会为你感到骄傲的。 |我仍然非常顺利地应对着母亲的角色。我知道，很多人在第一次经历这些事情时，都没有我这么顺利。 ]" "[var0 |谢谢。我只希望有朝一日能再次见到她，这样她就能见见他了。 [pc.name] 以及 [aster.name], |谢谢，但我觉得自己并没有那么特别。其实我得到了很多帮助。 ]阿姆里说着，手中的篮子轻轻摇晃着。你把手搭在她的背上，轻轻拍了拍她，给予她安慰。[var0 |等所有这些麻烦都解决了，或许我们可以去看看吧。 她当远北地区……至少相对来说离我们不远的时候，就没必要再等她来了。 |嘿，我是来帮忙的。 因为 你对我来说真的非常特别。 ]你说，亲她的脸颊吧。[var0 |我想要那个。 |谢谢。 [pc.name], ]她这样回答，同时用鼻子轻轻蹭你的鼻子。 你们三个人站在田野的边缘，看着孩子们一起奔跑、一起玩耍。 [aster.name] 它们在不同的群体之间穿梭，把年幼的幼崽们聚集到一起，确保没有一只幼崽被遗漏。每当有一只幼崽摔倒时，其他的幼崽都会立刻跑过去查看它是否受伤。通常，它们这么做更多是出于好奇心，而不是真正的关心，或者想要帮助Nova，但它们还是会确保其他幼崽不会受到太过粗暴的对待。 他们继续玩耍了一个多小时，直到整个团队开始感到疲惫。有些人比其他人更早放慢了速度，而当那些精力最充沛的人也开始逐渐放缓节奏时，有些人已经累得筋疲力尽。他们互相依靠，以免摔倒，同时努力跟上团队的步伐。 [aster.name] 他站在队伍的中间，揉着眼睛，努力站稳身子。当他们看起来快要倒下时，诺娃清了清嗓子。 “孩子们！有没有人想要一些面包呢？阿姆里小姐好心地为大家准备了一些面包！” 这个提议足以让即使是最疲惫的人也重新振作起来。 [silly |在我们之中 |其中 ]他们争先恐后地挤了进去，想要分到一些食物。阿姆里一边笑着一边分发食物，确保每个孩子都能得到足够的一份。他们分散开来，分成几个小小组，边吃边休息，然后才能再次回来继续学习。 [aster.name] 他就那样陪在你身边，吃着他的面包，看着其他人。 “你想留下来一起玩吗？我觉得即使今天不是你平常上课的日子，但诺娃应该也不会介意你留下来陪她上课的，”你问道。 他又环顾四周，然后点了点头。 “如果你想的话，可以在这里小睡一会儿，”诺娃说，“等大家都起床活动后，我会叫你的。” 他又点了点头，然后紧紧地抱了抱你和艾姆里，随后便走开，坐在了一个枕头上。 道别之后，你漫步着回到了酋长的小屋。就在你走进门的时候，Ahmri从背后紧紧地拥抱了你。 “谢谢你…… [pc.name]我很高兴你来了，”她说着，亲了亲你的后颈，然后绕到你的身后，在桌边找了个位置坐下。
rows.raw: ' "Actually, do you wanna go play with aunty Genova and some of the other kids?" you ask. [aster.name] perks up, nodding excitedly and stamping a hoof in anticipation. "Ok, ok, settle down. We can go, then!" you laugh, scooping him up into your arms and exiting the spare room. Ahmri gives you a curious look when she sees you. "We're headed to the matron's tent so [aster.name] can play with some of the other kids!" "Oh! I'll come too! We can have a picnic after!" she says, clapping her hands together. "You go first, I'll need to stop by the bakers and make sure I have enough for everybody." She gives you and [aster.name] both a smooch on the cheek, and then heads out ahead of you while you start off toward the matron's tent. As you get closer, you can hear the sound of children playing and laughing. [aster.name] squirms in your arms till you set him down, and rushes slightly ahead so he makes it through the door first. He looks back over his shoulder once in an impatient and unvoiced question, and runs off with a smile when you nod your head. "[aster.name]! Hello, little one! Are you here with-" Genova begins, seeing you coming right behind him before she can finish asking. "[pc.name]! Go play, little one! I'll keep your [pc.mf |dad |mom ] company." The little colt doesn't need any more excuse than that, running out to join the other children in the field behind the tent. You watch as he rushes up to a small group and joins them in kicking a ball around. Genova wanders up alongside you, watching the kids to make sure none of them are left out or doing anything that would get them hurt. "I'm glad they can entertain themselves so well," she says after a few minutes, "I can keep up with two or three of them at a time, but this generation of mother's have been so fertile that I can't hope to give them equal attention." "Sorry for adding to that problem," you say with a smirk. "No, don't apologize. It would never be that kind of issue. If anything I'm happy. It's overwhelming sometimes, but it feels good." "That's exactly how I feel!" Ahmri says, approaching from behind and coming up along your other side with a basketful of bread. "I sometimes feel like it's way too much for me, but then I squeeze [aster.name]'s little cheeks and it's like a stress-ball." "I don't know if it's quite the same," Nova says with a soft giggle. "But I'm glad to hear you're [var0 |taking so well to motherhood. Your mother was only here in the village for a short time, all things considered, but I'm sure she'd be proud of you. |still taking motherhood so well. I know many whose first time is not nearly so graceful. ]" "[var0 |Thanks. I only hope I can see her again someday so she can meet [pc.name] and [aster.name], |Thanks, but I don't think I'm really that special. I had lots of help, ]" Ahmri says, letting the basket sway in her arms. You put an arm around her back and give her a comforting squeeze. "[var0 |When all these troubles are resolved, maybe we can go visit her. No need to wait for her to come when the Far North is... at least relatively close, |Hey, I'm here to help because you're so special to me, ]" you say, kissing her on the cheek. "[var0 |I'd like that, |Thanks, [pc.name], ]" she replies, rubbing her nose against yours. The three of you stand at the edge of the field, watching the children run races and play together. [aster.name] flits between groups, gathering the younger kids into a group that's large enough to make sure no one is left out. Whenever one foal takes a fall, the others rush to make sure they're ok. Often it's more out of curiosity than care, or a desire to be helpful for Nova, but they still make sure none of the other kids are too rough. They continue playing for upwards of an hour before the group as a whole begins to tire. Some slow down earlier than others, and some are quite exhausted by the time the most energetic among them are winding down. They lean on each other to stop from falling over as they try to keep up with the group. [aster.name] rounds out the middle of the group, rubbing his eyes but trying to stay on his feet. Nova clears her throat when they look to be on the verge of collapsing. "Children! Would any of you like some bread? Miss Ahmri was kind enough to bring some for everyone!" That's enough to revitalize even the most tired [silly |among us |among them ], and they rush in a small stampede to get a share of the food. Ahmri doles it out with laughs and giggles, making sure every kid there gets a big portion. They wander off and split into small groups, eating and resting before they have to come back in for more learning. [aster.name] stays with you, nibbling on his bread and watching the others. "You wanna stay and play? I'm sure Nova wouldn't mind if you want to stay while she's teaching even though it's not one of your normal days," you ask. He looks around one more time, and then turns up and nods. "You can nap in here if you want," Nova says. "I'll wake you up when everyone is up and about again." He nods again, giving you and Ahmri big hugs around the legs before wandering off and plopping down on a pillow. After saying your goodbyes, you wander back to the chieftains hut. As you're walking through the door, Ahmri wraps you in a tight hug from behind. "Thank you, [pc.name]. I'm glad you're here," she says, kissing the nape of your neck and then walking around you to find a place at the table.'

rows.original:
Without a word, you scan the room and find one of the little centaur's toys. Spreading a blanket on the floor, you place the toy right in the middle, and then pat the blanket next to it.

        [aster.name] smiles happily, trotting over to the center of the blanket to grab the toy. He[flags.ASTER_SCOOP
            | feigns complete obliviousness
            |'s completely oblivious
        ] as you grab the edges of the blanket, and as soon as he's fully at the center you sweep your arms up. There's a cry of surprise as he's completely covered in blanket, but he laughs loud when you pull his totally covered form into your lap and begin tickling him through the fabric. When he pushes his way free, you pluck his glasses off before he rushes toward the door and then turns, his tail flitting about as he looks at you with curious excitement.
        
        You repeat yourself, taking the toy he left behind and placing it in the center of the blanket as you straighten it out on the ground. Once again, you pat the center of the blanket, but this time you give him a knowing smirk.
        
        He waddles forward with extreme caution, watching you every step of the way. When you make no move except to yawn, he casually reaches for the toy. Stopping just before he reaches it, he gives you one last pause and glance, and then reaches in to grab hold. As soon as his fingers touch it, you reach out and whip the edges of the blanket up over his head. He squeals with laughter as you pull him into your lap and tickle him once more, flipping the cover back over his head when he gets out early.
        
        This time he rushes away when he gets free, and kicks his hind legs into the air while you silently spread the pillow and move the toy back to its center. He looks between you and the toy, bristling with energy.
        
        "[pc.mf
            |Ba! Ba!
            |Ma! Ma!
        ]" he says, shaking his hands to get your attention. When you straighten and raise an eyebrow, he books it for the center of the blanket in an attempt to take advantage of your distraction. 
        
        This time he almost gets the toy in his hands before you can react, but you wrap him like a little burrito and hoist him off the ground. He laughs even louder this time, struggling to get free as you find all the best spots to tickle. Pulling the blanket away preemptively, you ruffle his hair and then ruffle his coat, scritching behind his forelegs and then helping him to his feet before he can get his bearings. He totters off toward the door in confusion, and then turns back around with a kick and a jump.
        
        He doesn't even wait for you to finish unruffling the blanket before he tries again, and manages to get both hands wrapped tightly around his toy. You cover him in the blanket anyways, listening to him giggle with a smile on your face as you leave him on the ground. Whenever he gets his head uncovered, you blow the hair out of his eyes and then cover him right back up again. Only after he fights to get out till he's too tired to struggle any longer, do you choose to set him free. Instead of running again, he just sits up in the blanket and cuddles the toy with a proud huff. 
        
        "You did it, you won," you laugh, hugging him tight and smooching him on the forehead.
        
        His smile grows wider, and then he yawns.
        
        "What, did playing around in the blankets get you all ready for a nap?" you ask, rubbing his back.
        
        He nods, getting up on shaky legs and hugging the stuffy to his chest as he wanders closer to the bed. You follow, placing the blanket more gently over him as you make sure he's got all the pillows he needs to be comfortable on the large cushion. With a smooch on the cheek while he nods off, you stay with him till sleep has him fully in its clutches. Then, you tuck him the rest of the way in and leave the room, pulling the shade closed as you do.
rows.translation:
你一言不发地环顾房间，找到了其中一个小半人马的玩具。你在地板上铺开一条毯子，将玩具放在毯子的正中央，然后轻轻拍拍毯子旁边的位置。

        [aster.name] 他开心地笑了，小跑着跑到毯子的中间去拿那个玩具。[flags.ASTER_SCOOP
            | 装作完全不知情的样子
            |他完全没有任何察觉。
        ] 当你抓住毯子的边缘，等他完全处于毯子的中心位置时，你迅速将双臂向上一挥。他会发出一声惊讶的叫声，因为此时他的全身都被毯子盖住了，但当你把他完全裹在毯子里抱到自己腿上，开始在毯子下面逗弄他时，他会开心地大笑起来。等他试图挣脱时，你会迅速摘下他的眼镜，然后他就会冲向门口，转过身来，尾巴欢快地摇动着，用充满好奇和兴奋的眼神看着你。
        
        你重复着同样的动作，将他留下的玩具拿起来，放在毯子的中央，然后把毯子平铺在地板上。再次，你轻轻拍了拍毯子的中央，但这次，你冲他露出了会心的微笑。
        
        它小心翼翼地摇摇晃晃地向前走，每走一步都会注视着你。当你除了打哈欠之外没有做出任何动作时，它便随意地伸出手去拿那个玩具。但在即将拿到它的那一刻，它又会停下来，再看你一眼，然后才伸手去抓住它。 他的手指一碰到它，你就立刻伸手把毯子的边缘拉起来盖在他的头上。他发出一阵欢快的笑声，而你则把他拉到自己腿上，再次逗他玩儿。等他好不容易从毯子下钻出来时，你又会把毯子重新盖回他的头上。
        
        这次，他一获得自由就立刻冲了出去，后腿高高腾起，而你则默默地铺好枕头，把玩具重新放到中间位置。他目光在你和玩具之间来回切换，浑身充满了活力。[pc.mf
            |啪！啪！
            |妈妈！妈妈！
        ]他说着，摇动手臂以吸引你的注意。当你挺直身体、挑起眉毛时，他就迅速把玩具放在毯子的中央，试图利用你的分心来达到目的。

这一次，他在你反应过来之前差点就把玩具拿到手里了，但你立刻像包墨西哥卷饼一样把他包起来，然后把他举到了空中。 这次他笑得更加厉害了，而你则不停地寻找各种最有趣的位置去逗他痒。你抢先拉开了毯子，揉乱了他的头发，又挠了挠他的外套，在他的前腿后面轻轻挠了挠，然后在他还没弄清楚状况之前就帮他站了起来。 他困惑地摇摇晃晃地朝门口走去，然后突然转过身来，一脚蹬地，跳了回去。
        
        他甚至都不等你把毯子整理好，就又尝试了一次，最终成功地用双手紧紧抓住了那个玩具。你还是把毯子盖在他身上，听着他咯咯的笑声，脸上带着微笑，然后把他放在地上离开。 每次他把头露出来，你就把他的头发拨到眼睛后面，然后再把他盖回去。只有当他拼命挣扎，直到累得再也无力反抗时，你才会选择放他自由。而他并没有再次逃跑，而是坐在毯子里，骄傲地抱着那个玩具。 
        
        你做到了，你赢了！”你笑着紧紧抱住他，然后在他的额头上亲了一下。

他的笑容变得更加灿烂，接着他打了个哈欠。

“哎呀，在毯子里闹来闹去，是不是已经让你想睡觉了？”你一边说，一边轻轻揉着他的后背。
        
        他点了点头，摇摇晃晃地站了起来，将那个闷热的物品紧紧抱在胸前，然后慢慢走向床边。你跟在他身后，更加轻柔地将毯子盖在他身上，确保他拥有足够多的枕头，能在那个大垫子上舒适地休息。在他渐渐入睡的时候，你在他的脸颊上轻吻了一下，然后一直守在他身边，直到他完全进入梦乡。之后，你把他被子掖得严严实实，然后离开了房间，顺手拉上了窗帘。

rows.original:
You pluck his glasses off in preparation before you speak up.

        "[flags.ASTER_WRESTLE
            |How about you show me how strong you're getting," you say
            |Wanna wrestle, kiddo?" you ask
        ], flexing and discretely noting the location of every pile of pillows in your immediate vicinity. 
        
        [aster.name] brightens with excitement, stamping a hoof and puffing up proudly. Before you can lay out any ground rules, he charges you with his arms wide open.
        
        [silly
            |You sense he's going for the Spumotti gambit, and sweep the leg. While he's off balance, you grab his waist and pull him into a Jassiran suplex. The child is defeated instantly, though he recovers in seconds.
            |His 'attack' is wide and slow, so you simply step to the side on your knees and scoop him up into the air. He laughs as you blow a raspberry into the side of his fluffy equine tummy, and then dump him unceremoniously onto a pile of pillows. Hopping back to his feet, he gives you his best growl (a noise that sounds more adorable than frightening) before charging once more.
        ]
        
        This time, [silly
            |he goes for the Spumotti gambit, and you sweep the leg. While he's off balance, you grab his waist and pull him into a Jassiran suplex. The child is defeated instantly, though he recovers in seconds.
            |you simply pull a particularly thick pillow into his path. He's much too focused to notice in time, much less avoid it, and there's a moment of panic as his forelegs clip the fabric and he sails through the air. It disappears when he paffs face first into a warm hug.
        ] You give him a big squeeze, turning this way and that till he's teetering and dizzy. Then you let him go, ruffling his hair and then pushing him down onto his side with the kind of nonchalance that you'll only be able to have when he's this small. That prompts more giggles, and he pretends to be defeated while he catches his breath.
        
        [silly
            |Anticipating another Spumotti gambit
            |Before he can press the attack again
        ], you pounce on him. He kicks his legs and giggles in a fit, trying to catch hold of your arms for long enough to push you away. When he does manage to get something close to a good grip on you, you pause for a few seconds to let him think he's pushing you away. The cheerful, anticipatory grin on his face says he doesn't believe it for a second, but you play along while grinning right back. Before he can fully catch his breath, you push back for more tickling, and then scoop him into the air again. A squeal of delight escapes from him as you caber toss him onto another pile of pillows.
        
        Things quickly transition from a mock wrestling match to him being perfectly content to be thrown around like a [silly
            |sportsball
            |toy
        ]. Even so, between the impacts, the running back to be thrown again, and the excited jumping and kicking, [aster.name] [silly
            |tries the Spumotti gambit, and you sweep the leg While he's off balance, you grab his waist and pull him into a Jassiran suplex. The child is defeated instantly, and this time he doesn't recover nearly as quickly.
            |is looking utterly exhausted after barely an hour.
        ] When you push him over onto the pillows, he stays there for just a little longer each time. It's not because he's getting tired of the game, but because he's getting tired in general.
        
        "You getting tired, [pc.mascFem
            |buddy
            |honey
        ]?" you ask, brushing his fluffy coat with your fingers.
        
        He nods slowly, head still pressed into a pillow. Letting him stay on that cushion, you bundle up a blanket around him and give him a smooch on the cheek. You stay for a little while longer, making sure he's sleeping comfortably before leaving him on his own and returning to the front room.

你在开口说话之前，先摘下了他的眼镜。[flags.ASTER_WRESTLE
            |不如你让我看看你变得有多强吧，”你说。
            |想打架吗，小家伙？”你问道。
        ]你一边活动身体，一边悄悄留意着自己周围每一堆枕头的位置。 
        
        [aster.name] 它兴奋地闪闪发光，蹄子不停地跺着，还骄傲地挺起了胸膛。还没等你制定任何规则，它就已经张开双臂向你冲了过来。
        
        [silly
            |你察觉到他打算使出“斯普莫蒂计谋”，然后趁他失去平衡的时候发动攻击。就在他措手不及之际，你抓住他的腰部，将他重重摔进“贾西兰过肩摔”的姿势中。那个孩子立刻就被制服了，不过几秒钟后他就恢复了体力。
            |他的“攻击”范围很广，动作也很慢，所以你只需跪着向旁边跳开，然后把他举到空中。当你对着他那毛茸茸的马肚轻吹一声“啵”时，他会哈哈大笑，随后你便毫不客气地把他扔到一堆枕头上。他重新站起身来，会发出最“凶猛”的吼声（其实那声音听起来更可爱而不是吓人），然后再次冲向你。
        ]
        
        这一次， [silly
            |他使出了斯普莫蒂计谋，而你迅速抓住了他的弱点。在他失去平衡的瞬间，你抓住他的腰部，将他重重摔在背上，使他瞬间败下阵来。不过，他几秒钟后就恢复过来了。
            |你干脆把一个特别厚的枕头扔到他的路上。他当时太过专注，根本来不及注意到，更谈不上避开它了。就在那一瞬间，他的前腿被枕头缠住，整个人被抛到了空中。然而，当他脸先着地、落入一个温暖的怀抱时，这一切都消失了。
        ] 你用力捏了他一下，然后把他往这个方向、那个方向扭来扭去，直到他摇摇晃晃、头晕目眩。接着你松开手，揉了揉他的头发，再若无其事地把他推到一边。只有在他这么小的时候，你才能表现得如此轻松自在。这会引发他更多的笑声，而他则假装被击败了，同时努力喘着气。
        
        [silly
            |预计对方会再次使出“斯普莫蒂计谋”。
            |在他能够再次发动攻击之前
        ]你猛地扑向他。他拼命蹬腿，同时咯咯笑着，试图抓住你的手臂，好把你推开。当他终于差不多抓住了你的手臂时，你会暂停几秒钟，让他以为自己已经成功把你推开了。 他脸上那欢快而充满期待的笑容清楚地表明，他根本不相信这一切，但你还是陪着他一起笑。还没等他缓过气来，你就又催着他让你继续挠他痒痒，然后又一次把他举到空中。 当你把他抛到另一堆枕头上时，他高兴地尖叫起来。

情况很快就从一场模拟摔跤比赛变成了他乐意被这样抛来抛去…… [silly
            |运动球
            |玩具
        ]即便如此，在各种冲击之下，那些被抛掷出去的跑卫们，还要在兴奋的情绪驱使下不断跳跃、踢腿。 [aster.name] [silly
            |他使出了斯普莫蒂战术，而你趁他失去平衡之际，抓住他的腰部，将他重重摔在背上，使他瞬间败下阵来。这一次，他恢复得可比上次慢多了。
            |仅仅一个小时后，他就显得疲惫不堪了。
        ] 当你把他推到枕头上时，他每次都会在那里多待一会儿。这并不是因为他已经对这个游戏感到厌倦了，而是因为他整个人都已经感到疲惫了。

“你是不是觉得累了…… [pc.mascFem
            |伙计
            |亲爱的
        ]他现在睡着了吗？”你一边用手指轻轻抚摸着他那柔软的毛皮，一边问道。

他缓缓地点了点头，头依然埋在枕头里。你让他继续躺在那个垫子上，然后给他裹上了一条毯子，还在他的脸颊上亲了一下。你在他身边多待了一会儿，确认他睡得很安稳后，才离开他，回到客厅去。

rows.original:
"Do you wanna read a story with me and Mommy?" you ask, cocking your head to the side.

        [aster.name] thinks for a moment, and then nods. You lead him back into the front room, where Ahmri gives the two of you an odd look.
        
        "[flags.ASTER_READ
            |Little guy wants to hear a story again, and [pc.dcb
                |you're better at that kinda thing.
                |you're the best at that.
                |I would too
            ]," you say.
            
            "I'm sure I can find a good story," Ahmri replies with a smile, giving [aster.name]'s cheek a squeeze before trotting off to her room to find a book.
            |Oh great storyteller, would you grace us with a story from your books?" you ask, bowing as [aster.name] giggles. Ahmri looks confused for just a moment, and then brightens.
            
            "Of course I can, just let me pick one from my trove," she says in the same exaggerated tone, trotting off toward her room.
        ]
        
        You take a seat near the table, and [aster.name] hops up onto another seat with his front legs so he can see the top. Ahmri returns a minute later with a small tome, and begins leafing through it as she reaches the table. She cuddles up close, with [aster.name] smooshed between you, and continues searching through the stories.
        
        "Hmm. Which story to tell today. A familiar tale or a new tale?" she asks, idly ruffling the young colt's hair with the hand that isn't flipping through the storybook. "I think I know just the one!"
        
        You listen as Ahmri begins telling a story about [rand
            |a mighty dragon who kidnaps a princess. The princess finds that the dragon is jealous of royal life, and pines to be courted by suitors. The kidnapped royal, on the other hand, longs for something to break up the monotony of doing nothing but declining suitors. Together, they devise a genius plot.
            
            "What if I mussed up all my make-up and pretended to be a terrifying dragon in human form?" Ahmri says, affecting a princessly voice. "You could assume human form and pretend to be a princess. It'll be foolproof if I do your make-up and stuff!"
            
            You [pc.isBimbo
                |don't see any flaws with that logic. It's how you'd do a switcheroo with a dragon if you were a princess.
                |somehow doubt those are the exact words used in the story, but
            ] [aster.name] giggles at the funny tone and the gestures Ahmri is making as she tells it.
            
            "I dunno... How could you make me pretty enough to be mistaken for a princess?" she continues, this time lowering her voice to a gravelly dragon growl. "There's no way it'll work!"
            
            She goes on to describe how the dragon transforms into a human form that is actually quite beautiful. By the time they find a dress that's large enough to fit her, she looks like a totally convincing —if a little muscular— princess! The actual princess, meanwhile, covers herself in dust and soot till her dress is black with the stuff. They practice etiquette and snarls in turn, and the dragon picks up on it with surprising grace.
            
            When it comes time for knights to try rescuing her, they rescue the dragon instead! The princess's father is a kindly oaf, nearsighted to the point of blindness, and he doesn't notice a thing is wrong! The castle staff notice, of course, but none of them complain when the princess suddenly becomes ten times more kind and considerate. The dragon's minions are not nearly as lucky, whipped into shape from lazy minions to an elite squad of maids and butlers.
            
            The story ends soon after, briefly describing the lives of both the main characters. The dragon lived happily as a princess, finding a suitor who she can safely reveal her secret to some years later. The princess lives a tougher life as a dragon, but even she finds love with several of the dragon's kobold minions!
            |a story about an adventuring party exploring a cave and finding loads of treasure, only to run afoul of a terrible schlorbo who stole the treasure in the first place. No solid description is given of the schlorbo, but it's described over multiple parts of the story as terrible, awful, no-good, wicked, smelly, rambunctious, and 'dainty.' The sun-kissed centaur then launches into an action heavy depiction of their battle with lots of arm movements.
            
            [aster.name] hangs on every word as the fight is described in simple terms, and startles when Ahmri punches a fist into her palm to illustrate it hitting the floor or someone being thrown against a wall. In the end, though, the whole party makes it out alive. The schlorbo is tied up using its own arms, and left to contemplate its wicked schemes while it works at unwrangling itself. The group take the riches, returning most of them to the nearby towns they had been stolen from and keeping what can't be accounted for.
            
            This story is very short, but [aster.name] still claps and cheers. Ahmri ruffles his hair as she reads through the last bit, explaining how the schlorbo realized the error of his ways and went on to become a venerable tax collector for a nearby kingdom. The party went on to have many more adventures, though none are directly described in the story, and each member survived to retire.
            |a story about a squirrel knight. The story takes place on a mighty oak tree, 'taller than a decently sized hill.' He has a shield made out of the top of a particularly large acorn, and uses a sewing needle he found as a sword. In a lengthy but adorable monologue, he describes how he'll protect the world from 'threats', and keep the peace between the denizens of the tree. [aster.name] giggles as she describes the fluffiness of his tail in excruciating detail.
            
            In practice, this extends to him meeting and chilling out with the various other animals that call the tree home. At its base, a family of skunks keep any ne'er-do-wells from approaching, and always bring extra tasty lizards to share. A little further up, he hangs out with his squirrel wife and kids. When Ahmri describes them running around him in quick circles, [aster.name] stamps a hoof and then steps down to kick up with his hind legs and run a brief lap around the room. You laugh, and his mom waits for him to return before continuing the story.
            
            As he climbs all the way to the upper limbs of the tree, he interacts with various birds who all have nests in different parts of the tree. All kinds share sticks and twigs for his own hidey hole, and he makes it all the way to the top of the tree where an eagle is nested. The eagle's eggs are as big as his torso, and the two of them chat about finding shiny things left by wyld elves, humans and other races that wander through the forest. 
            
            Nothing overtly exciting happens in this story, but [aster.name] is still rapt by the talking animals and the general serenity of it all. It ends with him snuggling up tight with his family and going to bed, just as snow begins to fall outside the hole of their nook.
        ]
        
        When Ahmri finishes her telling, [aster.name] gives her a brief clap and then unceremoniously wanders off to replicate the story with his toys. Your wife stays with you, sidling closer to fill the gap he left.
        
        "It's so adorable! I hope he ends up liking the actual reading as much as he likes hearing the stories. He's always trying to tell me about the kinds of stories he hears when Nova's teaching. Some of it I can understand just cause it's stuff I remember, but when he tries to talk really fast it's all just gibberish and I have to stop myself from giggling."
        
        "[pc.isDK
            |Ha! I'm glad he's so passionate about it,
            |I don't know if I'd be able to stop myself,
        ]" you say with a laugh.
        
        "[pc.isDK
            |Me too,
            |I don't think he'd mind,
        ]"
        
        The two of you sit and watch him for a while, and then get up to resume your business.
rows.translation:
你想和妈妈一起听故事吗？”你歪着头问道。

        [aster.name] 他想了一会儿，然后点了点头。你带着他回到了客厅，这时Ahmri用一种奇怪的眼神看着你们两个人。[flags.ASTER_READ
            |小家伙又想听故事了，于是…… [pc.dcb
                |你在这方面做得更好。
                |你在这方面是最出色的。
                |我也会的。
            ]你是这么说的吧。”

“我肯定能编出一个好故事来，”阿姆里微笑着回答道。 [aster.name]她捏了捏他的脸颊，然后便跑回自己的房间去找书了。
            |哦，伟大的故事讲述者，您能否为我们分享一段出自您笔下的故事呢？”你边说边鞠躬问道。 [aster.name] 咯咯笑了起来。阿姆里愣了一下，随即露出了笑容。

“当然可以，让我从我的收藏里挑选一个吧，”她用同样夸张的语气说道，然后快步走向自己的房间。
        ]
        
        你在桌子附近找了个座位坐下，然后…… [aster.name] 它用前腿跳到另一个座位上，这样就能看到上面的情况了。过了一会儿，阿姆里拿着一本小册子回来了，她走到桌子旁开始翻阅这本书。她紧紧地靠过来，坐得非常靠近…… [aster.name] 它挤到了你们中间，继续翻阅着那些故事书。

“嗯，今天该讲哪个故事呢？是一个熟悉的故事，还是一个全新的故事呢？”她一边用另一只手随意地拨弄着小马驹的毛发，一边问道，“我想我知道该讲哪个故事了！”

你静静地听着Ahmri开始讲述这个故事…… [rand
            |一条绑架了公主的巨龙。公主发现，这条龙其实非常嫉妒皇室的生活，渴望有追求者来向她求爱。而被绑架的公主则希望有什麽事情能够打破她每天只是拒绝那些追求者的单调生活。 他们一起想出了一个绝妙的计划。

“要是我把所有的化妆品都弄乱，然后假装成一条人类形态的恐怖巨龙会怎么样呢？”阿姆里用一种公主般的语气说道，“而你们可以假装成人类，扮演公主的角色。 如果我来帮你化妆之类的，肯定不会出错！ [pc.isBimbo
                |我觉得这种逻辑没有任何问题。如果你是公主的话，用这种方式来替换一条龙，确实是很合理的。
                |不过，我有点怀疑这些确实是故事中使用的原话。
            ] [aster.name] 听着阿姆里讲述故事时那滑稽的语气和动作，她不禁咯咯笑了起来。

“我真不知道……你究竟是怎么把我打扮得这么漂亮，以至于会被误认为是公主的？”她继续说道，这次她的声音却变成了低沉的龙吼般的声音，“这肯定不可能成功吧！
            
            她接着描述了那条龙是如何变形成一个人类形态的，而这个形态实际上相当美丽。当他们终于找到一条足够大的裙子让她穿上时，她看起来简直就像一位非常逼真的——虽然有点肌肉发达——公主！而真正的公主呢，却把自己弄得满身都是灰尘和煤灰，结果她的裙子也被这些脏东西弄得黑乎乎的。她们轮流练习礼仪和发出咆哮声，而那条龙也以惊人的灵活性模仿着她们的动作。
            
            当骑士们试图去救她的时候，他们反而救出了那条龙！公主的父亲是个善良但有些愚钝的人，近视得几乎看不见东西，所以他完全没有注意到发生了什么异常！当然，城堡里的仆人们都注意到了，但当公主突然变得比以前更加善良、更加体贴时，他们中没有一个人抱怨。而那条龙的仆从们就没那么幸运了——他们从原本懒惰的仆从，被改造成了一支精锐的侍女和管家团队。
            
            故事很快便结束了，简要描述了两位主角的生活结局。那条龙以公主的身份过上了幸福的生活，后来找到了一位可以放心向她透露秘密的追求者。而那位公主在成为龙之后经历了更多的艰难，不过她还是在与几条龙的 kobold 仆从们的相处中找到了爱情！
            |这是一个关于一支冒险队伍探索洞穴并发现了大量财宝的故事，然而他们却遭遇了一个极其可怕的怪物——正是这个怪物最初偷走了那些财宝。故事中并没有对这个怪物进行详细的描述，但多次提到它极其可怕、邪恶、无用、恶毒、散发着恶臭，同时还行为狂躁，甚至被形容为“娇弱”的存在。随后，这个被阳光照耀过的半人马开始详细描述他们与这个怪物的战斗过程，其中充满了各种激烈的动作描写。
            
            [aster.name] 每一个描述战斗的词语都充满了张力，当阿姆里用拳头击打自己的手掌来模拟拳头击中地面或将某人撞向墙壁的场景时，这种表现手法更是令人印象深刻。不过，最终，整个团队都成功活了下来。 那个笨蛋被自己的手臂绑住了，只能一边试图解开束缚，一边思考自己那些邪恶的计划。其他人则拿走了那些财宝，把大部分归还给了那些财宝原本被偷走的附近城镇，而把那些无法解释去向的财物留了下来。
            
            这个故事很短，但是…… [aster.name] 人们仍在鼓掌欢呼。当阿姆里读到最后一部分时，她挠了挠自己的头发，解释了那个笨蛋是如何意识到自己行为的错误，后来如何成为附近一个王国里受人尊敬的税务官的。这个团队后来还经历了许多冒险，不过故事中并没有详细描述这些经历，而且他们的每一个成员都活到了退休的年龄。
            |这是一个关于松鼠骑士的故事。故事发生在一棵高大的橡树上——那棵树比一座规模不小的小山还要高。这位骑士的盾牌是由一颗特别大的橡子做成的，而他的剑则是一根他找到的缝衣针。在一段冗长却又十分可爱的独白中，他描述了自己将如何保护世界免受“威胁”，并维护树上的生物们之间的和平。 [aster.name] 她详细描述着他那柔软的尾巴时，不禁咯咯笑了起来。

实际上，这也意味着他会与其他那些以这棵树为家的动物们见面、一起闲逛。在树的底部，有一家臭鼬家族，它们会阻止那些不速之客靠近，还会经常带来美味的蜥蜴与大家分享。再往上一些的地方，他会和自己的松鼠妻子以及孩子们一起玩耍。当阿姆里描述它们围着他快速跑来跑去的时候…… [aster.name] 它先跺了跺蹄子，然后用后腿蹬地，在房间里跑了一小圈。你笑了起来，而它的妈妈则等着它回来，才会继续讲故事。

当它爬到树的高处时，会遇到许多鸟儿，这些鸟儿的巢都分布在树的各个部位。 各种各样的动物都齐心协力，为他自己搭建藏身之处，最终他爬到了树顶——那里有一只鹰在筑巢。那只鹰的蛋有他整个躯干那么大，它们俩一起讨论着如何找到那些被野精灵、人类以及其他在森林中游荡的种族留下的闪亮物品。 
            
            这个故事中并没有发生什么特别令人兴奋的事情，但是…… [aster.name] 他仍然被那些会说话的动物以及整个场景所营造出的宁静氛围所吸引。故事以他和家人依偎在一起入睡作为结局，而此时，他们藏身的小洞外面，雪已经开始飘落了。
        ]
        
        当阿姆里讲完她的故事后， [aster.name] 他轻轻拍了拍她的肩膀，然后便若无其事地走开，开始用他的玩具来重现那个故事。而你的妻子则留在你身边，慢慢靠近你，试图填补他留下的空缺。

“太可爱了！我希望他最终能像喜欢听故事一样，也喜欢阅读这些故事本身。 他总是跟我讲诺娃上课时他听到的各种故事。有些内容我能够理解，因为那些也是我记得的事情，但当他讲得太快时，那些话就全都变成了一堆乱码，我简直忍不住要笑出来。"
        
        "[pc.isDK
            |哈！我很高兴他对这件事如此热情。
            |我不知道自己是否能够控制住自己。
        ]你笑着说。[pc.isDK
            |我也一样。
            |我想他应该不会介意的。
        ]你们俩可以坐下来观察他一会儿，然后起身继续你们的事情。
rows.raw:
"
        "Do you wanna read a story with me and Mommy?" you ask, cocking your head to the side.

        [aster.name] thinks for a moment, and then nods. You lead him back into the front room, where Ahmri gives the two of you an odd look.
        
        "[flags.ASTER_READ
            |Little guy wants to hear a story again, and [pc.dcb
                |you're better at that kinda thing.
                |you're the best at that.
                |I would too
            ]," you say.
            
            "I'm sure I can find a good story," Ahmri replies with a smile, giving [aster.name]'s cheek a squeeze before trotting off to her room to find a book.
            |Oh great storyteller, would you grace us with a story from your books?" you ask, bowing as [aster.name] giggles. Ahmri looks confused for just a moment, and then brightens.
            
            "Of course I can, just let me pick one from my trove," she says in the same exaggerated tone, trotting off toward her room.
        ]
        
        You take a seat near the table, and [aster.name] hops up onto another seat with his front legs so he can see the top. Ahmri returns a minute later with a small tome, and begins leafing through it as she reaches the table. She cuddles up close, with [aster.name] smooshed between you, and continues searching through the stories.
        
        "Hmm. Which story to tell today. A familiar tale or a new tale?" she asks, idly ruffling the young colt's hair with the hand that isn't flipping through the storybook. "I think I know just the one!"
        
        You listen as Ahmri begins telling a story about [rand
            |a mighty dragon who kidnaps a princess. The princess finds that the dragon is jealous of royal life, and pines to be courted by suitors. The kidnapped royal, on the other hand, longs for something to break up the monotony of doing nothing but declining suitors. Together, they devise a genius plot.
            
            "What if I mussed up all my make-up and pretended to be a terrifying dragon in human form?" Ahmri says, affecting a princessly voice. "You could assume human form and pretend to be a princess. It'll be foolproof if I do your make-up and stuff!"
            
            You [pc.isBimbo
                |don't see any flaws with that logic. It's how you'd do a switcheroo with a dragon if you were a princess.
                |somehow doubt those are the exact words used in the story, but
            ] [aster.name] giggles at the funny tone and the gestures Ahmri is making as she tells it.
            
            "I dunno... How could you make me pretty enough to be mistaken for a princess?" she continues, this time lowering her voice to a gravelly dragon growl. "There's no way it'll work!"
            
            She goes on to describe how the dragon transforms into a human form that is actually quite beautiful. By the time they find a dress that's large enough to fit her, she looks like a totally convincing —if a little muscular— princess! The actual princess, meanwhile, covers herself in dust and soot till her dress is black with the stuff. They practice etiquette and snarls in turn, and the dragon picks up on it with surprising grace.
            
            When it comes time for knights to try rescuing her, they rescue the dragon instead! The princess's father is a kindly oaf, nearsighted to the point of blindness, and he doesn't notice a thing is wrong! The castle staff notice, of course, but none of them complain when the princess suddenly becomes ten times more kind and considerate. The dragon's minions are not nearly as lucky, whipped into shape from lazy minions to an elite squad of maids and butlers.
            
            The story ends soon after, briefly describing the lives of both the main characters. The dragon lived happily as a princess, finding a suitor who she can safely reveal her secret to some years later. The princess lives a tougher life as a dragon, but even she finds love with several of the dragon's kobold minions!
            |a story about an adventuring party exploring a cave and finding loads of treasure, only to run afoul of a terrible schlorbo who stole the treasure in the first place. No solid description is given of the schlorbo, but it's described over multiple parts of the story as terrible, awful, no-good, wicked, smelly, rambunctious, and 'dainty.' The sun-kissed centaur then launches into an action heavy depiction of their battle with lots of arm movements.
            
            [aster.name] hangs on every word as the fight is described in simple terms, and startles when Ahmri punches a fist into her palm to illustrate it hitting the floor or someone being thrown against a wall. In the end, though, the whole party makes it out alive. The schlorbo is tied up using its own arms, and left to contemplate its wicked schemes while it works at unwrangling itself. The group take the riches, returning most of them to the nearby towns they had been stolen from and keeping what can't be accounted for.
            
            This story is very short, but [aster.name] still claps and cheers. Ahmri ruffles his hair as she reads through the last bit, explaining how the schlorbo realized the error of his ways and went on to become a venerable tax collector for a nearby kingdom. The party went on to have many more adventures, though none are directly described in the story, and each member survived to retire.
            |a story about a squirrel knight. The story takes place on a mighty oak tree, 'taller than a decently sized hill.' He has a shield made out of the top of a particularly large acorn, and uses a sewing needle he found as a sword. In a lengthy but adorable monologue, he describes how he'll protect the world from 'threats', and keep the peace between the denizens of the tree. [aster.name] giggles as she describes the fluffiness of his tail in excruciating detail.
            
            In practice, this extends to him meeting and chilling out with the various other animals that call the tree home. At its base, a family of skunks keep any ne'er-do-wells from approaching, and always bring extra tasty lizards to share. A little further up, he hangs out with his squirrel wife and kids. When Ahmri describes them running around him in quick circles, [aster.name] stamps a hoof and then steps down to kick up with his hind legs and run a brief lap around the room. You laugh, and his mom waits for him to return before continuing the story.
            
            As he climbs all the way to the upper limbs of the tree, he interacts with various birds who all have nests in different parts of the tree. All kinds share sticks and twigs for his own hidey hole, and he makes it all the way to the top of the tree where an eagle is nested. The eagle's eggs are as big as his torso, and the two of them chat about finding shiny things left by wyld elves, humans and other races that wander through the forest. 
            
            Nothing overtly exciting happens in this story, but [aster.name] is still rapt by the talking animals and the general serenity of it all. It ends with him snuggling up tight with his family and going to bed, just as snow begins to fall outside the hole of their nook.
        ]
        
        When Ahmri finishes her telling, [aster.name] gives her a brief clap and then unceremoniously wanders off to replicate the story with his toys. Your wife stays with you, sidling closer to fill the gap he left.
        
        "It's so adorable! I hope he ends up liking the actual reading as much as he likes hearing the stories. He's always trying to tell me about the kinds of stories he hears when Nova's teaching. Some of it I can understand just cause it's stuff I remember, but when he tries to talk really fast it's all just gibberish and I have to stop myself from giggling."
        
        "[pc.isDK
            |Ha! I'm glad he's so passionate about it,
            |I don't know if I'd be able to stop myself,
        ]" you say with a laugh.
        
        "[pc.isDK
            |Me too,
            |I don't think he'd mind,
        ]"
        
        The two of you sit and watch him for a while, and then get up to resume your business."

rows.original: Read a book with [aster.name] and Ahmri.
rows.translation: 与某人一起阅读一本书 [aster.name] 还有阿姆里。

rows.original: [aster.name] would probably love to hang out with some of your companions, but who will you bring him to see?
rows.translation: [aster.name] 我应该会很乐意和你的一些朋友一起出去玩，但你应该带他去见谁呢？
rows.raw: "\n    [aster.name] would probably love to hang out with some of your companions, but who will you bring him to see?"

rows.original:
You scoop a contented [aster.name] up and take him out in search of Agnimitra. It doesn't take you long to find her near the outskirts of the village, sitting under a tree and tuning her gittern. She doesn't notice you at first, engrossed in taking care of her instrument and enjoying the time spent relaxing. After each adjustment, she hums a tune to herself and tests it against the music she can make with her fingers, steadily going closer to the sound she's looking for. The effort pauses when she takes notice of you, and she clears her throat.
        
        "Oh? [var0
            |Do I have an audience? Who is this handsome gentleman come to see me play? A prince, perhaps?
            |Is my favorite little audience member back? Are you going to start in the front when I play this time?
        ]" she asks with a smirk, readying her instrument.
        
        [aster.name] [var0
            |blushes
            |shakes his head
        ], burying his face in your shoulder and smiling. When you set him down, he canters behind you and looks sheepishly out in Agni's direction. To his credit, he doesn't run away. Instead, he watches from behind you, peeking out to see what she's doing and hiding again when her gaze strays toward the two of you.
        
        Unperturbed, she finishes deciding on a song, and begins to play. It's a different tune than the one she'd been humming earlier, but it has a similar relaxing melody. Lilting and rolling through your ears like a summer breeze, the song relieves you of stresses you didn't know you were harboring. It's wordless, but you feel like words would only distract from the effect. As she plays, she's still glancing in your direction when she can afford to, raising her eyebrow.
        
        Spellbound by the music, [aster.name] forgets to continue hiding. He holds your leg, standing and watching with his eyes wide and his free hand near his chin. Till the music ends, he takes little steps that bring him closer and closer. By the time the song ends, he's maybe five feet from Agni, completely enraptured. When she concludes her music, he seems to realize how close he is, but doesn't turn away.
        
        "Pretty!" he says, clapping with childish enthusiasm and then jumping with an excited kick of his hind legs.
        
        "I'm glad you think so! I always love bringing out a child's enthusiasm! I could get used to that kind of attention from all my listeners. What about you, little guy? Do you like attention?" she says, raising an eyebrow.
        
        You aren't sure [aster.name] fully understands what she's asking, but he nods emphatically. In response, Agni gives his head a pat and a hair ruffle. To you, she gives a happy grin.
        
        "How do you make such adorable kids? [agni.hasKids
            |Ours, Ahmri's, it doesn't matter. I just wanna hug them all!
            |I just... nevermind, I just wanna hug them all!
        ]" she says, laughing as [aster.name] gets his fill of attention and runs back to you with a squealing giggle.
        
        "Good luck, I guess? Thanks Agni. I'm glad he likes music, and I'm glad I have you around to make such wonderful examples,"
        
        "Aww, stop, you'll make me start a fire if I flare up proudly!" she says, looking proud anyway.
        
        "Would you? At least a little bit, I mean, for his benefit?" you ask with a smirk.
        
        "Show off? Me? How could I not, for the little guy," she laughs, brushing her hands over her feathers till they flare and spark with tiny flames.
        
        At your side, [aster.name] gasps, and his little fist squeezes your leg. You look down, seeing the sheer awe on his face as he watches the dancing flames. He looks up at you, and then back at Agni, a little overwhelmed by the sudden amazing sight.
        
        "Wao..." he says, hugging you tight as he continues to watch.
        
        After the display is over, you scoop him up, and give Agni a nod.
        
        "Thanks for showing off. There's a little more I want to do while I'm here, but I'll see you soon," you say.
        
        "Take all the time you need. More time for me to practice!," Agni says, settling down to resume tuning her instrument.
        
        [aster.name] hums as you carry him back home, tapping gently on your head like a drum.
rows.translation:
你看起来非常满足。 [aster.name] 起身去找他，一起前往寻找阿格尼米特拉。不久之后，你就会在村庄的边缘找到她——她正坐在一棵树下，仔细地调校着她的吉特琴。起初她并没有注意到你的存在，因为她完全沉浸在修理乐器、享受这段宁静时光之中。 每次进行调整后，她都会自言自语地哼着曲调，然后用自己的手指尝试模仿那种声音，逐渐接近她想要的效果。当她注意到你的存在时，她的动作就会暂停，然后她会清了清嗓子。
        
        哦？ [var0
            |有人在看我表演吗？这位英俊的绅士是来观看我表演的吗？或许是一位王子吧？
            |我最喜欢的小观众回来啦吗？这次我表演的时候，你会站在前面吗？
        ]她带着一丝笑意问道，同时准备好了她的乐器。
        
        [aster.name] [var0
            |脸红了
            |摇了摇头
        ]他把脸埋在你的肩膀上，脸上带着笑容。当你把他放下来的时候，他会跟在你身后蹦蹦跳跳地走，然后害羞地朝阿格尼的方向张望。值得称赞的是，他并没有逃跑，而是站在你身后，偷偷观察她在做什么；而每当她的目光转向你们俩时，他就会立刻躲起来。
        
        她毫不慌张，选好了一首歌，然后开始演奏。这首曲子和她之前哼唱的那首不同，但旋律同样令人放松。这首轻柔动听的歌曲如同夏日的微风，缓缓流淌在你的耳边，帮助你缓解那些你甚至都没有意识到的压力。 这种美妙的感觉无法用言语来表达，但你也会觉得，任何言语反而会破坏这种氛围。当她演奏时，只要有机会，她还是会朝你的方向瞥一眼，然后微微挑起眉毛。

完全被这美妙的音乐所吸引…… [aster.name] 他忘记了继续躲藏。他握着你的腿，站在那里，睁大眼睛看着你，另一只空闲的手则放在下巴附近。直到音乐结束，他才会一小步一小步地靠近你。等到歌曲完全结束时，他可能已经距离Agni只有五英尺远了，完全被你迷住了。 当她停止演奏时，他似乎意识到了自己与她的距离有多近，但却没有转身离开。

“真美！”他兴奋地拍手叫道，然后用后腿猛地一跳，显得非常开心。
        
        我很高兴你这么认为！我一直都很喜欢激发孩子们的热情呢！我已经习惯了所有听众对我的关注。那你呢，小家伙？你喜欢被人关注吗？”她一边说，一边挑了挑眉毛。
        
        你不太确定。 [aster.name] 他完全明白她在问什么，但还是用力地点了点头。作为回应，阿格尼轻拍了他的头，还弄乱了他的头发。然后，她对着你露出了开心的笑容。

“你们是怎么养出这么可爱的孩子的呢？ [agni.hasKids
            |我们的，啊姆里的，这些都无所谓。我只想把他们全部拥入怀中！
            |我只是……算了，我其实就是想把他们全都抱在怀里！
        ]她笑着说， [aster.name] 它得到了足够的关注，然后发出吱吱的笑声跑回到你身边。

“祝你好运吧？谢谢Agni。我很高兴他喜欢音乐，也很高兴有你这样的榜样在身边。
        
        哎呀，别这样，你这样让我太骄傲了，我可能会真的生气的！”她说，不过语气里还是带着一丝骄傲。

“真的会吗？至少会有点吧，为了他的好，对吧？”你带着一丝笑意问道。

“炫耀吗？ 我吗？对于那个小家伙，我怎么可能不这么做呢？”她笑着，用手轻轻抚过自己的羽毛，那些羽毛立刻闪烁起微小的火焰来。

在你的身边， [aster.name] 他倒吸着凉气，小拳头紧紧攥着你的腿。你低头望去，看到他脸上充满着敬畏之情，正注视着那些跳跃的火焰。他又抬头看着你，然后又把目光转向阿格尼，显然，这突如其来的壮观景象让他有些不知所措。
        
        哇……”他边说边紧紧地抱住你，继续注视着屏幕。

展示结束后，你把他抱起来，然后向Agni点了点头。

“谢谢你的表演。我在这里还有些事情要做，不过很快就会再见到你。”你说。
        
        你可以花尽可能多的时间。这样我就有更多时间来练习了！”阿格尼说道，然后便坐下来继续调整她的乐器。
        
        [aster.name] 当你把他抱回家时，他的头部会轻轻地震动，就像鼓面在敲击一样。

        "Good luck, I guess? Thanks Agni. I'm glad he likes music, and I'm glad I have you around to make such wonderful examples,"
        
        "Aww, stop, you'll make me start a fire if I flare up proudly!" she says, looking proud anyway.
        
        "Would you? At least a little bit, I mean, for his benefit?" you ask with a smirk.
        
        "Show off? Me? How could I not, for the little guy," she laughs, brushing her hands over her feathers till they flare and spark with tiny flames.
        
        At your side, [aster.name] gasps, and his little fist squeezes your leg. You look down, seeing the sheer awe on his face as he watches the dancing flames. He looks up at you, and then back at Agni, a little overwhelmed by the sudden amazing sight.
        
        "Wao..." he says, hugging you tight as he continues to watch.
        
        After the display is over, you scoop him up, and give Agni a nod.
        
        "Thanks for showing off. There's a little more I want to do while I'm here, but I'll see you soon," you say.
        
        "Take all the time you need. More time for me to practice!," Agni says, settling down to resume tuning her instrument.
        
        [aster.name] hums as you carry him back home, tapping gently on your head like a drum."

rows.translation: 拿去吧。 [aster.name] 去见阿格尼米特拉。
阿格尼米特拉不在这里。

rows.original: You scoop [aster.name] up into your arms and cart him off to find Arona. It doesn't take you long to find her, wandering around the bazaar with a[var0 | |nother ] large armful of melons. She spots you and gives you a wolfish grin, and then notices your own armful. "[pc.name]! Glad I caught you, you can watch me smash these melons! [var0 |That food guy said these ones were rotten, and something about using the smashed bits as compost. I dunno about that, but it sounds like fun and he said this kinda thing happens often, so I'm all for it. Bring the tyke, too, he can watch as well!" she says, indicating a patch of flatter dirt nearby. |Hey to you too, [aster.name]! Been practicing your kicks?" she asks, and you feel [aster.name]'s hind-legs squirm as he nods ferociously. ] Arona carts her arm-load of Melons to the spot, and unsurreptitiously dumps them into a loose jumble. She scootches one with her foot so it sits apart from the others, and then pulls out her hammer. [aster.name], who had been watching with [var0 |abject curiosity |rapt attention ], squirms to get down as she readies herself. When you oblige, he runs in a semicircle around and past you to get a better look at what's going on. "Watch close, little colt. This is the best part," Arona says with a grin, hefting her hammer above her head. With one smooth motion, she brings it up higher and then brings it down with a succinct smack. The melon she set aside is turned to nothing more than rind and paste, splattering far enough to get a few splashes on your excited foal's coat. He doesn't seem to mind, though, jumping with his forelegs and smiling as he claps his hands together. "Smash! Sploosh!" he says, punching one of his little hands into the palm of the other and beaming up at Arona. "You think? You want more?" the orcess asks, getting swift nods in response. "Well then, I can't exactly say no to that, can I?" She scoots another melon over with her foot, and gives it the same treatment. This continues until there's one melon left, the biggest of the lot, and Arona is glistening with a thin sheen of sweat. Looking between the melon and your son, she gets an even bigger grin. "Hey, little man, wanna help with this one? [var0 |Show me what those hooves can do? |Show me how you've been practicing? ]" she asks, and [aster.name] immediately rushes over to help. He's so fast he almost trips over his own legs, and Arona guffaws as she helps him line up. He starts off by turning around, puffing up his chest, and giving his fruity target a jumping kick with his hind legs. It doesn't break on the first go, but he leaves a nice mark on the outside. From there, he kicks and stamps on it with his front legs. Eventually, the thing gives way with a soft crunch, and [aster.name] cheers as he continues stamping it into a fine slurry. "Good job, little guy, good job!" Arona laughs, clapping loudly and giving him a pat on the head. The young foal beams proudly, continuing on to smash the leftover rinds she'd left on the ground. You wait until it looks like he's getting tired, content to watch him have fun. When he can no longer muster the strength to smash the melon rinds, you pick him up and prepare to bring him back home. He makes a quiet noise of protest at first, but then seems to realize how tired he is when he leans against your shoulder. Arona gives you a wave. "I guess I'll bring as much of this mush as I can back. Good luck with the kiddo," she says. "Thanks, Arona. I've got a couple more things I want to take care of, but I'll come get you when I'm done," you reply, giving her a nod before heading back to the chieftains hut.
rows.translation: 你真厉害。 [aster.name] 把他抱起来，带他去寻找阿罗娜。你很快就能找到她，她正在集市里闲逛呢。[var0 | |另一个 ] 一大抱西瓜。她看到了你，露出一个狡黠的笑容，然后才注意到你自己也抱着一大抱西瓜。[pc.name]太好了，我终于抓到你了，你可以看我把这些“西瓜”砸得粉碎！ [var0 |那个卖食物的家伙说这些食物已经腐烂了，还建议把那些烂掉的部分用来制作堆肥。我也不太确定这种做法是否可行，但听起来还挺有趣的。他说这种事情经常发生，所以我也完全支持这个主意。把那个小孩也带上吧，让他也能一起看吧！”她说着，同时指向附近一块较为平坦的地面。 |你也好啊。 [aster.name]一直在练习你的踢技吗？”她问道，而你顿时感受到了…… [aster.name]它的后腿不停地扭动，同时它凶狠地点了点头。 ] 阿罗娜把那一大堆甜瓜搬到了那个地方，然后悄悄地把它们乱七八糟地堆放在那里。她用脚把其中一个甜瓜拨到一边，让它和其他甜瓜分开，接着拿出了她的锤子。 [aster.name]那些一直在观看的人 [var0 |强烈的好奇心 |全神贯注 ]她蠕动着身体准备下来，而当你照她说的做时，它便绕着半圈从你身边跑过，想更清楚地看看发生了什么。 “仔细看啊，小马驹。这才是最精彩的部分呢，”阿罗娜笑着说，将锤子举过头顶。 她动作流畅地先将锤子举得更高，然后猛地向下挥去——动作简洁而有力。 打耳光她之前留出来的那些瓜，现在只剩下瓜皮和瓜泥了，那些汁液溅得到处都是，甚至有几滴溅到了你那兴奋的小马驹的毛上。不过，它似乎并不在意，它用前腿跳跃着，还开心地拍着手。 砰！扑通！”他一边说，一边用一只小手拍打另一只小手的掌心，然后开心地望着阿罗娜。 “你这么觉得？你还想要更多吗？”女妖问道，得到了许多肯定的回答。“那么，我当然不能拒绝这个请求，对吧？她用脚把另一个甜瓜挪到旁边，然后对它做了同样的事情。这样的动作一直持续到只剩下一个甜瓜——那是所有甜瓜中最大的一个——而阿罗娜的脸上也蒙上了一层细薄的汗珠。当她的目光在那个甜瓜和你的儿子之间来回移动时，她的笑容变得更加灿烂了。 嘿，小家伙，想帮忙吗？ [var0 |让我看看那些蹄子到底有什么本事吧？ |让我看看你都是怎么练习的吧？ ]她问道， [aster.name] 他立刻冲过去帮忙。 他的动作快得几乎连自己的腿都撞到了，而阿罗娜看到这一幕，忍不住哈哈大笑，一边帮他调整姿势。他首先转过身来，挺起胸膛，然后用后腿朝那个水果状的靶子踢去。虽然第一次没有踢破，但还是在靶子的外表面留下了一道明显的痕迹。接着，他又用前腿继续踢打那个靶子，最终，那个东西在发出轻脆的声响后终于被踢破了。 [aster.name] 他一边高兴地继续把那些东西捣成细糊状，一边欢呼着。 “干得好，小家伙，真棒！”阿罗娜笑着，大声鼓掌，还轻拍了他的头。 那匹小马驹骄傲地笑着，继续把地上剩下的果皮捣得粉碎。 你就等着，直到他看起来开始疲惫，你也就心满意足了，只想看着他玩得开心。等他再也没力气去砸那些瓜皮时，你就把他抱起来，准备带他回家。一开始，他会发出轻微的抗议声，但当他靠在你的肩膀上时，似乎才意识到自己有多累。 阿罗娜向你挥了挥手。 “我想我会尽量把这么多东西都带回去。祝你们照顾好孩子，”她说。 “谢谢，阿罗娜。我还有几件事需要处理，处理完就会来接你，”你回答道，向她点了点头，然后便回到了酋长们的小屋。
