rows.original:
"I was thinking I could have a nice relaxing time and talk about the latest things we've done! What better way to know how things are progressing than to hear about them in person?" you ask.

    Both women nod, joining you in sitting and kneeling on the cushions and furs and getting nice and comfortable. You start first, giving the girls the details you know they want to hear about your adventures in the Marches. Ahmri gasps whenever you bring up something particularly exciting or lewd, and Atani's ears flit about in equal measure. Both are enraptured in the tale, and when you have them fully caught up they seem disappointed to not have more.
    
    Ahmri talks about the latest books she's been reading and about the centaur village's continued recovery efforts. She also explains her visit to the last trader who passed through in precise detail, explaining her thought process and why she bought each item she got. You and Atani hang on every word, if only because her tale is spoken with similar enthusiasm to yours. You're happy, at least, that she's not bored at home.
    
    Atani starts with some questions about Ahmri's reading, but transitions swiftly into the goings on of the marefolk village. She spends a little time talking about how her scouts have been successfully working with the centaurs to stymie the efforts of the cultists. More than that, though, she talks about her time spent reading with the village children. Between that and other duties that have her helping out, she sounds positively content. Sharing them with you is the highlight, of course, but the doing is just as fun.
    
    Both girls ambush you with a double-ended hug when storytime winds to a close. Atani nibbles your ear and gives you a kiss on one cheek, while Ahmri rubs her nose on your other cheek before also following it up with a smooch. 
    
    "Thanks for making this possible, [pc.name]," they both say.
    
    You relax a little longer in their arms before it's time for you and Ahmri to leave. Pushing yourself up, you help both women to their feet and give Atani a final goodbye kiss. After you pull away, Ahmri jumps in to give her a big squeeze. 
    
    "We'll see you next time!" the sun-kissed centauress promises as you're leaving.
    
    "I'll be waiting. This was fun!" Atani says, following you out and waiting by her guards as she waves goodbye. You and Ahmri wave back as you continue on toward the waystone.

    阿姆里聊起了她最近读过的那些书，也讲述了半人马村庄为恢复家园而付出的持续努力。她还详细地描述了自己去拜访最后一位经过那里的商人的经过，解释了自己当时的思考过程，以及为什么会购买那些物品。你和阿塔尼听得津津有味，至少是因为她讲述这些事情时的热情和你们的热情是一样的。至少，你很高兴她在家并没有感到无聊。
    
    阿塔尼首先问了一些关于艾姆里阅读情况的问题，但很快便转而讨论了马人村庄里发生的事情。她还花了一些时间讲述她的侦察队员们是如何与半人马们密切合作，共同阻止那些邪教徒的活动的。 更重要的是，她还会讲述自己与村里的孩子们一起读书的时光。除了这些，她还承担着其他各种帮助他人的任务，但听起来她非常满足。当然，与你们分享这些经历才是最令她开心的部分，而实际参与这些活动本身也同样充满乐趣。
    
    当故事时间即将结束时，两个女孩会突然从两边抱住你。阿塔尼会轻咬你的耳朵，然后在你的脸颊上亲一下；而艾姆丽则会用她的鼻子蹭你的另一侧脸颊，之后也会亲你一下。

“谢谢你让这一切成为可能。 [pc.name]他们俩都是这么说的。”

你在她们的怀抱中再放松了一会儿，然后就到了你和阿姆里该离开的时候了。你站起身来，帮助这两位女士也站了起来，然后给了阿塔尼一个最后的吻别。当你离开后，阿姆里立刻跑过来，紧紧地抱住了她。 
    
    下次见吧！”当你离开时，那位被阳光照耀着的半人马少女如此说道。

“我会等待的。这次真的很有趣！”阿塔尼跟在你身后走出门外，在她的护卫们旁边挥手道别。你和艾姆里也回过头来，继续朝着路标所在的方向前进。

"Is it [var0|that brand new three story karaoke place I saw while we were walking into town!?|'Dance Dance Sing Sing Septuple Gods Heaven' presented by DJ Kohakougar!?]" Ahmri asks, doing an excited backflip. "It's totally [var0|that brand new three story karaoke place you saw while you were walking into town!|'Dance Dance Sing Sing Septuple Gods Heaven' presented by DJ Kohakougar!]" Atani replies, doing an even higher and even more exciting jump. [var0|You had also taken note of the garishly out of place modern building in the middle of the otherwise quaint fantasy village, but had been too afraid to point it out until someone else confirmed its existence.|Ah yes, that wonderful place concocted by none other than DJ Kohakougar herself. At first you were like 'nah, there's no way a modern karaoke bar with all the fixin's and comfortable gorilla grip microphones could fit into a fantasy setting, that's preposterous'.] Now, though, you're as excited as ever to sing and dance with your proud pair of perfectly pretty pony princess partners. The three of you rush excitedly out of the chieftain's tent, pointing excitedly at the venue and linking hands as you bounce with anticipation. "Are you guy's going to 'Dance Dance Sing Sing Septuple Gods Heaven' presented by DJ Kohakougar?" Wredi asks. "It's all the rage these days. Don't have TOO much fun. Complimentary drinks doesn't mean drink until you pass out," Edessari adds. "Don't worry, guys. We won't do anything too crazy," Atani promises before immediately turning to you with a wink. Then, the three of you run off in a giggling rush before the bodyguards have a chance to respond. Soon, you reach the door to the fine singing establishment. A large rainbow neon sign above the door proclaims it to be 'Dance Dance Sing Sing Septuple Gods Heaven presented by DJ Kohakougar.' Along with the name, there's a digital display sign depicting a pixelated fox with 4 tails who periodically shifts into a bipedal form that does a short but very hip and happening dance before transforming back. Nondescript and non-important staff members greet you in the foyer, and escort you to a private room that will of course be charged to your credit. The room is luxurious, with supple black leather seats and state-of-the-art mics and song choice software. You aren't sure why, but there's even one of those spinny brush things that cows really like! This is the kind of place people talk about in the news. If it weren't for the fact that you know exactly why you haven't heard about this place, you would wonder why you hadn't heard about this place. As it is, you're content to feast your eyes on this marvelous home-away-from-home style entertainment venue. You and Atani plop down on the couch, and Ahmri sits on an ergonomically designed Taurseat™ that snuggly hugs her equine form. Leaning forward, you grab the control remote and begin flipping through the songs. They have SO MANY OPTIONS™, as advertised above the selector screen. It's honestly a little intimidating. Who could ever sing this many songs? How is it possible for this sheer number of songs to exist? How does your sun-kissed taur-wife maintain such a high level of fluffability? "Oh! Oh! Pick that one!" Atani says, shaking your shoulder and pointing to a specific song on the list. You hover over it for a second till the preview starts playing, and are immediately treated to some swiftly spoken and unintelligible lyrics followed by the word 'table.' Despite it's indecipherable nature, the song is very catchy, and you click it without hesitation. "I've never tried this one!" Ahmri says, gripping her mic with determination. The song begins, and you're immediately swept up in the rapid pace of the music. You must miss all but a fifth of the lyrics, but neither of the girls seem to mind. They're happily giggling on either side of you as they replace the end of every sentence with 'table'. "Whydja something something on a table! Humma numma shumma numma table!" Atani shouts, collapsing sideways onto your shoulder with a laugh. You join in with them, laughing aloud with every successive table. By the end you've devolved into replacing every word. "Table table table table table? Table table table table table!" you conclude as the song fades to black. Ahmri takes the remote, and her and Atani switch straight into a catchy, upbeat number that's very uplifting. The lyrics seem to talk about them 'being' fireworks, and there's lots of 'ah, ah, ah!' They're both up and dancing for this one, bouncing and holding hands around the same mic. You're too busy watching them bounce and smile to pay too close of attention to the lyrics, but you know one thing for sure. Your wives are even brighter than the moon moon moon. The girls pull you up for the next song, a bouncy beat about... big butts!? They join in, shaking their butts playfully as you all sing along.|both of your beautiful brides give you a smack on the ass. You laugh, joining them with spanks of your own as you all sing along.] When that song finishes, you've grown quite parched, so you order some drinks. Ahmri orders a mimosa, and Atani orders a hard cider, while you order whatever kind of drink you'd order, I can't read your mind. Zombie? Sazerac? Virgin shirley temple? Milk? Soda? They've got everything here, even water. You can go pour your own drink and then come back and drink along. Ahmri and Atani wait for you to return with the drinks, and then begin happily sipping. Each of your wives takes a seat beside you and flanks you with pressing shoulders. You sip your alcomohols and relax while recovering your stamina. For your last few minutes, you put on some Ayangatai throat singing and attempt to match the guttural noises with varying levels of success. Trying to go sound for sound with them is a lost cause, but it's fun to just mimic the noises while the professionals are singing in the background. You all sing and laugh till your voices are hoarse again, and then you and your horse-wives continue to hum tunes all the way out and along the whole walk back to the chieftain's tent. "Thanks, guys. This was a lot of fun. I'll take any excuse to visit 'Dance Dance Sing Sing Septuple Gods Heaven' presented by DJ Kohakougar," Atani says once you're safely through the entryway. "At least, as long as you're feeling silly." She turns to wink at the camera, and a laugh track plays. Ahmri gives her a final big hug, and the two of you leave. Atani comes out to stand by her guards and wave while you're walking, and you both wave back as you walk toward the waystone.
